The half marathon will include a section of out and back on a chip sealed county road returning to loop back onto the last half of the 10K route. The race meanders through open grasslands and wooded areas with stunning views of the surrounding valley.
This is NOT a fast and flat course! It includes rolling hills with elevation gain on the way out and high speed returns on mile 6-8 of the half and the last two miles of both the 10K and half marathon. 

What to Expect: Finisher medal, food truck, local craft beers (one free beer per runner for those 21 years of age or older or root beer), music, and food tent for runners, results ceremonies and lots of cheering!

Everyone knows that half the reason you run these crazy races is for the shirt, swag and finisher’s medal and the Falla Walla event will not disappoint. Every finisher receives a finisher medal.  YOU WILL NEED TO REGISTER  BEFORE SEPTEMBER 19 TO RECEIVE THE FREE SHIRT. T-SHIRT AVAILABILITY AND SIZE NOT GUARANTEED AFTER SEPTEMBER 19 REGISTRATION.

_______

5K Heroes Run

Welcome to the 2nd Annual Heroes Run. This run is a memorial for three Walla Walla health care professionals who have passed away. This 5K run is to honor these three remarkable people. 

Runners and walkers alike will be treated to the beautiful Millcreek nature pathway. This route will have a combination of asphalt and gravel road surfaces. The 5k will take place in conjunction with the Falla Walla 10K and half marathon. 

What to expect: There will be awards for the top 3 female and top 3 male finishers. All participants who registrar before September 12st will receive a free t-shirt. The first 140 participants 13 and up who registrar will also receive a commemorative glass. All kids 12 and under will be given a water bottle. At the finish line there will be a beer garden where anyone 21 and older can redeem their first beer on the house. A strawberry short cake social will again be provided by EastgateSDA.

What this run is really about:

• Melissa Harting was a registered nurse at Providence Saint Mary Medical Center in the Emergency Department. She began her long-time career at Providence St. Mary Medical Center starting out as a Certified Nursing Assistant and later moved into an Emergency Tech role. In 2018 she was accepted into Walla Walla Community Colleges Nursing Program where she graduated and obtained her Registered Nurse licensure in 2020.On October 4th, 2023, Melissa passed away at the age of 44. She was a dedicated mother, friend and healthcare provider in all of her roles. 
• Robert Becker was the 2nd year lead instructor for the Walla Walla Community College Nursing Program and had been teaching nursing students for over 34 years when he retired in June 2023. Many of the nurses in the Walla Walla Valley and beyond have had Rob as an instructor. His love for teaching and inspiring students went above and beyond. Rob passed away November 8th, 2023, at the age of 68. He was a devoted professor, mentor, and friend to many and a loving husband to Patti. 
• Ryan Pleasants, 41, of Walla Walla, WA, passed away on January 7, 2024, while on duty for the City of Walla Walla Fire Department. Ryan dedicated his life to serving his community, starting in the Cowlitz County - North County area as a mountain rescue EMT for 2 years. This was followed by a 19-year career as a firefighter/paramedic with the City of Walla Walla Fire Department, culminating in his promotion to Firefighter Engineer for his 20th year with the department. He continually showcased his commitment and passion for the community he served, his family, and his fellow fire brothers and sisters. 
 The proceeds from this 2nd annual Heroes run will benefit those in our community in bettering their lives. Melissa Harting and Rob Becker’s portions will go to their individual memorial funds at the Walla Walla Community College Foundation to help nursing student financially as they complete their nursing degrees. In honor of Ryan’s legacy, Ryan’s portion of the funds will go towards ascholarship to help current and future EMS providers advance their careers and improve the quality of care they will provide. This scholarship will be housed and managed by your local United Way of the Blue Mountains.

Thank you for giving and for honoring these three Heroes of our community. 

No Refunds and No Deferrals 

Must be present to receive free t-shirt and commemorative glass

name: Fool's Run 5k
description: The Fools Run 5K is an evening run through the scenic streets of Gig Harbor, WA. Set against the backdrop of the harbor at twilight, the event is designed to be playful, fun, and family-friendly, embracing a whimsical and lighthearted theme inspired by the spirit of April Fools.

name: FORGE
description:
ATTENTION: must sign up by 11:30pm  Thurs 5/29 to ensure Sweatshirt available for race day.

 

FORGE Backyard Ultra

  • Run a 4.167-mile loop every hour on the hour for 12 hours
  • Complete all 12 loops and you'll have run 50 miles
  • Miss the start or don’t finish in time? Your FORGE is over.

Everyone is celebrated but we will have winners: Male and Female 1. fastest total time & 2. final loop winner

Space is limited. Secure your spot today.

Date: June 7, 2025

Location: Trails and dirt roads south of Swinomish Casino, Skagit County, WA

Start Time: 7:00 AM

All Runners will receive:

  • FORGE running hat
  • FORGE hoodie
  • FORGEd custom medal(finisher prize)
  • Day of race food and snacks, Tailwind Nutrition Endurance Fuel.
  • Post FORGE celebration dinner
FORGE is a race built around a unique and growing format known as the "backyard ultra." Unlike traditional races where runners aim for a set distance or time, backyard ultras follow a simple but demanding structure: runners complete a 4.167-mile loop every hour, on the hour. Whatever time remains after finishing a lap becomes their rest period before starting again at the top of the next hour. This continues until the event reaches its predetermined duration—in FORGE’s case, 12 hours.
The format is gaining popularity worldwide because it removes the pressure of speed and replaces it with a test of endurance, pacing, and mental toughness. Fast runners and steady runners line up together every hour. Everyone starts at the same time, and the race unfolds differently for each participant. Some will aim for a personal-best distance, while others will push to complete all 12 laps.
One of the most unique aspects of this style of racing is the community it creates. The time between laps—when runners gather, recover, and prepare for the next start—becomes a shared experience. Conversations happen. Encouragement is exchanged. Whether you’re completing your first backyard-style event or chasing a new personal milestone, you’re not doing it alone.

 

At its core, FORGE is about stepping into a challenge and discovering what you’re capable of. There’s no finish line waiting for you at a set distance—just another lap, another opportunity to push forward. It’s an event designed to be hard, but also to be welcoming, rewarding, and deeply memorable.

name: Fowl Fun Run 5K & 10K
description:
Join us for the 47th Annual Fowl Fun Run!

Run the Valley with Skagit Runners

We offer two distances: a 5K run/walk and a 10K run. Both courses are run on flat, low-traffic farm roads in the Skagit Valley.

Stay for food, refreshments and for the opportunity to win a pumpkin pie!
 
Free Kids' Half-Mile Run
The half-mile kids' run for those 8 years and under starts promptly at 9:15 a.m. This fun run is free, but children must be registered in person by 9:00 a.m.

Race day schedule
8 am - 8:25 am: Volunteers set up


8:25 am - 9:30 am: Day of race registration


8:25 am - 9:30 am: Check in for pre-registered participants


9:15 am: 1/2 mile kids' run start


10 am: 5K & 10K start


10:05 am: Turkey begins the 10K


Noon: Both courses close


Packet Pick-Up: 1-5pm Friday, November 14th at Skagit Running Company (724 S 1st St, Mount Vernon, WA 98273)

 

Day of Race Registration: Please arrive early if you plan to register on the morning of the race.


Day of Race Packet Pick-up: Pre-registered participants may pick up their bib numbers starting at 8:25 a.m. on race morning.


Food and Refreshments: Traditional pumpkin pie available as a post-race treat!


Awards: Every participant will receive a finishers medal. Special awards will be given to the top 3 male and female finishers.


Beat the Turkey! Tom Turkey will be starting the 10K five minutes after the gun. Finish the 10K ahead of him and receive a special award at the finish line!

name: Frosty Moss Relay
description:
Welcome to the Green Season on the Olympic Peninsula of Washington State
Towering evergreens. Endless moss and ferns. Miles of waterfront. Snowcapped mountains. Need a cure for gray-season blues? Frosty Moss has you covered.

Pavement + Trail Runners Unite
From the Sol Duc River to Sequim Bay, the 80-mile Frosty Moss course follows the paved Olympic Discovery Trail and the singletrack Adventure Route. The 30-mile Mini Moss course begins at Ediz Hook in Port Angeles and end at Sequim Bay.

Celebrate After the Race
As if your day wasn’t epic enough, 7 Cedars Resort is ready to help you celebrate. They will host hot food, cold drinks, awards and fun after the race.

FROSTY MOSS RELAY
80 Miles – 15 Legs – Teams of 2-5
Relay legs are a mix of distances (3-11 mi) on paved or single-track trail ** Check out the Frosty Moss legs here
Wave starts 6-9 am

MINI MOSS RELAY
30 Miles - 8 Legs - Teams of 2-4 
Relay legs are a mix of distances (3-5 mi) on paved trail ** Check out the Mini Moss legs here
Wave starts 1-2 pm

FROSTY MOSS 50k (MINI MOSS SOLO)
Same route and greatness as Mini Moss, but solo! 
Start time 1pm, time cap 8.5 hours (9:30 p.m.)

REGISTRATION. Registration closes March 12, 2026 at 8:00 p.m..  

Frosty Moss: Teams of 2, 3, 4, or 5; $95 per person. Limited to 60 teams. Teams of 2-3 will be grouped for timing / awards. Teams of 4-5 will be grouped together for timing / awards. (price increase to $110 starting February 1)
Mini Moss: Teams of 2, 3, or 4; $75 per person. Limited to 45 teams.  (price increase to $85 starting February 1) 
Mini Moss 50K: $85 (price increase to $90 starting February 1) 

WHAT’S INCLUDED

In addition to an epic outdoor experience in the far northwest corner, all runners receive…

  • Swag bag of Frosty Moss Relay goodies and other surprises.
  • Comprehensive event guide, maps, course marking, and on-course race support.
  • Taco Bar and awards at the after-party at Jamestown S’Klallam Tribe’s 7 Cedars Resort.  No-host bar.
  • Bragging rights for getting after it all day on the Olympic Peninsula in winter!

WHO
You & your best running buddies—any mix of age, gender & ability, as long as your team can average a 12-minute pace or faster. Load up your team van with food, drinks, extra layers, tunes, and a fun competitive spirit. Captains, sign up and create your team, then start inviting your team members to sign up!

THE FROSTY MOSS EXPERIENCE

Frosty Mossers trace the Olympic Discovery Trail (paved multiuse path) & Adventure Route (singletrack trail) from west to east, beginning at the Camp Creek Trailhead along the Sol Duc River and finishing in Blyn at Sequim Bay. Mini Mossers follow the Olympic Discovery Trail from Ediz Hook in Port Angeles to Blyn at Sequim Bay.

You will be asked to enter the average pace of your team (minutes / mile). Be as accurate as possible. Do NOT pad your time because you are worried about making the cutoffs. If you run faster than your average pace and beat the exchange zone volunteers, you will be held and made to wait. You do not have anything to gain by padding your average pace! If your team members change over time and you need to adjust your average team pace, you can do so. 

You are welcome to use our FROSTY MOSS AVERAGE TEAM PACE CALCULATOR or MINI MOSS AVERAGE TEAM PACE CALCULATOR to help you. Please read the instructions on it first.

The team captain and 50K solo runners must attend the check-in/orientation at 7 Cedars Resort on Friday evening, March 14th. Your team can come with you, but only the team captain is required. Captains bring your Team Roster and your required night running gear.

Make sure to book your room(s) at 7 Cedars Resort - you can walk to your room right from the after party! They are offering a special rate of $169 King or Double Queen for us. To book, call the reservation agents at (360) 683-7777 Extension 1 and use the booking code FROSTY. Click here to book online. 

See the full website at: Frosty Moss Relay

To sign up - TEAM CAPTAINS -

  1. Sign up and Create your Group (Team Name)
  2. Choose your estimated average team pace (be as accurate as possible - if you register "conservative" and you end up running faster than your estimate, you will cause the race major issues in that volunteers may not be at exchanges yet. If this happens, you will not be allowed to exchange and you will have to wait for the volunteers to arrive before you can exchange and continue along the course. 
  3. SET UP A PASSWORD for your team, to prevent the general public from signing up onto your team.
  4. Let your team members know the Group/Team Name to sign up under as well as the Average Team Pace that you have chosen (they must choose the same) *you can change team members until a day and a half before the race.
  5. Plan your team theme - do it up! Costumes, care decorations, anything and everything! There will be prizes for the best Team Theme! 
  6. Follow us on social media to get race updates, including fun things like our hashtag contest with big prizes!

Refund Policy: There are no refunds for participant-initiated cancellations and no deferrals to next year. Transfers to another athlete are allowed. To transfer, follow these instructions. Transfers can be made until three days before the race. During the registration process, you will have the chance to purchase refund insurance (unavailable for Canadian racers - rules of the insurance company and not us or RunSignUp), which will allow a full refund if you are unable to attend the event due to several covered reasons including accident, illness and family emergency. Full insurance info, terms, and conditions HERE.  

If we are forced to cancel the race for any reason, participants will receive a free transfer to the following year, or an 80% refund.

If this happens, you will not be allowed to exchange and you will have to wait for the volunteers to arrive before you can exchange and continue along the course. 
  3. SET UP A PASSWORD for your team, to prevent the general public from signing up onto your team.
  4. Let your team members know the Group/Team Name to sign up under as well as the Average Team Pace that you have chosen (they must choose the same) *you can change team members until a day and a half before the race.
  5. Plan your team theme - do it up! Costumes, care decorations, anything and everything! There will be prizes for the best Team Theme! 
  6. Follow us on social media to get race updates, including fun things like our hashtag contest with big prizes!

Refund Policy: There are no refunds for participant-initiated cancellations and no deferrals to next year. Transfers to another athlete are allowed. To transfer, follow these instructions. Transfers can be made until three days before the race. During the registration process, you will have the chance to purchase refund insurance (unavailable for Canadian racers - rules of the insurance company and not us or RunSignUp), which will allow a full refund if you are unable to attend the event due to several covered reasons including accident, illness and family emergency. Full insurance info, terms, and conditions HERE.  

If we are forced to cancel the race for any reason, participants will receive a free transfer to the following year, or an 80% refund.

name: Girlfriends Run
description:
THE GIRLFRIENDS AND PINK BRIGADE HAVE RAISED OVER $900,000 OVER THE LAST 18 YEARS!
The 19th Annual Girlfriends Run offers a Half Marathon, 10K & 6K designed specifically for women to get together to do something good for themselves and to help support a very important women’s cause.

We started this event to honor and support one of our BFFs, Joleen Skarberg, who was diagnosed with Breast Cancer and continues to run it every year with her daughters, sisters, nieces, cousins and girlfriends! Watch for her – she’ll be wearing #1!

About half the gals run, half walk and many do a combination of running and walking. It doesn’t matter how you get to the finish line, as long as you get there!

name: Give NCW Turkey Trot
description:
Give NCW Turkey Trot is a great way to start your holiday season! The event features timed 5K and 10K races and an untimed, free run for kids. The 5K and 10K races are held on the Apple Capital Loop Trail along the Wenatchee riverfront. The Kids Race is held on a short course near the grounds of Pybus Public Market. Strollers and leashed dogs are permitted.

This family friendly event kicks off the annual Give NCW online giving campaign hosted by the Community Foundation of NCW.  Special thanks to Presenting Sponsor, Wenatchee Valley Medical Group and Gold Sponsors, Cordell Neher & Co. and Cashmere Valley Bank. Thanks to their sponsorship, every dollar from registration fees goes to support Give NCW. This giving campaign starts Thanksgiving Day and runs through Dec. 31 and supports over 75 nonprofit organizations in NCW. Race proceeds will be shared among the nonprofit organizations that participate in the campaign.

The “Best Dressed Individual” will receive a $500 Giving Card that can be redeemed to support nonprofits on Give NCW, and the “Best Dressed Group” will receive a $1,000 Giving Card. 

Planning to bring your dog? Enter your canine companion during the registration process and for an extra $5 donation, your pup will receive a Turkey Trot bandana (if it is among the first 150 to register) and a chance to win a Gift Basket from our friends at Firehouse Pet Shop!  

Location: The two races start and finish on the trail behind Pybus Public Market. The Kids Race is held in the boat launch parking lot behind Pybus Public Market.

Start times: 9:00am kids race; 9:15am 10K; and 9:30am 5K. 

Youth who are 12 years and younger can run untimed for free in the 5K, with a paid adult. Do not register them unless they want to be officially timed and qualify for the commemorative socks.

Packet pickup at Pybus Market: Wednesday, Nov 26th from 2:00pm-8:00pm or Thursday (race day), Nov 27 7:00am-8:45am. There will be NO DAY OF REGISTRATION

Swag: The first 750 paid registrants will receive a pair of commemorative Turkey Trot socks.

Aid stations: There are two aid stations - one at the 5k turnaround and one at the 10k turnaround with water and Gatorade. Porta potties are located at the start/finish, but not along the course. Note that the restrooms inside Pybus Market will not be open.

Course map: See below

Website: https://cfncw.org/turkeytrot

Email: melissa@cfncw.org.

name: Guardian Angel Color Run
description:
Join us for the Guardian Angel Color Run on Saturday, May 17th!

 

Celebrating 11 years, our Guardian Angel Scholarship Program offers a unique opportunity to serve our St. Nicholas community and invest in our students’ futures by creating Saints and Scholars. The program provides tuition assistance to local families who wish to make Catholic education a priority in their lives.

 

The run is open to the public as well as St. Nicholas students, families and parents. Join us for a family friendly 5k run/walk along the Cushman Trail featuring color stations along the course and a color blast at our start line. Each participant will receive a t-shirt designed by a St. Nicholas student, a color packet and lots of fun!

 

Once you've finished the race stick around for music, cupcakes and light refreshments!

name: Halloween Trick or Trot Run 5K/10K/13.1 SEATTLE
description:
🎃 👻 Trick or Trot! 👻 🎃

Run in our annual Halloween Run, where healthy fitness meets frightful fun! We'll even give you some free Halloween candy after your run! Find a friend, set a goal, and join this unique 5K, 10K, or 13.1 Half-Marathon run!

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

name: Heroes Walk 5K & Community Resource Fair
description:
CHECK IN BEGINS AT 9:00 AM 


Empowering Communities and Fortifying Families to End Veteran Suicide and Strengthen our Heroes to Lead their Communities.

HONOR HEROES - FORTIFY FAMILIES - CELEBRATE FREEDOM

Walk in support of veterans to choose LIFE. The enemy did not have victory in war, and will not win in the day to day battle for our veteran’s lives. Together we can end veteran suicide and fortify families after service. Live life abundantly with a community that hears, sees and recognizes the sacrifices of our HEROES. Family and supporters of our veterans are encouraged to join. Let’s gather in a big way to show the love and support of our veterans and the USA. 

The circle of return from military service to civilian life is a personal and community process. Join a community wide celebration and resources fair as we help veterans and families make the journey back home after service. 

Schedule: 

9 AM Registration Opens and Community Resource Fair

10 AM Opening Ceremonies 

11:00 AM Walk Commences on paths through Riverfront Park.
Those walking with kids are welcome to bring scooters, wagons, bikes or strollers to make your time easier with little ones. 

12 PM Victory Celebration at the Finish Line

1 PM Closing Ceremony and Resource Fair Closes


Heroes Walk brings awareness, solutions, and builds a connected community to end veteran suicide and homelessness by providing resources for wrap around care for the whole veteran and their family or support system. The content and event day will be mindful of the multigenerational crowd. 

Organizations desiring to join the resource community fair or sponsor the event, please email info@heroeshomestead.org.  Services for adults, children, veterans and spouses (including Gold Star families), as well as basic life needs and life enhancement and more are welcome to join.

name: I Can And I Will Run!
description:
I can and I will is the mantra Olivia and her mom, Alisa, have been saying since 2018. Whether it's prepping to be poked by a needle or running up a big hill, we remind ourselves that we can and we will! We take these words to heart and they have been pushing us to do big things!

Our goal with this run is to raise money for the Uncompensated Care Fund at Seattle Children's Hospital. Race day is Sunday, October 19th, 2025. The event offers kids dashes, a professionally timed 5k and a 10k, as well as a virtual run for our friends and fans who are not able to travel to Seattle. The start will be at Green Lake Community Center using both the inner trail, and surrounding parks for the 10k, finishing back at the start. The kids' runs will be held near the starting line after the other races are completed. We will have t-shirts for those registering early as long as supplies last as well as finisher medals!

We created this event to help Seattle Children's Hospital provide world class care to patients regardless of their ability to pay. Everyday a family walks into Seattle Children's Hospital and learns something that will forever change them. No parent should have to deal with a difficult diagnosis for their child and face financial hardship when seeking care for their child. 

Every step you take will make a difference in the lives of families who are impacted by a devastating diagnosis and wondering how they will pay the medical bills. 100% of race net proceeds from this fun run will benefit uncompensated care at Seattle Children’s Hospital. Thank you for your participation and help. You are ensuring that families can focus on their child's wellbeing; not the medical bill in their mailbox.

If you've been to the Run before, awesome, thank you for the ongoing support! And if you are joining us for the first time, welcome to the party!

name: International Sloth Day Run 5K/10K/13.1 SEATTLE
description:
Sloths will get there!

It doesn't matter how fast we get there, all that matters is we get there. Join this super fun unique 5K, 10K, or 13.1 Half-Marathon run where there is NO time limit!

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

name: Issaquah Schools Foundation Monster Mash 5K
description:
Help us raise a MONSTROUS amount of support for local students on October 25th! ISF Monster Mash 5K is a community-based, family-friendly event that raises funds for programs that serve students attending all 27 ISD schools.

We welcome all-ages and abilities. Convenient onsite parking, phased start times, and a professionally chip-timed course ensure a great experience for all. You’ll appreciate the flat, paved, out-and-back route whether you’re setting a new 5K PR or enjoying a brisk walk together as a family! Bring your creativity – festive costumes are encouraged!
This event sells out every year, so don't wait to register! Every registration submitted by October 12th receives a 2025 Monster Mash technical race tee & medal. Registrants receive free event photos and raffle tickets for prizes as well! Placement awards for fastest finishing times will also be presented. See below for details.

name: Jack & Jill Downhill Marathon, Half Marathon Washington
description:
We are in the World's top 25 fastest courses! https://www.halfmarathons.net/fastest-marathons/

Jack & Jill's Downhill Marathon is a fast, gentle downhill course on one of Washington's most scenic trails. North Bend, WA, is located just 31 miles east of Seattle. After you pass through the Snoqualmie Tunnel, you can enjoy the next 23 miles down a gradual 2000-foot net drop down the Cascade to Palouse Trail on a hard-packed, shaded dirt/gravel road. "YES," you can use your finish time to qualify for Boston or chalk up a new PR. Either way, this 26.2-mile journey is breathtakingly beautiful and sure to be a favorite.
 

🚐 SHUTTLE BUS INFO

Marathon: No shuttle to the start. You are responsible for your own transportation.
Half Marathon: Shuttle buses will take runners to the trailhead. From there, it’s a scenic 1-mile walk to the start.
No parking at the half marathon start, trailhead, or finish line.
Return shuttles are provided to take all runners back to their original parking locations after the race.
 
⏱️ Rolling Start

Start is staggered by pace groups with ~1 minute between waves.
All runners will be on course within a few minutes.
Line up according to pace to reduce congestion—faster runners should not have to weave around.
Half Marathoners: Don’t be late! A late start means walking uphill while others are racing downhill. Not fun.
 
👟 Shoes & Tunnel Gear

Road shoes are perfect. Trail shoes are not necessary.
Some runners use gaiters to prevent kicking up rocks, but that’s personal preference.
Marathon runners MUST carry a light for the tunnel.

Use the tear tag on your bib to mark your light and drop it in the bucket at the tunnel exit.
 
💧 Aid Stations

Located every ~2.5 miles.
Stocked with water, Gatorade, and GU gels at select stations.
 
🚫 Bib Rules

Do NOT run with someone else’s bib. This creates safety, emergency contact, and result issues.
We take this seriously—please respect the race, your fellow runners, and our volunteers.
 
🎽 Packet Pickup

Location: Snoqualmie Running Company

📍 38843 SE Newton St, Snoqualmie, WA 98065

Friday, July 25 – 11:00 AM to 7:00 PM
Saturday, July 26 – 3:00 PM to 7:00 PM
Race Day Pickup: PRE-PAID and PRE-ARRANGED ONLY for $25 paid by Wednesday of race week. Bibs will be available at the start line. You’ll receive your bib, shirt, and drop bag tag. 

 
🎒 Drop Bags

Bring a reasonable amount.
Secure it tightly and use the provided bib tag for ID.
We’ll transport your drop bag to the finish.
 
❗Refund Policy Reminder

As noted at registration:
No refunds, deferrals, or transfers.
Our only exception is if you volunteer to support the event.

 
Thanks for being part of this amazing community—we can’t wait to see you out there!

name: Jasper Mountain Trail Fest 2026
description:
Jasper Mountain Trail Fest is a fundraising event that benefits Jasper Mountain Reserve, an environmental 501(c)3 non-profit organization to improve and enhance wildlife habitats for rare and endangered flora and fauna native to the Blue Mountains in the Southeast corner of Washington State. Come and enjoy the beautiful natural scenery with the knowledge that your signup funds will benefit the conservation of the reserve.

 

For 2025, we are offering four unique race options:

1) Our classic (fifth annual!) 5-person relay race, 100 km total distance
2) Solo Half marathon, 13.1 miles with 2,570 feet of elevation gain
3) Solo Full marathon, 26.2 miles with 5,140 feet of elevation gain
4) Solo 7k Family Run (4.4 miles) with minimal elevation gain

 

Prices increases are on  April 17, 2025, May 18, 2025, and June 14, 2025. Sign up by May 29th, 2025 to guarantee you receive a race t-shirt and medal! (we have a few extras for late registrants on a first come-first serve basis).Contact info@jaspermountainreserve.org with any questions.

 

All races take place on the following single track trails (click on each for details):

Red Loop (3.3 miles)
Green Loop (4.4 miles)
Black Loop (5.4 miles)

 

Reserve Information and Accommodations

The start and finish line is at 934 Payne Hollow Road, Dayton, WA 99328, which can only be found on Google Maps.

 

Suggested arrival is during daylight the day prior to the race. Suggested departure is the day after the race. There will be an informal welcome reception and short presentation about the race in the Start/Finish area, commencing at 8:00PM on the evening prior to the race.

 

Parking and campsites, close to the start/finish line, is included in the race fee.

Campsites for racers are within Jasper Mountain Reserve. As this is a nature reserve, loud noises, including car engines, power generators, high volume loudspeakers etc. are strictly forbidden. Dogs must be on leash at all times. Camp-fires are only allowed at one designated area (please familiarize yourself with WA State and Columbia County seasonal camp fire restrictions). Bring your own food, water, and (battery) power sources (Jasper Mountain Reserve is off the grid, meaning there is no water or electricity). Portable sanitary facilities will be provided. As there is no garbage and recycling collection service please collect all trash and take it with you when you depart.

 

Accommodation options are also available just a short drive from the race! Choose from hotels and Airbnbs in nearby Dayton (11 miles from the event), Waitsburg (16 miles), or Walla Walla (37 miles).

 

Relay Race Details (Start Time 7:00AM):

Relay teams consist of 5 people sharing one assigned bib with an adjustable belt that can be exchanged between team members. Each racer signs up individually and can choose one of the following options:
1) No Team (the race organizers will assign you to a team)
2) Join an Existing Team
3) Create a New Team

 

All teams start together with the 1st runner of each team running the red loop at the same time. Once completed, the 1st runner passes the bib to the 2nd team member who will complete the green loop. Once completed, the 2nd team member passes the bib to the 3rd team member who will complete the black loop. Once completed, the 3rd team member passes on the bib to the 4th team member who will run the red loop, followed by the 5th team member who will run the green loop, followed by the 1st team member who will run the black loop and so on, until all 5 team members each have completed all three loops. Race timing will provide results for entire teams as well as individual times (splits) on each separate trail loop.

 

All three loops combined are exactly 13.1 miles, the distance of a half marathon. The relay race is expected to take 10-15 hours. Due to the rugged terrain which includes steep downhills, headlamps are mandatory for any runners after 8:00PM.

 

Half Marathon and Full Marathon Details (Start Time 7:00AM)

Calling all Ultra Trail Runners! Our new course is crafted specifically for the adventurous spirit of the ultra trail community. The half marathon is the perfect choice for those eager to test their limits or begin their journey toward ultra distances. For the fearless and bold, the full marathon awaits: 26.2 miles with over 5,000 feet of elevation gain, set against a backdrop of breathtaking natural beauty in the Blue Mountains. This isn't just a race; it’s a chance to immerse yourself in the beautiful landscape of a pristine nature reserve. Get ready to experience the ultimate trail running adventure, you won't be disappointed! All three trail loops within Jasper Mountain Reserve combined are exactly 13.1 miles, the distance of a half marathon, The full marathon will run the combined trail loops twice.

 

7k (4.4 miles) Family Run Details (Start Time 7:15AM)

This exciting new option will be on the beautiful Green Trail, 4.3 miles long with minimal elevation gain. It is ideal for runners who prefer a sprint option, or families with kids to run together, and for participants who prefer to walk.

name: Juanita Unified 5K - Heroes Run Here
description:
The Juanita Unified 5K is more than just a run (or walk!), it's a step toward a more inclusive and connected community. Juanita High School serves over 1,700 diverse students and is committed to creating an environment where every student feels valued. The 5K aims to support this vision by offering an inclusive experience for everyone in the Juanita community - school and beyond.

The Juanita Unified 5K is organized by the Juanita High School DECA chapter. DECA is an internationally recognized program that prepares emerging leaders and entrepreneurs through real-world experiences and strives to create confident, capable contributors to society. 

Funds raised will go to support Juanita DECA and the Unified program at Juanita. All donations will go through the JHS DECA Booster Club.

name: Jumping Mouse Turkey Trot
description:
Join us for the Jumping Mouse Annual Turkey Trot 5K — a community tradition that brings people together to celebrate health, gratitude, and giving back!

This year’s Turkey Trot will take place Saturday, November 22, 2025, on the beautiful Larry Scott Trail in Port Townsend, WA. 

Whether you’re running, walking, or trotting with family and friends, every step you take helps support Jumping Mouse Children’s Center and its mission to provide transformative therapy and advocacy for children’s mental health.

Event Highlights:

Scenic, flat 5K course on the Larry Scott Trail
Family-friendly and dog-friendly atmosphere (strollers welcome too!)
An uplifting way to kick off the holiday season while giving back to kids in need
Let’s lace up, have fun, and make a difference together. 🦃💛

name: K9 Candy Cane 5K Fun Run
description:
The K9 Candy Cane 5K Fun Run and Walk is held at the Renton Community Center Campus. Runners and walkers travel along the paved beautiful Cedar River Trail before looping back to the Community Center Campus. Competitive runners, fun runners, walkers and families (with or without) dogs are all invited to this annual event. Accurate and professional chip timing is provided by Bell Lap Productions. If registered before 10:00AM on Friday, November 21, participants will receive a hooded sweatshirt. Don't forget about our Annual Pet Food Drive for furry friends in need, help us FILL THE TRUCK! 

Registration Windows:

  • Early Bird Registration - August 28 to November 1.
    • Guarantees you a hooded sweatshirt. 
    • Ages 4 to 17 fee:        $20
    • Ages 18 and up fee:   $30
  • Standard Price Registration - November 2, ending at 10:00AM, November 21.
    • Guarantees you a hooded sweatshirt.  
    • Ages 4 to 17 fee:       $30
    • Ages 18 and up fee:  $40
  • Last Chance Registration -  Begins 10:01AM November 21, through 1:00PM on Saturday December 6.
    • Not eligible to receive a hooded sweatshirt, Fun Run Only.
    • Ages 4 to 17 fee:       $30
    • Ages 18 and up fee:  $40

Race Bib Number Pick Up:
If you have pre-registered, you may pick up your race bib and sweatshirt (if applicable) at The Renton Community Center, 1715 Maple Valley Hwy. Renton, 98057, Saturday, December 6, 9:30AM – 5:00PM. If you are picking up for family members or friends, you will need their race day registration confirmation. You will also have the opportunity to pickup your race bib and sweatshirt onsite the morning of the race. 

Race Guidelines for Humans and Dogs:

  • Strollers are welcome on the course for both humans and dogs.
  • Participants NOT wanting to be timed should NOT pass through the finish line, please exit the course to the left or right prior to entering the timing chute.
  • Your race bib is your timing chip. Please wear it outside of your clothing facing forward for accurate timing.
  • Timing will conclude 45 minutes after the start of the race.
  • Walkers stay to the right of the race course.
  • Extra sweatshirts are NOT purchased and will NOT be available day of race.
  • No more than two dogs per person.
  • All dogs are required to be current on vaccinations.
  • No dogs under six months of age.
  • Dogs must be on leash no more than 6 feet in length.
  • Owners are responsible for the well-being and safety of their dog(s) at all times
  • No female dogs in heat. 
  • No aggressive dogs or aggressive owners. Any signs of aggression towards other dogs or participants will result in being asked to leave the event.
  • Owners are responsible for always picking up after their dog(s). 

Pet Food Drive:
Please bring a can/bag of pet food to be donated to local animals in need. Help us FILL THE TRUCK! 

Click here: Course Map

Course Closure:
Recreational walkers/runners are non-competitive and will not be timed if finishing after 45 minutes. If you are participating in this event but are not being timed please be considerate and not cross the finish line where timing is taking place. Keep to the right or left of the timing chute.

Awards and Results:
Awards will be given to the top three runners overall in female, male, non binary, and youth. Free event stickers will be included for all participants.

Hooded Sweatshirts:
After 10:00AM November 21, hooded Sweatshirts are no longer available. Extra sweatshirts are not purchased and will NOT be available at the end of the race. The sweatshirt size you selected is what's purchased. Sweatshirts are unisex sizing.

name: Lake Meridian Triathlon
description:
Welcome to this Pacific Northwest Favorite Triathlon. Lake Meridian includes Olympic, Sprint, and Super Sprint individual events and a Sprint & Olympic Relay for teams of 2 or 3.  All athletes will receive a free T-shirt (if you register on or before August 1st) & finisher medal.  Stick around after your race and enjoy a meal,  the finish line celebration and awards ceremony,  Pint glasses are given to the top 5 finishers of each age group in the Sprint & Olympic - top 3 in the Super Sprint. 

Lake Meridian Park is a beautiful, spectator friendly venue. Lots of room for the kids to run around. 

See you on August 16th!

name: Lake Sammamish Half Marathon
description:
The Lake Sammamish Half Marathon is a point to point race that takes runners along the smooth trail that connects Marymoor Park in Redmond to Lake Sammamish State Park in Issaquah. This interurban trail is very popular with runners and is fully paved. We also offer a half-marathon walk category with a generous 4 hour time limit. This flat run is perfect for a half-marathon personal best whether you’re running or walking! 

The race is chip-timed, and each racer will receive a custom bib, participant shirt, and a finisher medal. Aid stations are provided every few miles (see course map) with Clif gels, Nuun and water, and the finish line will be by the beach and includes a nice line up of food and music.  

The Lake Sammamish Half is cupless, so you either need to bring a handheld bottle, wear a hydration pack, or we can provide you with a re-useable cup at the start line.

VIRTUAL RACE INFO - We have 40 spots for virtual runners. Once they sell out there are no more available. You can run the distance all at once or break it up into chunks and run it on the date of your choosing. You will receive a shirt and medal that will be mailed after the in person race.

Check out all the details on our website.

name: Lampson Cable Bridge Run
description:
This year marks the 47th annual running of the Lampson Cable Bridge Run! Finisher Medals will be given out to the first 2200 participants who finish the run. To receive your medal please ensure that your race bib is visible as you cross the finish line. So tell your friends and come out and enjoy this fun and exciting holiday tradition! Runners, no matter the distance they choose (5K or 10K) will start their race crossing over the Columbia River from Kennewick to Pasco, WA on the scenic Cable Bridge. The 1 mile runners will end shortly after crossing the bridge and be shuttled to the 5K/10K finish area. The 5K & 10K finish line is located at the Lampson warehouse. At the finish line you will receive your medal and refreshments before proceeding to catch the shuttle bus back to the fairground's parking lot. 

There is a discounted, non-timed 1 Mile Fun Run category for those that want to experience the fun and excitement of this yearly event, and still receive the finisher medal. Also there is a child 4 and under category that is free of charge. Participants in this category will receive their own special bib but will not be timed nor receive a finisher medal, instead they will receive a child's finisher ribbon.

For all timed race categories, timing chips are used and awards are given to the top participants in each age category. So if you are a competitive runner or someone who just wants to have fun walking with your friends, the Lampson Cable Bridge Run has what you are looking for.

name: Langlauf 10K XC Ski Race
description:
Langlauf is a 10K Cross Country Ski Race that takes place at the Mount Spokane Nordic Ski Center which is the premier Cross Country Ski Area in the Inland Northwest.  The race takes place on the traditional 10K course and has wave starts to accommodate skiers of all abilities and speeds.  Even maybe more epic than the race itself, are the pre and post race amenities that are enjoyed by all racers.  This is the biggest and oldest Cross Country Race in the Pacific Northwest...you don't want to miss it!

Once again, this year we are offering an adaptive skier category. If you are visually impaired or a sit skier you will be able to participate in our Wave start, but at Junction 1 will continue on Linder Road to a turnaround at the Inland gate then back to Brian's and our traditional finish line. Adaptive skiers must register but their guide skier can accompany them for no cost. Guides will need to sign a waiver the morning of the race and do not need to pay to register unless they want to be timed. Guides will be considered a volunteer and be entered in the prize drawing.

name: Last Chance Marathon and Half Marathon
description:
OK, here is your Last Chance to run a 1/2 marathon or full marathon this year! The 1/2 marathon course is an out and back and the full marathon course is the same out and back course two times, starting at Fairhaven Park Pavillion, running the Interurban trail out to Clayton Beach for the full 13.1 miles or 26.2. Course is subject to change if trail conditions mandate.

 

This trail has spectacular views and very few hills, just enough hills to make it interesting, and break up the flat sections. FYI: We have been known to have SNOW this time of the year so plan accordingly. The majority of this trail is covered with a canopy of trees which deflects some of the rain or snow, but this also means it doesn’t heat as fast as an open course would. It can get cold. The majority of the trail is an old railroad bed, very easy to run on gravel surface, with the exception of Arroyos Park. Arroyos Park is a double track trail with a few bridges and a few fun hills. It is a very well maintained set of trails.

 

The bathrooms at Fairhaven Park will be unlocked as well as the warm heated Pavillion.

 

You should plan on being self-sufficient and carrying your own water and aid. The 1st aid station on the course is ~ 3.5 miles into the race off Chuckanut Crest Drive. In the 1/2 marathon you will run by this aid station twice, and 4 times in the full marathon.  There will be an aid station at the turn around which you will access once in the 1/2 marathon and twice in the full marathon. We will also have an aid station at the start/finish so full 1/2 marathoners will have 3 chances to refill their water bottles, about every 3 to 3.5 miles, & marathoners will have 7 chances to refill their water bottles.  We will have water, an electrolyte drink and other snacks at the aid stations.  Usually I put some type of candy like candy corn, gummy bears, bananas, pretzels, typical ultra style foods. You won’t go hungry!
Keep an eye on the website for any changes to the event. Finishers will receive a Last Chance coin/medal similar to the quality of the Woolley Runs coin.  We will provide food at the end like all the NW Ultra Events.  While all your friends are recovering from their hang over and resting up before the evening’s festivities, you’ll be burning calories and ready to PARTY hardy knowing you’ve already burned off that extra beer or two, or three.

name: LEGACY 19
description:
"Instead of running with you, we are running in your memory."

In December of 2019, at 36 years of age, Tyler, within one week, received 2 diagnoses of Leukemia. He passed away after his first chemo treatment. He and his wife, Candace Kite, are graduates of Eisenhower High School and WSU. He left a beautiful legacy for their four children and those that knew him well. Parents, Bruce and Diane Crockett.

A 5K Run or Walk Fundraiser for the Leukemia Research Foundation in memory of Tyler Bronson Crockett. 

Register by October 1st, 2025.

name: Let Me Run Fall 5K 2025
description:
Come celebrate the end of season 5K for the Let Me Run program.  At Let Me Run we inspire boys through the power of running to be courageous enough to be themselves, to build healthy relationships, and to live an active lifestyle. This 5K celebrates 7 weeks of training for our boys and we invite you to join us as you walk, jog, or run to support the boys and help provide very important funding for our next season. This fall we are back at the beautiful course at Greenlake Park in Seattle.  Come feel the joy and sense of accomplishment as our boys cross the finish line!  

 

Schedule: 

8:30am - Registration and Packet Pickup opens

10:00am - 5K start 

10:45am - Awards

name: Light up the Night 5k
description:
Ring in the new year with sneakers, sparkles, and smiles! Our New Year’s Eve "Light up the Night 5K" isn’t about speed—it’s about celebration. Whether you're jogging, walking, skipping, or dancing your way through the course, you're guaranteed to end the year on a high note.

Everyone is encouraged to dress up—think glow sticks, LED tutus, silly hats, or even full-on costume sparkle! 

Families, kids, strollers, and pups on leashes are all welcome. This is your chance to do something active, social, and unforgettable before the clock strikes midnight.

Finish the year glowing—literally!  Come for the fun. Stay for the memories. And start the new year smiling.

name: Lookin For A Cure Seattle
description:
"We're "Lookin' For a Cure" in scenic Warren G Magnesun Park! Join A Cure In Sight on Saturday July 19th, 2025 from 8AM-11AM, to walk or run with us. We will be taking steps to find a cure for a rare eye cancer, Ocular Melanoma. Ocular Melanoma is estimated by the American Cancer Society to have roughly 3000 new cases each year nationwide. Bring your friends and family to the race day--all ages welcome to walk or run with us.

Register, become a fund raiser, make a team, grab your friends and family and raise money to support local research with Dr. Stacey and Fred Hutch Cancer Center.  Prizes will be awarded for largest team, largest fundraiser as well as top finishers.

Race Swag

  • Guarantee t-shirt if registered by June 30th.
  • Finisher Medal
  • Food & Drink
  • Aid Station
  • Commemorative Race Bib
  • Free downloadable photos
  • Official finishers time with age group placements

Race day schedule

  • Registration 7AM
  • Race start 8AM
  • Announcements Awards 10AM

Parking

Free parking past the boat launch area  just steps from the start line. If you have an issue on race day, please call 919-885-5264 for directions.

name: Lost Lake 25K
description:
Lost Lake 25K
Bellingham, Washington
Start: Lost Lake Trailhead
Finish: Larrabee State Park Amphitheater

Welcome to the Pacific Northwest’s hidden gem: the Lost Lake 25K — a perfectly crafted point-to-point trail run through the moss-draped forests, ridgelines, and  lake basins of Washington’s first state park.

This one-way loop (no redundancies, no backtracking) starts at the Lost Lake Trailhead, taking runners on a scenic journey through old-growth evergreens and fern-lined singletrack. The course weaves its way south through Larrabee’s rugged terrain, connecting some of the area’s most beautiful trails in a flowy, runnable rhythm.

On clear days, you’ll catch breathtaking views into Canada, over the bay into Bellingham, and across to the snow-capped summit of Mount Baker. Along the way, expect a mix of fast, forested descents, mellow climbs, and technical stretches near lakes and ridgelines.

The journey ends at the Larrabee State Park Amphitheater, where a celebratory finish line, post-race snacks, and mountain vibes await.

Whether you're chasing a PR or just soaking in the sights, this course delivers a little magic in every mile.

Come run the ridges, lakes, and lore of the Chuckanut Mountains. Welcome to Yeti.

name: Lunar New Year Run 5K/10K/13.1 SEATTLE
description:
🏇🐎 Gallop Into the New Year! 🐎🏇
✨ Step into the Year of the Horse with purpose, energy, and community spirit! ✨
Celebrate culture, fitness, and fresh starts with the Lunar New Year’s Run, which is your chance to embrace the bold spirit of the horse - symbolizing energy, freedom, and forward momentum.

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

name: Mad Meadows 50
description:
October is such a magical time in the Eastern Cascades that we couldn't resist offering a new event! This course has a bit of it all: smooth single track, incredible views, steep climbs, and technical sections. Oh, and did we mention it's Larch Season over here?

The 50k will reach elevations over 6000ft, while the 50M will top out over 7000ft at its highest point. This high-elevation course will offer views east into the Entiat River Valley and west towards the glaciated slopes of Clark Mountain and Dakobed (Glacier Peak). With gilded larches to frame the trails, this certainly won't be a race to miss.

name: Maple Valley Turkey Trot: Thanksgiving Day 5K
description:
Join us for the 7th Annual Maple Valley Turkey Trot 5K presented by Cayce Grove Law Offices benefiting the Maple Valley Food Bank! Register by end of day November 1 to guarantee your race day t-shirt. Sign ups after November 1 do not guarantee a shirt.
___

The Maple Valley Turkey Trot is a FUN walk or trot Thanksgiving morning through Lake Wilderness Park organized with the intention of coming together as a community during the Thanksgiving holiday to help those in need.

Children in strollers are not required to register (but will not receive shirts). All proceeds raised will go to fund Maple Valley Food Bank Programs as we enter into our organization's busiest season. All ages are welcome! We encourage Thanksgiving costumes & accessories!
___

Interested in Sponsoring the Turkey Trot? Visit: https://maplevalleyfoodbank.formstack.com/forms/maplevalleyturkeytrotsponsor25

___

Advanced Packet Pickup
TBD!

Day-Of Schedule
- Packet pick-up will begin at 7:30 AM on race day. Come early to grab coffee and snacks, and take photos in our photo booth (and with our giant turkey)! There's plenty to do and we'll have music keep up the energy!
- The race will begin at the Beach House at Lake Wilderness Park promptly at 9:00.
- Race route: https://www.mapmyrun.com/routes/view/6296717431

Parking
Please utilize the lower parking lots at the Lake Wilderness Lodge, nearest the arboretum, or the park parking lots specifically. Upper lots near the lodge will be closed off for safety on the route.

Chip Timing
This event will NOT be timed. A fun-run in its fullest form!

Strollers, Dogs, Bikes, and Water
We encourage the use of jogging strollers along the route of this family-friendly 5K. However, out of consideration for other participants, dogs will not be allowed on the course (with the exception of service dogs). For the safety and convenience of all participants, bikes are NOT permitted, as this is a fairly narrow out and back course. We will have water stations near the beach house before and after the race.

Accessibility
Please note that, while generally flat, this race course may not be suitable for all abilities, as the terrain is both paved and gravel. There is a slight incline to access the Green to Cedar River Trail from the arboretum. We will have volunteers stationed at these points to assist on an as-needed basis.

___
Race Contact Info
If you have any additional questions about this race, please contact Jon Cantalini at info@maplevalleyfoodbank.org 

Tickets are non-transferable and non-refundable.

name: MCCM Monster Mash 5k & Creature Crawl 1k
description:
🧪 Calling All Little Monsters & Mad Scientists! 🧪

🔬🧪 Registration is OPEN! The 3rd Annual Monster Mash 5K & Creature Crawl 1K is brewing up a morning of spooky science, silly experiments, and hands-on fun for the whole family! 🎃👟

📅 Saturday, October 25, 2025
📍 Howard Amon Park
🕤 Monster Mash 5K – 9:30 AM (top 3 male & female finishers in each category win prizes 🏆)
🕥 Creature Crawl 1K – 10:30 AM (costumes encouraged! Each child receives a FREE shirt with early registration + swag bag 🎁)

Throw on your monster costume or lab coat and join us for a morning of running, laughter, and STEM-powered fun—think colorful test tubes, wacky experiments, and plenty of spooky-cute energy!

👉 Sign up by October 1 for early bird pricing and to guarantee your event t-shirt. Same-day registration is available, but swag and vouchers are while supplies last.

Science-y Perks & Fun
🍩☕ Each 5K participant and 1K child gets a free cider/coffee and donut voucher (fuel for mad scientists!).
🎨 FREE face painting for all child registrants.
🍬 Trick-or-treating, STEM-inspired activity booths, and hands-on experiments for all ages!

Safety in the Lab
- No motorized scooters, rollerblades, or skateboards.
- Strollers welcome (please secure little ones).
- Service animals only 🐾.
- Bring water and stay hydrated 💧.
- Costumes encouraged, but make sure they don’t block vision or movement.
- Children must be supervised at all times.
- Stick to marked paths and follow volunteer guidance 🔦.

✨ All proceeds benefit the Mid-Columbia Children’s Museum, supporting the creation of a brick-and-mortar children’s museum in the Tri-Cities.

name: McKenzie Mott Memorial Turkey Trot
description:
After the tragic loss of our 15 year old daughter the family tradition of getting together for a movie, thanksgiving dinner and lots of family time was so hard to face without her. Kenzie loved tradition so to help us honor her legacy we created a new tradition for our family. Our family friends "the Larsen's"  inspired us to do something Kenzie would love to do so we did, we ran! We were so blessed to have over fifty of our friends and family join us for our first race as well as overwhelmed by the monetary donation that helped support our Safe Driving Scholarship for all local High School seniors. This is our 10th annual race and all proceeds continue to fund our scholarships.

Race Check-in/ Shirt Pick Up -Nov 25th-Selkirk Middle School 5:30-7:00, Nov 26th- Selkirk Middle School 5:30-7:00 & Race Day Nov 28th 7:30 a.m.- 8:45 a.m. 

Selkirk Middle School-1409 N. Harvest PKWY, Liberty Lake, WA 99019

Race will start promptly at 9:00 a.m. NE corner of pavilion park. Parking is available at Liberty Lake Elementary and Liberty Creek Elementary.

*To guarantee a shirt size, register by November 10th.

name: Meridian Turkey Trot Fun Run
description:
Whether you walk, jog, or run, join us for a Turkey Trot at Bellewood Farms to help raise funds for the Meridian High School Cross Country Team!  Try to keep up with our speedy cross country team if you can or just trot along for some fun!  Costumes are encouraged for this fun, family-friendly event. 

Rain or shine, the race will be on.  It's a guaranteed fun time!

*Strollers built for trail running are invited along for the ride, however our furry friends will have to sit this one out.



Where: 
Bellewood Farms
6140 Guide Meridian Rd., Lynden, WA

When:  Saturday November 22

Time: 
9:00am:    Bib pickup
9:30am:    1 mile Fun Run Starts
10:00am:  5k Race Starts

Cost: $15 per person or $40 per family with advance registration
             Day of event - $20 per person or $50 per family 
             *Registration is non-refundable

name: Millwood Daze 5k
description:
Community celebration 5k favorite is back!  The Millwood Daze 5k returns this year.  From it's tree-lined start in historic Millwood, its a flat, fast loop course great for runners and walkers.  Join us for the Millwood Daze celebration after the run with a pancake breakfast, street fair with community booths, and a classic car show.

Tee shirts available for purchase to all registrants.  Order by 8/12 to have it by race day.  After that, tee shirt pick up or delivery will be arranged.

name: MLK Freedom Run 5K/10K/13.1 SEATTLE
description:
Join in our annual Martin Luther King Jr. Day Run! Today, we gather to honor the legacy of Dr. King and his enduring commitment to justice, equality, and peace. As we lace up our shoes and hit the pavement, let’s reflect on his powerful message of love and resilience.

This event is not just about fitness; it’s a celebration of community, a call to action for social change, and a reminder of the work still to be done. Together, we can honor Dr. King’s dream and inspire one another to continue striving for a better world. Let’s run with purpose and passion!

Overview:

Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.

This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

name: Monster Dash 5K and Kids' Fun Run
description:
Spokane's Premier Halloween 5K Race and Kids' Fun Run.  Bring your costume.  Bring your shoes.  Let's dash!

Join us for the 17th Annual Monster Dash 5K Race and Kids' Fun Run, held in beautiful Manito Park on Spokane's South Hill. Enjoy autumn leaves. Show off your look. Run with friends. Monsters welcome.

You must register by end of day on October 13th to be guaranteed a shirt.  If you miss this cut-off, you can look for extra shirts after the race but quantities will be limited and first-come first-served.

 

Race Day - Sunday October 26, 2025

9:00am - Day-of bib and t-shirt pickup at the Lower Manito Park Picnic Shelter.

10:00am - The starting horn sounds to kick off the 5K Race. Dash!

11:00am - The Kids' Fun Run begins. Move those monster toes!

The Fun Run is offered at 1-mile, half-mile, and quarter-mile distances, each ending with candy goodie bags as kids cross the finish line. Grownups are welcome to walk or run next to their children on the entire course.

The 5K Race will be chip timed. Many parents complete the 5K on their own, then meet their children for the Fun Run. We love a family dash!

There will be prizes for overall winners and ribbons for age category winners.

----------------------------------

All proceeds from the race are donated to Active4Youth, a local non-profit that believes that by teaching sports and introducing healthy activities to children at a young age, we can begin to address the alarming rise of childhood obesity, while providing children with a safe place to play after school. Its elementary running program is provided at no cost to children in Spokane Public Schools, West Valley School District, and Central Valley School District.

$35 - 5K Race with T-Shirt *before or on October 13th*

$17 - Kids' Fun Run with T-Shirt *before or on October 13th*

name: Moses Lake Athletics Club Pumpkin Run
description:
Join us for our very first 5K — a perfect fall day, the Turner way!

Run (or walk!) through a gorgeous all-terrain (NOT stroller friendly) course featuring a pumpkin patch, corn maze, orchards, golden wheat fields, and peaceful canal roads.

This event supports the Moses Lake Athletics Track & Field Club, so grab your running shoes, soak in the crisp autumn air, and celebrate the season with us!

About This Event
All proceeds benefit the Columbia Basin Cancer Foundation. You may donate extra if you would like during the registration process! name: My Better Half Marathon
description:
Prepare yourself for a running event like no other. Romance. Kitsch. Sweat. My Better Half Marathon is a celebration of running, romance and rom-coms. There are 4 categories: Bromance (two guy friends), Besties (two best friends), Lovers (romantically involved) and Lonely Hearts (self-explanatory). Join Orca Running, February 8th, 2026 as we celebrate love in all of its forms!

Lover's registration is for couples of all kinds! Bestie's registration is for two girlfriends, mom and daughter, guy and gal, or anyone you call your bestie. Bromance registration is for two dudes who probably don't want to admit that they're inseparable. Lonely Heart's registration is for those currently enjoying being single or looking for love.

The half marathon course is a total of 2 laps.  The first lap has a steep but quick hill early on and is 6.9 miles in length.  The second lap is 6.2 miles long and is nice and flat! The 10K course is a total of 2 laps.  The first lap has some hills in the beginning and is 3.7 miles long whereas the second lap is nice and flat and is 2.5 miles in length! The 5k course is 3.1 miles long.  A steep but quick hill in the beginning is a great warm-up but once you come back down it’s a breeze!

Half Marathon Relay: The relay course can be completed in any way you prefer, as long as both laps are completed.  Lap one is 6.9 miles long and has a quick but steep hill in the beginning, Lap two is 6.2 miles long and is nice and flat!  It doesn’t matter who completes which lap.  There is a relay hand off area just before the finish line (in the park gazebo) where you make the exchange from one runner to the other.

Your entry comes with long sleeve 1/4 zip shirt, finisher medal, hot post oatmeal, and free race photos!

The My Better Half Marathon supports Rebuilding Seattle Together.

name: Never Say Never Half Marathon & 10K
description:
This race is all about YOU! Every decision we make has YOU in mind. This is a race designed for everyone from first timers to seasoned racers. It is a picturesque course with one sizable hill around mile 2 followed by flat road for the rest of the 10K and rolling hills for the remainder of the Half Marathon.  
There will be NINE water stations this year. There are six bathroom opportunities, and lots of fans cheering you on along the way. 
We are again partnering with BOX, a nonprofit organization founded by women, dedicated to building connections that support women and girls. In 2021 we donated $4,100 to the Highland School District, in 2022 we donated $2,000 plus products to Davis High School, in 2023 we presented a $3,000 check to Rod’s House plus a ton of period products, and in 2024 we were beyond proud to write an $8,300 to Children's Village. This was our biggest donation by far!!!! This year we are proud to announce we raised $9,000 for Yakima's YWCA!
We have finally decided on who we will be raising money for in 2026. We are so excited and proud to announce we will be raising money for Nathan's Place. When we started this crazy dream we raised money for Highland High School (unfortunately we did not have a race that year because of smoke) so, as this is our last year putting on the Never Say Never we wanted to again raise money for our hometown. 
Nathan's Place was born just last year!  Some amazing members of our community who noticed that our high school kids have no place to hang out after school dedicated their time and resources to create a gathering place. They have been worked tirelessly to make Nathan's Place more than just a dream. This summer they had work parties to paint and fix up a building the city was not using, they got their 501(c)3 status so they could raise money to get computers, games, a BBQ, a TV, and more. The kids were pumped to start the school year with a place to hang out, do homework, and give back to our community. Then an unfortunate accident happened this summer and the building got severely damaged. Currently they do not know if insurance will cover the cost of fixing the building so now Nathan's Place, has no place. They need our help more than ever. We don't want to see this dream, that our kids so badly need, go away. Your donations this year are going to make the biggest difference yet!
Flying pig trophies will be back again for first, second, and third place women and men runners and walkers for the Half Marathon and the 10K. 
However, if even a 10K doesn’t sound fun come for the Finish Line Celebration Party! This is FREE to attend and welcome to all! Come cheer on the racers, get fabulous grub from Tacos Don Chayo, get refreshed with local beverages, play yard games with or without your kids and partake in our BEST raffle yet! And the WHEEL of FUN will be back again for even more prizes!
