name: Ugly Sweater Fun Run 5k
description:
The Ugly Sweater Run is a one-of-a-kind event that brings together families, friends, and community members to celebrate the holiday season with a dash of humor and a lot of heart. Don your most outrageously festive holiday sweater and run or walk a designated 5k route, creating a joyous spectacle of holiday spirit. This snow or shine event is for all ages and abilities, and even pets are encouraged to dress for the occasion! Join us on Saturday, December 7th at 9:00am at Harbor Links.

All participants will receive a FREE race day gift!

name: United PDX 5K Fun Run
description:
United PDX 5K Fun Run
Location: Shelter #2, Cook Family Park, Tigard, OR
Date: June, 7, 2025
Start Time: 8:00am

United PDX Soccer Club, one of Oregon's largest youth soccer organizations, is excited to host its Second Annual 5K Run/Walk! By participating, you’ll help support nearly 3,000 youth soccer players, ages 4 to 19, as they pursue their passion for the game. This event promises a fun and active way to engage with your community while contributing to a great cause.

The Course:
Run or walk through Tigard’s scenic Cook Park, cross the beautiful Tualatin River, and enjoy the peaceful routes into Durham and Tualatin. The course is one flat, shaded 5K loop, making it perfect for participants of all ages and abilities.

Timing:
The race will be professionally timed by Eclectic Edge Racing.

Post-Race Activities:
After crossing the finish line, stick around for some post-race fun! Visit our amazing vendors, including:

Gotta Have Coffee
Carioca Bowls
Level Beer
It’s the perfect way to relax and refuel after your run!

Support Youth Soccer:
All proceeds from this event go toward supporting the United PDX Soccer Club’s programs, helping kids in our community stay active and connected through soccer.

name: Viking Family & Friends Mile
description:
Let's bring the FGHS Cross Country community together to celebrate the team and recognize our seniors one last time! Cheer on the Cross Country team at their senior night followed by an opportunity to run a mile under the lights cheered on by the athletes. 

Schedule of Events: 

Youth Mile Boys & Girls 4:15 PM

Middle School Girls 4:30 PM

Middle School Boys 4:45 PM 

JV Boys 5:00 PM 

HS Girls 5:15 PM 

Varsity Boys Boys 5:30 PM

Senior Night 5:45 PM 

Community 1 mile race 6:15 PM 

Community Walk/Jog 6:30 PM 

 

Entries for Youth and Open Miles is $10 per person - payable on this site when you register. You will have the opportunity to add an additional amount at checkout if you are able to. We are hoping to make this our annual, yearly fundraiser and would love to have all the support we can. Share the link, invite your friends. Let's have some fun! 

We will also collect cash/check donations at the race - and maybe even have some raffle prizes.

description: The Wooden Shoe 5k/10k and 1/2 Marathon Tulip Trail Run is an off-road run through the tulip fields of the Wooden Shoe TulipFest. name: YRun Dayton 5K / 1 mile Fun Run
description:
Course Description:  A mostly flat course through Dayton neighborhoods, with a moderate hill around mile 2.  Race begins and ends at the historic Courthouse Square Park in downtown Dayton.  Come enjoy this small town race, plan to stay afterwards to enjoy the after-party and local shops and restaurants.

 

YRun Dayton is a Dayton school district sponsored club whose mission is to bring communities together through movement.  All proceeds from the race will help fund K-12 running programs in the Dayton school district.

name: *BOUNDLESS POSSIBILITIES* 2025 CSNK2A1 Foundation Virtual Run, Walk & Roll
description:
JOIN US!  Join our worldwide Okur-Chung Neurodevelopmental Syndrome (OCNDS) community on OCTOBER 11TH and OCTOBER 12TH for our BOUNDLESS POSSIBILITIES Run, Walk & Roll for OCNDS! This event will help raise awareness and fund research for OCNDS, an ultra-rare genetic disease that affects individuals worldwide. IF YOU SIGN UP AFTER SEPTEMBER 22, WE CAN'T GUARANTEE YOUR RACE SHIRTS WILL ARRIVE ON TIME.

DO I NEED TO RUN TO PARTICIPATE?  Absolutely not! This is called a run, walk, or roll. Our goal is for you to safely come together with others to bring awareness to OCNDS. Invite some friends and family to join you to come together for OCNDS. You can meet at the park, your street corner, the beach, or anywhere - get out of the house and move! You can RUN. You can WALK. You can ROLL whether on a bike, wheelchair, walker, scooter, roller skates, or rollerblades.

What is our theme for the year? Our foundation theme for the year is BOUNDLESS POSSIBILITIES. The overarching goals of the foundation are to:

  1. Fund Research to Find Treatments/Cure
  2. Support Families
  3. Raise Awareness
  4. Advocate for Change
  5. Fundraise to support our efforts

We can’t do this alone, and we thank you for your commitment to come together to make the lives of those living with OCNDS brighter. Please send us photos of you with your family & friends moving toward BOUNDLESS POSSIBILITIES to bring awareness to OCNDS. 

WHY RUN, WALK or ROLL? WHY DONATE? OCNDS is a lifelong condition that significantly impacts the lives of those affected and their families. We’re raising $25,000 to support research focused on the top priorities identified at our recent conference—where families and researchers came together to chart the future of OCNDS. These include sleep, speech and language, anxiety, intellectual disability, GI health, and drug repurposing. Your support will help turn these priorities into progress.

HOW TO SIGN UP:

Step 1. Register to run/walk/roll the virtual 5k or 1 mile, and invite your family and friends to join! Give your t-shirt size and mailing address.  IF YOU SIGN UP AFTER SEPTEMBER 22, WE CAN'T GUARANTEE YOUR RACE SHIRTS WILL ARRIVE ON TIME.  

Step 2. Invite your friends and family to join you and register.  

Awards to be given for: *Loudest Family/Individual on Social Media, *Top Fundraiser, and *Most Creative Forward Together Photo on Facebook/Instagram

PRICING: $30 per adult registrant, $15 per child (2-18) registrant

name: 10th Annual Combat Cancer Walk
description:
Get ready to make a difference and have a blast at the 10th Annual Combat Cancer Walk hosted by Support Sisterz!

This community event is all about raising funds for women in Corona, Norco, Eastvale, and surrounding areas who are battling breast and gynecologic cancers.

This isn't just any walk—it's a community celebration! We’re honoring survivors, supporting those currently fighting cancer, and remembering those we've lost.

•  Event Details:
- Registration and Festivities: Start at 7 AM 
- Opening Ceremony: 8:30 AM
- Walk Begins:9 AM

•  Activities:
  - Live music
  - Vendors
  - Face painting
  - Balloon artists
  - Photo booth with souvenir photos

•  What to expect:
 - Awards for: 
  - Top fundraising team
  - Largest team
  - Top fundraising individual

•  Why join us?
  - Enjoy a beautiful 3 mile walk around Dos Lagos Lakes
  - Support local women battling breast and gynecologic cancer
  - Celebrate cancer survivors
  - Honor and remember those we've lost

Come for the cause, stay for the fun! Don’t miss out on this incredible day of community, celebration, and support. Mark your calendars and be part of something special!

name: 10th Antioch Rotary Club Bunny Hop 5K a.k.a. Antioch Rotary BunnyHop "X"
description:
2025 Results!

Please join the Antioch Rotary Bunny Hop 5K on April 19, 2025 (The day before Easter).

Here we go Hopping again!!!

It's Summertime so the Easter Bunny is on vacation! Next year we invite participants to run like the Hare or pace yourself steady to victory like the Tortoise. Participants will get a Finisher's Medal and are guaranteed a Bunny Hop T-Shirt if you register before Saturday, March 14, 2026.  Registration will open in October, 2025. If you like to be part of community video please  email your picture to rdeloso@yahoo.com.  Like us and see up to date notices on Facebook @AntiochBunnyHop5K

Important Notes:

(1) Packet Pick up will be at Fleet Feet Sports in Brentwood on Friday, April 3rd from 3-7pm. There will also be same-day Packet Pick-up on Saturday, April 4th from 7:15 - 8:25 a.m. Beat the confusion & crowds on Saturday by passing by Fleet Feet Sports on Friday!

(2) This 5K Fun Run is a timed event. Accurate timing is provided by the E-Tag attached on the back of your Race Bib - your time starts when you cross the Start Line Sensor and you finish when you cross the Finish Line Sensor. Race Timing will be provided by Ford Timing. 

All Finishers will receive a BunnyHop 5K Medal. First Place Overall in Men's & Women's will receive a plaque, and a Gift Card. 

Age Group Medals will go to the Top 3 in each of these Age Groups: 9 and under,
10-14, 15-19, 20-29, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, 60-69, & 70 and up.

AWARDS CEREMONY will take place after the KIDS KWIK DASH & EASTER EGG HUNT approximately 11:10am

(3) The 5K Course is entirely within Corteva Wetlands Preserve and the surface is mostly gravel and grass paths. Because of this we do not recommend bringing strollers or wagons unless you are prepared to carry these over some barriers and over the uneven terrain.

(4) We love our furry friends too, but we do not advise that you bring dogs to this fun run for safety reasons.

(5) The Bunny Hop Start Line is about 3/4 mile from the Antioch Marina Festival/Parking Area - please plan on a 20–30-minute nature walk! Plan on arriving at the Antioch Marina by 8:00 a.m. - there will be plenty of Parking and Porta Potties. Start Time will be approximately 9:00am

(6) This Race will happen Rain or Shine! 

(7) For Runners of Antioch Unified School District - please arrive at the Antioch Marina by 7:30am to pick up your Race Bibs and GoodyBags - There will be a special area for AUSD-sponsored Runners.

(8) Because of the size of the Event, we will not have a "Bag Drop"

(9) The KIDS KWIK DASH will take place at the Antioch Marina Parking Lot at approximately 10:30am

(10) The Easter Egg Hunt will follow the Kids Kwik Dash

The Rotary Club of Antioch is a non-profit volunteer civic organization servicing the local community for over 75 years. Some of the projects include Girls Empowerment Project, Boys King Conference, Community Beautification, and Assisting Seniors in the Community with home repairs.  The Bunny Hop 5k proceeds will directly go toward scholarships at the local high schools. If you would like to learn more about the Rotary Club of Antioch please visit www.antiochrotary.net

name: 11th Annual Native Breast Cancer Awareness Walk/Run
description:
Come enjoy a 1.4 mile walk or 2.8 mile run and a day of fun activities in 
support of NBCAWR. 


Early Bird Registration: $45 (starts June 16th; Ends Aug. 18th) 

**If you are a Breast Cancer Survivor, please contact Adiyama before registering: 
alecanadau@wiltonrancheria-nsn.gov

Late Registration: $55 (starts Aug. 19th; Closes Sep. 10th) with no guarantee 
of shirt size. 


Registration covers:  event t-shirt, swag bag, lunch, drinks, and raffle ticket. 


Fun Zone: carnival games, jump house, balloon artist and face painting. 


Extra Fun Stuff:  health booths, exercise, Garden of Hope, honoring of Breast 
Cancer survivors, traditional healing, live entertainment, lunch.  
Honoring Breast Cancer Survivors 

Our Mission: 
To increase breast cancer awareness and screening, especially for 
Native American women.  Breast cancer is the second leading cause of 
death for Native American women.  It's estimated that approximately 1 in 
8 women will get breast cancer in her lifetime.  Our goal is to raise 
awareness and encourage women to screen early. 


PACKET PICKUP 
Friday, October 10th (Office closed on Oct. 13th)  
Time: 2PM - 6PM

Location: Wilton Rancheria Tribal Warehouse (9728 Kent Street, Elk Grove)  

Parking is available in the parking lot in front of the warehouse or on the street.

name: 12th Annual Turkey Trot OC 5K
description:
2025 ONLINE REGISTRATION IS OPEN! 

Now in its 12th year, we invite you to join our annual Turkey Trot OC 5K on Thanksgiving morning at 8:00 am. Your participation will continue the work of ending homelessness one life at a time. 

Give a hand-up to OC families leaving homelessness behind! 

 

REGISTRATION

Every participant must be registered to take part in the race. 
Children aged three and under, including those in strollers, are welcome to join, but DO NOT need to register. However, they are not eligible to receive a T-shirt or a medal. 

 

PACKET PICK UP
Save time and pick up your packet on a day before the race. A person can pick up packets on behalf of other registrants. 
Packet pickup will be held on Monday, November 24th & Tuesday, November 25th from 3:30-6:00 pm at 1 Hope Drive, Tustin. 

**Packets can also be picked up the morning of the race from 6:30 am - 7:30 am. 

RACE-DAY SCHEDULE 
Pre-race refreshments -  6:30 am
5K Run/Walk starts -  8:00 am
Expo & awards -  following the race

**This event is rain or shine. 

AWARDS
Age Division awards will be given to the first and second place winner of each category:  9 & under, 10-14, 15-19, 20-29, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, 60-69, 70+.
Top Finisher prizes will also be given for both the top three male and female categories. 

 

GIVEAWAYS
T-shirts & medals will be distributed WHILE SUPPLIES LAST.

name: 13th Annual 5K Run & Walk for Kids' Growth - Los Angeles
description:
RAIN OR SHINE

Join the Human Growth Foundation (HGF) in collaboration with the Children's Hospital of Los Angeles and be part of a GROWing solution!

This community-friendly and leashed-dog-friendly event takes you through the beautiful Griffith Park. Designed for runners and non-runners alike, it encourages the highest level of community involvement. Participants can run or walk the 5K course—families and strollers are welcome!

By joining the 13th Annual 5K Run & Walk for Kids' Growth, you help raise awareness of childhood growth disorders and the importance of early diagnosis and treatment.

name: 13th Annual Luc's Run
description:
Luc's Run is held annually each spring in historic Tuolumne, California and Virtually Anywhere in the World. Luc's Run is known as one of the premier races in the county.  We are looking at welcoming our local 10K, 2-mile, and Kids Run (ages 10 & under) back to Tuolumne, CA in 2023! And of course welcoming our supporters around the globe through our virtual run where hundreds of enthusiasts from around the world walk and run in support of Luc’s legacy on their own turf with a virtual 1/2 marathon, 10K, 2-mile, and Kids Run (ages 10 & under). Sign up for two events and save 5%, sign up for all three and save 15%! 

On January 28, 2013, Luc, a United States Air Force pilot was on a training mission over the Adriatic Sea off the coast of Italy. During the sortie, Luc was forced to eject from his F-16 and did not survive the ejection.  Luc is survived by family and friends who continue his Legacy through the Major Lucas Gruenther Legacy Foundation.

Major Lucas Gruenther was an incredible human being.  He was an outstanding F-16 fighter pilot, community role model, and a true humanitarian.  He lived his life to the fullest and never took a single day for granted.  Luc is remembered for the way he treated people with wisdom and kindness and was a genuine human being who made a tremendous positive impact.

All proceeds from this race go to the Major Lucas Gruenther Legacy Foundation, an IRS-approved 501(c)(3) non-profit organization.  The purpose of the Major Lucas Gruenther Legacy Foundation is to bestow scholarships to Americans for the advancement of educational goals and self development.

name: 14th Annual GO2 SoCal 5k Walk/Run
description:
Join us for our annual 5k walk/run at beautiful Frank G. Bonelli Park*! Whether you walk or run the 5k, participate remotely or in person, come alone or recruit a team, you can step out, and raise funds for everyone impacted by lung cancer. 

We'll have activities for the whole family, including a walk/run, kids dash and more! All ages and abilities are welcome. 

*Vehicle entrance fee for the full day at Frank G. Bonelli Park on 10/11 is included with every registration. You can help your registration fee go further by covering your park fee upon arrival.

Join us for our annual 5k walk/run at beautiful Frank G. Bonelli Park*! Whether you walk or run the 5k, participate remotely or in person, come alone or recruit a team, you can step out, and raise funds for everyone impacted by lung cancer. 

We'll have activities for the whole family, including a walk/run, kids dash and more! All ages and abilities are welcome. 

*Vehicle entrance fee for the full day at Frank G. Bonelli Park on 10/11 is included with every registration. You can help your registration fee go further by covering your park fee upon arrival.

name: 15th Annual Reindeer Run/Walk
description:
Save the Date: the 15th Annual Reindeer Run will be here December 6th!

Come one, come all! There is something for everyone at the Reindeer Run. We welcome runners and walkers of every level to American Canyon on December 6th, beginning with pre-race festivities at 8am, and a staggered race start (10K at 9am, 5K at 9:05am for runners and 9:10am for walkers).  

 

This is a fun event for the whole family: kids 13-17 are $30 and youth 12 and under are $5 and include a finisher's medal and souvenir antlers! Early bird registration begins July 1st, so be ready to register to join in the fun!

 

*This event is contingent upon the requirements of Napa County Health Guidelines. If deemed necessary by the county, all in-person registrations will be switched to a virtual race. 


*Registration fees are non-refundable. Unused race fees are considered a donation to ACParks.

 

Need a race before the Reindeer Run? Be sure to check out these fantastic races on Thanksgiving Morning, November 27th:

Solano Turkey Trot, by Fleet Feet Vacaville

Napa Valley Turkey Chase, by Athletic Feat

name: 16th Annual Mardi Gras Madness 5K/10K!
description:
MARDI GRAS MADNESS IS BACK AND BIGGER THAN EVER FOR 2026!!!

ABOUT MARDI GRAS MADNESS
On Sunday, March 1, 2026, the members of the Junior Chamber International of Santa Clarita (JCI) and Santa Clarita Track Club are proud to present the 16th annual Mardi Gras Madness 5K/10K and Mini Madness 1K, benefiting JCI and Students Off And Running (SOAR) of Santa Clarita.  SOAR provides a fully supported Los Angeles Marathon training experience to SCV high school youth ages 14-18 at no cost to participants or their families, and is an Official Featured Charity of the 2026 Los Angeles Marathon.

Mardi Gras Madness is a premier family fun run / walk centered in the heart of the Santa Clarita Valley.  The event offers participants a scenic 5K / 10K USATF certified circuit course, chip timing, custom marathon quality finishers medal, tech T, health and fitness expo, beer garden, food, costume contest, games and giveaways, silent auction, celebrity hosting, and live entertainment. Mardi Gras Madness is open to strutters, strollers, and K9 participants as well. We hope to see you there!  Thanks for your support!

COURSE INFORMATION
MGM is a USATF certified rolling 5K/10K circuit run on paseos, with bridge overpasses that will challenge many runners, throughout the City and along the scenic South Fork River Trail. Please be advised, there is a dirt equestrian trail element as part of the 10K course from Mile 3.25 Mile 4.85. CLICK HERE for Course Details.

EARLY PACKET PICKUP AVAILABLE 
Early bib and packet pickup will be available 10:00am-4:00pm Saturday, February 28th in the Canyon Club courtyard just inside the rear entrance at Valencia Town Center in Valencia close to H&M. Valid ID is required to receive a 2026 - 8 One 8 - Beer Garden Access wristband. ​No exceptions will be granted.  Unfortunately, due to overwhelming demand, onsite registration cannot be guaranteed for 2026. CLICK HERE FOR EARLY PACKET PICKUP DETAILS. 

RACE DAY SCHEDULE
• Check-In/Pre-Registration only: 6:30am - 8:00am   
• 1K Warm Up: 7:25am
• 1K Start: 7:30am
• 5K/10K Warm Up: 7:55am
• 5K/10K Start: 8:00am
• Awards Ceremony/Drawing Giveaways: 9:30am
AWARDS• 1st - 3rd place age group awards in all 5K/10K race divisions as follows:
* 10 & Under
* 11-14
* 15-18
* 19-29
* 30-39
* 40-49
* 50-59
* 60 +
•  Awards for top three 5K/10K Women & Men Overall winners.
• Awards for top three Team Finishes.
• All 5K/10K runners receive a custom finishers medal, t-shirt & goodie bag!

GENERAL INFO
Location: Valencia Town Center
Dates: Sunday, March 1, 2026, 7:00 AM - 12:00 PM
Address:  Valencia Town Center - Valencia, CA 91355
Directions to Event: CLICK HERE

name: 2025 Brentwood Turkey Trot for Schools
description:
Welcome to the 12th annual Brentwood Turkey Trot for Schools.  This 5K event benefits both the Brentwood Union School District and Liberty Union High School District athletic programs. We are proud to host this community event to promote health, athletics, and education. 

 

In Person & Virtual Race Options

Participants can choose between an in-person or virtual run. For the in-person run,  the race will be at the Streets of Brentwood on Thanksgiving morning at 8:00 AM.  For the virtual run, you can run whenever and wherever you want starting on Monday, November 24 through Sunday, November 30.  All participants will receive a 2025 race t-shirt and medal.  

 

Race Fees*:

Children ages 3 and under are welcome to participate, no registration necessary.

August 9 - October 31, 2025

  • Ages 4-9 - $20
  • Ages 10-18 - $25
  • Ages 19 and up - $40

November 1 - November 26, 2025

  • Ages 4-9 - $20
  • Ages 10-18 - $30
  • Ages 19 and up - $45

Race Day Registration - November 27, 2025 (Only available if we have not sold out)

  • Ages 4-9 - $30
  • Ages 10-18 - $35
  • Ages 19 and up - $55

If you register on or after November 1st, you WILL NOT be asked to for a t-shirt size.  You will be able to select a t-shirt from a variety of sizes at packet pickup or on race day.  

*Processing fees will be added to your race fee.

Course Information:

For the safety of our trotters DOGS ARE NOT ALLOWED ON THE COURSE.
Strollers are allowed on the course if they are pushed by an adult.

 

Packet Pickup:

Participants can check-in and pick up their race bibs and t-shirt at packet pick up, scheduled for Wednesday, November 26th from 3:00 - 7:00 PM at Pioneer Elementary School located on Shady Willow Lane in Brentwood. *Please note virtual racers will need to pick up their shirt, bib, and medal at packet pickup or race day by 7:50 AM.  We are not able to ship out race swag.   In-person racers with guaranteed shirts sizes will need to pick up their shirts by 7:50 AM on race day or shirts will be released for shirt exchange.

name: 2025 Cal Tri LA - 10.19.25
description:
2025 Cal Tri LA - 10.19.25 Athletes will be charmed by the small-town feel of the Playa Del Rey beach community located south of Venice Beach and north of Manhattan Beach.

In SoCal, the convenience, safety and affordability of races like Cal Tri LA are few and far between. A quick Sunday morning drive to Playa del Rey, parking next to the transition along Dockweiler Beach and speedy morning packet pick-up providing athletes the opportunity to spend the morning focused on getting race ready. Athletes aren’t the only ones busy race morning. A full cadre of lifeguards from LA Beaches & Harbors and LAPD Traffic Officers are getting ready to keep athletes safe in the water and on the roads. Hours earlier, thousands of barricades, signs and cones are deployed on the bike and run course per the traffic control plan. Financially, the closer a venue is to a population center the higher the fee structure and producing a triathlon near LAX is no exception. However, tales of skyrocketing municipality fees are greatly exaggerated and Cal Tri Events remains lean with this year and next year’s prices locked in at 2015 rates.

14 EVENT OPTIONS. 7 Olympic distance events (Triathlon, Triathlon Relay, RunBikeRun, SwimBike, SwimRun, 1640 Yard Swim & 10K Run) and 7 Sprint distance events (Triathlon, Triathlon Relay, RunBikeRun, SwimBike, SwimRun, 400 yard Swim & 5K Run). Triathlon = swim + bike + run. Triathlon Relay is 2 or 3 athletes combined to complete the triathlon. Typically, the swim and run distances are standard but the bike distance varies from race to race. Check out the course maps for more detailed information.

TO DO. The Getty Center, Venice Canals Walkway, Skirball Cultural Center.

AIRPORT. Los Angeles (LAX)

AIR TEMPERATURE (AVG). 55 F / 81 F

WATER TEMPERATURE (AVG). 66 F. Wetsuit legal. Use the 20% CALTRI2025 discount code at blueseventy. Note: Fusion wetsuits not eligible for discount.

name: 2025 Cayucos Turkey Trot
description:
Thanksgiving Day Family 5k Fun Run / Walk

Check-in and bib pick-up will start Wednesday, November 26th at the Cayucos Pier from 2-4pm.  Each registered participant will have an assigned bib number and Thanksgiving-themed running socks, while supplies last.

On race day, check-in will begin at 7:30am.  We are set to start at 8:30am so be sure to give yourself enough time.  Dogs, strollers, and kiddos on scooters are all welcome.  

All proceeds will equally benefit Cayucos Elementary School and the California Association of Highway Patrolman Widows & Orphans' Trust Fund.

We'll forgive you if you have trouble concentrating on the road ahead of you while running The Humboldt Redwoods Marathon, half or 5K. After all, you'll probably be looking up at the old-growth redwood trees which tower over the course! This race is in Humboldt Redwoods State Park and the Half Marathon follows the second half of the iconic Avenue of the Giants Marathon course.

All courses are USATF Certified. The Marathon is a Boston qualifier. The race starts and finishes at the Dyerville Bridge.

name: 2025 Jingle Bell Run - Los Angeles, CA
description:
Get ready for this year’s Jingle Bell Run, the original festive race for charity brought to you by the Arthritis Foundation. Wear your favorite holiday gear, and let's jingle all the way toward a cure!

Whether you're running, walking, or strolling, bring your friends, family, and coworkers along for the ride. Together, we're spreading joy and making strides towards a brighter future — saying "YES" to life, despite arthritis.

Don't miss out on this special occasion to make a real difference while celebrating four decades of impact with the Jingle Bell Run. Let's lace up, hit the pavement, and jingle our way toward victory over arthritis!

name: 2025 Kaiser Permanente Get Fit Festival
description:
Not a runner or a biker… no problem!  Join the fun with lots of activities to choose from, including:

  • Food trucks – sample some of OC’s finest food trucks. Available from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m.
  • Thrive Apparel Blowout Sale – grab a workout shirt, shorts, hat, etc. at a great price (cash or check only) 
  • The Thrive Zone – try your luck at one of the challenging carnival games
  • The Fitness Zone – try Zumba, yoga, or line dancing.
  • The Kid’s Zone – bounce and blast your way through the kid’s zone (activities for ages 4-12)
  • Fitness and Health Expo – check out a new product or service from a select group of fitness and health professionals
  • Live music – hear the great sounds of Catfish Junction playing live on the main stage

name: 2025 Kindness Matters Walk - CA
description:
The Kindness Matters Walk will be held in-person in Fullerton, CA on Thanksgiving morning and virtually wherever you are for 2025!  All participants are encouraged to register online in advance of the walk.

How does the virtual walk work?  You can run, walk, rollerblade, kayak, or even push a stroller on your own 5K.  It’s your choice!  We will be streaming a live event complete with giveaways, contests, speakers, and more on 11/27/2025 at 8:00 am PST.  Post pictures of you/your group as you do your activity, and post to Facebook and Instagram with the hashtag "#KMWalk2025" - we would love to see you!

Event Challenge:

Starting on 11/14/25 through 11/26/25, participants can log miles walked, ran, biked or swam.  We'll have some awards for those participants with the most miles.  *** If you want to participate in the event challenge (i.e., who walks or runs the most miles), you will need to register for the virtual walk - and of course you are welcome to walk in-person on 11/27 in Fullerton even if you register for the virtual walk ***

Registration is simple - just click the "Sign Up" button to start your registration process.  Register yourself or others in your family/group - and please create or join an existing team if you'd like.  Registration is $20 per person ($10 for ages 0-18).  Each participant will have the option during the registration process to select an "add on" walk shirt.  The add-on purchase options will only be available until: 10/31/2025.

You also have the option to make a donation directly to the KM Legacy Fund at the Orange County Community Foundation at oc-cf.org - another great way to support the KM Legacy Foundation! (optional)

Kindness is cool ... and so are our sponsors!  You will see our event sponsors on the screens during registration.  Please help support these companies/groups as they have so generously supported the KM Legacy Foundation.  Thank you sponsors!

Proceeds from the KM Walk support brain tumor research at a national level, and young adult leadership development opportunities locally in the Fullerton Joint Union High School District.

name: 2025 Optimism Cal Tri Newport Dunes - 11.2.25
description:
2025 Optimism Cal Tri Newport Dunes - 11.2.25. Started in 1978 as the Human Race Triathlon, Cal Tri Newport Dunes is the longest running triathlon in the world operating from the same location. Also started in 1978 was the Ironman World Championship Triathlon Oahu but it moved to Kailua-Kona, Hawaii in 1981. This serves as the Cal Tri Events National Championship Race with registration in the 1500-2000 range.

12 EVENT OPTIONS. 6 Olympic distance events (Triathlon, RunBikeRun, SwimBike, SwimRun, 1640 Yard Swim & 10K Run) and 6 Sprint distance events (Triathlon,  RunBikeRun, SwimBike, SwimRun, 400 yard Swim & 5K Run). Triathlon = swim + bike + run. Typically, the swim and run distances are standard but the bike distance varies from race to race. Check out the course maps for more detailed information.

TO DO. Disneyland Park & California Adventure Park. Balboa Island Ferry. Newport Beach.

AIRPORT. John Wayne (SNA)

AIR TEMPERATURE (AVG). 60 F / 73 F

WATER TEMPERATURE (AVG). 65 F. Wetsuit legal. Use the 20% CALTRI2025 discount code at blueseventy. Note: Fusion wetsuits not eligible for discount.

TO DO. Disneyland Park & California Adventure Park. Balboa Island Ferry. Newport Beach.

AIRPORT. John Wayne (SNA)

AIR TEMPERATURE (AVG). 60 F / 73 F

WATER TEMPERATURE (AVG). 65 F. Wetsuit legal. Use the 20% CALTRI2025 discount code at blueseventy. Note: Fusion wetsuits not eligible for discount.

name: 2025 Pacific Palisades Turkey Trot
description:
The annual Pacific Palisades Turkey Trot celebrates its 11th Year on Thanksgiving Day 2025! Please come be part of the family fun...

REGISTER TODAY and join us at The Palisades Village Green in downtown Pacific Palisades on Thanksgiving morning -- November 27th -- to get your holiday season off to a running start!

(NOTE: The 10K course is a second lap of the 5K course)

In order to keep this tradition going strong, we must minimize the impact we place upon the neighborhoods along the course route. Being respectful to our community has always been an important priority as we strive to continue this holiday tradition.

10 Things to Know for About The 11th Annual Pacific Palisades Turkey Trot…(Please check back in October on updated site and parking information)

  1. Parking is available in and around the Alphabet Streets
  2. If you live near Palisades Village, please walk. Less cars = better experience for everyone involved with the event
  3. Head directly to Sunset & Swarthmore and look for the Registration Area
  4. Festivities start at 7:30 AM -- the earlier you come, the more fun your day will be
  5. Both the 5K and 10K start at 8:30 AM. The race program will conclude by 11AM
  6. Fast runners to the front. Slower runners, walkers and strollers please move to the back of the field
  7. Dogs allowed this year. Please lean up after your dog (bring bags) and be mindful of other runners.
  8. Medals and Water will be available at the Finish Line
  9. 5k runners ideally should finish by 9:30 AM. 10K runners by 10:30 AM
  10. Medical Staff will be on-site

name: 2025 PRE-SALE Ride Santa Barbara 100
description:
Ride Santa Barbara returns for its 14th year on October 18, 2025!

RideSB100 offers four distinct courses to suit a range of cycling abilities – each course offering a world-class Santa Barbara cycling experience! 🚵🏻‍♂️

All courses start along the beach and follow the beautiful Santa Barbara beachfront before turning inland to experience all Santa Barbara has to offer. Cyclists will wind through some of the most exclusive neighborhoods in the country; experience the rolling foothills lined with citrus and avocado orchards and climb some of the most famous mountains in the country, all while experiencing some of the most beautiful views in southern California.

 

All cyclists will receive:

  • Official 2025 RideSB100 t-shirt
  • Official 2025 RideSB100 water bottle
  • Official RideSB100 musette bag with sponsor goodies
  • Fully supported aid stations
  • Mechanical support
  • Finish Line Festival with Lots of food and beer
  • 100-mile riders get a commemorative coin at 50-mile mark
  • Age group medals for Gibraltar Challenge
  • Option to buy event Jersey $99; Shorts $99
  • And more!

All riders will receive an overall chip time and riders who participate in the Gibraltar Challenge will be ranked for the King and Queen of the Mountain (KOM/QOM) Jersey awards! 

 

RIDES*

 

100 mile 

The 100 mile course is one of the most beautiful and challenging 100 miles of riding you may ever accomplish!
Route includes the Santa Barbara waterfront, the foothills of Carpinteria and Montecito, the famous 7 mile climb up Gibraltar Road and the flatland’s of Goleta before finishing back at Chase Palm Park.

Recommended for experienced cyclists only - View Course

 

100 km + Gibraltar Challenge

62 miles of some of the most spectacular riding Santa Barbara has to offer.
Includes the famous 7 mile climb up Gibraltar Road without riding the full 100 mi distance!

Recommended for experienced cyclists - View Course

 

100 km Coastal Route - 4,000' of climbing

62 miles of some of the most spectacular riding Santa Barbara has to offer.
Intermediate to experienced level cyclists - View Course

 

34 miles - 2,200' of climbing 

Ride through some of the most exclusive neighborhoods in the country before turning inland to experience the back roads and rolling foothills of Santa Barbara with a few short climbs along the way.
Beginner to intermediate level cyclists - View Course

*Event details are subject to change.

 

Referral Program:

Refer 5 people, and receive a $50 refund!
Refer 10 people, and receive a FULL refund on your entry!

 

Charity

Ride to benefit MOVE Santa Barbara County! Help us raise needed donations and awareness for the great work they’re doing in Santa Barbara County. The mission of MOVE is to advocate for equitable county-wide infrastructure for walking, bicycling, and public transit and to empower and educate communities to choose active and sustainable forms of transportation. 

 

Registration Policy

Entry fees are NON-REFUNDABLE. Sorry, no exceptions. Once we receive and accept your entry, you will not receive a refund if you cannot participate. You may transfer your entry to another participant, but all transfers are subject to a $25.00 fee plus any difference in the registration price. 

For more information, visit our website ridesb100.com or e-mail our team at info@ridesb100.com.

 

Follow us on Facebook, Instagram, and Twitter! 

Subscribe to our e-newsletter! 📧

  • Finish Line Festival with Lots of food and beer
  • 100-mile riders get a commemorative coin at 50-mile mark
  • Age group medals for Gibraltar Challenge
  • Option to buy event Jersey $99; Shorts $99
  • And more!

All riders will receive an overall chip time and riders who participate in the Gibraltar Challenge will be ranked for the King and Queen of the Mountain (KOM/QOM) Jersey awards! 

 

RIDES*

 

100 mile 

The 100 mile course is one of the most beautiful and challenging 100 miles of riding you may ever accomplish!
Route includes the Santa Barbara waterfront, the foothills of Carpinteria and Montecito, the famous 7 mile climb up Gibraltar Road and the flatland’s of Goleta before finishing back at Chase Palm Park.

Recommended for experienced cyclists only - View Course

 

100 km + Gibraltar Challenge

62 miles of some of the most spectacular riding Santa Barbara has to offer.
Includes the famous 7 mile climb up Gibraltar Road without riding the full 100 mi distance!

Recommended for experienced cyclists - View Course

 

100 km Coastal Route - 4,000' of climbing

62 miles of some of the most spectacular riding Santa Barbara has to offer.
Intermediate to experienced level cyclists - View Course

 

34 miles - 2,200' of climbing 

Ride through some of the most exclusive neighborhoods in the country before turning inland to experience the back roads and rolling foothills of Santa Barbara with a few short climbs along the way.
Beginner to intermediate level cyclists - View Course

*Event details are subject to change.

 

Referral Program:

Refer 5 people, and receive a $50 refund!
Refer 10 people, and receive a FULL refund on your entry!

 

Charity

Ride to benefit MOVE Santa Barbara County! Help us raise needed donations and awareness for the great work they’re doing in Santa Barbara County. The mission of MOVE is to advocate for equitable county-wide infrastructure for walking, bicycling, and public transit and to empower and educate communities to choose active and sustainable forms of transportation. 

 

Registration Policy

Entry fees are NON-REFUNDABLE. Sorry, no exceptions. Once we receive and accept your entry, you will not receive a refund if you cannot participate. You may transfer your entry to another participant, but all transfers are subject to a $25.00 fee plus any difference in the registration price. 

For more information, visit our website ridesb100.com or e-mail our team at info@ridesb100.com.

 

Follow us on Facebook, Instagram, and Twitter!

name: 2025 RACE at Your Own Pace to #ShadeOutDM - "Together we can Wipe-Out DM"
description:
🐾 Baroooo! Welcome Everypawdy! 🐾
We’re tail-wagging excited that you’re joining us for this year’s RACE at Your Own Pace to #ShadeOutDM!

This year, we're doing things a little differently - and we can't wait to see how YOU Bark Out Loud for the pups! Our goal? To quadruple the awareness about Degenerative Myelopathy (DM) by inspiring dog lovers everywhere to take action alongside you.
Because let's face it - everyone knows at least one dog lover!

This year’s design gives you new and creative ways to build your own community, honor dogs past and present, and help prevent this heartbreaking disease.

 
🌟 Event Details

  • Location: Wherever you are! It’s virtual so walk, run, ride, or roll from your own neighborhood.
  • Dates:  November 9-16, 2025
  • Registration: FREE! (But we kindly suggest a $25 donation to help us continue our mission.)
  • RACE Packet, FAQs, and More: Scroll below for full details!

 ******************************************************

 🐶 Why We RACE

Because some pups can’t - and we can!
Degenerative Myelopathy (DM) is a devastating disease, but the good news is it’s preventable through proper genetic testing prior to breeding. Together, we’re barking out loud to spread awareness and save future pups.

 ****************************************************** 

🚶🏽‍♀️ Ways to Participate

Choose your style - move your way!

🏃 Competitive Runners

  • "The Fast & the Furriest 5K Run" - Fastest 5K in a single day
  • “Iron Paw Endurance Challenge” - Most miles run total over the week

🚶 Competitive Walkers

  • “The ShadeOutDM Sprint” - Longest distance walked in a single day (tie-breaker: fastest time)
  • “Miles for Mutts Marathon” - Most miles walked total over the week

🐕 Dog Jog

  • Are you already walking your dog daily? Make it count by participating virtually with your pup(s) – non competitive
  • There will be a special award for the “Top Dog Distance Challenge” - Top 10 distances on our WoofTrax Event

🐾 Couch Dog - (Supporter)

  • Don’t want to go out, but still want to cheer us on? This is your moment! Every event needs a barking fan club - and we know a few pups who’d rather bark from the window. WOOF, BORK, WOOF!

🚴 Cruisin’ for Dogs

  • 🚴 “Pedal for the Pups” (Bicycle) - Top Pedal-Powered Distance (Most miles ridden total over the week)
  • 🏍️ "The Ruff Riders " (Motorcycle) - Ruff Rider Mileage Master (Most miles ridden total over the week)
  • 🛴 ,"Sidewalk Surfers" (Scooter) - Scooter Squad Mileage Leader Distance Award (Most miles ridden total over the week)
  • 🛹 "Shreddin’ to Save Tails" (Skateboard) - Gnarliest Skate Miles Logged total over the week
  • 🛼 "Skates, Blades & Barks" (Roller skates, Roller blades, Ice Skates) - Distance Award (Most miles skated total over the week)
  • 🐴 "Hoofbeats for Hope" (horse) - Distance Award (Most miles ridden total over the week)

🏊‍♂️ Surf & Swim Supporters for Dogs

  • 🏊‍♂️ "The Big Splash Swim"  Furthest distance swam over the full week
  • 🏄‍♂️"Ride the Tide Challenge" Awards for the Most consecutive days surfed over the week

🐶 Aqua Paws - Pup Swim or Dog Surf

  • 🐶🏊 "Doggy Paddle Dash" - ALL swims logged will be eligible for additional PRIZES!
  • 🐶🏄 "Surf’s Pup Showdown" - ALL rides logged will be eligible for additional PRIZES! 

NEW! ♿ Wheelin’ Warriors 💪💜 - for our handi’cappable people and pups with any type of disability or special need who want to roll, stroll, or simply be part of the race community! 

We proudly include participants using wheelchairs, mobility scooters, adaptive devices, or living with mobility, sensory, cognitive, or chronic health conditions - and of course, our amazing pups in wheels too. 🐾🦽

  • "Pups With Grit" (pups in wheels) - ALL rides logged will be eligible for additional PRIZES!
  • "Racing with Heart" (people in wheels) - ALL rides logged will be eligible for additional PRIZES!
  • "Rolling, Not Strolling" (mobility scooters) - ALL rides logged will be eligible for additional PRIZES!
  • "Adaptive Allies" (handicappable people) - ALL walks logged will be eligible for additional PRIZES!

You're not just joining a race, you’re helping us show the world what strength, heart, and inclusion really look like.

 

*Log your miles by using our Group "2025 Walk to Wipe-Out DM by ShadeOutDM" on WoofTrax https://link.wooftrax.com/lxa416 
 

******************************************************

👕 How to Get Your Official RACE T-Shirt

Only participants who raise $200 or more will receive an official Shade Out DM Race T-Shirt!
This reward is based on individual fundraising totals - not team totals or general donations - so be sure your donations are credited to your personal page!

Check out our Fundraising Prize Wave (below) 

🎯 Make it your goal to earn a shirt, and challenge your friends, family, and coworkers to earn theirs too!

 ******************************************************

📌 How to Sign Up

  1. Register Online
    Choose to support an existing team or start your own.
  2. Start a Warrior Team
    If your dog has taken or is taking the DM journey, start a Warrior Team in their honor. (You don't have to have a pup with DM to start a team, Teams can be Advocacy, Corporate, Rescues, Schools, Clubs, etc.)
  3. Get Your Bib
    You’ll receive a race bib via email (check spam or log into your profile).
  4. Strike a Pose!
    Snap a photo of your pup (or stuffed animal!) wearing sunglasses and your race bib.
  5. Post & Tag!
    Share on social media during race week and tag #ShadeOutDM in ALL your posts!
    (Let’s flood the feed and get people asking, “What’s DM?”)

 ****************************************************** 

🧬 About Degenerative Myelopathy (DM)

DM is often called the canine version of ALS (Lou Gehrig’s Disease). It’s a progressive, genetic disease affecting the spinal cord and over 100 dog breeds (& mixed breeds now too). Symptoms usually appear between ages 8-14, starting with ONE hind-leg weakness & loss of coordination, eventually leading to full paralysis, incontinence, organ failure, and respiratory failure all while their mind is still fully aware.

The tragedy?

  • Many vets still don’t know about DM
  • It’s often misdiagnosed
  • It’s entirely preventable with genetic testing

DM is on the rise - NOW is the time to speak up for the pups!

******************************************************

💜 About Shade Out DM Foundation

Shade Out DM Foundation is a 100% volunteer-run, registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization. We are dedicated to:
📚 Educating ~ 💬 Supporting ~ ♿ Loaning ~ 📣 Advocating

Our Mission:
To improve the health and well-being of dogs affected by DM while preventing future cases through awareness and education.

Your Support Helps:

  • Fund KC’s Kruisers Loaner Cart Program for dogs in need
  • Attend veterinary and breed-specific conferences
  • Contribute to DM research
  • Provide awareness materials and educational outreach

All proceeds go directly toward these efforts.
🌐 Donate at: www.shadeoutdm.org

 
Let’s RACE to #ShadeOutDM - because no dog should suffer needlessly!
Together, we can make a difference. 💜🐾

description:
🐾 Baroooo! Welcome Everypawdy! 🐾
We’re tail-wagging excited that you’re joining us for this year’s RACE at Your Own Pace to #ShadeOutDM!

This year, we're doing things a little differently - and we can't wait to see how YOU Bark Out Loud for the pups! Our goal? To quadruple the awareness about Degenerative Myelopathy (DM) by inspiring dog lovers everywhere to take action alongside you.
Because let's face it - everyone knows at least one dog lover!

This year’s design gives you new and creative ways to build your own community, honor dogs past and present, and help prevent this heartbreaking disease.

 
🌟 Event Details

  • Location: Wherever you are! It’s virtual so walk, run, ride, or roll from your own neighborhood.
  • Dates:  November 9-16, 2025
  • Registration: FREE! (But we kindly suggest a $25 donation to help us continue our mission.)
  • RACE Packet, FAQs, and More: Scroll below for full details!

 ******************************************************

 🐶 Why We RACE

Because some pups can’t - and we can!
Degenerative Myelopathy (DM) is a devastating disease, but the good news is it’s preventable through proper genetic testing prior to breeding. Together, we’re barking out loud to spread awareness and save future pups.

 ****************************************************** 

🚶🏽‍♀️ Ways to Participate

Choose your style - move your way!

🏃 Competitive Runners

  • "The Fast & the Furriest 5K Run" - Fastest 5K in a single day
  • “Iron Paw Endurance Challenge” - Most miles run total over the week

🚶 Competitive Walkers

  • “The ShadeOutDM Sprint” - Longest distance walked in a single day (tie-breaker: fastest time)
  • “Miles for Mutts Marathon” - Most miles walked total over the week

🐕 Dog Jog

  • Are you already walking your dog daily? Make it count by participating virtually with your pup(s) – non competitive
  • There will be a special award for the “Top Dog Distance Challenge” - Top 10 distances on our WoofTrax Event

🐾 Couch Dog - (Supporter)

  • Don’t want to go out, but still want to cheer us on? This is your moment! Every event needs a barking fan club - and we know a few pups who’d rather bark from the window. WOOF, BORK, WOOF!

🚴 Cruisin’ for Dogs

  • 🚴 “Pedal for the Pups” (Bicycle) - Top Pedal-Powered Distance (Most miles ridden total over the week)
  • 🏍️ "The Ruff Riders " (Motorcycle) - Ruff Rider Mileage Master (Most miles ridden total over the week)
  • 🛴 ,"Sidewalk Surfers" (Scooter) - Scooter Squad Mileage Leader Distance Award (Most miles ridden total over the week)
  • 🛹 "Shreddin’ to Save Tails" (Skateboard) - Gnarliest Skate Miles Logged total over the week
  • 🛼 "Skates, Blades & Barks" (Roller skates, Roller blades, Ice Skates) - Distance Award (Most miles skated total over the week)
  • 🐴 "Hoofbeats for Hope" (horse) - Distance Award (Most miles ridden total over the week)

🏊‍♂️ Surf & Swim Supporters for Dogs

  • 🏊‍♂️ "The Big Splash Swim"  Furthest distance swam over the full week
  • 🏄‍♂️"Ride the Tide Challenge" Awards for the Most consecutive days surfed over the week

🐶 Aqua Paws - Pup Swim or Dog Surf

  • 🐶🏊 "Doggy Paddle Dash" - ALL swims logged will be eligible for additional PRIZES!
  • 🐶🏄 "Surf’s Pup Showdown" - ALL rides logged will be eligible for additional PRIZES! 

NEW! ♿ Wheelin’ Warriors 💪💜 - for our handi’cappable people and pups with any type of disability or special need who want to roll, stroll, or simply be part of the race community! 

We proudly include participants using wheelchairs, mobility scooters, adaptive devices, or living with mobility, sensory, cognitive, or chronic health conditions - and of course, our amazing pups in wheels too. 🐾🦽

  • "Pups With Grit" (pups in wheels) - ALL rides logged will be eligible for additional PRIZES!
  • "Racing with Heart" (people in wheels) - ALL rides logged will be eligible for additional PRIZES!
  • "Rolling, Not Strolling" (mobility scooters) - ALL rides logged will be eligible for additional PRIZES!
  • "Adaptive Allies" (handicappable people) - ALL walks logged will be eligible for additional PRIZES!

You're not just joining a race, you’re helping us show the world what strength, heart, and inclusion really look like.

 

*Log your miles by using our Group "2025 Walk to Wipe-Out DM by ShadeOutDM" on WoofTrax https://link.wooftrax.com/lxa416 
 

******************************************************

👕 How to Get Your Official RACE T-Shirt

Only participants who raise $200 or more will receive an official Shade Out DM Race T-Shirt!
This reward is based on individual fundraising totals - not team totals or general donations - so be sure your donations are credited to your personal page!

Check out our Fundraising Prize Wave (below) 

🎯 Make it your goal to earn a shirt, and challenge your friends, family, and coworkers to earn theirs too!

 ******************************************************

📌 How to Sign Up

  1. Register Online
    Choose to support an existing team or start your own.
  2. Start a Warrior Team
    If your dog has taken or is taking the DM journey, start a Warrior Team in their honor. (You don't have to have a pup with DM to start a team, Teams can be Advocacy, Corporate, Rescues, Schools, Clubs, etc.)
  3. Get Your Bib
    You’ll receive a race bib via email (check spam or log into your profile).
  4. Strike a Pose!
    Snap a photo of your pup (or stuffed animal!) wearing sunglasses and your race bib.
  5. Post & Tag!
    Share on social media during race week and tag #ShadeOutDM in ALL your posts!
    (Let’s flood the feed and get people asking, “What’s DM?”)

 ****************************************************** 

🧬 About Degenerative Myelopathy (DM)

DM is often called the canine version of ALS (Lou Gehrig’s Disease). It’s a progressive, genetic disease affecting the spinal cord and over 100 dog breeds (& mixed breeds now too). Symptoms usually appear between ages 8-14, starting with ONE hind-leg weakness & loss of coordination, eventually leading to full paralysis, incontinence, organ failure, and respiratory failure all while their mind is still fully aware.

The tragedy?

  • Many vets still don’t know about DM
  • It’s often misdiagnosed
  • It’s entirely preventable with genetic testing

DM is on the rise - NOW is the time to speak up for the pups!

******************************************************

💜 About Shade Out DM Foundation

Shade Out DM Foundation is a 100% volunteer-run, registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization. We are dedicated to:
📚 Educating ~ 💬 Supporting ~ ♿ Loaning ~ 📣 Advocating

Our Mission:
To improve the health and well-being of dogs affected by DM while preventing future cases through awareness and education.

Your Support Helps:

  • Fund KC’s Kruisers Loaner Cart Program for dogs in need
  • Attend veterinary and breed-specific conferences
  • Contribute to DM research
  • Provide awareness materials and educational outreach

All proceeds go directly toward these efforts.
🌐 Donate at: www.shadeoutdm.org

 
Let’s RACE to #ShadeOutDM - because no dog should suffer needlessly!
Together, we can make a difference. 💜🐾

name: 2025 SHAY 5K Run/Walk
description:
Spreading Help Around You is a 501(c)3 non-profit organization that was founded in 2014 in honor of Shaylyn Anela Pinoliar, who tragically passed away on November 14, 2012. Our mission is to help and support families who have lost a loved one, educate them on the importance of being prepared during such a time of loss, and provide active service to the community.  As well as promote Pedestrian Safety Awareness. This year we proudly launched the SHAY Scholarship Program, making an exciting new chapter in our commitment to supporting education and empowering future leaders. 

Each year, since Shaylyn’s passing, family, friends, and community members gather to honor her memory with an Annual 5k Run/Walk on Thanksgiving morning. Last year, we changed the event to be held on the Saturday after Thanksgiving. It was a great success, and we look forward to continuing the tradition this year to honor her memory.

name: 2025 Winters Spooktacular Fun Run and Costume Contest
description:
DOWNTOWN WINTERS HARVEST FESTIVAL:

The three day Downtown Winters Harvest Festival will be on October 24th, 25th and ending on October 26th. The festival will include harvest themed events that are fun for the whole family the entire weekend. The 2025 Winters Spooktacular Fun Run and Costume Contest is part of the Winters Harvest Festival. 

RACE EVENT DESCRIPTION:

Grab your costume and running shoes and head out to the 2025 Winters Runners and Walkers Club Spooktacular Fun Run and Costume Contest on Sunday, October 26th.  We’re going to have a WICKEDLY good time.  This event is a thriller for the entire family.  In addition to the 5K & 10K, kids will scream with excitement on the 1 Mile Monster Dash. We will have an individual costume contest, as well as a best group costume contest.  Please join us for Winter’s 6th Annual Halloween Fun Run sponsored by the Winters Runners and Walkers Club. So if you dare to challenge yourself to a spooky fun time, sign up TODAY and we’ll be waiting for you at the starting line…  Trick-or-Treat!  Happy Halloween!  Nutrishop Electrolyte mix will be available at one of the the 5k/10k course water stations and GU Stroopwafels.

ONLINE REGISTRATION CLOSING:

Cutoff date for Online Registration is 10/24/25 at 11:59 PM.

REGISTRATION AND PACKET/PU:

Late Registration and Packet Pick-up 10/25/25 (Saturday) in front of Berryessa Gap Vineyards Tasting Room 15 Main Street Winters, Ca 95694 Winters from 10am-4pm & Race Day 10/26/25 (Sunday Race Day) at Rotary Park, corner of Railroad St. and  Main Street, Winters, Ca 95694 from 6:30-9:30am.  Sunday Race Day registrations close at the start of each race. 

START TIMES:

8:00am Start 10K (3 Hour Limit after race start time)

8:10am Start  5K (3 Hour Limit after race start time) 

9:30am 1 Mile Kids Monster Dash and 1Mile Adult

REGISTERED PARTICIPANTS:

All Races Finishers receive custom medals. 5K and 10K finishers receives Chip Timing. 1 mile Adult, 5K and 10K Finishers receives a custom medal + Tech Tee + One Free Hooby’s beverage (must be 21 years old for beer) (wine not Included) “ONLY FOR USE ON 10/26 FROM 8:00AM-12:00PM”. 1 Mile Monster Dash Finishers receives a custom medal + Tech Tee.

All Shirts Guaranteed before 10/10/25).  

NOTE:

The 5K & 10K course is open to regular traffic, please observe all traffic laws. Volunteers may be at intersections along the course. The 5K & 10K course will start opening sometime after 10:00 AM, there is a 3 hour timed course Limit for 5K and 10K race after the race start times. The start line will be separated by Pace Markers. 

AWARDS:

Place Awards for 5K&10K Male and Female 1st, 2nd, 3rd place winners. Costume Contest prizes for Individual and Best Group choices 5k / 10K and 1 mile monster dash.

1 mile Monster Dash $20.00. 1 mile individual adult/teen $20.00.

5K 4/21 until 9/12 $30.00. 9/13 until 10/26 $35.00, then $40.00 on Race Day.

10K 4/21 until 9/12 $35.00, 9/13 until 10/26 $40.00. then $45.00 on Race Day.

The three day Downtown Winters Harvest Festival will be on October 24th, 25th and ending on October 26th. The 2025 Winters Spooktacular Fun Run and Costume Contest is part of the Winters Harvest Festival.

Grab your costume and running shoes and head out to the 2025 Winters Runners and Walkers Club Spooktacular Fun Run and Costume Contest on Sunday, October 26th.  We’re going to have a WICKEDLY good time.  This event is a thriller for the entire family.  In addition to the 5K & 10K, kids will scream with excitement on the 1 Mile Monster Dash. We will have an individual costume contest, as well as a best group costume contest.  Please join us for Winter’s 6th Annual Halloween Fun Run sponsored by the Winters Runners and Walkers Club. name: 2026 Avenue of the Giants Marathon
description: The Avenue of the Giants is one of the most beautiful races in the world!  It runs through old growth redwoods and follows a natural creek in the middle of a state park.  Staged on "The Avenue of the Giants" in Humboldt Redwoods State Park, located in rural Northern California. Course is on a paved road that winds gently up hill but is mostly a flat, fast destination race.  With little to distract you, the tall trees inspire the athlete in each of us to be strong.  The course is certified and the marathon is a Boston Qualifying event.

name: 2026 Cal Tri Castaic Lake - 6.20.26
description:
2026 Cal Tri Castaic Lake - 6.20.25

18 EVENT OPTIONS. 6 Olympic distance events (Triathlon, RunBikeRun, SwimBike, SwimRun, 1640 Yard Swim & 10K Run), 6 Sprint distance events (Triathlon, RunBikeRun, SwimBike, SwimRun, 400 yard Swim & 5K Run) and 6 Youth Sprint distance events (Triathlon, RunBikeRun, SwimBike, SwimRun, 400 yard Swim & 5K Run). Triathlon = swim + bike + run. Typically, the swim and run distances are standard but the bike distance varies from race to race. Check out the course maps for more detailed information.

CASTAIC LAKE. 
The 35th annual Castaic Lake Triathlon takes place at scenic Castaic Lake just 20 miles north of Los Angeles. The Castaic Lake Recreation Area, located just north of Santa Clarita, is an 11,200-acre multi-use facility with two lakes, boating, world class fishing, hiking, walking, horseback riding, wake boarding, jet-skiing, camping, picnicking, kayaking, and sailing.  August is a great time to enjoy the water in the high 60s, and a staging area aptly named Paradise Cove. "Tri-cation" Friday night camping available through Castaic Lake.


THE COURSE. 
The swim course is a modified V shape in Paradise Cove at Castaic Lake, with 8 lifeguards in the water on paddleboards.  The bike course then goes out on back roads to limit your interaction with cars.  The bike course does include some U-turns on back roads to allow this, so athletes should slow down at the turn around points.  The run is primarily on the rolling trails overlooking Castaic Lake. 

WHO WE SUPPORT
All proceeds will benefit the Canyon High School Cross Country and Track Teams (we've been doing this for 33 years to support our programs).  

This is a great triathlon for new triathletes.  For years our coaches and athletes have encouraged new triathletes (young and old), and created a welcoming atmosphere of support.  We offer an enjoyable experience for triathletes of all experience levels.  


AIR TEMPERATURE (AVG).
Mid June temperatures are often cooler in the morning, with early morning fog burning off to reach the mid 80s.  Our event will possibly be around 60 degrees.

WATER TEMPERATURE (AVG). 

Water temps in June typically range in the mid to high 60s.  Email updates will be sent out closer to the race with updates. Use the 20% CALTRI2025 discount code at blueseventy. Note: Fusion wetsuits not eligible for discount.

description:
🏁 2026 Challenge: Run, Walk & Bike 2,026 Miles in 2026! 🏁

 
Starts January 1, 2026 - Embark on an EPIC year-long fitness journey! Whether you choose to complete this SOLO or TEAM up with friends, the goal is to cover 2,026 miles between January 1 and December 31, 2026
 
🧍‍♀️ Solo Challenger
Take on the full 2,026 miles on your own. Every mile you run, walk, or bike counts toward your personal achievement.

 

👥 Team Challenger
Form a team of 2+ participants and divide the 2,026 miles in any way you choose. Each team member will receive their own Finisher's Medal and Race Shirt in the mail!

 

Registration Includes:
  • Finisher's Medal: Celebrate your achievement with a BADASS medal!
  • 2026 Challenge Shirt or Tank Top: Buttery-soft apparel to showcase your accomplishment.
  • Official "2,026 Miles" Sticker: Display your commitment proudly.
  • RaceJoy App: Sync your activities and track progress on the live leaderboard.
  • Live Leaderboard: Stay motivated by seeing how you and others are progressing.
  • Custom Finisher's Certificate: Personalized recognition of your success.
  • Milestone Achievement Awards: Earn accolades as you reach key milestones.
  • Free Shipping within the USA
  • Charitable Donation to "Direct Relief"- more info on our website

name: 2026 Disneyland® Half Marathon Weekend presented by HONDA
description:
In 2026, runDisney® is going to “Celebrate Happy” during the Disneyland® Half Marathon Weekend presented by HONDA, January 29–February 1. Happening amid the 70th anniversary of the Disneyland® Resort, this race weekend will be centered around some of the different ways to celebrate what delights us most. So come enjoy miles of smiles during a 5K hosted by Joy from Disney and Pixar’s Inside Out. Join Sorcerer’s Apprentice Mickey in an imaginative 10K. Run together with a friend as part of an “it’s a small world®” attraction-themed half marathon. And, for the ultimate achievement, take on the Dumbo Double Dare challenge made up of both the 10K and the half marathon. There are even Kids’ Races hosted by Stitch and morning yoga with Miss Piggy. As always, magic and one-of-a-kind medals are included.

 

Participants must attend the runDisney Health & Fitness Expo at least one day prior to their first event to pick up their race bib, participant shirt and pre-purchased merchandise. The Expo takes place Thursday, January 29 – Saturday, January 31.

name: 2026 Lake Chabot Trail Challenge (Half Marathon & 5K)
description:
“Beginning July 1, 2024, the “Honest Pricing Law” or “Hidden Fees Statute,” SB 478, makes it illegal for businesses to advertise or list a price for a good or service that does not include all required fees or charges other than certain government taxes and shipping costs.”

RACE INFO: We are so excited to celebrate the 42nd annual Lake Chabot Trail Challenge Half Marathon and 5K. This race is well regarded amongst serious trail runners in the outlying areas. The race begins at 8am for the Half Marathon and 8:30am for the 5K. Please arrive early so that you may find parking, pick up your bibs, use restrooms facilities, and be properly prepared to race before the start. Race takes place rain or shine and there are no refunds.

RACE COURSE: The half marathon course is a scenic, hilly loop, mainly on dirt fire roads.  The ridge-line views look down upon scenic Lake Chabot, surrounding grassy slopes, and eucalyptus groves.  Mt. Diablo and San Francisco Bay are visible along the route. There are water stations with first aid and radio support; we recommend bringing your own hydration as well.  The half marathon has a time limit of 3.5 hours. The 5k (3.1 miles) course is an out and back that has gentle rolling hills and consists mostly of paved surfaces.  This route includes one water station with first aid and radio support.

RACE FEE: Pre-registered runners will be guaranteed a t-shirt if registered by Sunday, May 10th, 2026.  The price for the 5K is $40 and Half Marathon $65. You must register by Saturday, June 6th. We will accept race day registration; however, the price for the 5K is $45 and Half Marathon $70. If you register on race day, we can only accept cash, check or Venmo.

There is a nominal fee (~$5) for Chabot parking lot. Free parking on Lake Chabot Rd and nearby streets.

RACE PACKET & BIB PICK-UP:  We will have race packet and bib pick-up on Sunday, June 7th starting at 7am at the Willow picnic site which is also the finish line area. We will not be mailing out any race packets or bibs. Both races are chip-timed.

T-SHIRT: Entry fee includes short sleeve, high quality t-shirts for registrations by May 10th so sign-up early.  There are no guarantee of t-shirts for runners registered after that date and on race day. We ask for those who did not get a shirt to check in after the race. Please ensure that you select the appropriate t-shirt size. We will not be doing any size exchanges from your original request.

AWARDS: Finisher's medals to those who complete their race.  Age division medals given to the top 3 in each of 12 age divisions in the half marathon and 9 age divisions in the 5K.

Photos:  Race photos are being provided by Darrell Lavin of Darrell Lavin Photography. You will receive an email post-race for instructions on how to access and purchase official race photos.

QUESTIONS: If you have any questions, please contact Rachel Lunt at teamlunt07@gmail.com.

DIRECTIONS: The entrance closest to the event's parking lot is: 17404 Lake Chabot Road, Castro Valley, CA 94546.  On Google Maps, this will appear as "Entry of Lake Chabot Parking Space."  The registration area and start lines are just a few minutes walk from the lot ( just follow the signs).

name: 20th Annual Freedom Run on the Ranch - July 4th 2026
description:
A Ladera Ranch tradition - The Freedom Run on the Ranch is happy to invite you to run in the kids Firecracker 1k or our 5k and 10k runs.  The event provides our community the ability to support local charities through the race registration proceeds and sponsorship opportunities.  We encourage all to enjoy this great opportunity to celebrate our national holiday and have a little fun while running the streets of your community.  We will  have several festivities to support the runners and non-participants at the event with a breakfast and sponsor vendor area during the morning event.  Please help us celebrate the 4th of July festivities and raise awareness and much needed support to the charities.  Remember price increases on June 22nd.  Also help support our charities by purchasing breakfast from participating local restaurants.  All proceeds benefit the charities.

Packet Pickup - TBD

Race Day Calendar:

6:00 am Race Registration opens

7:00 am - 10k run starts

8:30 am - 5k run starts

8:00 am - XclusiveTaqueria Moderna Pancake breakfast begins

9:45 am - Kids 1k run starts

11:00 am - Event ends

name: 310K Run/walk powered by Leslie Cohen Law
description:
Leslie Cohen Law PC is once again proud to be hosting the 310K Run/Walk, a 5K event that raises funds for the Public Counsel Debtor Assistance Project. Now in its 14th year, the 310K is a community-driven race that takes place right on the beach in Santa Monica, drawing many returning runners and walkers year after year. The event welcomes participants of all paces—whether you're running to set a new personal record or walking with friends to support a great cause. With in-person and virtual options, the 310K offers a meaningful way to give back while enjoying one of the most scenic race routes in beautiful LA.

NEW DATE & LOCATION!

This year, the 310K will take place on Sunday, November 23rd—a great way to kick off Thanksgiving week with purpose and community spirit.

We're also excited to announce a new start and finish location at Tongva Park (at Ocean Ave. & Colorado Blvd.), just a few steps from the iconic Santa Monica Pier.

Our Beneficiary

Proceeds from the 310K support the Public Counsel Debtor Assistance Project (DAP), which provides free bankruptcy-related legal services to individuals and families across Greater Los Angeles. Through clinics, educational workshops, and one-on-one legal representation, DAP helps clients understand their rights, navigate the legal system, and find paths toward financial stability. DAP is part of Public Counsel, the largest pro bono legal aid organization in the United States. Leslie Cohen Law PC received the James King Community Service Award from Public Counsel in 2016 in recognition of the impact of the 310K.

name: 36th Annual Lopers Club Holiday Classic Half Marathon, 10K, and 5K
description:
The Lopers Club and the City of Loma Linda present the 36th annual Lopers Club Holiday Classic Half Marathon, 10K, and 5K! The Holiday Classic is the Inland Empire’s longest running annual holiday running event and a local tradition for runners and walkers of all ages and abilities!

Location

The race Start/Finish will take place in front of the Loma Linda Fire Station located at 11325 Loma Linda Drive in Loma Linda. Park in any nearby lot except for the Veteran's Hospital.

Event information

This year’s event will take place on Sunday, December 7, 2025. The Half Marathon and 5K will run simultaneously. Start time is 7:00 am. The Half Marathon has a course limit of 4 hours which is allows for walkers who can maintain an 18 minute per mile average pace. There will be many walkers as well as runners in both the 5k and Half Marathon.

The Start/Finish Line will be located near the corner of Barton Road and Loma Linda Drive, in front of the Loma Linda Fire station.

Event features

The Holiday Classic Half Marathon, 10K,  and 5K run/walk, provides scenic mountain views with stimulating inclines on a course which winds through the lovely streets of Loma Linda. Beautiful, long-sleeved tech shirts will be provided for all participants who register prior to November 9, 2025. Participants registering after the cutoff will receive a shirt while supplies last, we might not have your size if you register in less than three weeks before the event. All finishers of both the Half Marathon and the 5K event will be awarded beautiful finishers' medals. Trophies will be awarded to the overall top male and female winner of each race. Division medals will be awarded to the 1st, 2nd and 3rd place male and female finishers in each of 20 age divisions. Bring the kids! The Holiday Classic includes a ¼ mile Elves Trot fun run for children ages 3-6. Every participating elf will receive an adorable Santa medal.

Post-race festivities

All participants of the Half Marathon and 5K will receive a free breakfast. There is a $3 charge for Elves Trot participants. Also free to all participants, a soothing, post-race mini-massage provided by gentle therapists from Precision in Movement.

Groups/teams

Create a team for your family, friends and coworkers to join. Each team participant will get a $5 discount for teams of between 5 and 14 participants. Each participant will get a $10 discount for teams of greater than 15 participants.

Bib pickup and registration

Pick up your shirt and bib Saturday, December 6, from 10 am to 3 pm, at Running Center in Redlands (1430 Industrial Park Avenue).

Volunteer check-in

Volunteers can pick up their volunteer assignments and T-shirts Saturday, December 6, from 10 am to 3 pm, at Running Center in Redlands (1430 Industrial Park Avenue).

Holiday Toy Drive

Join the Loma Linda Fire Department and ABC7 in the 33nd annual Spark of Love Toy Drive--the largest community toy drive in the nation.

The fire department will be accepting new, unwrapped toys and sports equipment for under-served children and teens. The toys collected will be donated to families within our own community.

Donations are also accepted at both Loma Linda fire stations and at Loma Linda City Hall.

The Spark of Love Toy Drive embodies the spirit of compassion, generosity and community involvement during the holiday season.

name: 39th Annual Tinsel Triathlon
description:
Tinsel Triathlon & 5K
Reverse Sprint Pool Triathlon
As one of the oldest and largest independently owned reverse sprint pool triathlons on the West Coast, it is certainly an ideal end of the season endurance race.  The 35 year old event truly can be the perfect venue for Triathletes of all levels.  For first timers who have always wanted to be triathletes the course is well defined, attainable and loaded with helpful volunteers.  We are also an awesome setting for the seasoned triathlete. The course layout lets you push yourself hard for a solid workout.  What better way to get your game on ... Reverse Sprint Pool Triathlon!

The Tinsel is a Sunday Triathlon run on a usually sunny, yet crisp, Southern California day with all roads closed and the coffee hot.  The 5K run takes place in a scenic, calm area of West Hemet, California in Riverside County.   Known as a "flat & fast" course, the 12 mile bike ride gives the rider a feeling of being on the country roadside.  The race ends in the 25 meter heated pool at West Valley High School, triathletes will swim 150 meters (up & back 6 times) to the finish line where you receive a unique Tinsel finisher medal.  The awards ceremony follows immediately and the bling is top shelf!

name: 39th Golden Gate Park XC Open    hosting the                                 USATF Masters 5k XC National Championships
description:
HOTEL

San Francisco Marriott Fisherman's Wharf, 1250 Columbus Ave, San Francisco, CA 94133

(415) - 775 - 7555

Special rate of $149/night (limited number of rooms; don't delay, book today!)  Must book by OCTOBER 10th.

Please call the hotel directly and ask for the USATF group rate for the Masters Cross Country Championship event, or use the link below by copy/paste into your browser address bar:

https://www.marriott.com/event-reservations/reservation-link.mi?id=1757618926213&key=GRP&app=resvlink

Declarations for the Masters race and bib pickup will be at this hotel on Friday.

**NO RACE DAY REGISTRATION**

Masters runners MUST run in the Masters races to be eligible for scoring for Masters teams (both for the USATF Masters 5k XC National Championship, and for the Pacific Association XC Grand Prix) and for Individual Masters awards.

YES!  Masters runners can run in BOTH the Masters race and the Open race!  Your result from the Masters race will count towards team scoring, PA Grand Prix, and National Championship.  The result from the Open race would count to complete an Open team for the PA Grand Prix, and for fun!

A 5k cross country race consisting of two loops (1 big loop, followed by 1 little loop) in beautiful Golden Gate Park.  This historic and iconic race is a staple event on the Pacific Association of USATF annual Cross Country Grand Prix, and also serves as a venue preview race for the Pacific Association XC Championship race.  Race against some of the best athletes on the west coast, traversing over grass, dirt, and rolling hills.   

This year, we are honored to host the USATF Masters 5k XC National Championship!  Masters athletes from all over the US will compete for bragging rights, glory, and memories that will last a lifetime.

For the Open races ONLY: Bib transfers available race morning with a fee of $10.  Absolutely no bib transfers for the Masters races.

This year, we are honored to host the USATF Masters 5k XC National Championship!  Masters athletes from all over the US will compete for bragging rights, glory, and memories that will last a lifetime.

For the Open races ONLY: Bib transfers available race morning with a fee of $10.  Absolutely no bib transfers for the Masters races.
