name: 3rd Annual Jerry's Miles for Manhattans
description:
We are back for YEAR 3! A walk honoring the one and only Jerry Fourie! Jerry has done so much for the Pleasanton community, specifically in the area of sports and he was/is truly one of the best there ever will be. Walk participants will loop the Pleasanton Sports Complex to honor him and cherish the memories we had both on and off the softball field. Please join us on December 20th, 2025 for the 2 mile walk (route here).

The walk is free of charge; however, if you would like to make a donation in honor of Jerry Fourie, please donate to the Pleasanton Girls Softball League: The Jerry Fourie Scholarship Fund, a scholarship fund created by his immediate family.

Parking will be available in the two lots off of Parkside Drive that are closest to Hopyard. The rest of the lots east of those parking lots will be inaccessible as fields are closed during the winter.

Lot 1: https://goo.gl/maps/dEyzSxwDp3T41kvz7 

Lot 2: https://goo.gl/maps/mydZMMHZYuzy9U178 

The walk will conclude at 11:30am but all are invited to Porky's Pizza for post gathering fun and perhaps a Manhattan or two to toast Jerry!

We hope to see you on December 20th either in person or virtually!

name: 3rd Annual Porterville 5K/10K Trail Run
description:
Description:

On 4/12/2025, the Porterville Military Academy athletic department is hosting a 5k/10k run/walk starting and finishing at Porterville Military Academy. Join us for a 5k or 10k dirt path course that is out and back. We are also hosting a children's 1/4 mile short course for your little ones to get in on the action. We look forward to seeing your whole family enjoy this community event.

All 5k race participants will receive for FREE:
  • Custom race t-shirt
  • Finisher Medal
  • Chip time and digital certificate
  • Race bib with individual number
  • Upbeat motivational music
  • Free Parking
All kids 1/4 mile participants will receive for FREE:
  • Custom race t-shirt
  • Finisher medal

Age Group Winners:

The top three males and the top three females in each age group will be rewarded with a prize after the race! The prize is still being worked on and will be posted here as soon as the artwork comes back. The age groups are...

  • 1-10
  • 11-19
  • 20-29
  • 30-39
  • 40-49
  • 50-59
  • 60-69
  • 70-79
  • 80+

Packet Pickup:

  • Place: Porterville Military Academy front office
  • 4/9/2025 from 4:00 PM - 7:00 PM
  • 4/11/2025 from 3:00 PM - 7:00 PM
  • If you are unable to make it to packet pickup, you can come on the morning of the event from 6:30 AM - 7:45 AM

Virtual Race - If you live locally, you are encouraged to come to packet pickup. Otherwise, the race medal will be mailed to you after the race.

We do not store any unclaimed race packets after the race. If you do not pick up your packet prior to the race, then it is considered forfeited. Leftover supplies are donated to volunteers and local charities.

Who we support:

  • The Experimental Aircraft Association (EAA), is an international organization with over 200,000 members. EAA chapters provide a community for pilots and aviation enthusiasts. The Porterville EAA Chapter 1547 has supported Porterville Military Academy Cadets in multiple facets by providing scholarships, overseeing more than 150 Porterville Military Academy Cadets flying an airplane, and mentoring our future aviators on the theories of flight.

name: 41st Nature Made Great Race: Half Marathon, 5K, 10K, 15K, 10M, 1M
description:
The Nature Made Great Race is a celebration of running that features the incredibly scenic Chesebro Half Marathon mostly trail race, and on road: the Deena Kastor 5K, Old Agoura 10K, 15K Double Stack Challenge, Cronies 10.3 Mile Triple Stack Challenge and United Track 1 Mile run/walk.

Established in 1986, the Great Race has won many awards and accolades over the years including:

Best Half Marathon in Nation by Active.com
Voted #1 Running Event in L.A.
Selected a Top 10K in U.S. by Runner's World
Best Race Swag by Competitor Magazine
Best Post-Race Party by LA Sports & Fitness Magazine
Best Post-Race Party by Active.com
Best Post-Race Party by Runner's World
Best Brunch Run by Athlinks 

 

Runner Perks

  • Run on a beautiful, scenic and serene course
  • Custom-designed drawstring goodie bag with actual goodies
  • Premium technical running top (men's or women's cut, in short sleeve or long sleeve)
  • All finishers are rewarded with a beautiful, commemorative finisher’s medal
  • Two medals for finishers of the 10 Mile Triple Stack Challenge and 15K Double Stack Challenge
  • LA's #1 Post-Race Party with lots of quality free food, music and shopping
  • Live Results with RFID timing
  • Photographers on course
  • Plenty of aid stations
  • USATF certified and sanctioned courses
  • Well-marked routes
  • The Great Race Super Discount on Great Race apparel & gear (the earlier you register, the more offers you receive)
  • Sports & Fitness Expo
  • Free parking at the Expo
  • Free race day parking
  • Announcer greets you at beautiful Chumash Park at SoCal’s most active, fun finish line
  • Hundreds of Age Group Awards
  • Prizing: Audio/Video Equipment to Top Finishers in Select Races like TVs, Headphones, Music Players, etc.

Great Race runners comment year-after-year about the gorgeous scenery, the serenity and the most Most Beautiful Courses in Southern California!

So Much Fun!

name: 43rd Annual Providence Saint John's Health Center Brentwood Run
description:
🏃‍♀️ Join Us for the 43rd Annual Brentwood Run 🏃‍♂️

Be part of a beloved Brentwood tradition as the 43rd Annual Brentwood Run returns to San Vicente Blvd! This historic race features a flat and slight downhill course, making it a fast and enjoyable run or walk for participants of all levels. Beyond the race, enjoy a huge expo with local vendors and a dedicated kids area. Best of all, your participation benefits the Brentwood Library and supports the local community!

name: 5K for Fragile X
description:
Superheroes are back once again!! 

Join us on Saturday, April 18th, 2026 for the 13th Annual 5K Walk/Race for Fragile X and celebrate our Southern California Fragile X Community! Click Here for Event Details for Participants 

Why race for Fragile X syndrome? 

Fragile X syndrome (FXS) is the leading known cause of inherited intellectual disability and the leading single gene cause of Autism. Fraxsocal’s mission is to promote public awareness and with your help we can accomplish this goal! Also, to provide a forum for families and children with FXS to meet & greet and create a stronger FXS community! We also support research for effective treatments and ultimately a cure for FXS. Treatments for Fragile X are likely to help people affected by autism, Alzheimer’s, and other brain disorders.

Fragile X Community 

A Family Fun Day will proceed after the walk with Family, Friends, Food and Fun!! It's a great time to chat with other families affected by fragile X syndrome (FXS) and it's also a nice opportunity for you to take your kid(s) or adult(s) with FXS or any disability for that matter, judgement free! 

How to participate:
  • Participate in person: Sign up to walk, run, bike, scoot or stroll (it's a very family friendly walk/run) All you do is click the "Sign up" button above and register yourself and the whole family! Mark your calendar and be sure to arrive early so you can get your FREE t-shirt and goodies before we begin. 
  • Participate virtually: Sign up by clicking the "Sign up" button above and register yourself and the whole family! (Make sure you have someone there in person to pick up your t-shirts otherwise you will be donating them to our organization in which we say, "thank you"! ) 
  • Start a Fundraiser: Whether you are participating in person or virtually you can start an individual fundraiser (starting goal is $250) and attach it to a TEAM (Starting goal of $2,500) in the honor of your Fragile X Super Hero.
  • Become a Sponsor:  Whether you personally, your company or a company you know are interested we have multiple packages to choose from! 
 
Race Fundraising Goal: $75,000 Last year we raised over $55,000!!! Let's see if we can top that!! Donations can be made by clicking the Donate Tab.
 
Share!

Inform your network of supporters! Use these Social Media graphic template to help you tell others that you are racing and/or fundraising! Invite them to race or donate in your honor or in the honor of your Fragile X Superhero.

 

More about our organization: 
FRAGILE X ASSOCIATION of SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA (FRAXSOCAL)
Our non-profit organization was formed to promote public awareness of Fragile X Syndrome with special emphasis on educators and health professionals; provide a forum for families and children with Fragile X to meet and share their ideas, concerns and problems; and support scientific research on Fragile X Syndrome.

name: 71st Annual Fontana Days Run
description:
The Fontana Days Run is an internationally renowned race recognized by the USATF as the World's Fastest Half Marathon Course since 1985.

The Fontana Days Run is a 13.1 mile Half Marathon that starts in the San Bernardino National Forest at an elevation of 3,800 feet and drops nearly 2,500 feet to the finish line in front of Fontana City Hall. Due to the gradual downward slope of the course, many runners use the Fontana Days Run to improve their personal record or qualify for larger races.

In addition to the Half Marathon, there is a 5K Run, 5K Race Walk, 5K Family Fitness Walk and a Children's Half Mile Dash so the whole family can participate.

name: 8th Annual Run4Sharks & Ocean Health Fair 5k/1mile Fun Run...Custom medal to all Finishers: Timed 5k !
description:
Come out and get your fitness on with a 5k timed race through the community streets with police marshals and volunteers to assure your safety. Or choose the 1mi fun run for kids 10 and under, or adults can just walk it! 1mi is NOT timed but all kids will receive a shark themed goody bag and their choice of shark socks!  This is a fun community event of ocean awareness and fitness raising funds for Shark Stewards nonprofit's Ocean Academy group at South Jr High in Anaheim.  As well as their online youth education programs. Choose a 5k run with a 9am start. Walk or run it, professionally timed with prizes for top 3 in each age group. 10 under, 11-15, 16-25, 26-35, 36-45, 46-55, 56-65, 66 over. Kids and family 1mi for FUN, walk/run with bubble station, water sprinkler run through, and other fun stuff. Wear an ocean costume and win a prize. Costume winners top 3 boys & girls.

Sponsor a Kid: We want to send a group of kids to CIMI on Catalina Island, a ocean science weekend. Sponsor a kid, any amount and we will pool the funds to make sure a kid runs instead of you, earning his/her spot on the list to go to Catalina.  Thank you in advance for your generosity.

TEAMS OF 5 OR MORE GET $5 OFF...Here's how: The first four people signing up for the team pay current price. Anyone signing up for  team after the fourth person gets $5 off current price and the first four people will then automatically get a $5 refund. Questions? call or text race director: Maria @ 951-496-6520. 

 

Can't make it to the event? Choose our Virtual Option and do it in your neighborhood. On site, browse through our booths and learn about ocean health, sharks, and fitness from our sponsors. Located at our Ocean Academy school, South Jr. High 2320 E. South St. Anaheim, CA 92806. This is a fundraising event with an Opportunity drawing supporting Shark Stewards, a fiscally sponsored project of Earth Island Institute, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit. Shark Stewards works to protect sharks and preserve healthy ocean ecosystems.

 

ONLINE REGISTRATION CLOSES 6PM ON FRIDAY NOVEMBER 14th RACE DAY REGISTRATION OPENS AT 7:30 AM.

name: 9th Annual Lake Forest Chamber Elf Yourself 5K
description:
The Lake Forest Chamber of Commerce's 9th Annual holiday FUN RUN 5K takes place in the stunning Lake Forest Sports Park on Saturday, November 22, 2025. It is a fast, flat course contained within the park. Our theme is Elf Yourself to kick off the holiday season! This is a fun family event for all, strollers and pets are welcome!

We have a large post-race expo with local restaurants passing out samples, vendors, and various fitness companies. There is even games & crafts for kids, photos with Santa, bounce houses, a hot chocolate station, and more! Make sure to bring your pets for our pet parade, there are awards for best dressed pets!

Stay up to date with our race by following our social media platforms on Facebook and Instagram!

In order to guarantee receiving a full swag bag, make sure to register by 11/3/25

Packet Pick Up Information: 

Packet Pick-Up will be on Friday, November 21st from 3:00 PM to 6:00 PM
Located at Spectrum Specialties & Awards/The Lake Forest Chamber Office
26239 Enterprise Court, Lake Forest, CA 92630

Next Door to South Coast Photography
MUST bring a copy of your signed waiver and an ID
If you want to pick up for a friend, you are able to do so if you have a picture of their ID and a signed copy of their waiver
If you can't make it at this time, we will also have packet pick up in the morning before the race, but make sure to arrive early! 
 

 

Day of Race Information

Parking: Enter the Sports Park from the Portola Parkway entrance (NOT Lake Forest Drive). We will be closing all park entrances prior to the race start for runner's safety. 

The Park will be on lockdown from 8 AM to 11 AM. There are NO exceptions to this rule because it is for runner's safety. 
Overflow parking will be available across the street at Saddleback Church (just a short walk away). If you need to arrive late or leave early, you must park over here and not inside the Park. 
Get to the start line early!
 

This is a timed event with 4 Waves!

  • Wave 1: Fast PR Elves
  • Wave 2: Speedy Elves
  • Wave 3: Runner/Jogger Elves
  • Wave 4: Walkers/Strollers/Pet Elves
     

Additional Runner Information:

The Start Line is located on the large grass area referred to as "the commons" before the soccer fields. 

Awards will be given in age groups for the 1st, 2nd, and 3rd males and females. There will also be top overall awards for males and females. 
Every person will receive a Finishers Medal upon completion of the race!
Make sure to dress up in your best holiday gear! Don't be afraid to go all out!
 

Course Information:

It is a flat 2 1/2 looped course entirely within the Sports Park! We are running on the streets of the Park. 

It will be clearly marked with colorful arrows (one color per lap) & a lead cyclist from Pure Ride Cycles for the fastest runners.
We will have pacers leading each wave! 
 

Tentative Schedule of Events: 

8:00 AM - Runners Start to Arrive

8:30 AM - Race Announcer Starts/Line Up 

8:30-8:45 AM - Carolers 

8:45 AM - Herbalife Warm-Up

8:55 AM - National Anthem 

9:00 AM - Wave 1 Release Fast PR Elves
                Wave 2 Release Speedy Elves
                Wave 3 Release Runner/Jogger Elves
                Wave 4 Release Walker/Strollers/Pet Elves

9:00 AM - Expo Officially Opens

9:15 AM - Finish Line Medals (Ongoing)

9:30-11:00 AM - On Going Raffles & Expo Activities

10:00-10:15 AM - Podium Awards 

10:00 AM - Demo(s) 

10:30 AM - Pet Costume Contest 

10:45 AM - Pet Costume Awards

11:00 AM - Start Clean Up 

Introductions: 

  • Herbalife will be warming up the runners!
  • National Anthem
  • Jade Tully is your race announcer!
  • Caren Ware of Itz About Time will be timing our race!
  • Mary Visconte of Spectrum Specialties/CEO of the Lake Forest Chamber is our Race Director! 

Be sure to say HI to everyone! 
 

Post-Race Expo:


Don't run away after the race. Be sure to hold onto your Bib # to check if you won any raffle prizes! Raffles will be ongoing at the DJ station and written on a dry erase board. Keep checking back to see if you won! 

We have a Kid's Zone called Candy Cane Lane: photos with Santa, games, activities, bounce houses, and more!
Samples from the following: past vendors have included Urban Grill, La Casita Olvera, Coffee, Raising Cane's, A Little Something Sweet, & More! 
 

Fun Facts: 

  • Most of the race is put on by volunteers including our professional photographers: The Walman Photography, and Eagle Community Credit Union.
  • All your pictures are FREE! They will be uploaded onto our Elf Yourself Facebook photo albums, be sure to like our Page! You will be able to download the photos from there! 
  • Be sure to tag our Instagram and Facebook pages on any pictures you post of the event!
  • This Event Supports Local Chamber Charities (such as years past):
    • The Pet Adoption Center of O.C.
    • Boys & Girls Club of Laguna Beach
    • Dream Animal Rescue
    • Kiwanis Club of Lake Forest
    • And MORE!!
       

We thank you for all of your support! If you have any additional questions or concerns, please contact the Lake Forest Chamber of Commerce by emailing info@lakeforestCAchamber.com or calling (949)583-9639.

Jingle All the Way: A Merry Christmas Run!" is a delightful Holiday run that reminds us of the true essence of Christmas – spreading love, giving selflessly, and cherishing the joy of togetherness with family, friends, and even strangers, all while getting a run in before the Christmas festivities! 

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

name: Abrazo 5K Walk & 10K Run 2026
description:
Abrazo 5K Walk & 10K Run

This year’s Abrazo 5K Walk and 10K Run embraces the theme “Get Up, Stand Up.” Inspired by Bob Marley’s words, “One love, one heart, let’s get together and feel all right,” we honor his legacy of using music to uplift voices, champion social justice, and spread messages of love, unity, and resilience.

Casa Familiar continues this spirit through our mission of Advancing Communities—even in the face of adversity—by celebrating the strength of our comunidad.

Join us to uplift community wins and support Casa’s youth and senior programs. As a participant, you’ll help us meet growing needs while celebrating together.

Expect lively Rasta vibes, energizing music, and two special awards presented after the race during a short closing program.

Event Details

The Abrazo 5K Walk & 10K Run takes participants along the San Ysidro–Tijuana border. With an expected 300 attendees, this annual fundraising event is brimming with community spirit, fun, and contagious energy. 

Date:

Saturday, May 2, 2026

Schedule:

  • 6:30 AM: Registration 
  • 7:00 AM: Welcome 
  • 7:30 AM: 10K Run
  • 7:35 AM: 5K Walk 
  • 8:45 AM - 11 AM: Awards & Raffles  

Recommendations

We strongly recommend taking advantage of our Early Registration Package Pick-Up on DATE. Enjoy a delicious brew and pick-up your registration package from one of the following local favorites: 

South Bay Tap House 
2004 Dairy Mart Rd. #113 
San Ysidro, CA 92173 

Mujeres Brew House 
1983 Julian Ave. 
San Diego, CA 92113 

We also encourage the use of public transportation. The event start/finish line is just a 15-minute walk from the San Ysidro Trolley Station (Blue Line).

name: Aim High With Charge
description:
Join us as we celebrate our 9th annual Aim High in 2025. Through this event we are able to give back to those who serve our countries and communities. The event will be held, Saturday, Oct. 18, 2025 Aim High at Coyote Valley Sporting Clays in Morgan Hill, CA, and includes a 20-station clay shoot competition, multiple raffles for firearms and other prizes, as well as breakfast and lunch.

As in year's past, Aim High raises funds for the Taya and Chris Kyle Foundation (formerly the Chris Kyle Frog Foundation). TACK-F is focused on changing the world for this generation and the next by recognizing and strengthening service families through unique programs and powerful partnerships. Donate, sponsor, volunteer or attend! All funds raised through Aim High go directly to TACK-F and can be put to work immediately.

name: Akash Wine Run 5k
description:
THIS RACE WILL SELL OUT SOON SO SECURE YOUR SPOT TODAY!

Like Running or Walking?  Love Wine?  This race is for you! 

Join us on Sunday, March 1, 2026 at 10:00am for an exciting annual event that features Akash Winery & Vineyards. Come join us on the gorgeous, open-air patio, where you’ll find far more than beautiful views and amazing wine. This winery is loved by locals and out-of-towners alike, thanks to the happy energy and friendly faces of our knowledgeable team.  So, whether you are looking to run, walk or just enjoy the wine and camaraderie this race is a sure thing for a great time and an incredible experience! This race is timed and scored by J3 Timing.  Results will be posted at www.J3Timing.com. 

Registration Includes:

  • T-shirt:  Super Soft Ring Spun Cotton t-shirt included! 
  • Wine Glass: Shatterproof, Collapsible, and Portable!
  • Finisher Medal: Doubles as a Bottle Stopper!
  • Race Bib: Chip timed 5k run/walk
  • Results Posted Online
  • ...and of course, a pour of wine!

name: Alameda July 4th Parade R.A.C.E.
description:
Come out for our July 4th tradition and run this flat and fast point to point 5k thru the closed streets of Alameda. We will be starting again at 8:30am to provide ample space between our runners and the Parade that follows. 

General Overview: 

The 5K run (3.1 mile) and walk takes you through beautiful Alameda winding thru business and residential streets. This run benefits the Midway Shelter of Alameda. 

Packet Pick-up:

  • 7/1 thru 7/3: Laurens Closet. 1420 Park St, Alameda. Hours 10:00am - 5:00pm  
  • 7/4 Race morning registration opens at 7:30am 1440 Park St, Alameda ~ La Pena corner of Santa Clara (New Location)

Race Day Details: 

  • Start: 1420 Park St. Alameda, ca. 94501
  • Packet Pick-up : 7:30am
  • Race Start : 8:30am
  • Finish: 1526 Webster St, Alameda, CA 94501 (across from Tapout Fitness)

We will have shuttle service in 2026 to get runners back to the start. We have made strides towards this for a couple years and we finally have it lined up for this year. 

 

If you are traveling via Bart or public transportation please review the schedules below to get you to the race start, and picked up from the race finish. 

  • Bart Website: https://www.bart.gov/
  • AC Transit Site: https://www.actransit.org/

name: Alameda Pride Fun Run/Walk
description:
5K Fun Run/Walk for All Ages

We are excited to be holding the City of Alameda's third Pride Event! We had so much fun the last 3 years and we are back to do it again! The weekend's event will include a 5K Fun Run/Walk through the streets of Alameda, fun and colorful outfits are encouraged! This year's event will not be timed, we are just out to have fun and support a great organization. The fun will start and end at the Elks Lodge at 2255 Santa Clara Avenue in Alameda. All participants will receive a t-shirt, water, and snacks which will be provided by Alameda Starbucks. There will be prizes for the top finishers. This event will be the start of Saturday's fun-filled day which includes, music, dancing along the streets & parks of Downtown Alameda.

Support from this race will help with inclusivity, diversity & support for our community. This will include amazing things such as anti-bullying programs & GSA's in schools, LGBTQ+ scholarships, and local LGBTQ+ businesses/organizations/programs, the Queer Teen Alameda Center and much more.

Registration begins at 8:00am at the Alameda Elks Lodge.

Alameda Pride, Inc., is a 501(c)3 non-profit organization.

Refund Policy - Refunds given if the event is cancelled.

name: Alhambra Pumpkin Run 2025
description:
Join us on Sunday, October 26th for our 12th Annual Alhambra Pumpkin Run and Halloween Festival in Downtown Alhambra! Proceeds benefit the Alhambra Educational Foundation! Our mission is to provide a fun, family environment to promote physical fitness, health and give back to our community with a fun event that brings you costumes, music and entertainment.

HOW TO RUN WITH US?
STEP #1: SIGN UP! - Register online early! We will be selling out and selling a capped number of runners this year.
STEP #2: PICK UP! - Pick up your runner’s packet on Saturday, October 25th: 9am - 1pm
STEP #3: SHOW UP! - Show up on Sunday, October 26th to run or walk with us in your run gear, Halloween costume, or your Pumpkin Run t-shirt!

RUNNERS RECEIVE:

  • Commemorative 2025 Pumpkin Run t-shirt
  • Commemorative 2025 Pumpkin Run custom finisher’s medal received after crossing the finish line
  • Commemorative 2025 Pumpkin Run runner's bib with timing chip
  • Commemorative 2025 sponsored tote bag for 10K, 5K and 1K finishers
  • Chip timing (excluding 1K runners) for accurate run time results received after the 10K and 5K
  • 1 Free Beer sponsored by Ohana Brewery for runners 21+ OR 1 Free non-alcoholic drink sponsored by Alhambra Educational Foundation for runners under 21
  • years of age located next to the Beer Garden tent across from the main stage.
  • Prizes for fastest runners to be determined.
  • Free photos from our photographers that will posted on our Facebook page after the event.
  • Free goodies and giveaways at the finish line and festival hosted by proud sponsors.
EVENT HIGHLIGHTS:
  • Free and fun outdoor festival for the entire family!
  • Trick-or-Treating at local Downtown Alhambra businesses on Main Street!
  • Live entertainment including a band, dance performances and DJ!
  • Certified Alhambra Farmers Market!
  • Annual Downtown Alhambra Hallowscream Kids Costume Contest at 11:00am!
  • Kids Zone including pumpkin patch, carnival games, and more!
  • Beer Garden and bar hosted by Alhambra Education Foundation and sponsored by Ohana Brewery! Proceeds benefit the Alhambra Educational Foundation. 
AGE REQUIREMENTS:
10K AGES:
Children 6 years and up may run/walk the 10K as paid participants. All children ages 12 and under must be accompanied by a registered adult for the entire duration of the race for safety. All participants need a bib/registration to enter the 10K and run the route. Children 5 years and younger are free to run/walk or be pushed in strollers for free. There is no registration needed for children 0 to 5 years.
5K AGES:
Children 6 years and up may run/walk the 5K as paid participants. All children ages 12 and under must be accompanied by a registered adult for the entire duration of the race for safety. All participants need a bib/registration to enter the 5K and run the route. Children 5 years and younger are free to run/walk or be pushed in strollers for free. There is no registration needed for children 0 to 5 years.
1K AGES:
Our 1K Kids race begins with a fun warm up of exercises and quick dances led by our fun Master of Ceremonies before this race begins. A 1K is 0.62 miles. Parents/Guardians may run behind their runner during the run. *All parents and runners must wait behind the barricades until it is their assigned group time.
  • Group #1: Age 6
  • Group #2: Age 7
  • Group #3: Ages 8
  • Group #4: Ages 9 & 10
KIDDIE FUN RUN AGES:
The Kiddie Fun Run is back! Our Kiddie Fun Run begins with a fun warm up of exercises and quick dances led by our fun Master of Ceremonies before the race begins. This route will be a 1/2 K (roughly a quarter mile).  Parents/Guardians may run behind their runner during the run. *All parents and runners must wait behind the barricades until it is their assigned group time.
  • Group #1: Age 4
  • Group #2: Age 5
PLEASE NOTE: Age divisions for the 1K and Kiddie Fun Run are subject to change depending on registration participation. For the safety of the children, some divisions may be divided up into smaller groups. Updated age divisions are subject to change. Final determination will be made by race director and posted on our social media pages before the race.

RUN ROUTES:
10K ROUTE:
Our 10K route is two loops of our 5K route. You get to see our beautiful Alhambra community twice. How lucky are you?  Upon making the 1st loop around and beginning the 2nd loop, DO NOT RUN OVER THE TIMING MAT. Running over it will stop your time and we want to make sure your run time counts.  Make sure you enter the barricaded lane to the right of the inflatable archway and keep running.
5K ROUTE:
Our 5K route begins on Main Street facing west. Runners travel west on Main Street to 6th Street and turn right and loop back on Main Street facing east. When runners hit Garfield, they will turn left onto Garfield traveling north as they pass the Renaissance Theater corner.
Runners then loop right and travel back to Main Street as they pass a DJ on the Renaissance Theater corner by Applebee’s and turn left onto Main Street and travel east down to El Molino Ave and then make a U-turn back around to face west on Main Street.
Runners travel west back to Garfield Ave. and turn left and travel south on Garfield Ave. to Bay State and then make a U-turn back around to face north on Garfield Ave. When runners hit Main Street, they will turn left onto Main Street traveling west to the FINISH LINE!
1K ROUTE:
The 1K course features a turnaround loop easy for the kids to follow and a police bike will be guiding the runners on the loop. The race begins on Main Street at our start line (cross street: 2nd Street) facing east Alhambra. The race begins and runners make a U-Turn at 5th Street and runners turn back around on Main Street facing west and ending at the finish line on 2nd Street.
KIDDIE FUN RUN ROUTE: 
The Kiddie Fun Run course features a turnaround loop easy for the kids to follow and a police bike will be guiding the runners on the loop. The race begins on Main Street at our start line (cross street: 2nd Street) facing east Alhambra. The race begins and runners make a U-Turn at 3rd Street and runners turn back around on Main Street facing west and ending at the finish line on 2nd Street.
PARTY TIME & FUN RUN!
The Alhambra Pumpkin Run is also a HUGE party! Dress up in your best Halloween, Pumpkin or Orange gear! Being so close to Halloween, many of our runners dress up to the run. Feel free to wear anything and all orange, a Halloween costume or a big and fun pumpkin tutu! Make it fun. Make it memorable.
*Costumes may not create a safety hazard to yourself or other runners.
*Costumes must be family friendly and appropriate for all ages. 

REFUND POLICY:
All entry fees are non-refundable and non-transferable. 
You may not alter, reproduce, give or sell your number to another individual – doing so will result in your disqualification as well as the participant who uses your race number. The entry fee for this year's event will not transfer to next year's event, no exceptions. This policy stays in effect whether you are injured, have an unexpected business or family emergency, pregnancy, Act of God, etc. There are no exceptions. Any inquiry regarding this policy will be directed back to this page. There is no rain check date, events will be held rain or shine.
 
There is no rain check date. The event will be held rain or shine.
 
FOLLOW US ON INSTAGRAM
FOLLOW US ON FACEBOOK
#AlhambraPumpkinRun2025

name: Almond Bowl 5K & 10K November 2nd, 2025
description:
Join us, in person, on November 2nd, 2025 for the 51st Annual Almond Bowl in the beautiful Lower Bidwell Park!

Keeping with the Chico tradition we will be hosting a 5k and 10k race starting on South Park Drive and finishing near the Sycamore Field. The price of this race includes your race shirt from Upper Park Clothing, a race bib for you to wear during your run and plenty of post-race snacks for after your run! 


This race, along with the Bidwell classic, are fundraisers for our local high school's cross-country teams and band programs! Additional donations can be accepted in the registration page! 

 

RACE START TIMES


5k: 8:00am

10k: 8:10am

 

REGISTRATION

Registration for this year's Almond Bowl will be available online. In person registration will be available during packet pick up only. 

 

Race Fee Schedule

July 1st - Sept 30th -  (online)                  10k $55.00

                                                                        5k $45.00

Oct. 1st - Oct. 31st - (online @ 9:00am) 10k $60.00

                                                                        5k $50.00

In person Registration at Packet Pickup 
 
                                                                      10k $60.00

                                                                        5k $50.00
 

In person registration will be available at Fleet Feet Chico during packet pickup ONLY. (October 31st and November 1st, 2025) Packet pickup will be from 10:00am - 2:00pm each day. 

 
Registration Information
Online registration closes October 31st at 9:00 a.m. Registration will be available in person on October 31st and November 1st at Fleet Feet Chico from 10am-2pm. You need to Register by Friday October 17th to guarantee yourself race shirt. If you register between October 18th - November 1st your shirt will NOT be guaranteed. Limited number of extra shirts will be available first come first serve at packet pickup. All left over shirts/unclaimed shirts will be available for pickup or for sale (non-registered runners) AFTER the race on November 2nd. Shirts will be first come first serve starting at 9:00am.  

OFFICAL COURSE CERTIFICATION AND MAPS

5K and 10K: Flat, fast loop through beautiful (newly paved!) lower Bidwell Park. 

Click here for both course maps.

 

DIRECTIONS AND PARKING FOR OPTIONAL RACE LOCATION

To the course:
Enter Chico via Highway 99 either from the north or from the south. If you are coming from the north on 99, take the Highway 32 offramp and turn right at the first intersection. If you are coming from the south on 99, take the Highway 32 offramp and turn left at the second intersection. Now you're heading west on 32 (East 8th St). From here. If coming from north 99 take the highway 32 exit and turn right onto 8th St. 

Take 8th St just under a half-mile, then turn right on Sycamore St.
Sycamore St runs a few blocks into Woodland Ave, which runs parallel to the park. The park itself will be closed to vehicle traffic on race day, so find a parking spot on or near Woodland Ave. Please be courteous and park legally. Do not park in a way that blocks local residents' entry to or exit from their homes.
There are several entrances to the One Mile Recreation Area from Woodland Ave. For race-day packet pickup, look for the sign marked pre-Registered. For any other assistance, make your way to the Information booth.


 

PACKET PICKUP

Packet pickup will be held at Fleet Feet Chico on the following days and times:

Friday and Saturday October 31st and November 1st, 2025

10:00am-2:00pm 

Fleet Feet - Chico
241 Main Street
Chico, CA 95928
(530) 345-1000

 
Race Rules:
Be courteous when overtaking slower runners or walkers in your elected race location. We want you to race hard and fast, but with safety of yourself and others in mind.

Where your Race number so it is visible on the participant's front!

Run your race with pride!

You must cross the timing mat for your chip to be read. If you are planning of racing for top finisher, the race is based on gun time and first to cross the finish line.

All other placements (age groups) will be based on chip timing.


Run, hard, run fast and have fun!


No pets will be allowed on course during the race.


All strollers must start at the back of the pack.


Thank you for understanding. 
 

AID STATIONS AND RESTROOMS
There will be 3 for the 10k and 2 for the 5k.

1.     Cedar Grove Bathrooms – Water 
2.     Peterson Drive Gate – Water 
3.     99 Overpass (Vallombrosa side) – Water
Restroom on the course will be located at One Mile recreation on the North and South side of the pool, Cedar Grove Park, and Pettersen Dr. Park entrance as well as portable restrooms at the start and finish.
 
 

T-SHIRTS AND AWARDS
Guaranteed Tee-shirt cutoff is October 17th, 2025

Cotton Poly blend shirts from Upper Park Clothing Co. will be provided to all participants who register for this event before the tee shirt cutoff. (10/17/25) Any participant who registers on or before October 17th will be guaranteed a race tee. Any participant who registers after October 17th will be able to receive a race shirt based on a limited size availability (very few extras will be ordered). Any shirts not picked up at packet pick up prior to the race will be available on a first come first serve basis to all paid runners for pick up, and available for sale to any unregistered spectators starting at 9:00am at the Fleet Feet booth. 
All shirts come in adult male (unisex) sizes, so you may wish to choose a smaller size than normal for female and child runners. No youth sizes will be available. 
 

AWARDS FOR TOP FINISHERS
 
We will be offering a CASH PRIZE Top male and female for each race! (5k & 10k) We will have an award ceremony at 8:30am for the 5k, 9:00am for the 10k.
 
Age group awards can be found at the Fleet Feet tent following the award ceremony for each race. 
(Awards will also be offered to the top three in each age group category for each gender in each race)
 
All unclaimed prized will be available for pick up at Fleet Feet Chico on Tuesday 4th during regular business hours. (11:00am-4:00pm)

Age group brackets will be as followed: 

14 and under / 15-19 / 20-29 / 30-39 / 40-49 / 50-59 / 60-69 / 70 and over
  
For more information, please email kristina@fleetfeetchico.com or shawna@feetfeetchico.com

**No Refunds on race entries or merchandise purchased for this event**

name: Always Hope Easter Run 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
🐣 Get ready to lace up your sneakers and chase some fun!
Join us for the Always Hope Easter Run - a family-friendly, fun, and make memories that’ll last longer than chocolate eggs!

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.

name: Amore Under the Stars Gondola Ride
description:
Indulge in a 50-minute relaxing and romantic gondola cruise through the canals and waterways of the Coronado Cays. Each pair will enjoy a 50-minute boat ride with wine and snacks. Each Gondola fits 3 couples per boat, and 3 time slots will be available to select your cruise’s departure. 21+ only.

Participants will receive wine and snacks for 2. Please be aware that each boat will be shared by 3 couples per boat.

name: Anaheim Ducks 5K presented by Arrowhead Water
description:
The 4th annual Anaheim Ducks 5K presented by Arrowhead Water is coming back to Great Park in Irvine on Sunday, February 8th!

The course will start right outside of the Ducks practice facility - Great Park Ice & FivePoint Arena - and proceed throughout and around the park.

This year's event will include appearances by Anaheim Ducks mascot Wild Wing, a vendor village with family friendly games and activities, music by DJ JoJo, and much more. All proceeds will benefit the Anaheim Ducks Foundation's mission of producing positive change for children and families throughout Southern California by providing educational opportunities, broadening access to the sport of hockey and addressing the health and wellness needs of the community.

Both competitive and casual runners/walkers are welcome, and each participant will receive a race day t-shirt, finisher's medal, and souvenir runner's bib. Plus - attendees who register for the 'DUCKS 5K + Game Ticket!' option during registration will also receive (1) Terrace Level ticket to a Ducks home game at Honda Center!

name: Annual San Bernardino Turkey Trot
description:
New Date AND New Location!

San Bernardino's Family Fun Thanksgiving Tradition has gotten a make over! 

The event will now be on the Saturday before Thanksgiving, the 22nd of November.

We are also excited to announce a new scenic course through Cal State San Bernardino!

Please come out and "wobble before you gobble".  Come out and continue your family fun tradition with your closest and newest friends at our new location.

A portion of the net proceeds will go towards supporting Alexander Foundation and Exonerated Nation.  

It is important to note that any runners that register after November 10th are not guaranteed a participant shirt.

5k, 10k and kids 1k courses around campus.

  • Chip timing for 5k and 10k run/walks
  • Custom-designed diecast finisher medals to all 5k/10k participants  
  • Age group awards three deep to top male and female 5k & 10K winners in 18 age categories
  • Shirts for 5k/10k participants in adult unisex and youth sizes
  • Discounts for teams/group of 8 or more (*contact is sbturkeytrot@gmail.com or hit the contact us button)
  • Team competitions with awards to the biggest team and the fastest team
  • Finish-line festival featuring costume contest, music, food, freebies, and fun for adults and kids of all ages

PACKET PICK-UP 

Friday, November 21st, 1-4pm

On The Spot, 2999 Kendall Dr, San Bernardino, CA 92407

You can pick up your bib, t-shirt, at packet pick-up or on race day morning at the event venue starting at 6:00 AM.

We expect heavy traffic race day morning; carpooling and early arrival is strongly recommended!

RACE DAY SCHEDULE 
6:00 AM - Late registration / packet pick-up 
7:00 AM - 10k start 
7:15 AM - 5k start 
8:30 AM - 1k Kids Run

8:00 AM - 5k & 10k age group winners announced*

*Age group awards are based on chip time.

name: Applied Materials Silicon Valley Turkey Trot
description:
Founded and produced by the Silicon Valley Leadership Group Foundation, the Applied Materials Silicon Valley Turkey Trot is the largest Thanksgiving Day race in America. It allows participants to start Thanksgiving Day off on the right foot by celebrating generosity and wellness with thousands of other runners and walkers committed to investing in their community. All event proceeds are donated to four nonprofit beneficiaries: Healthier Kids Foundation, HomeFirst, Second Harvest of Silicon Valley, and Second Harvest Food Bank Santa Cruz County.

This family-focused event welcomes participants of all fitness levels—elite runners, joggers, and walkers—to enjoy the flat and fast course that flows through downtown San Jose's local neighborhoods and businesses.

So kick off the holiday season by joining your Silicon Valley neighbors at San Jose's biggest Thanksgiving Day block party. Sign up to make the Applied Materials Silicon Valley Turkey Trot your newest Thanksgiving tradition!

description:

name: Ascot Hills Challenge 5K
description:
Event proceeds benefit Wilson High School Fire and Police Magnet Cadet Program and Ascot Hills Park.  

​The Los Angeles Unified School District (LAUSD) and The Los Angeles Fire Department (LAFD) have partnered in bringing the very first LAFD fire academy magnet school program to Woodrow Wilson High School in El Sereno, CA, joining the existing LAPD student police cadet program.

 
Join us on the best 3.1 mile trail course in East Los Angeles! 

Our 5K course will challenge all levels of runners, walkers and hikers.  The race is chip-timed for those seeking friendly competition and/or a chance to win a commemorative LAFD challenge coin.

​If you enjoy trail running, walking or hiking, you'll be certain to enjoy this event with spectacular views of Los Angeles, Dodger Stadium and the Hollywood sign, all visible from within the park.

name: Aut2Run for Autism (15K, 5K, 10K, Fun-K, 1 Mile & Virtual Race)
description:
We are excited to welcome you back to an in-person Aut2Run at California State University Channel Islands on Sunday, April 26th, 2026! For those of you who can't experience Aut2Run in-person, but would still like to support Autism Society Ventura County, we will be offering a virtual option for you to participate in. This year is extra special to us as we celebrate Aut2Run's 14th anniversary!

100% of the proceeds from Aut2Run go directly towards fulfilling Autism Society Ventura County's (ASVC) mission to create connections, empowering all with Autism to live fully. ASVC works to promote lifelong access and opportunity for all individuals within the autism spectrum and their families to be fully included members of the community. They achieve this through education, advocacy, a variety of programs, increasing public awareness, and collaboration with other agencies.

ASVC programs are primarily for individuals, families and caregivers who have people in their lives with autism of all ages. We also collaborate with service providers, agency staff, educators and teachers, and professionals who are interested in furthering the mission of ASVC. Their programs are open to any individual, family, or community member impacted by autism. Our Board consists of all dedicated volunteers.

In-Person Race Information: 

10K (1/2 Road & 1/2 Trail) Run - 7:00am Please note, we have a strict course time limit for the 10K. All participants must be able to complete the 10K in 75 minutes (that is a 12 minute per mile pace).  If you do not reach the University Park Entrance (heading back to the South Quad after the trail loop) in 54 minutes, you will be transported to where the 5K joins in at Channel Islands Dr and will receive a DNF (Did Not Finish).
5K Run/Walk - 8:45am
1 Mile Run/Walk - 10:15am
Fun-K - 10:45am This event is for children under age 12 and for adults with special needs and their caregivers. Limited to 300 participants.
15K Hero Run - Participants run both the 10K and 5K events separately. The times from the two races will be combined to give you your 15K results.

name: Autumn Vines Temecula Wine Tour
description:
Let's explore the exceptional wine and welcoming atmosphere at Temecula Valley which is known as Southern California’s Official Wine Country. Travel via charter bus to 3 different wineries and try samplers of local wine! Price includes transportation, light refreshments, charcuterie appetizers, and 3 tastings. Lunch at the last Winery is optional and not included in the registration fee.

Meet us at the NASNI Visitor Lot for departure at 9:30 AM or Admiral Baker Parking Lot for departure at 10:15.

 

First Winery by 12:00 Peltzer Winery tasting included amazing farm. Hosted tasting will last 50 minutes. 

Second Winery by 1:00 Wilson Creek Winery. Seated tasting included will last 50 minutes. This winery is famous for its almond wine.

Third Winery by 2:00 Maurice Car'rie Winery Seated tasting, live music included. Optional lunch not included. This winery is famous for its brie cheese bread. This tasting will last an hour and 20 minutes.

name: Avalon Benefit 50 Mile/50K Run
description: The Avalon Benefit 50 Mile/50K Run is the oldest Ultra Trail Run in California with the 50 Mile run entering its 43rd year.   The 50K joined the party six years ago and instantly became a California classic in trail running traversing all of the same trails that the older run uses.   Running the Avalon Benefit 50Mile/50K provides you a first rate, up-close and personal experience of one of California's natural jewels in trail running across Catalina Island.   The run begins and ends in Avalon and in between you simply have to run the entire length of the island - and back!  In between you will experience beautiful vistas, tremendous views of the Pacific Ocean, see a bison or two and experience some of the sports great volunteers and aid stations.

name: Aztlan XC Classic
description:
Aztlan XC Classic was established in 1976. It has been long due and now we welcome you back. This time, those who have competed at this event are now well into their 50s. You are now coaches, mentors, teachers, parents and even grandparents. Bring your family, team or if you're still challenging yourself then sign up and let’s celebrate our success.

This event exclusively benefits Aztlan Athletics Foundation (AAF). For details about the subsidized running camps, scholarships, and complimentary registrations visit AztlanAthleticsFoundation.org.

name: Back to the Future: 88 MPH Dash 5K, 10K & Half
description:
Back to the Future: 88 MPH Dash 5K, 10K & Half

October 18, 2025 · 7:00 a.m. PST · 6846 Owensmouth Ave, Canoga Park, CA

Get ready to rev up your DeLorean and hit 88 MPH! This race celebrates the iconic Back to the Future trilogy, with a special nod to Back to the Future Day—October 21, 2015—the date Marty McFly and Doc Brown traveled to the future in Back to the Future Part II.

Presented by Jed & Ted’s Excellent Races

Whether you're a time-traveling teen or a mad scientist, this race lets you channel your inner McFly and dash through time with style.


---

  • 88 MPH Sprint 5K⚡ Perfect for those looking to make a quick getaway from 1985.
  • Twin Pines 10K 🌲 A tribute to the mall where it all began—before the pine trees were history.
  • Enchantment Under the Run Half Marathon 🎶 Dance through time and space in this nostalgic long-distance challenge.
  • The Multiverse Flux Capacitor Challenge (Virtual) 🌀 Can't make it in person? Join us virtually and complete any distance to earn your medal.

Expect time-traveling tunes, futuristic photo ops, and plenty of 80s nostalgia. Costumes encouraged—think puffer vests, lab coats, and hoverboards!


---

📦 Multiverse Option (Virtual Runners Welcome!)

Can't make it IRL? Run virtually anytime from Oct 18–21, and we'll ship you your finisher medal. No need for a time machine!

This is a Jed & Ted’s Excellent Race—fun, fast, and full of nostalgia.

Sign up now. The future is what you make it—so make it a good one!


---
Parody Disclaimer
This race is a fan-made parody event inspired by 80s pop culture and is not affiliated with or endorsed by any official trademark holders.

name: Badwater 267 VR
description:
BADWATER: It’s a frame of mind, a global family of horizon-chasers, and a statement to the world about priorities and preconceived notions of what is possible. Badwater is a way of life! Are you ready to kick off the New Year with an authentic, original Badwater experience?

AdventureCORPS® – the organizers of the iconic worldwide series of Badwater® races – are pleased to offer the BADWATER 267 VR in which competitors virtually and sequentially traverse the routes of all three Badwater® races – the 51-mile Badwater Cape Fear, the 81-mile Badwater Salton Sea, and the 135-mile Badwater 135 – for a total of 267 miles, or 430km. These three events comprise the legendary Badwater Ultra Cup - and Badwater 267 VR! Start off the New Year with this new challenge and immerse yourself in the world of Badwater!

If you are up to the challenge, you will complete 267 miles (430km) during the month of January. You have 31 days to complete 267 miles on foot - or 133.5 miles swimming, 801 miles cycling  - and you can do them anywhere you want, including indoors. There is also a multi-sport division for those who want to combine different sports (including paddle sports, cross-country and downhill skiing, skateboarding, and more; see below.) Participation is based on the “honor system,” but there is a highly recommended - and very popular - Private Strava Club to bring everyone together.

Go at your own pace, as often or as long as you want, wherever you live, anywhere on the planet! 

Guidelines:

• Running Division: You must complete all 267 miles on foot: This includes Walking, Hiking, Snowshoeing, and Treadmill, whether indoors or outdoors, covering 267 miles (430km) in 31 days. This is the Running Division, in which ONLY these bipedal activities may be counted. Also Note: In the Strava app, always log any of these activities as "Running" so that they appear on the club leaderboard.

NOTE: Elliptical is NOT allowed in the Running Division. 

• Cycling division: You must bike all the miles, whether outdoors, indoors, or both. (For logging and covering the 267-mile course, 3 miles cycling = 1 mile running. If you are cycling indoors, please make it realistic.)

NOTE: Indoor bike rides with an average speed of more than 16MPH / 25.75KPH DO NOT COUNT. 

• Multi-Sport division: MANY sports may be included, besides, cycling, swimming, and running: All paddle and rowing sports, ice-skating, rollerblading, skateboarding, and cross-country skiing are also allowed in the multi-sport category, and all they all count one-for-one.

For swimming, 1 mile swimming = 2 miles running. Similarly, for prone paddling - i.e. no paddle - this is considered equivalent to swimming and counts 2 miles for each 1 mile paddled.

For Elliptical, you must go 2 miles - with some intensity, NOT in the easiest setting - to log 1 mile in the RunSignUp system. (Elliptical is only allowed in the Multi-Sport division, NOT in the Running division.)

• Strength training counts in the Multi-Sport division: 1 hour of strength training equates to 4 miles of running. Also, Yoga and other types of fitness classes count as 3 miles for a one-hour class.

• Downhill skiing or snowboarding also count: 1150 feet of vert = one mile, thus 10,000 feet of vert equals the 8.67-mile daily requirement. (A total of 307,050 for 267 miles!)

• Cycling: Indoor bike rides with an average speed of more than 16MPH / 25.75KPH DO NOT COUNT. 

SWAG & AWARDS:

Participants will receive a BADWATER 267 VR tech shirt, BADWATER buff, and BADWATER sunglasses in a custom Badwater box. For those who log the necessary miles within the RunSignUp system, a BADWATER 267 VR Medal will also be awarded. (Medals are not sent just for participating; they are sent to those who cover the distance AND log all the necessary miles with the RunSignUp system.) These items will be shipped approximately 45 days after BADWATER 267 VR concludes. See the event webpage for all the info.

This is not a traditional ultra, nor a run-of-the-mill virtual – Badwater events are NEVER traditional – it’s the BADWATER 267 VR – an authentic and original BADWATER event – and we hope you will join us!

POLICIES:

There are NO refunds after December 30. There are also no credits or transfers.

See the event webpage for all the info.

name: Badwater Salton Sea, presented by Mount to Coast
description:
The BADWATER® ultra running experience returns to the Anza-Borrego Desert and Palomar Mountain when the twelfth BADWATER SALTON SEA - presented by Mount to Coast - race takes place on April 26-27, 2025.

 

This remarkable event challenges teams of two or three ultrarunners – running together as duos or trios for the duration, NOT in a relay – to tackle an unimaginable traverse of Southern California deserts and mountains. The  route covers 81 miles (130km) from Salton City (elevation 234 feet / 71m below sea level) to Palomar Mountain, the almost tallest mountain in San Diego County (elevation 5500 feet / 1676m.)* Eight of the 81 race miles pass through Anza-Borrego State Park on a single track trail from Borrego Springs to Ranchita, creating a race route which is a mix of road and trail. There is a total elevation gain of over 9000 feet (2740m).

The eleven previous editions were received with wide acclaim. The thirteenth edition – with a limit of 100 runners – is scheduled for April 18-19 (Saturday-Sunday), 2026.

RACE DIFFICULTY

This is an extremely difficult race held in extreme conditions: Veterans of this event routinely state that it is as hard as any of the toughest 100 milers they have done.

The extreme weather changes - from 100+F / 38+C during the day, often with a sand storm, to freezing temperates with very wet fog at night - along with the extreme challenge of the two major mountain ascents - combine to make this an extremely difficult race.

It is critical to train properly for the heat and to train effectively for very steep desert single-track trail section of the race which is done in maximum heat and without the support crew nearby. Additionally, the single track trail is VERY steep and surprises runners every year with both its steepness, rugged terrain, and intense heat. Knowledge of maintaining proper electrolyte balance is also critical. Study the relevant articles at Badwater University closely, as well as race reports from former competitors.

Team Format

Unique to Badwater® Salton Sea is a “Team Ultra Racing” format: All race entrants must enter and race as teams of two or three runners (all male, all female, or co-ed divisions), remaining together for the duration – NOT in a relay format – and sharing just one support vehicle with at least two crew members.

 

We encourage each runner to select teammates with compatible running style and pace, and with whom he or she would really like to share this experience!

 

Divisions are offered for All Male, All Female, and Mixed (for 3x teams, 2 men and 1 woman, or 1 man and 2 women, are considered equal).

 

Some teams have come together in the past through the wonders of the internet, for example through our Facebook Event Page for each year’s event, or just through personal social media (and real world!) connections!

 

It is very important to pick good teammates to have an ideal experience at this race, and to have the highest likelihood of the whole team finishing together, intact, which SHOULD BE the goal of every team in the race. Here’s what we suggest:

 

– Invite runners that you have run with a lot, and find you have compatible speeds, styles (pacing, how much time you spend getting aid, etc.), and temperament (sense of humour, how much you like to talk versus staying quiet or listening to music, etc.). Those could be runners in your club or with whom you train a lot. But that could also be runners who don’t live near you, but you only see at races.

 

– Think about all the races you do. Aren’t there others who consistently finish right near you in lots of races? Seems like a good place to start with picking a teammate, don’t you think?

 

– Taking that a step further, why not pick teammates with whom you actually compete directly? Again, you’re likely about the same speed, so why not work together instead of against each other, for a change? Why not “bury the hatchet,” so to speak?

 

– What about fellow runners that you are mentoring, whether “formally” or just in a friendly way? Why not help another runner have an amazing experience in your company, with you playing the role of “grizzled old veteran” or Jedi of ultra running? There is no Luke Skywalker without Obi-Wan Kenobi, after all.

 

Anyway, those are a few ideas for not only picking good teammates, but also for having an exemplary experience, something that will really be transcendent, and meaningful, and will resonate far and beyond after the race is over and you’ve – hopefully – gone home with your buckles.

 

QUALIFYING REQUIREMENTS: Entry may be denied to those without sufficient endurance credentials. All applicants must have completed at least one difficult 50-mile ultramarathon in the previous 12 months prior to entry. Proof of this qualification must be included within the entry application OR by email at least 60 days prior to the race. Completing one or more tough 100-milers before this event is highly recommended, as is experience in desert heat racing. Veterans of this event routinely state that it is as hard or harder than any of the toughest 100 milers they have done.

 

REFUND POLICY: Generally speaking, it is our expectation that registered teams will not withdraw from this event. Instead, if one runner has to withdraw from the race, he or she will be replaced with a new teammate, at the discretion of the remaining runner(s) on the team. There are no transfers of registration, nor roll-overs to the next year. Entry fee refunds, less 25%, will be offered until 60 days prior to the event. After that, there are no refunds, nor roll-overs or credits.

 

ALL TEAMMATES MUST ENTER ON THE SAME WEEK: Please submit all teammates’ registrations and payments on the same day or within a few days. No runner or team is considered fully registered until ALL runners on the team are registered and paid in full. Runners who register, but don’t have a full team registered within two weeks, may be dropped from the roster and issued a refund, less 25%.

 

EVENT CANCELLATION: If the event is canceled due to pandemic, hurricane, community disaster, or other force majeure, neither refunds nor credits will be given.

 

ROUTE APPROVALS: Although we anticipate using the same or nearly the same route each year, the final, exact route is subject to approval from various government agencies and is always subject to change due to various factors beyond our control.

 

Visit our Badwater.com website for more information!

name: Barra of Mendocino Harvest Celebration Run 5k
description:
Like Running or Walking?  Love Wine?  This race is for you! 

Join us on Sunday, October 26, 2025, for a Harvest Celebration 5K run, an exciting new event at Barra of Mendocino Winery! Start times offered at 11:00 AM and 12:30 PM (you’ll select your preferred start time during registration). Experience the charm of this family-owned and organically farmed vineyard, certified annually by CCOF (California Certified Organic Farmers). Want to know more? Click here! After the race concludes, unwind with a post-event glass of wine in the beautiful gardens while soaking in the scenic surroundings. Enjoy a variety of delicious offerings from food trucks and partake in fun lawn games, making it the perfect outing for friends and family. Whether you're planning to run, walk, or simply indulge in the delightful wine and camaraderie, this event promises a truly memorable experience. This race is timed and scored by J3 Timing.  Results will be posted at www.J3Timing.com. 

Registration Includes:

  • T-shirt:  Super Soft Ring Spun Cotton t-shirt included! 
  • Wine Glass: Shatterproof, Collapsible, and Portable!
  • Finisher Medal: Wine Glass Shaped Medal!
  • Race Bib: Chip timed 5k run/walk
  • Results Posted Online
  • ...and of course, a pour of wine!

name: Bearathlon 2025
description:
Mark your calendars for October 19, 2025, and get ready to race at the Berkeley Marina! Registration is open until and on race day.

This year, we're excited to introduce a 5K run alongside our classic races:
🏊‍♂️ Draft-Legal Sprint: 750m swim, 20k bike, 5k run 
🚴‍♀️ Classic Sprint: non-draft legal, 750m swim, 20k bike, 5k run
🏃‍♂️ Classic Relay: team of three with each person racing one leg each (750m swim, 20k bike, or 5k run)
🔥 Mixed Team Relay: team of four with each person racing a super sprint triathlon (250m swim, 5k bike, 1k run)
👟 New! 5K Run

Bearathlon 2025 is designed for athletes of all levels, from beginners to elite competitors. With Open Age Group and Collegiate divisions, there’s a spot for everyone. Whether you're racing solo or as part of a team, you won’t want to miss this thrilling event! Please be sure to check the race website for packet pickup information and schedule changes: https://www.caltriathlon.com/bearathlon.

Packet pick up is available the day before: Saturday, October 18th, and on race day. On Saturday we will distribute packets at the local Sports Basement (2727 Milvia St., Berkeley) from 2pm - 6pm. On race day, we will be at the Berkeley Marina starting at 6am.

Join us for an unforgettable race day—see you at the start line! 🏁🐻

name: Bed to 5K/10K/13.1 Snoozers Run LOS ANGELES
description:
Are you a professional napper with dreams of becoming a 5K finisher? Whether you're getting off the couch or out of bed, this event is made for YOU!

- Fun, no-pressure 5K route 
- Comfy t-shirt (yes, it’s pillow-soft!)
- Snacks at the finish line   
- Prizes for "Best Pajama Outfit" and even a virtual option if you ended up snoozing in ;)

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

name: Bedrock Valley Gravel Ride
description:
BEDROCK VALLEY GRAVEL RIDE

A Gravel Ride experience you don't want to miss. Choose your ride experience around Diamond Valley Lake. This is truly a historic ride in an ancient place. This area's heritage begins during the Ice Age where the most concentrated amount of Mastodons once roam the earth. The remains of hundreds of Mastodons and other prehistoric dinosaurs were discovered in the bedrock of where the lake now rests.

NEW! GRAVEL ROCK BIKE RACE is the first Gravel Bike race that takes you around the Lake. Ride Gravel/Mountain/E-Bike

GRAVEL ROCK RIDE 36K takes you ONE LOOP around beautiful Diamond Valley Lake. Great for your first Gravel/Off-Road Ride

GRAVEL ROCK RIDE 72K takes you TWO LOOPS around beautiful Diamond Valley Lake. Test your skills and make it a double.

GRAVEL ROCK RIDE 108K takes you THREE LOOPS around beautiful Diamond Valley Lake. Find your limits and test your endurance.

GRAVEL KIDS 10K is a fun and flat fun ride for the spirited rider/beginner. An out and back course that gets you stoked!

name: Bedrock Valley Trail Runs
description:
BEDROCK VALLEY TRAIL RUNS

The Bedrock Valley Trail Runs is a NEW trail running experience you don't want to miss. We offer something for the whole family to enjoy. Choose from the beautiful  Bedrock Valley Trail Marathon, Trail Half Marathon, 15k, 5k, Stroller 5k and bring the kids for the the 1 Mile Kid's Fun Run around Diamond Valley Lake. This is truly a historic run in an ancient place. This area's heritage begins during the Ice Age where the most concentrated amount of Mastodons once roam the earth. The remains of hundreds of Mastodons and other prehistoric dinosaurs were discovered in the bedrock of where the lake now rests.

TRAIL MARATHON is a great introduction into trail marathons. A relatively flat loop around the lake ending with some beautiful single track with small climbs. Ideal for all running levels.

TRAIL HALF MARATHON is a beautiful out and back section along the lake bed and perfect for accomplishing your first half marathon.

15K course challenges the runner with a little of everything: flat, fast, climbing, descending on the famous Wildflower single track trail.

NEW! 10K is a fast out and back with views of the lake.

NEW! STAMPEDE 5K is a fast and flat out and back. Great for a fast run or hike. 

SOARING 5K is a great distance through the stunning Wildflower Trails. Great for a quick run or hike. This course does take you up and down the trails finishing along the shoreline.

STROLLER TRAIL 5k our first specific stroller only 5k is a beautiful flat 3.1 miles out and back. Enjoy with the little ones.

KID'S 1 MILE FUN RUN is open to children 10 and younger. This is a non-timed run. All kids receive a finisher’s medal and other goodies.

NEW! GRAVEL ROCK BIKE RACE is the first Gravel Bike race that takes you around the Lake. Ride Gravel/Mountain/E-Bike

We are a CUPLESS race series. Please make sure to bring some form of hydration vessel to carry hydration for your event. There will not be cups provided at aid stations.

name: Beginner Sailing: Oct 18 & 19
description:
Two-day adult sailing classes are offered most weekends from 9 am to 4 pm at Fiddler's Cove Marina. Classes are open to all eligible MWR patrons and sponsored guests. Minimum age requirement is 16 years or older with a parent or guardian.

Class fees per person vary by military affiliation and rank. Dependent fees are calculated at the sponsoring active duty or retiree rate. Pre-registration is required as classes can fill up quickly.

Registration includes boat rental, instruction, and textbooks. Students per boat will be kept to the minimum amount possible in order to maximize learning potential and will range from one to four. Number of students per boat is dependent on the boat size, sailing conditions and the skills being developed in the class. On completion of the course, participants receive a Navy Sailing Qualification Card.

A valid California Boater Card and/or a course completion certificate is required before attending the first class. This is a free California Safety class required for all boat owners 16 years and older. California Boater Cards and/or course completion certificates will be checked at the start of the first class. A free online course is offered through https://www.boatus.org/california/.  Once the course is complete and an application has been filled out through California State Parks then a card will be sent in the mail to your address. A digital card will be emailed at the completion of the course and is a valid representation of a California Boater Card for this course.

Once you sign-up please stop by Fiddlers Cove Marina boathouse to pick up your study materials. Some preliminary reading will be given before the start of the course.

Please note: closed-toe shoes are required aboard all Navy MWR boats. Sunscreen, sunglasses, and hats are strongly recommended.

name: Bell Gardens 5K
description: Bell Gardens 5K course is designed to provide fast times, and it’s ideal for spectators. This is a two-loop course that covers flat wide public streets of Bell Gardens. Participants will start at Veterans park at the corner of Perry and Suva, head east towards Scout Street, then back to complete the loop on Florence Place. Making a turn on Perry then onto lap 2. A water station will be available at the start of the second loop. The Kid's 1/2 mile is out and back on Suva Street. The road will be completely closed to traffic.

This event supports NOT TODAY CANCER and their mission to find a CURE for devastating childhood cancers. 
 
Despite childhood cancer rates being on the rise, only 4% of US Federal Funding for Cancer Research goes to Pediatrics. 
 
When Mason was 9 years old he was diagnosed with T-Cell Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL).  His cancer was treated with chemotherapies that have been in use for decades, because there is a devastating lack of funding for new treatments with better outcomes!  
For two years, Mason and his family used the slogan “Not Today Cancer'“ as their mantra and when he died from the disease, the journey continued and this local non-profit was founded in Mason's honor. Scientists are close to a cure to help children like Mason and you can help! 
 
NOT TODAY CANCER

description:
The 12th Annual Big Bear Turkey Trot
✨ What’s New This Year
📍 A new home in the Moonridge Corridor, starting and finishing at Dank Donuts.
🌲 A fresh route on the Rathbun Creek Trail, with a memorable lap through the Moonridge Zoo 🦓🦙🦅.
🏃 A 3-mile fun run that’s approachable for everyone.
👶 A free kids’ run, keeping the tradition alive for the next generation.
 
🗓️ Event Schedule
Time
Activity

Registration & check-in opens

Holiday Warmup Yoga 🧘 with Colin Schour
9:30 AM

💸 Registration
Adults: $40
Youth (under 18): $25

Locals: $5 discount with ID at packet pickup
No refunds (rain, shine, or snow—it’s all part of the fun).

🎄 A holiday finisher ornament
🧘 A lighthearted yoga warm-up
🎭 A lively costume contest
🥧 The pumpkin pie aid station (yes, actual pie!)
🎶🍹 The Danksgiving party at the finish line
 
📦 Packet Pickup
🗓️ Monday, Nov 24 – Wednesday, Nov 26 (4–7 PM): The Yellow Post, 546 Pine Knot Blvd

Strollers & kids? Strollers are welcome, and the kids’ run is free.
Refunds? Nope. The Turkey Trot happens in any weather.
Local discount? Show ID for $5 off.

The Big Bear Turkey Trot has always been about more than miles—it’s a morning of laughter, costumes, pie, and community. This year, we’ll gather in Moonridge, run the trail, visit the zoo, and then celebrate together at Danksgiving. We’ll see you out there. 🦃✨

name: Big Sur River Run
description:
Big Sur River Run is a benefit race for two important Big Sur community organizations, Big Sur Health Center and Big Sur Fire. There are two races, a 10k and 5k. Both courses are all flat, black-top road loops alongside Big Sur River, through Pfeiffer Big Sur State Park's redwood and oak grove campgrounds. The 10k is a certified course. The 5k is a Family Fun Run or Walk. No Bicycles, dogs, strollers, skates, wagons, or other wheeled conveyances (other than wheelchairs) are permitted. Prizes for 10K Race winners and top finishers.

Since 1981 two of Big Sur’s most vital institutions have been supported by the generosity of those who love to run. Most who visit Big Sur revel in the remoteness without taking in the impact it has on emergency services. The local Volunteer Fire Department, Big Sur Fire, and the Big Sur Health Center both rely on donations to provide support for visitors and residents alike. The run’s beneficiaries, Big Sur Fire and the Big Sur Health Center, have never done more to serve and support our community than in recent years. These critical emergency services need our support more than ever and we encourage you to donate to each organization directly. To date over 30,000 runners have joined the cause, supporting these institutions, and basking in the beauty of Big Sur. Will you join us this year?
