name: Davis Stampede
description:
The Davis Stampede takes place each year in February, and includes 5K, 10K and Half Marathon routes. We also offer a family friendly 2K (1.24 mile) fun run/walk division that is perfect for younger athletes, families, and pups. Starting and finishing at Davis’ Playfields Park, the Davis Stampede is a great way to kick off 2026 with a commitment to fitness. Courses are mostly flat and take runners and walkers through east and south Davis’s greenbelts and neighborhood streets. Race amenities include finisher’s medals, half marathon pace groups, t-shirts, a post-race expo, and course water stations stocked with water and electrolyte replacement along the course.

 

Registration will open on October 1, 2025

Please register early! The Half Marathon often sells out or comes close to it.

 

Start Times:

8:00 a.m. - Half Marathon and 10K
8:10 a.m. - 5K
9:00 a.m. - 2K 
last updated 9/2025; subject to change

Entry Includes:

Blend performance short sleeved t-shirt, finisher medal, chip timing, eligibility for division awards. Option to upgrade to a long sleeve technical (100% polyester) shirt for $8; available while supplies last. You also may opt out of the short sleeve t-shirt and save $5. 

Packet Pick Up:

You can pick up your packet (bib and shirt) on Saturday, February 21 from 1pm to 4pm at Playfields Park (race venue). We allow you to pick up for friends, and ID is not required.  You can also pick up on race day (Feb. 22) starting at 6:30 a.m. If picking up on race day, we suggest arriving at least one hour prior to your race start. We encourage all participants to have their QR code available on their phone for fast check-in. You can find this in your confirmation email. 

Safety pins will be available at registration. On race morning, please pin your race bib to the clothing on the FRONT of your body so that it is visible to timing officials, course monitors, and race photographers. 

Overall and Age Group Awards:

Overall awards will be presented to the top male, female and nonbinary finishers based on gun time. Age group awards will be determined by net time and will be awarded to the top three male, female, and nonbinary registrants per age group. Registrants may decline to state their gender and / or age, however, those entrants will not be eligible for age group or overall awards or results ranking in those categories.  Award pick up is available on race day; unclaimed awards are not mailed. Awards also presented to the top three finishers in each special division. See section below for more detailed information on age groups and special divisions. 

Participate Virtually:

Those who are unable to attend on event day or who would prefer to participate on their own schedule may register as a virtual participant. Virtual packets will be mailed on or about 2/25/26 and will include a bib, finisher medal for the division you designate upon entry, and t-shirt (if selected). Virtual participants are welcome to pick up their packets at the Saturday Packet Pick Up if preferred. The deadline to sign up as a Virtual Participant is Thursday, February 19. The last day to request a switch from an in-person division to the virtual division (in cases of injury, change of plans, illness, etc.) is February 21 at 11:59 pm and this may be done via email.  Virtual participants may upload their results online by following these steps: (1) search name in upper right-hand corner; (2) next to name, click 'edit time'; (3) input your finish time in the format of HH:MM:SS and provide other requested information. Times may be submitted from February 21 through March 22 (link will be available on Feb. 21), although you may complete your run/walk any time that works for you after time of registration. Submitting a time is optional and not required. There are no age group or overall awards for the virtual divisions.  

Half Marathon:


Half Marathon course cut-off time is 3.5 hours or 11:30 a.m. Those on a pace to finish after this time will be offered a ride back to the finish line.

Minimum age to participate in the Half Marathon is 15. Consideration will be made on a case by case basis for youth 14 and under to participate in the Half Marathon who are sufficiently trained; must be accompanied by an adult (who must be registered). Send your request to acopfoundation@gmail.com by February 12th.

Water/fluid stations will be located approximately every two miles and will offer water and electrolyte replacement. Please carry nutrition or salt with you should it be a part of your training/racing regimen. 

Strollers, Dogs, Wagons, and Wheels:

Wheelchair entrants may participate in all divisions. Racing wheelchairs should start at the front and coordinate with event official; pushed or casual wheelchair entrants should start toward the back. Pushed wheelchairs should start towards the back. Adaptive Divisions in the 5K, 10K, and Half Marathon.  Please note: half marathon has approximately 1/4 mile on crushed gravel by Barovetto Park plus about 1 mile on trail (service road around Wildhorse Golf Course). 5K or 10K entrants wishing to push a stroller MUST start toward the back of the pack at the starting line, no exceptions.  In the 2K, strollers, dogs, wagons (for children or dogs) and wheelchairs are permitted. Wagons must have seatbelts if children are inside them. Those with dogs or strollers should line up behind the runners who are participating without a dog/stroller. Dogs must be on a nonretractable leash, well behaved in crowds and around other dogs, and owners must clean up after their pet. It is not suggested that children under age 11 run unaccompanied in the 2K. 

Timing:

Because this even utilizes chip timing for all events, we remind participants that there is no need to crowd the start line when the race starts; your time does not start until you physically cross the mats at the starting line. All age group awards and results placements, except for the top overall finishers (i.e. first 3 per gender across the finish line), are determined by chip/net time.

Guides/Support Runners for Adaptive Entrants:

If you are a sighted guide for a visually impaired participant, or a support runner/walker for an entrant in an adaptive category, please do not enter the adaptive division. Support Runners (including sighted guides) must be registered for the event either as a standard paid entrant or as a support runner. To register for the support runner/walker category, select "Support Runner" choice at registration (end of list). Those registering as a support runner will not be eligible for age group awards nor be ranked by age.   In the case that support runners  wish to receive the full race experience (eligible for awards, ranked by age division, etc) in that case they should register for the distance they are going to run/walk (Half Marathon, 5K, etc) instead of as a Support Runner, but be sure to not enter an Adaptive Division. Email acopfoundation@gmail.com with any questions prior to registering.  

Notes:
- We suggest that support runners/walkers and guides wear high visibility clothing or a vest indicating that they are a guide or a support runner. However, it is not required. 
- Please do not register as a Support Runner if you do not already have an athlete you are paired with. At this time we do not have a matching program, but will post if there are adaptive entrants seeking support runners.
- Please email us at acopfoundation@gmail.com with any questions. 

Beneficiary 

The event will benefit Cancer Champions. Read more about their mission at https://cancerchampions.org.  

Volunteers

Volunteers are needed to help with a variety of tasks on race day, as well as at Packet Pick Up. Sign up on the volunteer tab. For more information about the opportunities we have available for interested volunteers, or to sign up as a group, please see the volunteer tab on our website here. 

Refund Policy & Race Rules:

Entries are non-refundable and non-transferable to other events in the case of illness, injury, or change of plans; event happens rain or shine. You must be registered for the distance for which you intend to participate.  We reserve the right to postpone, delay, reschedule, or cancel the event if unforeseen condition occur that would compromise the ability for the event to be held in a manner that is safe for athletes, volunteers, staff, law enforcement, and the community. Should the event be postponed, rescheduled, or canceled, refunds will NOT be offered. Read complete details here: https://runsignup.com/Race/28183/RefundPolicy

name: Davis Turkey Trot
description:
We offer multiple events and distances, with something for every age group and ability. On event morning, along with an enjoyable run or walk through Davis’ residential neighborhoods and greenbelts, participants enjoy our post-race expo, with refreshments and samples from vendors. Prizes for timed events to overall winners as well as the top three finishers in each category. Prizes to top finishers in special divisions for 2 Mile, 5K, 10K, and Half.

 

2025 Start Times

2025 times are subject to change and may change from the below

7:50 AM - Half Marathon
8:05 AM - 2 Mile
8:30 AM - 5K
9:00 AM - 10K 
10:15 AM - 1 Mile (Timed, all ages)
10:30 AM - Kids Fun Runs (1/2, 1/4 mile + Toddler Trot)
Last Updated 7/25/25

NOTE: There are field limits for all divisions due to the width of the routes and safety concerns. The Half Marathon has sold out or neared sell-out in both 2024 and 2023; register early. 

RACE INFO AT A GLANCE:

Race Venue: Civic Center Park | Corner 7th and B Streets 
Google Map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/bWHbhN219Muk71ve9  

Pre-Race Packet Pick Up: Friday, November 21 from 1:30 to 6:00 pm at the Veterans Memorial Center, located at 14th Street at B Street (in between the Yolo County Library and Davis High School). Address: 203 East 14th Street, Davis, CA 95616
Friday Parking: Davis High School student lot or library lot

Saturday (Race Day Pick Up): 6:30 am onwards at Civic Center Park
Arrive at registration 60-75 minutes early if picking up race day
Saturday parking: Downtown streets or at Davis High School
(suggested) and walk down B Street from 14th to 7th Street

  • 2024 Race results available here.
  • 2023 Race results: https://bit.ly/DTT2023Results  

Divisions and Amenities

1 MILE/2 MILE/5K/10K/HALF Entries: Includes chip timing and eligibility for age group awards, long sleeve, DryBlend (50/50) t-shirt, and a finisher medal.  Age division awards three-deep in age groups. Prizes to the top three finishers by gender (men, women, nonbinary) in special divisions in the 2M, 5K, 10K, and Half Marathon.  Participants are eligible to win both age group and special division prizes. See bottom of page for more info.  It is not suggested that children under age 11 run unaccompanied by an adult in any of these distances. All participants on the course for the 1M, 2M, 5K, 10K, Half must be registered. Children in strollers are FREE but we ask that you complete a registration for them. They will receive a complimentary commemorative race bib (which you can display during the race on the stroller, not required) and you will have the option to add-on a short sleeve t-shirt for them if you desire. One parent / guardian may run alongside a child in the Kids Fun Run and does not need to be registered. All participants on the course in the 1 Mile, 2 Mile, 5K, 10K, and Half Marathon must be registered. 

Age Groups: 5K, 10K, Half Marathon have 5 year age groups as follows:

  • 5K: 7 & Under, 8-9, 10-11, 12-13, 14-15, 16-19, …, 75-79, 90+
  • 10K: 11 & Under, 12-13, 14-15, 16-19, 20-24, …, 75-79, 80+
  • Half Marathon:  1-15 Yrs, 16-19, 20-24, …, 65-69, 70+

2 Mile and 1 Mile will have the following age groups: 

  • Children 8 and Under, Children 9-12, Teens 13-17, Adults 18-39, Masters 40-59, Seniors 60+.

Men, women, and nonbinary divisions will be awarded equally. Age group placement will be determined by net (chip) time for all events. Overall top finishers by gender (top 3 for 5K, 10K, Half; top 1 for 2 mile and 1 mile) will be determined by gun time for all timed events. 

 

Half Marathon: This 13.1 mile course (same route as 2023-2024) starts at 7:50 a.m. and travels through Downtown Davis, the Cannery, into the country via F Street and Road 29, and through the Davis greenbelts, finishing on B Street at the same finish line as the other races. Pacers from GVH will be present from 1:40 to 3:00 goal finish times to help you achieve your race aspirations. Water stops are every two miles (approx.). Course cut-off is 4 hours or 11:50 am. If you are not on track to finish within this timeframe, you will be offered a ride back to the finish line.  There are two "hills" on the half marathon route: 1) Covell Blvd overpass after the Cannery (to go up and over the train tracks) and 2) the footbridge to cross Covell and enter Community Park, near Catalina Ave. For the most part this is a very flat course.  The course has approximately one unpaved mile along the north edge of town along the canal. description:

Prizes for timed events to overall winners as well as the top three finishers in each category. Prizes to top finishers in special divisions for 2 Mile, 5K, 10K, and Half.

 

2025 Start Times

2025 times are subject to change and may change from the below

7:50 AM - Half Marathon
8:05 AM - 2 Mile
8:30 AM - 5K
9:00 AM - 10K 
10:15 AM - 1 Mile (Timed, all ages)
10:30 AM - Kids Fun Runs (1/2, 1/4 mile + Toddler Trot)

RACE INFO AT A GLANCE:

Race Venue: Civic Center Park | Corner 7th and B Streets 
Google Map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/bWHbhN219Muk71ve9  

Pre-Race Packet Pick Up: Friday, November 21 from 1:30 to 6:00 pm at the Veterans Memorial Center, located at 14th Street at B Street (in between the Yolo County Library and Davis High School). Address: 203 East 14th Street, Davis, CA 95616
Friday Parking: Davis High School student lot or library lot

Saturday (Race Day Pick Up): 6:30 am onwards at Civic Center Park
Arrive at registration 60-75 minutes early if picking up race day
Saturday parking: Downtown streets or at Davis High School
(suggested) and walk down B Street from 14th to 7th Street

  • 2024 Race results available here.
  • 2023 Race results: https://bit.ly/DTT2023Results  

Divisions and Amenities

Prizes to the top three finishers by gender (men, women, nonbinary) in special divisions in the 2M, 5K, 10K, and Half Marathon.  Participants are eligible to win both age group and special division prizes. See bottom of page for more info.  It is not suggested that children under age 11 run unaccompanied by an adult in any of these distances. All participants on the course for the 1M, 2M, 5K, 10K, Half must be registered. Children in strollers are FREE but we ask that you complete a registration for them. They will receive a complimentary commemorative race bib (which you can display during the race on the stroller, not required) and you will have the option to add-on a short sleeve t-shirt for them if you desire. One parent / guardian may run alongside a child in the Kids Fun Run and does not need to be registered. All participants on the course in the 1 Mile, 2 Mile, 5K, 10K, and Half Marathon must be registered. 

Age Groups: 5K, 10K, Half Marathon have 5 year age groups as follows:

  • 5K: 7 & Under, 8-9, 10-11, 12-13, 14-15, 16-19, …, 75-79, 90+
  • 10K: 11 & Under, 12-13, 14-15, 16-19, 20-24, …, 75-79, 80+
  • Half Marathon:  1-15 Yrs, 16-19, 20-24, …, 65-69, 70+

2 Mile and 1 Mile will have the following age groups: 

  • Children 8 and Under, Children 9-12, Teens 13-17, Adults 18-39, Masters 40-59, Seniors 60+.

Men, women, and nonbinary divisions will be awarded equally. Age group placement will be determined by net (chip) time for all events. Overall top finishers by gender (top 3 for 5K, 10K, Half; top 1 for 2 mile and 1 mile) will be determined by gun time for all timed events. 

 

Half Marathon: This 13.1 mile course (same route as 2023-2024) starts at 7:50 a.m. and travels through Downtown Davis, the Cannery, into the country via F Street and Road 29, and through the Davis greenbelts, finishing on B Street at the same finish line as the other races. Pacers from GVH will be present from 1:40 to 3:00 goal finish times to help you achieve your race aspirations. Water stops are every two miles (approx.). Course cut-off is 4 hours or 11:50 am. If you are not on track to finish within this timeframe, you will be offered a ride back to the finish line.  There are two "hills" on the half marathon route: 1) Covell Blvd overpass after the Cannery (to go up and over the train tracks) and 2) the footbridge to cross Covell and enter Community Park, near Catalina Ave. For the most part this is a very flat course.  The course has approximately one unpaved mile along the north edge of town along the canal. Minimum age is 15. Age exceptions made on a case by case basis; if granted, those under 15 must be accompanied by an adult who is registered for the race. Email to inquire. 

 

Virtual Entries: Includes packet mailing via USPS (packets sent postrace), commemorative bib number, Long Sleeved t-shirt (opt-out if you prefer no tshirt), and finisher medal. Virtual Entrants will be emailed information about how to upload their time to our results server. Complete your virtual run or walk anytime between November 1 and December 15th. Virtual entrants may pick up their packets at packet pick up 11/21 if desired; otherwise they will be mailed after the race.

 

1 Mile All-Ages Run or Walk: The 1 Mile race will be timed and be for all ages. Prizes will be awarded to the top overall men, women, and nonbinary finisher plus the top three finishers by gender in each of the following age divisions: Children 8 and Under, Children 9-12, Teens 13-17, Adults 18-39, Masters 40-59, Seniors 60+. All people traveling on the 1 Mile course must be registered. Strollers are allowed but must start at the back, no exceptions. It is not suggested that children under age 11 run unaccompanied by an adult in the 1 Mile. This race goes on city streets.

 

Kids Fun Run Entries: A non-competitive, un-timed fun run with multiple distances. 1/4 Mile: Ages 3-12. 1/2 Mile: Ages 5-12. Toddler Trot: Ages 5 and Under.

 

NEW Add-On Davis Turkey Trot Merchandise for participants: During registration you may add-on the following items to your entry:

  • Short Sleeved cotton t-shirt. Available in sizes Adult S up to Adult 2X and Youth XS-XL. This shirt will be available for pick up in the Extra Merchandise tent during Packet Pick Up or on Race Day.
  • Embroidered Davis Turkey Trot hat. Moisture wicking running cap or trucker cap (47 brand) adjustable. Available in one-size-fits-most adults. Hats will be available for pick up in the Extra Merchandise tent during Packet Pick Up or on Race Day.
  • Bark Bag. Bark bag includes a pup-themed small Davis Turkey Trot medal (different medal than humans receive), Turkey Trot themed bandanna, and other dog-themed giveaways.
  • Add-ons are available while supplies last; please order early. No refunds; all sales are final. Sales tax will be applied to add-on purchases.
  • Add-ons are not mailed for no shows but are mailed for virtual participants with their packets.

Guides/Support Runners for Adaptive Entrants: If you are a sighted guide for a visually impaired participant, or a support runner/walker for a disabled entrant in an adaptive category, please do not enter the adaptive division - that division is for the disabled athlete to enter. Support Runners (including sighted guides) for entrants must be registered for the event either as a standard paid entrant or as a support runner. name: Davis Turkey Trot Vendor Registration
description:
The Davis Turkey Trot’s 2025 event will mark a thirty-seven year commitment from A Change of Pace to providing Yolo County with a fun, safe health-oriented event. Our goal is to have a giant party afterwards and we want to invite everyone. Our booth fees are meant to be affordable for small and local businesses as well as nonprofits.

 

  • The deadline to sign up to be a booth vendor, or to sponsor a company team, is November 15th.
  • Tents, tablecloths and other items to be supplied by vendor and are not included. 
  • You can add on the rental of one 8’ table and two chairs to your booth reservation. Tents are not available for rental. 
  • A site map and one-sheet will be emailed out on approximately Wed., Nov. 19, 2025.
  • The expo happens on Civic Center Field (grass) on Saturday, November 22, 2025 and will take place rain or shine. 
  • Insurance Requirements - Due to requirements from our event insurance provider, all sponsors, vendors, subcontractors, and booth operators must provide a Certificate of Insurance (COI)

 

We have two options for companies to take part in this year's event:

 

(1) Enhanced vendor booth package. This includes:


- 10x10' vendor booth at the event with premium placement
- Logo on the Davis Turkey Trot event page on changeofpace.com
- One post on the A Change of Pace social media (Facebook, Instagram) promoting your business (business must provide photos)
- One banner displayed at the event on the race finish line fencing (banner must be supplied by sponsor, max size 3'x8')

 

(2) Standard vendor booth package. This includes:


- One 10'x10' booth space in the post-race expo, where you can showcase products to event attendees, sample, do demonstrations, etc. 
- If you need a table and chairs, you may add this on during the registration process for $20
- Discounted rate available for nonprofits

 

 

Questions? Email us at acopfoundation@gmail.com

description:
The Davis Turkey Trot’s 2025 event will mark a thirty-seven year commitment from A Change of Pace to providing Yolo County with a fun, safe health-oriented event. Our goal is to have a giant party afterwards and we want to invite everyone. Our booth fees are meant to be affordable for small and local businesses as well as nonprofits.

 

  • The deadline to sign up to be a booth vendor, or to sponsor a company team, is November 15th.
  • Tents, tablecloths and other items to be supplied by vendor and are not included. 
  • You can add on the rental of one 8’ table and two chairs to your booth reservation. Tents are not available for rental. 
  • A site map and one-sheet will be emailed out on approximately Wed., Nov. 19, 2025.
  • The expo happens on Civic Center Field (grass) on Saturday, November 22, 2025 and will take place rain or shine. 
  • Insurance Requirements - Due to requirements from our event insurance provider, all sponsors, vendors, subcontractors, and booth operators must provide a Certificate of Insurance (COI)

 

We have two options for companies to take part in this year's event:

 

(1) Enhanced vendor booth package. This includes:


- 10x10' vendor booth at the event with premium placement
- Logo on the Davis Turkey Trot event page on changeofpace.com
- One post on the A Change of Pace social media (Facebook, Instagram) promoting your business (business must provide photos)
- One banner displayed at the event on the race finish line fencing (banner must be supplied by sponsor, max size 3'x8')

 

(2) Standard vendor booth package. This includes:


- One 10'x10' booth space in the post-race expo, where you can showcase products to event attendees, sample, do demonstrations, etc. 
- If you need a table and chairs, you may add this on during the registration process for $20
- Discounted rate available for nonprofits

 

 

Questions? Email us at acopfoundation@gmail.com

name: Day of The Dead 5K
description:
Event Location

  • Date & Time: Sunday, October 26, 2025
    Location: Wild Runners Fair Oaks, 10149 Fair Oaks Blvd, Fair Oaks, CA

Participant Packet Pick Up

  • Saturday, October 25, 2025, 10 am – 5 pm
  • Race Day, Sunday, October 26, 2025, 6:30am - 7:30 am
  • Location: Wild Runners Fair Oaks, 10149 Fair Oaks Blvd,  Fair Oaks Ca 95628

Race Day Schedule

  • 6:30 am - 7:30 am: Race day registration and packet pick up
  • 7:30 am: All final items dropped off for the La Ofrenda
  • 8:05 am - Kids Races begin
  • 8:20 am - Day of the Dead progression to starting line
  • 8:30 am - Day of the Dead 5k race begins
  • 9:30 am - Awards ceremony and costume contest

Swag & Event

All participants receive:

  • Bib number, timing device and safety pins
  • Short-sleeved event shirt
  • Finisher medal
  • Coupon for one-free tamale for each participant*
  • Special offers from our sponsors

* Redeemable only at the post-event expo and festival on October 25, 2025. 

  • Family-Friendly Walk/Run Events: The Day of the Dead 5k has something for every generation to enjoy from a 5k for adults to our Kid Races. 
    Live Entertainment: Immerse yourself in Mexican tradition with live music and performances. With stilt walkers and live music, transport yourself to another time as we pay homage to the cultural heritage of our grandparents.
  • La Ofrenda: To honor loved ones who have passed, bring offerings, such as photographs, flowers, nostalgic items, and foods as we create a collective space of remembrance and gratitude.  All items should be placed on La Ofrenda by 7:30am in front of the Wild Runners store at 10149 Fair Oaks Blvd.
  • Antojitos Delights: Enjoy the flavors and culinary delights that our grandparents cherished. In addition to free home-made tamales for race participants, indulge in the food and delectable treats of Mexican heritage.
  • Post-Race Festival and Expo: Unwind and connect with fellow participants post race! Explore our Community Partner and vendor booths showcasing the latest in fitness, wellness, and recovery services.  

5k Course

The race kicks off with a 0.5-mile downhill through the charming Old Fair Oaks Village neighborhood and over the bridge. Following a 3.2-mile out-and-back path along the picturesque American River Trail towards Bannister Park, the course remains entirely on paved roads and trails, catering to participants of all abilities and those with strollers.  The race concludes with an approximate half-mile ascent back to the finish line.

Awards & Age Divisions

Awards ceremony to follow event at 9:30 a.m. for the 5k and costume contest. Prizes for overall male and female winners will be presented. Top three finishers in each age division will receive a special prize. Age-group winners pick up prizes at the Awards table.

Top boy and girl finishers in the 1/4 and 1/2 mile races will receive a special prize. All other kid finishers will receive medals.

Top 3 finishers in the male and female races will respectively receive: 

  • 1st Place: $100 gift card to Wild Runners
  • 2nd Place: $50 gift card to Wild Runners
  • 3rd Place: $25 gift card to Wild Runners

1st place finishers in each Age Group (5k Run) will receive a free pair of socks from our sponsor from OS1st:
12 & Under, 13-15, 16-18, 19-24, 25-29, 30-34, 35-39, 40-44, 45-49, 50-54, 55-59, 60-64, 65-69, 70-74, 75-79, 80+

Costume Contest:

  • 1st Place: $100 gift card to Wild Runners
  • 2nd Place: $50 gift card to Wild Runners
  • 3rd Place: $25 gift card to Wild Runners

Rules & Guidelines for all entrants*

  • Bib numbers must not be altered, should be worn on the front of the runner, and be visible.
  • No unregistered runners, walkers or pacers.
  • Wearing headphones is discouraged.
  • No bicycles.
  • Your pup is welcome to participate in the 5k race (always on leash and after signing a waiver).
  • Strollers are welcome.
  • Walkers/runners of all abilities and capabilities welcome. 
  • Shirts are not guaranteed for the late registration 

* No refunds

name: Día De Los Muertos 5k Race
description:
Come celebrate Día De Los Muertos (Day Of The Dead) and run a 5k race. 

 

5k run/walk starts 9am on Saturday November 1st, 2025. All levels are welcome, it is a fully paved path, strollers are welcome.

 

All participants will receive a tshirt with registration, top 3 in each age group and top 3 over all in male and female categories will receive ribbons.

 

The race will be held at North Natomas Regional Park, it is a flat course held on the sidewalk which is a loop around the entire park. All ages and running/walking abilities are welcome to participate. Participants are welcome to wear costumes.

Only dogs allowed are service dogs, this is a USATF rule because this is a sanctioned race by USA Track and field.

https://www.usatf.org/home/top-utility-nav-content/event-insurance-sanctions/sanctions-faqs#Can%20dogs%20or%20other%20animals%20participate%20in%20sanctioned%20events?

 

This is a fundraiser for the Azteca FC youth Cross Country and track program. Every season members from Azteca FC work hard to qualify for the Junior Olympics. This 5k is a fundraiser to assist the athletes who qualify to attend and compete in the Junior Olympics. In July 2025, Jackson Sevilla and Ethan Tang, represented Azteca FC at the Junior Olympics In Savannah, Georgia. Your generous support helps athletes compete at the highest level and gain national recognition to help them earn opportunites to compete at the college level.

www.Aztecafc.com

Sponsors of this race include Lisa Kaplan, District 1 City of Sacramento Councilmember and Azteca FC.

name: DIA DE LOS MUERTOS 5K RUN/WALK - CLOVIS
description:
Join Us for a Vibrant Celebration of Life and Remembrance!

Dia de los Muertos, or Day of the Dead, is a cherished Mexican holiday that honors and celebrates the lives of those who have passed away. Families gather to create colorful altars, share stories, and remember their loved ones with joy and gratitude. This unique race at Clovis invites you to participate in a heartfelt celebration filled with culture, community, and connection.

Don’t miss this chance to celebrate life, community, and the rich traditions of Dia de los Muertos. Register today and join us for a day filled with joy, remembrance, and connection!

A FEW REASONS TO JOIN OUR EVENT!

  • HOODIES for all participants (Must be registered by October 5th). Shirts if registered after that date. 
  • Unique MEDAL
  • TACOS
  • HOT CHOCOLATE
  • Dia de los Muertos "PAN DULCE"
  • $100 CASH to top male/female!
  • $200 CASH to team with most participants!
  • $200 CASH to the fastest team (top 5 runners in your team count for scoring)
  • COFFEE MUG for everyone who register by Sunday, October 5th.
  • COFFEE TUMBLER for top 10 male/female!
  • Unique age group AWARDS
  • ALTAR setting decoration
  • Picture with our CATRINA
  • ATHENA/CLYDESDALE age group divisions
  • Best costume competition
  • GREAT RUNNING COURSE
  • KIDS RACES
  • FUN, MUSIC

BIB PICK UP/LATE REGISTRATION:

SAT, OCT 25TH, 2:30-5:00PM @ FLEET FEET STORE

SUN, OCT 26TH, 7:45-8:45AM @ RACE LOCATION (CALIFORNIA HEALTH SCIENCES UNIVERSITIES @ 120 N. CLOVIS AVE, CLOVIS CA 93612

name: Dia De Los Reyes Magos Half Marathon & 5k - Bakersfield
description:
"Dia de los Reyes Magos" or 3 wise men day is a very important Mexican celebration! On January 6th, kids are expected to receive presents from the "Reyes Magos" and families get together to share the "Rosca de Reyes" or sweet bread and drink some hot chocolate! This "Rosca de Reyes" bread contains inside several baby Jesus. It's the tradition that whoever gets the baby Jesus is expected to bring tamales and hot chocolate on February 2nd! Join us at this celebration for a morning of family fun at the Dia De Los Reyes Magos Half Marathon and 5k. 

A few reasons to join our event:

  • UNIQUE MEDALS
  • AGE GROUP TROPHIES FOR BOTH 5K AND HALF MARATHON
  • HOODIES (FOR THOSE WHO REGISTER BEFORE DECEMBER 15TH) SHIRTS FOR THOSE WHO SIGN UP AFTER
  • TACOS
  • HOT CHOCOLATE
  • $100 TO FIRST MALE/FEMALE IN THE HALF MARATHON
  • $200 CASH TO TEAM WITH MOST PARTICIPANTS
  • ROSCA DE REYES SWEET BREAD
  • COFFEE MUGS (For those who participate in dance competition :)

  • ATHENA, CLYDESDALE CATEGORIES/AGE GROUP AWARDS

name: DINO DASH
description:
It's an Orange County tradition!

The Dinosaur Dash is a community run, walk, and bike event benefiting the Tustin Public Schools Foundation. There's something for everyone--a 2k fun run, chip-timed 5k and 10k runs, and Bike Tours for all riding levels (15k and a family-friendly 5k).

The finisher medal for the 10k, 5k, and Bike Tour features our unique, student-designed logo.

The 5k and 10k top finishers in each racing age division will receive the official Dino Dash trophy--hand-made by Tustin Unified students. Second- and third-place finishers will receive a medal. The 2k Fun Run and the Bike Tour are not timed and do not have age division awards.

The 15k bike tour passes through Tustin and Irvine before returning to The Market Place in Tustin.  This tour is recommended for riders age 13 and up since it is on open roads.  We also offer a family-friendly 5K tour on closed roads. The Bike Tours are not timed.

A free family Expo will offer activities, school fundraising booths, and exhibitors.

The Tustin Public Schools Foundation is a charitable organization that supports the students and teachers of Tustin Unified schools by funding grants, scholarships, and enrichment programs such as after-school sports, robotics, college readiness, Tustin Summer Academy, and more. 

PLEASE NOTE: Race day registrations (Sunday, November 2nd) do not include a shirt.

6:30 AM - Bike Tour - 15k begins on open roads

8:00 AM - 5K Chip-timed Run Begins

8:20 AM - TUSD Middle School Cross Country 5k Begins

8:45 AM - 2K Fun Run Begins (non-timed)

10:30 AM - Event Ends

name: Dirty 30 XL - GRAVEL MEETS MTB
description:
Twice the Grit, Double the Glory – Tackle the Dirty 30 XL on a Drop Bar bike or Mountain Bike at Lake Hodges! Choose your challenge: one lap or two of scenic single-track, rugged fire roads, and relentless climbs — all packed into a thrilling figure-8 course layout built for both drop bar (gravel bike) and mountain bikes. Starting and finishing at Lake Hodge main parking lot offers easy access to trailheads and beautiful support areas and don’t  forget great community building! Riders will reconvene at a central aid station at the staging area after each lap — a great opportunity to refuel, regroup, and soak in the atmosphere before heading out again. The course design is configured as a figure 8, great spectating and easy to re-fuel. Hammer Nutrition Feed station is 1 and 2 at Sunset (just under the HWY 15) @mile 3.6 and 17.

WHEN:

  • December 6, 2025


WHERE:

  • Lake Hodges Boat Ramp20175 Lake Drive, Escondido
  • This address takes you to the gate of the parking lot. Proceed through the gate and follow the road to the boat ramp parking lot

SCHEDULE:

  • Registration/Check-In: 6:30am
  • Course Open for Pre-Riding: 6:30am
  • Race Start: 8:00am

COURSE:

  • Diverse trail types: Expect a seamless mix of hard-packed gravel, smooth and rolling fire roads, punchy climbs, and technical singletrack — all hugging the scenic north shore of Lake Hodges .
  • Flow and challenge: The route weaves through connecting areas like Raptor Ridge and Highland Valley Trail, offering both flowy descents and test-your-metals climbs. Lake view trails may also be incorporated for extra elevation and epic views.
  • Distance per lap: 30 miles
  • Elevation gain: Approx. 1,750 feet per lap (3,500 feet total for the 60-mile option)
  • Route style: Figure 8 loop — riders pass through the main venue at mile 21 just over the halfway point of each lap.
    30‑miles Lap - RideWithGPS

name: Diwali Fun Run + Festival
description:
Due to problems with permits, this event has been changed from a race to a party and fundraiser for Purrific Rescue. Tell your friends!
Join us for an exciting evening celebrating Diwali with a party and an (optional) self-timed 5k race*!

Whether you're a runner, walker, or party-goer, this event promises something for everyone. This family-friendly event combines fitness, fun, food, cat rescue, and Diwali festivities as we light up the night together!

*It's self-timed, but the first 3 women and first 3 men to come back to the Community Center will get awards! Everyone who runs gets a medal too.

Volunteers needed! If we get enough volunteers, we can have non-chip timing!

name: Do It For Her 5K
description:
Run through Temecula’s Wine Country and enjoy the tranquil beauty of rolling vineyards and sun-drenched hills. As you run along the winding paths, the early morning light casts a golden hue over the landscape, highlighting the neat rows of grapevines and the rustic charm of the wineries scattered throughout the valley. Finish with a Vitagliano sangria made from some of the finest Super Tuscan-style wines produced in California.  Shop our local vendors carrying locally grown produce and handcrafted items, all under a beautiful covered patio.  Food Available for purchase.


All proceeds benefit the Heather Janikowski Foundation and the Make A Wish Foundation

name: Dream Big 5k
description:
Join us for a day of fun and fitness at the third annual Dream Big 5k, proudly presented by the Kiwanis Club of Victorville. Whether you’re a seasoned runner or just looking for a fun walk with friends and family, this event promises an enjoyable experience for participants of all levels.

The race takes you through the scenic paths of Victor Valley College, located at 18422 Bear Valley Rd, Victorville, CA, starting bright and early at 8:00 am on Saturday, August 23. But the fun doesn't end at the finish line! Stick around for a variety of race day activities, including local vendors, lively music, and more. Every stride you take helps us support students in the Victor Valley, driving the change we wish to see in our community. Grab your running shoes, and let’s make dreams come true together at the Dream Big 5k!

After the main Dream Big 5K, stick around for even more fun—our Dream Big Mini K for children ages 12 and under! Held at Victor Valley College, this in-person event is all about encouraging kids to get active, dream big, and feel proud of their accomplishments. It’s a joyful, high-energy experience where little ones can cross the finish line to the cheers of friends and family.

The first 50 registered participants of the Mini K will receive a special finisher medal—so don’t wait to sign up! Let’s make it a day to remember filled with smiles, movement, and celebration. Come cheer them on and help create a lasting memory at the Dream Big Mini K!

name: East Bay Front Runners Pride Run and Walk
description:
Hosted by East Bay Front Runners and Walkers 

Come join us at the East Bay's premier LGBTQ+ Pride Race, EBFRW's 21st Annual Pride Run and Walk! We are offering both in-person and virtual options, with running and walking events:

IN-PERSON PRIDE RUN OR WALK – At beautiful Lake Merritt in downtown Oakland

The race starts and finishes at the Adams Point picnic area adjacent to the Lake Merritt Sailboat House in Lakeside Park (on mapping apps: 568 Bellevue Ave., Oakland, CA) on Saturday, October 11, 2025 at 9am. Events include a 5K walk, 5K run and 10K run. Registration for each event is $38.75 (including $3.75 in fees). No refunds or exchanges. Proceeds benefit The Pacific Center for Human Growth in Berkeley, Running for a Better Oakland, and East Bay Front Runners & Walkers. All participants receive discounted shopping at Sports Basement and Road ID, finisher ribbon, and a pair of famed rainbow-tipped Pride socks. Top finishers receive medals. Finisher times will be available on our website and social media. The race celebrates National Coming Out Day.

VIRTUAL PRIDE RUN OR WALK

You have from Saturday, October 11, 2025 through Sunday, October 19, 2025 to complete your distance. Events include a 5K walk, 5K run and 10K run. You can complete your race anywhere you like. Please do so safely. Registration fee is $33.75 (including $3.75 in fees). No refunds or exchanges. Please send us your result no later than Wednesday, October 22, 2025. Proceeds benefit The Pacific Center for Human Growth in Berkeley, Running for a Better Oakland, and East Bay Front Runners & Walkers. All participants receive a PDF bib, discounted shopping at Sports Basement and Road ID, finisher certificate, and finisher ribbon. Print out your PDF bib and send us a photo of yourself wearing it. Finisher times will be available on our website and social media. The race celebrates National Coming Out Day.

name: Elevate 5k & 12 Hour Race at First Baptist Church
description:
Please visit www.ElevateRace.com for the most up to date and detailed information.
Thank you for your interest in participating in our 8th annual Elevate race!

  • What: 5k & 12 hour race
  • Purpose: To support our Elevate missions project
  • When: 5k starts Sat, Feb 14, 2026 @ 9:30am / 12 hour race starts Fri, Feb 13, 2026 @ 8:45pm
  • Where: First Baptist Church campus in Santa Maria, CA
  • Cost:
    • 5k = $22
    • 12 Hour = $45 (This is a bargain! The average price for 12 hour races here in CA is $155.)


All the proceeds from this event will go to support the Elevate missions project. Your participation as either a runner or volunteer will help make it possible!

5k: For only $22 you can challenge yourself to complete the 5k (3.1 miles) race. Awards will be given to the winners in both distances for the different age groups at the 10:30am awards ceremony. While this is a competition, everyone is invited to participate regardless of age or physical ability. It will be a lively and encouraging environment which will be fun for both first timers and experienced runners. Runners must arrive by 8:45 on race morning to receive their race bib and all final instructions before the race begins at 9:30am.  The 5k awards ceremony will take place at 10:30am.

12 Hour race: I know we have some adventurous people out there! How far do you think you could run and walk in 12 hours? The race runs from Friday night at 8:45pm until Saturday morning at 8:45am. It will finish 45 minutes before the start of the 5k. This is a great time to test yourself physically and mentally. Would you like to complete your first marathon? In 12 hours you could even walk a marathon if you could finish each mile in just under 28 minutes.

Here's some good news. We'll have some food and drinks to fuel you through the night, and you can take breaks as often as you'd like. Each lap is 1 mile, and near the start/finish line we'll have an area set up specifically for the 12 hour participants. You're encouraged to bring a comfortable chair, footrest, change of clothes, blankets and anything else that can help make your experience more comfortable. Napping is permitted but not encouraged. Friends and family members are invited to spend the evening there with us supporting and encouraging the participants. There is no minimum number of miles you have to complete. Yes, the person that completes the most loops is the winner, but runners and walkers of all levels are encouraged to set an individual goal and see what they're capable of doing. Races like this are typically very relaxed. Very few people would run the entire time in a race of this distance. Going through the night also provides a unique experience. There will be a variety of awards for the 12 hour race & the 12 hour race awards ceremony will take place at 8:45am right when the race finishes.

As a bonus (or maybe more like a penalty), all 12 Hour participants can also participate in the 5k for free if desired! 12 Hour runners must arrive by 8:00pm Friday evening to receive their race bib and all final instructions before the race begins at 8:45pm.

Course info: Each loop is 1.036 miles for the 5k. The 5k is three loops. For the 12 Hour race there is a minor adjustment to make each loop 1 mile. The loop is entirely on the First Baptist / VCA campus, and during the 5k there will be volunteers throughout the course in order to provide a safe environment for young runners. 12 Hour runners will need to have either a headlamp or flashlight to use on the back portion of the loop where there are no lights.

For the 5k we will have water, Gatorade and bananas during the race and celebratory ice cream sandwiches at the end for all finishers. The 12 Hour participants will have a variety of hot and cold drinks and solid foods to choose from. We hope you have a great time training for and participating in this race!

Please visit www.ElevateRace.com for the most up to date and detailed information.

name: Ellevate Foundation 5K
description:
Beginning Thursday November 27th through Sunday November 30th, join us by completing 3.1 miles from wherever you are!
You can do this by running, jogging, walking, skipping, rolling!

Log your miles on an app like Strava or whatever tracking device you use. 
This is not necessary but fun to show your friends and family what you accomplished.

Ellevate Foundation is a 501c3 nonprofit formed in 2023 for the purpose of elevating women by providing tools and resources to grow personally and professionally, and provide grants to attend professional development events. Our goal for 2025-2026 is to raise enough money through our annual Women's Leadership Summit (WLS), donors and fundraising events like this, to not only fund our annual summit but to fulfill our mission of sending at least 2 women to a national professional development event.

Join us between November 27 - November 30 for second annual virtual 5k.

All profits go to Ellevate Foundation's mission.

name: Ely Mountain Trail Race
description:
Ely Mountain Trail Race – Shaver Lake, CA

14K (8.7mi) + 8K (4.9mi) | Balsam Forebay | Cooler temps. Hot trails.


We’re stoked to bring a brand new adventure to the San Joaquin Running Co lineup — and this one’s a beauty. Join us in the mountains above Shaver Lake for the first-ever Ely Mountain Trail Race, where crisp air, big climbs, and epic views are all on the menu.

 

The 14K course brings the heat with about 1,800 feet of climbing, including a 1,000’ ascent up Ely Mountain. You’ll earn sweeping views of the Sierra, Shaver Lake, and the valley below — then fly down some smooth and fast singletrack and dirt roads back to the finish.

 

The 8K hits a slightly easier route to the top but still climbs about 800 feet, with all the mountain vibes and finish line feels.

 

🏔️ Special Award for King & Queen of the Mountain – fastest segment times to the top of Ely!

🎽 Custom race shirts

🏅 Finisher medals + podium awards

🍕 Post-race food + refreshments

🌲 All the crisp mountain air you’ve been missing

We’re capping this one at 250 runners, so don’t sleep on it — grab your spot and come break in these trails with us.

name: End of the Trail Half Marathon, 10K & 5K
description:
PACKET PICK-UP:

February 27th (Friday). Sole 2 Soul Sports - Visalia at 4241 S. Mooney Blvd (Target Shopping Center). 

TIME: 3:00pm to 6:00pm

 

RACE DAY PACKET PICK-UP:

OPENS at 7:00am, Near the start line under the Visalia Runners Canopy

 

ALL RACES START TIME: 8:00 AM

 

START & FINISH: MOONEY GROVE PARK at the END OF THE TRAIL STATUE.

COURSE DETAILS: The half marathon, 10K, and 5K will Start & Finish at the End of the Trail Statue (road) and will run approximately 1 mile through scenic Mooney Grove Park before heading out the back gate.  The half and 10K continues out on country roads with lots of local cross country teams cheering you on. There will be  DJ Music at the 10k Turn-Around.

These routes are FLAT & FAST with closed roads, DJ’s, live bands, portable restrooms, aid stations, and more! 

At the Finish Line, you will be welcomed back with your EOTT Custom Finisher’s Medal, Hot Breakfast, Chocolate Milk, and a Post-Race Celebration in the Park! You’ll want to stay around and relax in the park with your running buddies!

Whether you Run or Walk, you'll want to join this memorable experience in the beautiful setting of Mooney Grove Park.

Race Proceeds & All Donations will benefit many local high school running programs in Tulare County, athlete scholarships and other community running events to promote health and wellness. You will see those high school runners cheering you on, working our Aid Stations, and keeping you moving!

Why End of the Trail?

  • Courses are Flat & Fast
  • It's a Post Race Party in the Park
  • Closed Running Streets
  • Perfect Cool Weather
  • Custom Finisher's Medal
  • FREE Race Tech Shirt to ALL 5K, 10K & Half Marathon participants 
  • Half marathon, 10K, & 5K Overall Awards
  • Half marathon, 10k, & 5K age group Awards
  • FREE Hot & Fresh Breakfast
  • FREE Rosa Brothers Chocolate Milk
  • FREE Race Photos
  • FREE Chip Timing
  • FREE Interactive Race Day Experience with RaceJoy
  • Post Race Celebration Venue for You, Family, Friends
  • And MORE

name: Endless Summer in the LBC 5K, 10K, & Half Marathon
description:
🌊☀️ Sun. Sand. Miles. Vibes. ☀️🌊

 

Join us on July 12th, 2025, for Endless Summer in the LBC, the ultimate mid-summer running experience along the beautiful Long Beach waterfront. Whether you're looking to set a new PR, enjoy a scenic run, or just soak in the summer vibes, this event has something for everyone!

🏝 Event Highlights:
✅ Scenic Course: Breathe in the fresh ocean air and enjoy stunning beach views along our fast, flat course.
✅ Frozen Treats at the Finish: Cool down with ice-cold frozen pops after you cross the finish line!
✅ Hydration Stations with ICE: Stay refreshed with Gatorade, water, and ice at two aid stations along the course.
✅ Volunteer Medic on Scooter: Keeping an eye on everyone and making sure we all stay safe in the summer heat!
✅ Beach-Themed Photo Ops: Snap your best summer vibes with our amazing beach-inspired backdrops!
✅ Shaded Family Viewing Area: Friends and family can chill in a shaded spectator zone while they cheer you on!
✅ Awards & Swag:
🏅 All finishers receive a custom medal.
📸 FREE race photos to capture the moment.
🥇 Top 3 male & female finishers in each distance win awards.

👟 Event Details:
📅 Date: Saturday, July 12, 2025
📍 Location: Long Beach Waterfront
🏃 Distances: 5K, 10K, and Half Marathon
⏰ Start Times:

7:00 AM – Half Marathon
7:30 AM – 5K & 10K
🎉 Fun Contest – Summer Vibes Edition!
Bring out your best summer-themed outfits! Show up in your most colorful, beachy, tropical attire, and you could win a special prize! Categories include:
🌴 Best Beach Bum Look
🌺 Most Tropical Vibes
😎 Coolest Sunglasses Style

📍 Race Logistics:
🎟 Bib Pick-Up: 6:15 AM – 7:35 AM at the Race Ready Athletics Tent.
🚗 Parking:

Free street parking on along Ocean Blvd.
Paid parking inside the lot $2.00 per hour.


🚻 Restrooms: Available at the start/finish area and along the course.
🍼 Stroller & Walker-Friendly: Everyone is welcome!
Why CaliFlow Runs?
We’re all about good vibes, community, and making running fun. Whether you’re a seasoned racer or just getting started, our events are designed to be inclusive, energetic, and unforgettable.

So grab your sunnies, lace up, and let’s chase Endless Summer in the LBC! 🌞🏃‍♂️🏖

name: Falcon 5K
description:
Hey Falcon 5k supporters - we've already locked down the date for next years run! 

Join us on Saturday, August 15th for the Second Annual Falcon 5k, a community event supporting the College Park High School Cross Country Team! This race is a great way to celebrate the start of the season, build our community, connect with local runners, and show your support for our student-athletes.

Whether you're a seasoned runner, a proud alumni, or a supportive community member, this event is open to all and promises a fun, energetic atmosphere. Proceeds will go directly to the CPHS cross country program to help with travel, gear, and meet expenses.

The race will start at 8AM at the College Park Track, be sure to register by August 2nd to guarantee your t-shirt size!

Come run, cheer, and be part of the College Park spirit!

We're working on more fun to add to next year and would love any additional support anyone would like to add to the program. Please email us at cpfalcon5k@gmail.com if you're interested in helping!

We’re looking for Sponsors, if you or a business you know would be interested, details are HERE!  Thank you!

 

5K Start: 8:00 AM

Bib Pick up: TBD

Race Goodies: All 5K participants will receive an awesome race shirt 

On-site Registration & Bib Pick Up: Available at 7am morning of the event at the course if you were unable to make it to bib pick up

name: Falconry Lessons: Hawk Walk
description:
Experience the ancient art of falconry — where humans and birds of prey work together in perfect harmony. In these hands-on lessons, you’ll learn how to handle, train, and fly magnificent raptors like hawks and falcons under the guidance of a master falconer. Discover the deep bond between falconer and bird, gain insight into centuries-old hunting traditions, and witness the power and grace of these incredible creatures up close. Perfect for nature lovers, adventurers, and anyone seeking a truly unforgettable wildlife experience. 

Transportation will be departing NAB Liberty Center at 0900.

name: Fall Into Fitness
description:
Do you go to the gym? Take a daily walk? Play a sport? Or simply wanting to get more movement but don't know how? This challenge is for you! Fall Into Fitness is a 3 week long virtual Fitness Challenge hosted by Health Corps and San Diego Unified School District. All you have to do is to log your regular minutes or hours of movement here on RunSignUp, while also encouraging you and your friends to get out of your comfort zones and win prizes!

How do you win? The challenge is to log more hours/minutes of movement than your friends, other staff members, and family across San Diego Unified School District. The more you move, the higher your chances are of winning bragging rights at your school or in your family AND cool prizes! You can either sign up individually, join your school's team, or both! Each week we will have 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place individual winners and one main overall school winner at the end of the challenge. The school with most movement logged will win a banner for their school and a special donation!

Never push yourself too hard, and always know your limits. But this is your chance to take that extra mile in your own life and go on that walk after lunch, or on that hike you've have been putting off with friends. Don't forget to check the live leader board, under the "Results" tab, each week to see where you rank! Remember, no movement is too small, and goes a long way for your overall wellness!

name: Fast Times at Canoga High 5K, 10K & Half
description:
October 11, 2025 · 7:00 a.m. PST · 6846 Owensmouth Ave, Canoga Park, CA

Get ready to cut class and cruise into the Fast Times at Canoga High—an 80s high school-themed race inspired by the most iconic mallrats, burnout legends, and SoCal dreamers of the decade.

Presented by Jed & Ted’s Excellent Races

Whether you're sprinting for Spicoli, crushing on Stacy, or just here for the vibes, this race lets you live your best homeroom-skipping, mixtape-blasting high school fantasy.


---

  • Spicoli Sprint 5K 🍕 The chillest distance for those who show up fashionably late but still get the job done. Bonus points if you order pizza at the finish line.
  • No Shirt, No Shoes, 10K 🏄‍♂️ This one’s for rule breakers, wave chasers, and anyone who’s ever daydreamed in class. Dress code optional—attitude required.
  • The Ridgemont Crawl Half Marathon 🎓 Senior year stress meets marathon grind. Long, intense, and full of questionable decisions. You got this, class of ’85.
  • The Multiverse Mall Dash (Virtual) 🌀 Transfer students from other timelines can run any distance, anywhere, and still earn their medal. Mallwalkers, you’re welcome.

Expect mall food court energy, stoner soundtrack bops, and unexpected “pop quiz” cheers along the way. Costumes strongly encouraged—Hot Dog on a Stick uniforms, Vans, and feathered hairdos get extra credit.


---

📦 Multiverse Option (Virtual Runners Welcome!)

Can’t make it IRL? Run virtually anytime from Oct 11–13, and we’ll ship you your finisher medal. Zero judgment if you run it while cutting class.

This is a Jed & Ted’s Excellent Race—fun, fast, and full of nostalgia.

Sign up now. Spicoli says it’s righteous.


---

Parody Disclaimer
This race is a fan-made parody event inspired by 80s teen culture and is not affiliated with or endorsed by any official trademark holders.

name: Feathered Feet Trot 5K, 10K, 1 Miler & Kids Dash
description:
🦃 CaliFlow Runs Presents: Feathered Feet Turkey Trot

Mile Square Turkey Trot – Fountain Valley, CA
5K | 10K | 1-Mile Gobbler Dash | Little Turkeys 200-Yard Dash
📍 Mile Square Park | Fountain Valley, CA
🕘 Start Time: 9:00 AM (5K & 10K)
🚪 Park Opens: 7:00 AM | 🎟 Bib Pick-Up: 8:15 AM

 
🏃‍♀️ Trot. Gobble. Go.
This isn’t just another turkey trot — it’s CaliFlow Runs style 🏁✨
Join us Thanksgiving week at Mile Square Park for a fun, cozy, family-friendly race full of crisp fall vibes, gratitude, and good energy. Whether you’re flying for a PR, jogging with friends, or strolling before the big feast, we’ve got a distance for every pace and every turkey.

 
🗺️ Location & Parking
📍 Mile Square Park – Fountain Valley

Enter through the main gate off Euclid → turn left into Lot PA
Follow signs to our festive start/finish area near the playground
✨ Clean restrooms are available right by the start line
🚗 Parking: $7 per car
💵 Cash = fastest | 💳 Cards accepted

👉 Mile Square Regional Park
16801 Euclid St, Fountain Valley, CA 92708
👉Link to Park Entrance

 
🏁 The Course
🌿 Scenic. Smooth. Fast.
The 5K & 10K are one big, beautiful loop through Mile Square Park with fall colors, wide-open paths, and clear markings — arrows, chalk, and signs to keep you on track.
👀 Heads up: It’s an open course, so stay alert and trot smart!

Link to Course Maps

 
📅 Race Day Schedule
🦃 5K & 10K Start: 9:00 AM
🍂 1-Mile Gobbler Dash: Follows the main race start
🐣 Little Turkeys 200-Yard Dash: Right after the Gobbler Dash

Link to Start Line

 
🎉 What to Expect
✨ Fall photo ops & festive décor
🍬 Sweet post-race treats
🎶 Music + good vibes at the finish festival
🛍️ Goodie bags for all kids
🏆 Medals for all finishers + age-group awards (top 3 M/F in each distance)

 
🍂 Gobble. Giggle. Go.
Round up your crew, lace up your shoes, and make memories before the big feast. Rain or shine, we trot together — because Thanksgiving traditions don’t pause for weather! 🏃‍♂️🦃🍁

name: Fiddler's Cove Monster Mash Bash - Trick or Treating
description:
Join us at Fiddlers Cove Marina for trick or treating at our Monster Mash Bash Sunday October 26th 2025 from 2:00- 6:00pm.  

Trick or treat times will be 3pm and 5pm. Trick or treat will lead by a staff member down through our waterfront RV park.  Activities for all ages to enjoy!  NEW THIS YEAR Open during Monster Mash- WOE TO NEVERMORE POP-UP LOUNGE! Music, crafts, inflatables, costume fashion show and raffle prizes, food trucks, wine slushies and so much more!

If you have missed the registration period, we will be taking walk-ups. 

Parents do not need to register for this event. Please only register children that will be participating in trick-or-treat. 

Events at the Bash include:

  • Woe to Nevermore- Wednesday Theme Pop-up Lounge
  • Inflatable bounce house and gaming area
  • Food trucks
  • Wine Slushies
  • Music
  • Costume Fashion Show
  • Prizes
  • Pumpkin Decorating
  • Ghost ship rides

Overflow parking can be found at Silver Strand Housing.

Each youth may sign-up for one of the two allotted trick or treat times and need to be accompanied by a parent or guardian.

name: Fiddler's Cove Pop-up Lounge- Woe to Nevermore
description:
Step into the shadows of Nevermore Academy, where the drinks are deadly (in the best way), the music is delightfully awful, and the dark vibes never end… quite normally.

Fiddler's Cove Pop-Up Lounge- Woe to Nevermore is a shadow-drenched pop-up bar inspired by the eerie halls of Nevermore Academy and the inky soul of Wednesday Addams herself. Sip, socialize, and summon your inner outcast.

Pre-Registration is strongly recommended.  Cost includes admission, custom glass and your first drink. 

Friday October 24th- 21+ ONLY- 4:00pm - 10:00pm. 

Saturday October 25th- Open to all ages- 4:00pm- 10:00pm 

Sunday October 26th- Open to all ages- 2:00pm-7:00pm (OPEN DURING MONSTER MASH EVENT)

name: Filthy 50+ - MTB Ride with Benefits
description:
The 11th Annual Filthy 50+ will take you through various areas of San Dieguito River Park and Black Mountain Park. Fast and flowy for all skill levels. The 30 mile riders will head out and turn around at the 15 mile mark and the 50+ mile riders will continue on to the Black Mountain Park area where you will encounter a lollipop and new trails to go with it! The course will be fully marked with Pink Flags and Red Arrows. Fully stocked feed stations will be placed throughout the ride to keep you fueled up.

There will be a kid’s ride supported by Team Quick n’ Dirty at 8:45am. Awards will be given out immediately following the kids ride. Registration for the kid’s ride will be online and onsite. 

When riding the course please be aware that the trails will be open to the public so please pay attention to other riders, hikers, and horseback riders. Please pay special attention when riding the switchbacks portion of the course and use courtesy when passing. Thanks!

WHEN:

Saturday, October  25, 2025

  • Start time will be 8:00am for 50 mile riders and 8:30 for 30 mile riders. 

WHERE:

  • San Pasqual Staging Area near 18194 Bandy Canyon Rd., Escondido, CA 92025 GOOGLE MAPS LOCATION

REGISTRATION:

  • REGISTER EARLY - IT WILL SELL OUT!
  • Registration closes the day before the race -or- when registration is full. If registration is full, the waitlists will open.
    Check-in will be open from 6:00 to 7:30 on day of event

COURSES:

  • 50 Mile Course RideWithGPS
  • 30 Mile Course STRAVA

FEED STATIONS:

Please stop if you need to refuel. There will be plenty of Hammer Nutrition products available. The mile marker and addresses are below if your support crew want to do hand-ups.

#1– 11 Miles & #4– 42 Miles (12653 Sunset Dr Escondido, CA  92025)
#2– 21 Miles & #3– 32 Miles (San Dieguito River Park San Diego, CA 92127)

FILTHY 50+ REGISTERED RIDERS WILL RECEIVE:

  • Swag bag provided by Hammer Nutrition
  • Commemorative FILTHY 50+ event item
  • QnD Costume Party sponsor by 805 Beer!
  • Awards for the Top 3 Finishers in each class for the 50+ mile ride
  • Awards for the Top 3 Males and Top 3 Female finisher of the 30 mile ride
  • Electronic Timing and Results.
  • Fully stocked Feed Stations at strategic locations. Feed Stations will include: hydration by Hydro, fruit, food, and Hammer Nutrition Products. The station will also include a self-help mechanic area. (Each Feed Station can be accessed in both directions).

ENTERTAINMENT:

  • Live entertainment at the Filthy 50 Oasis
  • Kids area with a Kids ride!
  • Food will be available at an additional cost
  • Vendor Village
  • Prize raffle with a portion of the proceeds going to SDRP Bike Patrol.

The primary goal of the Filthy 50+ Fun Ride with Benefits is to bring the mountain biking community together and to celebrate what we all love to do, RIDE OUR BIKES! Additionally, we want to bring awareness concerning the trails we ride on, as well as give back to the organizations that keep us riding on those trails. As part of the Filthy 50+ we urge you to help us give back by donating to the SDRP Bike Patrol.

name: Finding Kids 5K with LuxFit
description:
Finding Kids and LuxFit are teaming up for a 5K to support a life-changing cause! Finding Kids is an organization dedicated to protecting vulnerable children, locating missing and exploited youth, and ensuring they and their families receive the care and support they need.

When you run, you’re not just racing; you’re giving children a second chance at safety, justice, and hope.

Event Details

  • Date: Sunday, November 9, 2025
  • Time: 9:00 – 11:30 AM
  • Location: LuxFit
  • Entry Fee: $35 (+ processing fee)

Agenda

  • 9:00 – 9:30 AM: Arrivals & Check-In
  • 9:30 AM: Welcome Remarks from Finding Kids
  • 9:45 AM: 5K Starts
  • 10:45 – 11:30 AM: Post-race Party, raffle, and closing remarks 

Make Your Miles Matter Even More
Help us raise awareness and vital funds for Finding Kids (www.findingkids.org). After registering, you’ll have the option to create your own fundraising page. Share it with friends, family, and colleagues. Every dollar raised brings us closer to protecting children and bringing predators to justice.

And that’s not all…

  • Raise or donate $100 → Receive a special Finding Kids x LuxFit hat + 1 raffle ticket
  • For every $500 raised → Earn a raffle ticket for a chance to win amazing prizes like Giants tickets, LuxFit classes, local restaurant gift cards, wine, and more.
  • Raise $5,000 or more → Unlock the exclusive opportunity to join a Finding Kids investigator on a ride-along to see firsthand how they help bring children home safely.

name: Finish The Ride and Finish The Run Griffith Park
description:
Full event details can be found at www.streetsareforeveryone.org/finish-the-ride-griffith-park

It’s not just an event; it’s a movement for the safety of all on the streets of California.


Join cyclists, runners, walkers, and many others to enjoy the beautiful scenery and back roads of Griffith Park. Our rides take you on a journey through the park and surrounding areas, and our runs/walks travel around the most tranquil areas of Griffith Park. Top it all off with our wonderful end-event venue at the Autry Museum. 

The event benefits:
Streets Are For Everyone – aims to improve the quality of life for pedestrians, bicyclists, and drivers alike by working to reduce traffic-caused fatalities to Zero.

SAFE addresses the problem in a holistic fashion through direct education, broad awareness campaigns, partnerships, community outreach, policy and legislation, support for those impacted and other proven strategies.


Check out FinishTheRide.org for videos and information about the amazing beginnings of the movement.


The event includes:


Finish The Ride -- Sunday, May 3rd, 2026
12 Mile Fun Ride/Roll
20 Mile Nice N' Easy
35 Mile Leg Burn
Bahati Foundation Metric Century

Andrew Jelmert Half Century

 

Finish The Run -- Saturday, May 2nd, 2026
Run = 1K Kids and Puppy Run, 5K, 10K and Half Marathon


Free t-shirt or athletic sleeves with registration
Chip timing (5K, 10K, and Half Marathon only) and NEW individual event medals awarded for all events!
Great live music and dancing, Beer Garden (2 beers included for 21+)
Free festival and safety expo with giveaways, raffles, prizes, and more. 

Feel free to bring the whole family, even the dog!


Join Finish The Ride and Finish The Run Griffith Park 2026, not only for yourself but for those who survived, those who didn't, and the safety of ALL!
#FinishTheRide #FinishTheRun #NeverGiveUp #PhoenixRising


For more information on the event itself or how you can help, e-mail us at Events@StreetsAreForEveryone.org or call (844) 884-7233 Ext. 801

name: Finish The Ride and Finish The Run Santa Clarita
description:
Finish The Ride & Finish The Run – Santa Clarita
Sunday, October 26, 2025 • 6:00 AM – 2:00 PM
West Creek Park • 24247 Village Circle Drive, Valencia, CA 91354

name: Fleet Feet Fall Classic - Trail October 19th, 2025
description:
LOCATION

South Rim Trail Head/ Backside of Bidwell Golf Course
Chico, CA US 95928

 

DISCRIPTION 

Fleet Feet Chico is pleased to offer two trail races in our beautiful Upper Bidwell Park.  The two races will start on the south side of the park down Annies Trail for a fun adventure on the single-track trails. Toss in a creek crossing and a nice finish through Yahi and the golf course, you’re sure to enjoy your run! 

 

The two races include a half marathon and a 4-mile an hour backyard endurance challenge! 

 

The Half Marathon will start at 8:10am along the rock wall off Centennial/South Rim trail head. This race will be a challenging climb with 1600 ft of gain in the first half. Enjoy a party at the top of 10-mile house at Aid station #1 and enjoy an all downhill second half of the race!

 

4-mile endurance race will start at 8:00am. Runners will run a 4-mile loop. If you complete the loop in under 60 mins you will go back in the shoot for loop #2. At the top of each hour a new round will start. This will continue for 8 hours! Every other lap we will change the direction of the loop!  If there is more than one person going into the final hour the run will become a foot race to the finish! If you complete all 8 loops, you will have run approximately 32 Miles! Do you have what it takes? Do one loop, 3 loops or all 8! It’s sure to be a good time for the runners and the spectators!

 

After the race head up to Bidwell Golf Course Bar and grill for some delicious food and drinks! 

 

By supporting this race, you are supporting two great causes! 

Chico Velo Trailworks. Launched in 2014, Chico Velo’s Trailworks supports and manages the creation and maintenance of sustainable and enjoyable trails in our region. They have established a strong partnership with the City of Chico to maintain the trails in Upper Bidwell Park. Trailworks have done additional work in the Oroville area and beyond. They are actively seeking new partnerships and opportunities within our community to promote sustainable trail design. Trailworks volunteers put in hundreds of hours every year improving trails for all users to enjoy. To see their latest project check out our Colby Mountain Recreation Project.  A portion of your race entry will go to this great local stewardship as they continue their work to help keep our local trails accessible for us all! If you would like more information on this program or would like to sign up for a park cleanup day, click the link below.

Chico Velo Trailworks - CHICO VELO

 

In addition to supporting Chico Velo Trailworks we are also donating a portion of the race proceeds to local fire academy cadets. Many of the current class are volunteer firefighters who have worked and volunteered in our community and are continuing their education to be able to make a lifelong career the Fire industry. With a fire prone environment that we live in throughout Butte County we rely on our local fire personnel, staff and volunteers to keep our community safe! Cadets will be volunteering on the racecourse to help ensure the safety of all our participants.  Cadets can be seen on our racecourse supporting our race as emergency EMTs and safety aids at the creek crossings. If you are interested in becoming a volunteer firefighter visit the links below for more information.

Become a Volunteer | Butte County, CA

 

RACE START TIMES


4-Mile Endurance Run            8:00am

Half Marathon                         8:10am

 

REGISTRATION

Registration for this race is available online.

  • Online registration closes October 17th at 9:00am.
  • In person registration on October 17th and 18th at Fleet Feet Chico from 10am-2pm.
  • Register by Friday September 29th to guarantee yourself race shirt.
  • If you register between September 30th – October 18th your shirt will NOT be guaranteed, they will be first come first serve at packet pickup.
  • All leftover shirts (if any) will be available for pickup or for sale (non-registered runners) AFTER the Half Marathon race on October 19th. The shirts will be available first come first serve starting at 10:00am.  

 

RACE FEE SCHEDULE

  • June 1st – June 30th - (online)        
    • Half Marathon   $80.00
    • 4-Mile Endurance Run     $80.00
  • July 1st – September 30th (online)         
    • Half Mar._______________$85.00
