name: Howl-o-ween Doggie Dash 5K
description:
Join us for our 8th Doggie Dash - the Howl-o-ween Doggie Dash 5K! Run (or walk) with your pup (or without) to help LA Frontrunners raise funds for The Rescue Train & Angel City Pit Bulls! There will be two separate 5Ks - one for humans only and one for pups with their human! All the details are below.  Pets are such a vital part of so many of our lives, so come race your heart out or take a stroll, and help us support two organizations whose missions are to care for pets in need and to make sure those who are struggling are able to care for and have their pets in their lives.

Location & Date
The Howl-o-ween Doggie Dash 5K takes place on Sunday, October 26, in Griffith Park. The humans only 5K starts at 7:30 and the pups and human 5K starts at 8:30.  The start/finish area is the Park Center grassy area in Griffith Park. The 5K is one loop around the golf course and is trail/packed dirt and flat.

Course & Race Info
The start/finish area for Howl-o-ween Doggie Dash 5K is in the Park Center grassy area in Griffith Park (diagonally across from the Griffith Park Visitor Center/Ranger Station). Look for us by the picnic tables between the tennis courts and Shane's Inspiration Playground.  The 5K is one loop around the golf course. If this is your first 5K, 5 kilometers = 3.1 miles. The path is packed dirt and flat.

7:30 AM - Humans Only 5K: The first 5K is for two footers only - no pups allowed. If you don't have a dog, or your partner/spouse/child won the coin flip to race with your dog at 8:30, this is the race for you.

8:30 AM - Pups & Human 5K: The main event is a 5K for pups (on leash) with their human. No solo humans allowed. One pup per human and the race limit is 100 entries. You can fly as fast as your pup pulls you or leisurely stroll the 5K around the golf course. There will be a water stop (for both you and your pup) about halfway through the 5K.

Doggie Howl-o-ween Costume Contest
Of course there's a costume contest! With prizes!

Beneficiaries
The Rescue Train: The Rescue Train is a unique, no-kill, animal-welfare organization based in Los Angeles. We are a small but mighty group of animal advocates, dedicated to making the world a kinder place for pets and the people who love them.  Since our inception in 2004, we have been recognized for our hard work: we labor in the trenches of our city and county shelters, find solutions to pet overpopulation and fight for the rights of animals. Thanks to our dedicated volunteers, we have saved thousands of animals from suffering and euthanasia.  Click HERE for therescuetrain.org.

Angel City Pit Bulls:  Angel City Pit Bulls takes in dogs (mainly from our local shelters) that fall under the generic term pit bull who demonstrate people-soft, responsive qualities and solid temperaments. Their adorableness and gushy love of people make them fantastic family dogs. We have a wide range of energy levels, so whether you are looking for a running partner or a potential “therapy dog”, we will typically have a dog that will fit the bill.  Click HERE for angelcitypits.org.

Pups & Human 5K Awards
It's a race! Of course there's awards! In the Pups & Human 5K, categories are determined by the weight of the pup. Awards will be given to the top 3 overall pups across all divisions. Division awards are top 3 in the following categories: TOY: up to 12 lbs., SMALL: 13 to 25 lbs., MEDIUM: 26 to 50 lbs., LARGE: 51 to 75 lbs., XL: 75+ lbs.

Human Only 5K Awards
Awards will be given to the top 3 overall males and females in the 5K. Age group awards are top 3 in the following categories: 10 & Under, 11-14, 15-19, 20-24, 25-29, 30-34, 35-39, 40-44, 45-49, 50-54, 55-59, 60-64, 65-69, 70-74, 75-79, 80+

Race Day Registration & Packet Pick-Up
There is NO RACEDAY REGISTRATION. Online registration will close at sell-out.  Packet pick up will be race morning starting at 7:00 AM. 

Past Results & Free Past Pix
For past results/info, please click HERE.  For free pix, please click HERE.

About LA Frontrunners
Los Angeles Frontrunners (501c3) is a running and walking club for members and friends of the LGBTQ+ community.  In addition to running, walking, more running (and lots of eating), LAFR raises funds and collects goods to donate to local charities. Past beneficiaries include; The Rescue Train, Westside Food Bank, SRLA, PAWS/LA, Life Worth Saving, Friends of Griffith Park, InsideOut Community Arts, Friends of Project 10, Angel City Pit Bulls, The Breakfast Club at St. Thomas the Apostle, and the Don Thompson Scholarship at the USC Film School.

It's a race! Of course there's awards! In the Pups & Human 5K, categories are determined by the weight of the pup. Awards will be given to the top 3 overall pups across all divisions. Division awards are top 3 in the following categories: TOY: up to 12 lbs., SMALL: 13 to 25 lbs., MEDIUM: 26 to 50 lbs., LARGE: 51 to 75 lbs., XL: 75+ lbs.

Human Only 5K Awards
Awards will be given to the top 3 overall males and females in the 5K. Age group awards are top 3 in the following categories: 10 & Under, 11-14, 15-19, 20-24, 25-29, 30-34, 35-39, 40-44, 45-49, 50-54, 55-59, 60-64, 65-69, 70-74, 75-79, 80+

Race Day Registration & Packet Pick-Up
There is NO RACEDAY REGISTRATION. Online registration will close at sell-out.  Packet pick up will be race morning starting at 7:00 AM. 

Past Results & Free Past Pix
For past results/info, please click HERE.  For free pix, please click HERE.

About LA Frontrunners
Los Angeles Frontrunners (501c3) is a running and walking club for members and friends of the LGBTQ+ community.  In addition to running, walking, more running (and lots of eating), LAFR raises funds and collects goods to donate to local charities. Past beneficiaries include; The Rescue Train, Westside Food Bank, SRLA, PAWS/LA, Life Worth Saving, Friends of Griffith Park, InsideOut Community Arts, Friends of Project 10, Angel City Pit Bulls, The Breakfast Club at St. Thomas the Apostle, and the Don Thompson Scholarship at the USC Film School.

📅 Saturday, November 15, 2025

 Race Overview 🦃


Kick off the holiday season with the 2nd Annual Huffin’ for the Stuffin’ Run! Enjoy a 5K, 10K, or Half Marathon along the scenic Long Beach shoreline. Whether you’re chasing a PR, running with friends, or earning your stuffing early, this festive run is perfect for all paces and all ages.

name: Impact 5K:  Dash Thru the 80s
description:
IMPACT 5K:  DASH THRU THE 80s STRIKES BACK!

Join us on FEBRUARY 22nd for a day to support addiction recovery!

Check in starts at 6AM, the 5K starts promptly at 8am.  Join us for an inspiring and impactful day at the second annual Impact Drug & Alcohol Treatment Center 5K Run/Walk at the picturesque Hahamongna Watershed Park in Pasadena. This exciting event is designed to bring together our community in support of a healthier, safer, and more vibrant Pasadena.

COME IN YOUR BEST 80s GEAR!  

We will be rocking to the sounds of 80s tribute band THE SKINNY TIES

Dash Thru the 80s will host a costume contest with amazing prizes and judged by KROQ's Megan Holiday!

Impact has been active in the treatment of addiction for men and women for over 50 years.  Our ability to continue this level of care comes because of the generosity of our supporters.  This event, and the funds raised, will go a long way toward making sure that we can continue the simple promise we make to everyone still lost in the fog of addiction:  we're here when you're ready.

We can't wait to see you all at Hahamongna Park!

name: Inaugural AMCFF “Running Con Ganas” 5K to Unite Los Angeles Community at LA Mission College
description:
AMCFF is proud to announce the first ever Running Con Ganas 5K, taking place on Saturday, November 8, 2025, at Los Angeles Mission College. This inspiring community run will bring together students, families, and neighbors to celebrate health, determination, and educational opportunity.

“Ganas” — the Spanish word for “desire, drive, and motivation” — reflects the spirit of this event. All fitness levels are welcome to participate in the 5K, which will weave through the scenic LA Mission College campus and surrounding areas.

Running With Purpose

The AMCFF “Running Con Ganas” 5K is more than just a race — it’s a movement to:

Promote health, wellness, and community pride
Encourage students and families to engage in active lifestyles
Raise funds to support the 2026 AMCFF Scholars, providing financial assistance and resources to deserving students

Runners will receive a medal and timed bib!

For more information, visit www.cardenasfoundation.org/

name: Indio Veterans 5K Run/Walk
description:
This Veteran's 5K Run/Walk is to honor and support the brave men and women who served our country. This family-friendly event is great for runners and walkers of all ages and abilities, offering a course through an area of the Empire Polo. Come join us in this event as we celebrate veterans' service and sacrifice. 

Participants will receive a commemorative t-shirt and a portion of the proceeds will benefit Hunter Lopez Memorial Foundation. This event will also feature a pre-race celebration with refreshments, music, and a special ceremony to honor our veterans. Let's come together to run, remember, and show our appreciation for those who have given so much for our freedom. 

Kid’s under the age of 10 are free and veteran’s receive a $25 discount.

name: Inland Valley Turkey Trot
description:
Join us for the 4th annual Inland Valley Turkey Trot! The race will take place in the City of Menifee from Lago Vista Sports Park. The 2 Mile, 5K, and 10K courses are flat and fast with a downhill start and short uphill to the finish along scenic Menifee Lakes. The course is perfect for runners and walkers of all ages!

**Please be aware that this event is held on an open course, which means the streets will remain open to traffic. All three events will occur on the sidewalks and bicycle paths that run along the course.**

**Please visit the Inland Valley Turkey Trot event page for race and course info**

Events

**All events are capped to a limited field size** 

  • 2-Mile
  • 5-K
  • 10-K
  • Endurance Challenge (10K, 5K, 2 Mile)
  • Kids Fun Run (300 Meter Dash)

What's included in registration:

  • 2025 Commemorative T-Shirt - Unisex/Men's and Women's Styles
  • 2025 Finisher's Medal
  • Race Bib with Chip Timing
  • Free Race Photos
  • Complimentary Churro!
  • Post Race Snacks and Refreshments
  • Kids Fun Run Participant Medal and Donut (Kids Ages 2-8 Only)

Race Day Schedule

Race Start begins on Thanksgiving morning, Thursday, November 27, 2025

  • 6:30am - 10K Race
  • 6:30am - Endurance Challenge (10K, 5K, 2 Mile)
  • 8:00am - 5K Race
  • 9:00am - 2 Mile Race
  • 9:30am - Kids Fun Run (Parents may run/walk alongside their child during the run)

2Mile, 5K, and 10K Endurance Challenge!

Craving a Thanksgiving Feast running challenge? Sign up for the Endurance Challenge and complete all three distances for the ultimate Thanksgiving Day challenge!

Only 20 spots are available for the Endurance Challenge, so act quickly to secure your spot and get the opportunity to complete all three races!

Run as a team!

Make it a fun Thanksgiving activity for the whole family. Grab your friends and family and sign up as a team! 2025 turkey trot teams will be entered to win a charcuterie board from Boards by Design Charcuterie!

Awards

Custom awards brought to you by goruncrew!

  • The top three overall men and women in each distance will receive a custom race medal and goruncrew prize.
  • Overall winners will receive a complimentary entry into next year's turkey trot event!
  • Set a new course record and win a goruncrew prize!

Course Records

10K

  • Colby Piehler-Pike - 36:37 (2024)
  • Jessica Clayton - 39:46 (2023)

5K

  • Jared Saunders - 17:27 (2023)
  • Angela Neill - 19:30 (2022)

2 Mile

  • Tyler White - 11:50 (2023)
  • Gabriela Sevilla - 15:09 (2023)

Lago Vista Start/Finish Area

  • Snacks and refreshments provided by Baron's Market at the Start/Finish area.
  • Breakfast burritos, coffee and dessert will be available for purchase onsite from local vendors!
  • Each Kids Fun Run participant will receive a participant medal and donut.
  • Our friends from PacificPro Physical Therapy Canyon Hills will be onsite!

name: Intermediate Sailing: November 1 & 2
description:
Two-day adult sailing classes are offered most weekends from 9 am to 4 pm at Fiddler's Cove Marina. Classes are open to all eligible MWR patrons and sponsored guests. Minimum age requirement is 16 years or older with a parent or guardian.  

**A minimum of 5 hours of sail time is required post beginner sailing course. 

Class fees per person vary by military affiliation and rank. Dependent fees are calculated at the sponsoring active duty or retiree rate. Pre-registration is required as classes can fill up quickly.

Registration includes boat rental, instruction, and textbooks. Students per boat will be kept to the minimum amount possible in order to maximize learning potential, and will range from one to four. Number of students per boat is dependent on the boat size, sailing conditions and the skills being developed in the class. On completion of the course, participants receive a Navy Sailing Qualification Card.

A valid California Boater Card and/or a course completion certificate is required before attending the first class. California Boater Cards and/or course completion certificates will be checked at the start of the first class. A free online course is offered through BoatU.S.. Once the course is complete and an application has been filled out through California State Parks then a card will be sent in the mail to your address. A digital card will be emailed at the completion of the course and is a valid representation of a California Boater Card for this course.

Once you sign-up please stop by Fiddlers Cove Marina boathouse to pick up your study materials. Some preliminary reading will be given before the start of the course.

Please note: closed-toe shoes are required aboard all Navy MWR boats. Sunscreen, sunglasses, and hats are strongly recommended.

name: International Sloth Day Run 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
Sloths will get there!

It doesn't matter how fast we get there, all that matters is we get there. Join this super fun unique 5K, 10K, or 13.1 Half-Marathon run where there is NO time limit!

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com

name: IPA10K & Hallowine Half Marathon
description:
Join us for a sure-to-be unforgettable day at The Barlow! On Saturday November 1, 2025, the IPA10K and Hallowine Half Marathon unite for an epic event in Sebastopol, CA. This exciting multi-faceted event features the 8th annual IPA10K and 12th running of the Hallowine Run produced by Destination Races. poduced by A Good Run and Destination Races. Take part in one of several race options: the IPA10K, Hallowine Half Marathon, 3K, or The Beer Mile.  For dog lovers, the Wagging Tail Run invites you to run alongside your bestie while “treating” them like a king or queen.

Enjoy an expanded post-race festival at The Barlow, one of the North Bay’s favorite gathering spots. The festival features local craft brewers and wineries, live music, food trucks, a Halloween costume contest and the iconic Beer Mile competition featuring the best beer milers in the world, the hilarious Brewery Challenge and 2-person beer mile relay.  Dotted with shops, restaurants, and tasting rooms, The Barlow is the perfect open-air gathering place to relax and mingle with friends, family and running buddies. 

Don’t miss one of the year's most anticipated event—register now to save and get ready to run, sip, laugh, cheer and celebrate!

name: Iron Mountain Hike
description:
6 mi out & back | Moderate Difficulty | Elevation Gain 1,110 to 1,950 feet | Poway, CA

The first section of the trail is easy to moderate, with little incline. The middle section of the trail switchbacks east of the peak and overlooks Ramona. The top section to the peak is a steep, rocky areas and switchbacks. 

Safety Tips: Shade is extremely limited on this trail. Wear lightweight non-cotton clothing and head covering (hat). Use sunblock. Must carry 2L of water, coupled with electrolyte tablets. Wear a trail shoe with good traction. Bring a small backpack to carry your water, snacks, and other hiking essentials. Trekking poles recommended if you have them. Come prepared with a fully charged cellphone.

name: Ironstone Vineyards Wine Run 5k
description:
Like Running or Walking?  Love Wine?  This race is for you! 

Join us on Sunday, March 29, 2026 starting at 10:00am for an exciting new event that features Ironstone Vineyards. Ironstone Vineyards is a premier Calaveras County destination with Wine Tasting, Dining and Estate Tours. So, whether you are looking to run, walk or just enjoy the wine and camaraderie this race is a sure thing for a great time and an incredible experience!   • Race Bib: Chip timed 5k run/walk
  • Results Posted Online
  • ...and of course, a pour of wine!

name: IRVINE 4th of July-Red, White, & Blue 5k & 1 Mile
description:
Click here to LOOK UP your bib number that you got assigned

https://runsignup.com/Race/FindARunner/?raceId=60114

 

So Cal’s 4th of July RED, WHITE, & BLUE 5k & 1 Mile

Saturday, July 4, 2026 | 8:30 AM
Irvine Valley College – Lot 5
5500 Irvine Center Dr., Irvine, CA 92618
(Entrance off Jeffrey. All other campus entrances will be closed.)

 
Flat and fast out-and-back course entirely on the Irvine Valley College campus
8:30 AM Mass Start, following a live National Anthem performance
Professional National Anthem singer will kick off the race
Live Fife & Drum Corps will entertain before the race and be available for fun photo ops
(Insider tip: ask them about their running times—they're cross-country athletes under those uniforms, adding authentic talent to this historical tribute!)
Patriotic atmosphere with live music, great selfie moments, and a vibrant community vibe
Bring your best FREEDOM energy and come ready to race, run, jog, or walk this healthy, high-spirited way to start your 4th of July
Custom shirts, huge finisher medals, chip timing, and age group awards
 

Bib & Shirt Pickup
Race Morning Pickup:
Begins at 6:30 AM in Lot 5
– Includes music, a selfie booth, and the awards area
– You may pick up for others; no ID required

Optional Early Packet Pickup:
Friday, July 3 | 2:00–5:00 PM
Location: Manassero Farms at Irvine Valley College (enter off Jeffrey)
33 Irvine Valley, Irvine, CA 92618

Race Day Schedule
6:30 AM– Race Day Registration & Bib/Shirt Pickup Opens
7:00 AM– Live Fife & Drums + Heritage Song Performances
8:00 AM – Diaper Dash (50 yards out & back)
8:05 AM – 1-Mile Fun Run (Can run with kids or as part of the combo option)
8:15 AM – Opening Ceremony + “Born in the USA” Singalong & Warm-Up
8:30 AM – 5K MASS START
9:15 AM – Overall Winners Announced
9:30 AM – Age Division Awards Begin

 

Food & Refreshments
Bring cash for fun food options at the finish line! Here's what to expect:

Specialty coffee drinks from a local coffee vendor
Delicious cookies from Galletina’s
Fresh fruit to refresh post-race
Our FAMOUS Street Tacos and Tamales—a crowd favorite!
You can pre-purchase food vouchers as an add-on during registration.

 
🎖 What’s Included with Registration🎖
Custom 4th of July themed race shirt (front and back design)
Huge 4-inch custom-cast finisher medal
Chip-timed results with a custom race bib
Water and fruit at the finish line
Eligibility for age group and overall awards
 
🏆Awards
Top 3 Male & Female Overall
5K & 1-Mile Age Group Awards (3 deep in 5-year increments):
1–10, 11–14, 15–19, 20–24, 25–29, 30–34, 35–39, 40–44, 45–49, 50–54, 55–59, 60–64, 65–69, 70–74, 75–79, 80–84, 85+
 
Strollers
Strollers are welcome! Please stay to the right and use at your own risk. Only registered participants with a bib will receive a finisher medal. Be sure your bib is worn on the front and visible to finish line staff.

Important Note for Combo Runners (5K + 1-Mile)
If you are running both the 5K and the 1-Mile:

Use only one bib at a time
Stash your unused bib away from the start/finish mats
If doing the 1-Mile Fun Run with your kids, wear your Fun Run bib and leave your 5K bib at the first aid/water station tent near the finish line
Following these steps helps avoid timing issues and ensures your results are accurate. Thank you!


Weather
Rain or shine—the event will go on! Celebrate your freedom and fitness this 4th of July.

 
🚗 Parking
Irvine Valley College requires a $5 parking fee per vehicle
You can purchase online during registration or pay on race day
Display your parking pass on the driver's side dashboard
Entrance allowed only from Jeffrey Road (Irvine Center Dr. entrance will be closed for the course)
Race staging takes place in the southeast corner of Lot 5, between the Manassero Farm Stand and the two-story Performing Arts building. We are the only event on campus that day.

 
Hosted by Caren Ware Events
Professionally chip-timed by Itz About Time
Offering fun, fitness, and community for everybody—and every BODY!

name: Irvine/Orange County Turkey Trot 5K & 1 Mile
description:
Irvine/Orange County Turkey Trot 5K & 1 Mile
Thursday, November 27th, 2025
Thanksgiving Day
Irvine Valley College

THERE IS AN AWESOME CUSTOM CAST FINISHER MEDAL awaiting ALL you!  Choices of designs when you finish. A great race bib.  And the perfect Turkey designed, fun event shirt. 

7:30 am Turkey Feast Combo 1 Mile and 5k

8:00 am 5k Turkey Trot Race

9:10 am Kids Gobble Wobble Races Start

Two New Race Choices!  Choose the best race for you and earn a custom finishers medal and slice of fresh pumpkin pie!
Run fast, jog, trot, walk, or enjoy a nice stroll on this flat scenic course.  A scrumptious SLICE OF PIE awaits you at the finish. Along with So Cal's best custom cast finisher medal, you get an awesome shirt and CHIP TIMED.  Get your friends and family together and kick off the holidays together!   Guaranteed to be a picture perfect way to start celebrating THANKSGIVING DAY!

Run up a mini appetite with our family friendly 1 Mile or kick it up a notch with our 5k.  For those who plan to really indulge your can double down and enter our Turkey Feast Combo and run the 1 Mile and the 5k back to back!  This flat, friendly course is walker friendly and stroller ready.  Come out and see why it's become a holiday tradition for thousands of people !

We'll DECK out your Thanksgiving trimmings with:

*. Awesome Custom Cast Medals.
*. Soft Comfy event shirts for all.
*. Tasty pumpkin pie at the finish.
*. Custom Race bibs.
*  Chip timing by Itz About Time. 
*. Division awards for top three male and female in each age division. 5 year age spans from 10 & under to 80 & over!
*. Trophies for top three overall finishers male and female.
*. Holiday Expo to jump start your shopping.

1 Mile Turkey Dash:  7:30am Start.  This division is a fun run/ walk and non timed event.  This is great start for those who want a shorter distance to keep their whole tribe together.  It’s and out and back course so you’ll see everyone both directions!   If you gotta skip out quick then come on out for this one and earn some fast bling with a fantastic medal for everyone who finishes.

IRVINE/OC 5k Turkey TROT:  8:00am Start.  This is open to all ages and takes place around the perimeter of the college campus.  It's a speedy course that swings by citrus grove tree's and some pumpkin patches!  it starts and finishes in the same spot so you won't miss seeing your friends somewhere along the way!  

Turkey Feast Combo:  7:30am Start.  This is for the those who like extra helpings at Thanksgiving!  We love this challenge!  Each participant will start at 7:30 with the 1 mile race.  You'll need to complete the 1 mile in 30 minutes so you'll have time to line up for your second race, the 5k at 8am.  You’ll receive 1 shirt and two medals if you complete both races!  Rally up!  You may pick up your 1 mile medal after your 5k race so you don't have to run with it!

Gobble Wobble Kids Event:  These kids races offer shorter distances if they don't want to do the 5k.  9:15 A.M:  Diaper Dash - 50 yards (3 and under)
9:20 A.M:  Tot Trot  - 100 yards (4 to 5 years old)
9:25 A.M: Youth Race -1/4 Mile (6 to 10 years old)
9:28 A.M: Youth Race - Half Mile (11 to 12 years old)


Kid's Gobble Wobble Race Details

All participants receive a race bib, custom cast medal, event t-shirt, and slice of pie!   5k is chip timed and kid's runs are for fun.  We will start lining the kids up at 9:05 per age group.  All the kids races are on a out and back loop and start and end in the same spot.   The course will be closed and lined with volunteers to direct all kids to the turnaround spot. They can turn early if they want with no penalty if they think it's too far.  One adult per child can run with their participant and the parent does not have to register but will not receive the shirt, medal, bib or pie. 

If you have a child that just wants to ride in a stroller with you on the 5k course, they can do so without registering.  They will not receive a medal, bib, shirt or pie but they can share yours! 

Awards

Professional Chip timing and results for all 5k participants. Age Division awards will be given 3 deep in the following age categories: 1-10, 11-14, 15-19, 20-24, 25-29, 30-34, 35-39 40-44, 45-49, 50-54,55-59 60-64, 65-69, *70-74, *75-79, *80 and over. Yes!  We split the final divisions to celebrate our 70 and over rock star field!  We're happy to celebrate this growing category and look forward to seeing everyone earn their race bling! 

Costume Awards will be given for Best Dressed so come decked out and you may take home a prize! Win as an individual or a group (6 people max)!

Early Packet Pick Up: Optional

Packet Pick up will be held on Wednesday, November 26th from 12 pm to 4pm at Road Runner Sports in Laguna Hills.
24291 Avenida De La Carlota; Suite P-5; Laguna Hills, CA 92653  (plan on i being a traffic day, give extra time to 

Pick up your bib and shirt  at packet pick up or on race morning at the race from 6:30am to 7:30am
One person can pick up for others
Walk up registration accepted at early packet pick and on race day morning.
Shirts and Shirts sizes are not guaranteed for race day late registration.

Race Day Pick Up:

You may pick up your race bib and t-shirt on race day from 6:30 am to 7:30 am. In the quad, in front of the performance arts theater. That's the big two story orange building on the Irvine Valley College campus.

Parking:  Cost is $5.  Entrance is only allowed on Jeffrey (Entrance closed on Irvine Center Drive- its part of course).  All other campus entrances will be closed.

YOU MUST purchase a  PARKING PASS AN PUT ON YOUR DASH.  THIS CAN BE DONE ONLINE, AT PACKET PICK UP, OR with attendants as you drive into the lots.  THE CAMPUS PD charge  for every vehicle and look for the passes.  ( This parking fee is required on entering and parking at any local college).

Takes place wind, rain, or shine.

FAQ's
 Are dogs allowed? Due to college's policy, dogs are not allowed on the run course.

name: Irvine/Orange County Turkey Trot 5K & 1 Mile
description:
Irvine/Orange County Turkey Trot 5K & 1 Mile
Thursday, November 27th, 2025
Thanksgiving Day
Irvine Valley College

THERE IS AN AWESOME CUSTOM CAST FINISHER MEDAL awaiting ALL you!  Choices of designs when you finish. A great race bib.  And the perfect Turkey designed, fun event shirt. 

7:30 am Turkey Feast Combo 1 Mile and 5k

8:00 am 5k Turkey Trot Race

9:10 am Kids Gobble Wobble Races Start

Two New Race Choices!  Choose the best race for you and earn a custom finishers medal and slice of fresh pumpkin pie!
Run fast, jog, trot, walk, or enjoy a nice stroll on this flat scenic course.  A scrumptious SLICE OF PIE awaits you at the finish. Along with So Cal's best custom cast finisher medal, you get an awesome shirt and CHIP TIMED.  Get your friends and family together and kick off the holidays together!   Guaranteed to be a picture perfect way to start celebrating THANKSGIVING DAY!

Run up a mini appetite with our family friendly 1 Mile or kick it up a notch with our 5k.  For those who plan to really indulge your can double down and enter our Turkey Feast Combo and run the 1 Mile and the 5k back to back!  This flat, friendly course is walker friendly and stroller ready.  Come out and see why it's become a holiday tradition for thousands of people !

We'll DECK out your Thanksgiving trimmings with:

*. Awesome Custom Cast Medals.
*. Soft Comfy event shirts for all.
*. Tasty pumpkin pie at the finish.
*. Custom Race bibs.
*  Chip timing by Itz About Time. 
*. Division awards for top three male and female in each age division. 5 year age spans from 10 & under to 80 & over!
*. Trophies for top three overall finishers male and female.
*. Holiday Expo to jump start your shopping.

1 Mile Turkey Dash:  7:30am Start.  This division is a fun run/ walk and non timed event.  This is great start for those who want a shorter distance to keep their whole tribe together.  It’s and out and back course so you’ll see everyone both directions!   If you gotta skip out quick then come on out for this one and earn some fast bling with a fantastic medal for everyone who finishes.

IRVINE/OC 5k Turkey TROT:  8:00am Start.  This is open to all ages and takes place around the perimeter of the college campus.  It's a speedy course that swings by citrus grove tree's and some pumpkin patches!  it starts and finishes in the same spot so you won't miss seeing your friends somewhere along the way!  

Turkey Feast Combo:  7:30am Start.  This is for the those who like extra helpings at Thanksgiving!  We love this challenge!  Each participant will start at 7:30 with the 1 mile race.  You'll need to complete the 1 mile in 30 minutes so you'll have time to line up for your second race, the 5k at 8am.  You’ll receive 1 shirt and two medals if you complete both races!  Rally up!  You may pick up your 1 mile medal after your 5k race so you don't have to run with it!

Gobble Wobble Kids Event:  These kids races offer shorter distances if they don't want to do the 5k.  9:15 A.M:  Diaper Dash - 50 yards (3 and under)
9:20 A.M:  Tot Trot  - 100 yards (4 to 5 years old)
9:25 A.M: Youth Race -1/4 Mile (6 to 10 years old)
9:28 A.M: Youth Race - Half Mile (11 to 12 years old)

All participants receive a race bib, custom cast medal, event t-shirt, and slice of pie!   5k is chip timed and kid's runs are for fun.  We will start lining the kids up at 9:05 per age group.  All the kids races are on a out and back loop and start and end in the same spot.   The course will be closed and lined with volunteers to direct all kids to the turnaround spot. They can turn early if they want with no penalty if they think it's too far.  One adult per child can run with their participant and the parent does not have to register but will not receive the shirt, medal, bib or pie. 

If you have a child that just wants to ride in a stroller with you on the 5k course, they can do so without registering.  They will not receive a medal, bib, shirt or pie but they can share yours! 

Awards

Professional Chip timing and results for all 5k participants. Age Division awards will be given 3 deep in the following age categories: 1-10, 11-14, 15-19, 20-24, 25-29, 30-34, 35-39 40-44, 45-49, 50-54,55-59 60-64, 65-69, *70-74, *75-79, *80 and over. Yes!  We split the final divisions to celebrate our 70 and over rock star field!  We're happy to celebrate this growing category and look forward to seeing everyone earn their race bling!

name: Ivanhoe Runs Silver Lake! Two-mile Run/Walk
description:
The Ivanhoe Run is back with a new home, more forgiving mile-count and laid back start time.

Join us on Saturday, November 15th for a timed fun run/walk around our beloved Silver Lake Reservoir. Whether you're a marathoner, weekend warrior, walker, stroller-pusher, and/or someone who just wants to hang out at the playground and drink coffee, join us! 

All proceeds support Friends of Ivanhoe.

name: Jingle All the Way - Christmas Day 5K, 10K
description:
Join us this Christmas Day for a festive and fun run! Whether you're a seasoned runner or just looking to add a little holiday cheer to your workout, this race is for everyone.

🏃‍♀️ Feel the magic of the season as we dash through a wintery wonderland! All participants will receive a holiday-themed medal and race bib, and to make things even more festive, we’re handing out jingle bells to attach to your shoes so you can jingle all the way to the finish line! 🎶✨ (optional)

All finishers receive a medal, free race day photos, and yummy finish-line snacks.
Dress in your favorite holiday costume to win our costume contest!
 
 
Race Day Details:
7:30 AM to 8:35 AM Bib Pick-Up and Same Day Registration Open
8:30 AM 5K/10K Start
 

Course Information:
5K run out 1.56 miles and back
10K run out 1.56 miles and back completing two loops for a total of 6.20 miles

2 water stations will be on the course and water fountains will be along the way.



Parking Details: Street parking is free and beach lot parking is $2.00 per hour

 

What you get:


Free Race Day Photos
A finishers medal
Jingle Bell for your shoe
Finish Line Treats
Awesome picture spots
2 on-course water stations


Awards:

All participants recieve a medal

Top 3 in male & female all distances will receive a placement medal

name: Jingle Bell Jog – 5K, 10K, 10-Miler, Half Marathon
description:
Jingle Bell, Jingle Bell, Jingle Bell Jog!

Join us at Alamitos Beach this December for the Jingle Bell Jog, a holly jolly celebration of festive vibes, ocean views, and merry miles. Whether you’re racing to sleigh your PR or just dashing through the sand with bells on, this cheerful coastal run is the perfect way to wrap up your year with some holiday sparkle.

It's the holiday season so dress with flair! We love to see the festive apparel you wear!

Race Details

Start Location: Alamitos Beach, 780 E Shoreline Dr. Long Beach, CA – Google Maps
Parking: Parking in the local lots is usually $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free but limited.

Event Schedule

Saturday
1:00-3:00pm – Early bib pick-up on the 2nd floor at Sports Basement Long Beach (store discount sent via email the week of the event & post-race)
2100 N Bellflower Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90815

Sunday
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens
7:00am – Half marathon & 10m start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10m)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Course

5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route
10m: The 5m route is used for the 10m (two laps) – 5m route
Half: This route is used for the half marathon and run 3 times – half route

More about the Course

The beach path is an open course, so you will encounter others using it. When we start the race, please stay on the right side of the beach path. The right side is for pedestrians and the left side is for cyclists.

On-Course Support: A fully stocked water station is located at the Belmont Pier. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, gatorade, gels, and fruit snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk, a runner turn sign, and a flag

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Awards: 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.
Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and earlier on Instagram. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, the San Fernando Valley, and Orange County. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule

Have Another Question? Check our FAQ page, it's probably answered there!

name: Juneteenth Freedom Run/Walk
description:
The Juneteenth Freedom 5K/5 Mile Run is an event that goes beyond just a race. Juneteenth commemorates the day when 250,000 slaves in Texas, which became the last bastion for slavery during the final days of the Civil War, were declared free.

All participants in the live and virtual race will receive a tech shirt and medal. The live 5K/5 Mile race will have placement awards.

NEW THIS YEAR: Kids' age group awards and cash prizes for breaking the course record for the 5K and 5 mile races.

The 5 Mile race is a 20-point race in the Central Valley Runner of the Year series.

name: Kaweah Lake Bottom Trail Run
description:
Experience the newest trail race in Three Rivers near slick rock on the lake bottom of Kaweah Lake, just 6 short miles from the entrance to Sequoia National Park.

Whether you're aiming for a personal best or simply soaking in the beautiful surroundings, this race offers something special for every runner. Both distances are out and back on a combination of paved and dirt trails. So, lace up your shoes and come join us for a beautiful run on the lake bottom. 

All proceeds to benefit St. Anthony Retreat & Conference Center. St. Anthony is a peaceful and naturally beautiful setting for individual and group retreats, as well as both religious and secular conferences and gatherings. St. Anthony Retreat Center provides meeting space, dining and overnight accommodations for up to 100 guests. St. Anthony Retreat Center is located adjacent to the newly built Santa Teresita Youth Conference Center. For more information about St. Anthony's and Santa Teresita Youth and Conference Centers please visit their website at stanthonyretreat.org  

Parking is limited so try to CARPOOL if possible.

All Finishers Receive: 

  • Lake Bottom Finisher Tee
  • Custom Wood Medal 
  • FREE Race Photos
  • Finish Line Snacks 
  • Chip timing with live results

name: Kendra's Race
description:
In 2006, after the death of their teammate and friend, Kendra Payne, the University of California, Santa Barbara (UCSB) Triathlon Team changed the name of their annual triathlon to Kendra’s Race. The race has been held every year since then and each year the UCSB triathlon team generously donates a portion of the entrance fees to the Kendra Chiota Payne Memorial Fund.

The 2025 Kendra's Race consists a Collegiate Sprint race, Age Group Sprint, 5k Run and Triathlon Relay.

About the course:

The swim will start at Campus Point. Athletes will swim out 200m, take a left, swim for another 400m, take another left, and swim 200m back in. They will head up a flight of wooden steps to the transition area.

Kendra's Race will feature a two loop, 12.7 mile, fast and flat bike course around the Santa Barbara Airport.  Racers will make their way out of transition and head west through the UCSB campus via the bike path, most of which has been recently repaved.  After making their way all the way around the Santa Barbara Airport, cyclists will pass through Goleta Beach and head back onto the bike path towards UCSB.  After completing two loops, racers will then head back into transition.

The run course consists of a 1 loop run over a rolling 5k course. It follows the UCSB lagoon and consists of paved and hard-packed trails. Racers will leave transition and run down to the lagoon. They will run on the trail system on the bluffs before dropping down to the lagoon where they will pass an aid station. Runners will continue along the lagoon to the turn around point. After turning around, runners will follow nearly the same route back before sprinting to the finish in lot 6.

name: Kerman Almond Festival Scholarship Fun Run/Walk
description:
The event kicks off with a 5K Run/Walk at 9 am, funds raised go towards an Agriculture Scholarship. All family members are invited to join the fun! Following the Run/Walk, the Festival will begin at 11:00 am. Enjoy live entertainment, a variety of food vendors, an Almond Baking contest, Kids zone with bounce houses, an Agricultural-Related Photo Competition, Wine Tasting, Arts & Crafts, Car Show and much more!

The Kerman Almond Festival Fun Run/Walk is a family event with a Kids run for 12 and under and a 5K Walk or Run for participants 13 and older.

name: Kids Haunted House Paint & Shriek
description: Build, paint, and decorate a mini wooden haunted house for a spooky, cute, or glamorous craft. Snack on spooky treats and sip something sweet to get your creative juices flowing. Stick around to watch the Halloween classic movie, The Nightmare Before Christmas, while your creations dry!

name: Kids Survival Skills: Fire Crafting and Safety
description: Understanding fire safety and the science of fire helps kids stay safe and make smart choices in emergencies. This month, junior survivalists will learn how to start a fire through various methods, build awareness about the science of fire, and fuel their curiosity to spark brighter, safer, futures!

name: Kings County Turkey Trot
description:
Welcome to the 2025 Thanksgiving Day, Kings County Turkey Trot!

NEW THIS YEAR: START/FINISH LOCATION, 3K FUN WALK, AND KIDS RACES!!

**KIDS THAT RUN IN THE "KIDS RACE" CAN ALSO WALK THE 3K, OR RUN/WALK THE 5K WITH FAMILY**

What:  The Turkey Trot is back (organized by Champions Recovery Alternative Services), and we can’t wait to see you! Come join the fun on Thanksgiving morning in beautiful downtown Hanford.  

When:  Thursday, November 27, 2025 at 8 AM. (Kids Races will start at 7:30am) - Rain or Shine.   

Where:  Our New Start/Finish Line, 325 N Douty Street (Between Superior Dairy & Civic Center Park), in Hanford.  Same 5K Route, just a BIGGER Race Finish Line Venue to Cheer, Support, Meet Up, and Hang Out with your family and friends!

This course is scenic, and will take you around downtown; before the 5K splits and does an out-an-back on Douty Street, and the 3K Walkers return to the Finish Line!

Medals:  Medals will be awarded to our Top 20 Male & Top 20 Female 5K Finishers, must be registered in the 5K chip timed race!

Kids Races: 1/4 Mile Fun Race, and 1/2 Mile Fun Race. 

Biggest Flock Award: Create your team/group, have your family & friends (maybe your entire work) join it....Win the BIGGEST FLOCK AWARD! Tie-Breaker - Best Dressed!  

Packet Pick-Up:  
Tuesday, November 25th & Wednesday, November 26th from 9 AM to 6 PM, at 311 N Douty Street (Champions Corporate Office). 

On Thanksgiving Morning, we will open at 6:30 AM. To avoid long lines and a late start the day of the race, please pick up your packet early!  

Race Benefits: Champions Recovery Alternative Programs, Inc., a local community-based organization dedicated to nurturing a healthier Kings County.

name: KIWANIS  RESOLUTION 5K Run/Walk, and 10K Run/Walk
description:
KIWANIS Resolution Races are in-person runs at Mountain View Shoreline Park! We’ve both a 5K and 10K event to choose from, with Digital  Chip timing for both.

 

This year we are again running on Saturday January 3 to give  holiday travelers a chance to participate too. Start the new year out with a great run on a great day on the Bayland trails!. It's a beautiful location with free parking, great race, with post-race snacks and lots of awards.

 

Please note that no dogs are allowed in Shoreline Park.

 

We will again have a 1K Kids run this year for ages 1-10 and this year all 1K participants will also receive a race T shirt. Plan on bringing all kids and the neighbors too! 

 

Race Day is Jan 4, 2025. The 10K starts at 10:00 AM and the 5K starts at 10:15 AM. All inside Mountain View Shoreline Park. Parking is free for all.  

 

All participants who register by December 15 will receive a specially designed race T-shirt.

 

Also please upload photos from your race experience to this website. We'd love to share your experience of the race. 

 

You may visit our permanent website WSJKrun.org for information about past races and Kiwanis current charitable work. Or Click HERE for more info about Kiwanis of West San Jose and/or HERE for specific programs information.

name: L.A. CHINATOWN FIRECRACKER 5K/10K/KIDDIE/PAW'ER DOG RUN/WALK & BIKE RIDE
description: L.A. Chinatown Firecracker Run Committee, Inc. (LACFRC) is a 501(C)(3) non profit organization with a non-salaried group of volunteers who donate their time and energy to organize and stage events and programs; promoting health, fitness, and cultural awareness to the greater Los Angeles community. name: LA Classic Turkey Trot
description:
Join us for the 2nd Annual LA Classic Turkey Trot! Our event offers a 5K run/walk through beautiful Griffith Park in Los Angeles as well as a 5 Miler and 15K for those looking to challenge themselves! Run through the start and finish line at the Shane's Inspiration area in Griffith Park!

Whether you're running for a PR, running for fun, or walking, there's no better way to start the Thanksgiving holiday! Costumes are encouraged!

name: La Jolla Cove Swim
description:
Iconic Open Water Swim held in La Jolla, California the first Sunday after Labor almost every year since 1916. 

There are four swim events available on race day. 

  • 250 Meter kids race "Garibaldi Grommets"
  • 1 Mile "Sea Lions"
  • 3 Mile "Leopard Sharks"
  • 4 Mile "Whole Enchilada" Swimmers compete in both the 1 mile & 3 mile events  - there is about an hour between the 2 swims.

All swimmers receive an event t-shirt. All finishers receive a finisher's medal. There are Age Group Medals awarded that follow U.S. Masters Swimming age brackets. For the kids race it is by individual year. 8 year olds will only be competing with 8 years etc up through 12 years of age.

name: La Jolla Half Marathon & 5K
description:
The La Jolla Half Marathon is one of America's most picturesque and beautiful point-to-point races. Starting at the Del Mar Fairgrounds, the course follows a scenic coastal route before reaching the challenging climb to the summit of Torrey Pines State Park. The course then rolls atop Torrey Pines mesa, continues down through residential La Jolla Shores, and finishes at La Jolla Cove.

For those interested in a shorter option, the La Jolla Shores 5K offers a mostly downhill course and features some of the most scenic views of the last 3.1 miles of the half marathon course.

name: Lafayette Res Run for Education
description:
About the Lafayette Res Run for Education

The Lafayette Chamber and the City of Lafayette are co-sponsors of the Lafayette Res Run for Education which is traditionally held the third Sunday in October. 

 

The 2025 Lafayette Res Run for Education will be held Sunday, October 19. 5k: 8am, 10k: 8:15am, 2 mile: 8:45am in downtown Lafayette, CA.

 

Back by popular demand, from its introduction in 2020, you can register for the Reservoir Challenge – the virtual race which “runs” around the 2.7-mile paved trail of the Lafayette Reservoir October 11-18. Please note, the Reservoir Challenge is not an option on Sunday, October 19 as the Reservoir will be closed for the 10K runners. The Reservoir Challenge is great opportunity to safely walk or run the Reservoir on your own, perhaps beating your time from last year. 

 

Beneficiaries of the event are the local schools and the services and programs of the Chamber. See below for what we gave back to our schools last year! 

 

The Run is the city’s most popular “family affair”, involving kids, parents, grandparents, and hundreds of serious runners from throughout the Bay Area. Join us in 2025 for the 10k, 5k, the 2 mile run/walk for fun or the Reservoir Challenge! Sprinters, walkers, the “stroller brigade” and many of Lafayette’s top four legged residents are welcome to join in the fun. 

 

The first 100 students to register from each school will receive a voucher for a free 1/4 pound of bulk candy from Zoonie's during packet pickup! 

 

Packet Pickup
Race packets that include our traditional long sleeve t-shirt (while supplies last) and race bib will be available for pickup at the Lafayette Chamber Office, 251 Lafayette Circle, Lafayette, CA [map it] on the following dates/times (subject to change):

Tuesday, October 14, 9am-5pm
Wednesday, October 15,10am-6pm
Thursday, October 16, 9am-5pm
Friday, October 17, 9am-1pm
Saturday, October 18, 9am-noon
Sunday, October 19, 7:15am-8:45am Mt. Diablo Blvd, just east of Lafayette Circle

 

Support your school. Sign up now! 

**Parking and fees are not included in registration price.

 

 

Giving Back to Our Local Schools

In 2024, the 32nd annual Lafayette Res Run for Education allowed the Chamber to give back $37,497.95 to our local school organizations!

Lafayette Res Run for Education Final Competition Winners!
Acalanes High School wins MOST Improved with 14.29%: $500 prize
Lafayette Elementary won MOST Registrations with 375: $500 prize
Burton Valley Elementary won the Early Bird Contest through September: $500 prize

Beneficiary amount per school:
Burton Valley Elementary $7292.99
Happy Valley Elementary $6278.68
Lafayette Elementary $7136.05
Springhill Elementary $5646.08
Stanley Middle School $7235.25
Acalanes High School $2366.53
Campolindo High School $1207.48
Miramonte High School $334.89

 

Thank you to everyone who contributed in making this such a successful event. 

Banner photo by Gloria Touchet Photography

name: Lake Casitas Short Course Championships (Middle School Racer Sign Ups ONLY)
description:
Lake Casitas Short Course Championships is a high school level meet, home of the Ventura County Championship on the beautiful Lake Casitas Cross Country Course where many legends of the sport have run over the last 30 years. This year will feature a NEW middle school level race in 2025. This will be one middle school race with all genders and grades. If registrations are over 200 runners, we may increase to two races.

IF LESS THAN 40 SIGN UPS BY OCTOBER 29TH, WE WILL NOT RUN THE MIDDLE SCHOOL RACE, AND YOU WILL GET A REFUND.

Important race information: 

  1. Course Map Link HERE
  2. Middle School Race Time:  4:15pm
    1. High School races will follow at 4:45pm and 5:15pm. Stick around to watch the "big kids" race!
  3. Awards: Top 30 boys and Top 30 girls will receive medals in the finish chute. 
  4. Cost: $5 goes towards timing with live chip timing and awards. Paid here, on RunSignUp. Parents can register their athletes. 
    1. Registration closes for entries on Oct 29th at 8:00pm.
  5. Directions: 11311 Santa Ana Rd, Ventura, CA 93001. From the main Lake Casitas gate, turn right and drive about 2 miles to the cross country course and boat launch ramp
  6. Parking: NO BUSSES OR CARS WILL BE ALLOWED PAST THE LAST GATE AFTER 3:45pm. If you get to the course early, park in the group campsite area before the last gate. There will be people there to help direct you. Busses should park along the top road before the gate. However, if you park down on the course level you will not be able to leave until the final race is completed for the day and the runners have left the finish area (usually about 6:00pm). It is a ¼ mile walk from the parking area down to the starting line/check in area. After drop off, some bus drivers may prefer to park in the paved lot to the left (south) of the entrance station of the park and then return to pick the team up. There is a $10 charge per vehicle entering the park. Please be sure parents and friends aware of this charge so that they may plan carpools. 
  7. Water: Please provide water for your teams and make sure your runners pre-hydrate. Faucets are available to refill your containers around the Spectator Hill, by the restrooms, and in the camping areas. We will have water in cups at the finish line for athletes. YOU MAY PROVIDE WATER TO ATHLETES DURING THE RACE. 
  8. T-shirts and snack bar: We will have custom Lake Casitas Short Course Championships t-shirts for sale as well as a light snack bar. Halloween themed, get yours before we sell out!

Questions? Contact Garrett at garrett.reynolds@oxnardunion.org

name: Lake Sonoma 100K, 50K, TS Half Marathon
description:
Join us in Healdsburg, California, on April 11th 2026 for the TERREX Lake Sonoma 100K, 50K, and Trail Sisters Half Marathon! We are excited to have adidas TERREX back as our presenting partner!

We are stoked to team up with Mountain Outpost to bring you full livestream coverage, athlete panels, interviews, and commentary from special guests!

Lake Sonoma 100K

The 100K course will start with a climb up Pritchett Peak with a water only stop at the top. Once you reach the summit you’ll head back down toward the Lake Sonoma Visitors Center and then up to the hill to South Lake Trailhead where you’ll embark on an out and back of the original old school LS course and then back down the hill to the finish. It’s the same great Lake Sonoma Relentless experience, only this time with a big climb to kick it all off!

Lake Sonoma 50K

It’s not worth it unless you have to work for it! The 50k start is located in the green space next to the Lake Sonoma Visitor Center (you can’t miss it). After a short road section to get the field spread out  the course then continues onto beautiful rolling single track trails. You will continue past South Lake, Island View, Warm Springs Creek, Wulfow, Liberty Glen and the Bummer aid stations, finally crossing the scenic lake bridge. Remember to save some juice for the last few miles, as you have a screaming downhill towards the finish. The race starts at 7:30am.

Don’t forget to enjoy the views! … and be sure to take a dip in the water to cool off. (but don’t drink!)

Trail Sisters Women's Half Marathon

The Trail Sisters (TS) Half Marathon is a women’s only event. It was created to foster encouragement and camaraderie amongst all abilities and experience levels. This out and back course starts with steep trail ascent to South Lake Trailhead, but also provides a speedy descent to the finish. True to its label, you can expect relentless rolling hills that will challenge your mind and body. Lucky for you though, you will share the journey with a community of supportive Trail Sisters to help you through! You will have 4 and half hours to complete the half marathon course.

Come Celebrate!

Lake Sonoma isn’t just a race event, it’s a celebration. We always complete the weekend with a Celebration and Thank You event at Coyote Sonoma in Healdsburg, CA. Everyone involved with the event is invited to enjoy wine, charcuterie, and share stories from the weekend.

See you on that start line!
Gina & Justin
LS Race Directors

This out and back course starts with steep trail ascent to South Lake Trailhead, but also provides a speedy descent to the finish. True to its label, you can expect relentless rolling hills that will challenge your mind and body. Lucky for you though, you will share the journey with a community of supportive Trail Sisters to help you through! You will have 4 and half hours to complete the half marathon course.

Come Celebrate!

Lake Sonoma isn’t just a race event, it’s a celebration. We always complete the weekend with a Celebration and Thank You event at Coyote Sonoma in Healdsburg, CA. Everyone involved with the event is invited to enjoy wine, charcuterie, and share stories from the weekend.

See you on that start line!
Gina & Justin
LS Race Directors

name: Lake Sonoma 100K, 50K, TS Half Marathon
description:
Join us in Healdsburg, California, on April 11th 2026 for the TERREX Lake Sonoma 100K, 50K, and Trail Sisters Half Marathon! We are excited to have adidas TERREX back as our presenting partner!

We are stoked to team up with Mountain Outpost to bring you full livestream coverage, athlete panels, interviews, and commentary from special guests!

Lake Sonoma 100K

The 100K course will start with a climb up Pritchett Peak with a water only stop at the top. Once you reach the summit you’ll head back down toward the Lake Sonoma Visitors Center and then up to the hill to South Lake Trailhead where you’ll embark on an out and back of the original old school LS course and then back down the hill to the finish. It’s the same great Lake Sonoma Relentless experience, only this time with a big climb to kick it all off!

Lake Sonoma 50K

It’s not worth it unless you have to work for it! The 50k start is located in the green space next to the Lake Sonoma Visitor Center (you can’t miss it). After a short road section to get the field spread out  the course then continues onto beautiful rolling single track trails. You will continue past South Lake, Island View, Warm Springs Creek, Wulfow, Liberty Glen and the Bummer aid stations, finally crossing the scenic lake bridge. Remember to save some juice for the last few miles, as you have a screaming downhill towards the finish. The race starts at 7:30am.

Don’t forget to enjoy the views! … and be sure to take a dip in the water to cool off. (but don’t drink!)

name: LAP: ATV and Desert Camping Trip to Anza Borrego State Park
description:
UPDATED Liberty Adventure Program: Sunday, November 9-Monday, November 10

Ocotillo ATV & Palm Canyon Campground (about a 2-hour drive from Coronado)

Listen to nearby coyotes while sleeping under the stars. Anza Borrego desert state park is the perfect place to ride ATV’s and explore one of southern California’s best kept secrets. This trip includes basic meals, camping gear, ATV excursion, transportation, and guided hike.

DAY 1:  will depart for ATV tours in Ocotillo, CA at 0800 AM from NAB Liberty and 0830 AM from NASNI Liberty Centers. arrive at Ocotillo, CA and start our two-hour ATV tour. Drive to campground through the Anza Borrego desert state park towards our final campground at Palm canyon. set up camp, visit the visitors center and town, bonfire, dinner, refreshments and Games 

DAY 2: Guided hike through the palm canyon trail, experience photo ops sightseeing, sand sledding, before leaving the area, drive through Julian for apple pie and then back to San Diego. 

 

Packing list will be provided before departure date. please pack in layers to stay warm! as this time of year can be freezing at night. 

 

Camping equipment, food, experience, and transportation provided.  

***Open to JUNIOR ENLISTED E1-E6 ACTIVE DUTY

name: LASAA Mug Run - Altadena Station Forever Run
description:
LASAA’s mission is to provide athletic events for our members, comprised of Los Angeles County Sheriff’s Department employees and law enforcement personnel, to promote health, fitness, and camaraderie. 

The Mug Run series started in 1993. The primary participants were law enforcement personnel with an average of 10 runners.  Since then, the Mug Run series opened its participation to the general public. Today, participation has grown to over 300 runners.  The race provides outside friendly competition and positive interaction between law enforcement and the community. 

Runners are participating in the Inaugural Altadena Forever Run, commemorating the one-year anniversary of the Altadena Eaton Fire, honoring our community's resilience and recovery.  Proceeds will directly benefit Altadena Eaton Fire Survivors as well as the Sheriff's Support Group of Altadena. 

Whether you’re running, walking, or cheering from the sidelines, this event welcomes everyone—runners, walkers, families, friends, neighbors, and first responders—to come together in strength and solidarity.  Let's help those still rebuilding their lives and show what Altadena can do when we run together.

name: LASD Turkey Trot 5K
description:
Join Us for the Exciting Turkey Trot 5K at Bonelli Park!

Get ready to kick off the holiday season with a bang at the annual Turkey Trot 5K on Saturday, November 15, 2025! Nestled in the beautiful Bonelli Park, this is more than just a run—it's a celebration of community, fitness, and fun!

Why You Should Join Us:

Stunning Location: Experience the breathtaking views of Bonelli Park as you trot through nature’s beauty.


Free for LASAA Members: If you're a member of LASAA, registration is on us! Non-LASAA members and the public can join the fun for just $30.


Day-of Registration: Forgot to register? No problem! Sign up on the day for $10 (LASAA) or $40 (non-members).


Swag Galore: Every participant walks away with a stylish T-shirt and a dazzling finisher medal, so you can show off your accomplishment!


Exciting Raffle Prizes: Enter for a chance to win incredible prizes, including a brand-new e-bike! You won't want to miss out on this!


This event is perfect for families, friends, and anyone looking to embrace the spirit of gratitude while getting active. Gather your crew, challenge yourself, and celebrate together as we trot toward a healthier lifestyle!

Don't wait—mark your calendars, lace up those sneakers, and join us for a memorable day of fun and fitness! Let’s make this Turkey Trot an unforgettable experience! 🦃🏃‍♂️✨

name: Last Dash Before Midnight 5K, 10K, & Half Marathon
description:
Start your New Year’s Eve off with purpose, positivity, and a little sweat. Let’s dash into the new year together!
 

Last Dash Before Midnight – Long Beach Edition

🎉 5K, 10K & Half Marathon
📍 Long Beach, CA
📅 Date: December 31st

End 2024 on a high note with one final run before the clock strikes midnight! The Last Dash Before Midnight is your chance to lace up, take in the stunning Long Beach coastline, and finish the year strong. Whether you're chasing a PR or just embracing the celebratory vibes, this race is the perfect way to reflect on the past year and stride into 2025 with momentum.

Event Highlights
🌊 Scenic Course: Run along the picturesque Long Beach shoreline with refreshing ocean breezes and beautiful sunrise views.


🎶 Festive Atmosphere: Soak in the energy of a fun-filled morning with music, good vibes, and a supportive running community.


🏅 Commemorative Medal: Finish strong and collect a unique medal marking your final race of the year.
📸 Photo Ops: Capture your last run of 2024 with themed backdrops and stunning coastal scenery.

 

Why Join Us?
There’s no better way to wrap up the year than with an uplifting race, surrounded by like-minded runners ready to welcome 2025 on a strong note. Reflect on your accomplishments, set the tone for the year ahead, and make unforgettable memories with an epic morning run!

Registration Includes
✅  Race on a scenic course
✅ Exclusive Last Dash finisher medal
✅ Free race photos
✅ Post-race refreshments to celebrate your final run of 2024

Race Day Schedule
📅 Check-In: 6:15 AM
🏁 Start Times:
🔹 Half Marathon: 7:00 AM
🔹 10K & 5K: 7:30 AM

Kick off your New Year's Eve (in the morning) with movement, motivation, and a dash of celebration. Let’s cross that finish line and stride confidently into 2025! 🎊✨

name: Leprechaun Chase – 5K, 10K, 10-Miler, Half Marathon
description:
Let's celebrate St. Patricks Day

Race Details

Start Location: Alamitos Beach, 780 E Shoreline Dr. Long Beach, CA
Parking: Parking in the lot is $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free.

Event Schedule

Friday
4:00-6:00pm – Early bib pick-up on the 2nd floor at Sports Basement Long Beach (store discount sent via email the week of the event)
2100 N Bellflower Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90815

Saturday
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens 
7:00am – Half marathon & 10m start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10m)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Courses

5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route
10m: The 5m route is used for the 10m (two laps) – 5m route
Half: The 5m route is run twice and the 5k route is run once for the Half – 5m route and 5k route

More about the Course

The beach path is an open course, so you will encounter others using it. When we start the race, please stay on the right side of the beach path. The right side is for pedestrians and the left side is for cyclists.

On-Course Support: A fully stocked water station is located at the Belmont Pier. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, gatorade, gels, and fruit snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk, a runner turn sign, and a flag

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Awards: 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.
Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and earlier on Instagram. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, the San Fernando Valley, Orange County, and San Diego. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule.

Have Another Question? Check our FAQ page, it's probably answered there!

name: Let’s have a Wicked time! The Haunted Trail - Balboa
description:
Tag along with Liberty as we take on Balboa Park--with two haunts in one! Registration includes your admission into the eXperiment Maze (a 3,500 square foot mind-bending maze of distorted realities, horror legends, and nightmares brought to life), the mile-long Haunted Trail, and transportation to and from Balboa Park.

*This ticket is open to Active Duty E1-E6 only. No guests or dependents. MWR transportation is required for all registrants.*

New this Year: DARK CARNIVAL -  a new scare zone with roaming monsters, games, photo ops, expanded Gift Shop, and bites from local food trucks to fuel your fear.

Warning: This attraction contains high impact scares and strobe lights which may not be suitable for people with heart conditions or prone to seizures. Attraction may include the use of fog juice as well as spraying water.

name: Liberty Airsoft Trip
description:
October 2025 Location: SC Village, Chino, CA

Spend the day playing airsoft at the SC Village, Chino. This location features 12 maps that will deliver adrenaline-filled fun and challenge players at every level.

Price includes transportation, admission to park, goggle/rifle rental and 1000 BB's. Additional BB's are available for purchase on-site at SC Village. MWR Liberty will also provide snacks/refreshments. Please bring money for food stop in town. 

What to Wear:

Wear closed-toed shoes. Wear loose -fitting attire that covers most of your skin. In cooler weather, wear hoodies, sweatpants. In hotter weather, wear lightweight, breathable clothes to keep you cool while also shielding you from the sun. We highly recommend you bring gloves!

name: Lights for Life 5K
description:
The team at Project 99 invites you to join us for the Lights for Life 5K, our signature mental health and suicide awareness campaign. This year’s event continues our mission to shine a light on suicide prevention and bring the conversation "out of the dark." Your participation helps us spread hope, raise awareness, and ensure that no one feels alone in their struggles.
By running, walking, or supporting this 5K, you are directly contributing to our efforts to educate local students and the broader community about mental health and suicide prevention. Project 99 Play for Life, Inc., is so grateful for the generous support that allows us to make an impact today and grow our mission for the future. All additional donations are tax-deductible and will help us expand our educational outreach, keeping students engaged and encouraging them to "stay in the game" and play for life.
In addition to participating in the race, we encourage youth to get involved behind the scenes, with opportunities to volunteer in event planning, preparation, and execution. Together, we can continue to build a community where mental health is prioritized, and no one is left in the dark.
Let's bring hope, awareness, and prevention into the light.

name: LOOK GOOD FEEL GOOD SAN LEANDRO 5K, 10, HALF MARATHON & MARATHON
description:
The 8Th Annual Race is on!

 

Ready to make the Move and become part of something exciting in San Francisco Bay Area?

Are you a Runner/ Walker who is coming to California?

 

Tie up your shoe laces and on the trail for the historic Look Good Feel Good San  Leandro Marathon race  

Every year Runner all over the United States of America gather at San Francisco Bay Area to run for Awesome Cause!  while giving back to  foster education and college scholarship for underserved girls and young adults!  Proceeds benefit the charitable works of the non profit organization called Divine Mercy Family Foundation.

Inspired by runners like you, the Look Good Feel Good 5K, 10K, Half Marathon and Marathon race for college scholarship takes you through a world of adventure that begins on a flat terrain then goes from paved to trails.   With  5K elevation of 71ft, 10K elevation of 96ft, and Half Marathon elevation of 204ft you are set to cruise the San Francisco bay shoreline.

The race is out-and -back.  5K makes a loop and head out towards the bay trail. 10K, half marathoners and marathoners head straight out toward Hayward Bay trail.
Water stops are located at 1mile, before the 10K turn around and at the half marathon turn around.  Potty -a -potty is located close to the start and finish line and at the 10K aid station.  
You will enjoy breath taking views of the San Leandro shoreline.  With the view of water wrapping around all routes.  You are poised to gaze at San Francisco heading back to the finish line.
This race is worth it as the route takes you along the coastlines of the San Leandro marina scenic route.  Enjoy the adventures of nature.  Gaze at the variety of birds and wildlife along the paths.
 
 The route maps are found on this link


https://www.divinemercyfamily.org
 
The marathon runners will run the half marathon route two times (2x) 
 


All registered runners will receive finisher medals. Prices will be awarded to the 1st, 2nd and 3rd runners in  5K, 10K, Half Marathon and Marathon.This is an endurance race.  Will take both physical and mental energy.
Here is what to expect for the marathon- ( Half Marathon 2x)
At the start the marathon takes off and head out toward the Hayward bay trail to make the first turnaround at the half marathon turnaround before heading back.  At the half marathon turn around, all marathon runners will receive the first bracelet.  Make sure to hydrate and get ice packs at the aid station before heading back to the start line. Get more hydration and energy gels.  Make a U-turn and return to the half marathon turn around to receive the final bracelet.  Having completed the half marathon 2x, runners must proceed to finish line to receive their finisher medals.  A total of 2 bracelets are required to receive the final medal. Always ask for the bracelet at the half marathon turn around. 
The marathon cut off time is 6 hours. Although some athletes make it in four (4) hours. The marathon halfway is 4 hours. All marathon runners must complete the halfway point not later than 11:45 am.  This means all marathon runners must  complete their 2x turnaround  at the half marathon turnaround and head out toward the finish line  at 11:45 am.  
However, we encourage you to run at your pace.  
 

If you need help along the route  contact the race director - Francisca by phone / Tex at this number (808) 756-2436
 
  Please, run at your go pace. For sore or bruised legs, no worries, Dr. Carter and her team will be at your service to provide the care you need.

Eat and rest well
Stay hydrated; Carry your own extra water and hydration as weather may be hot

To beat COVID-19, maintain social distancing, Wash hands
Please, Stay home if you are sick.

 Get Involved Now!

If you or someone you know is inclined to give tax deductible donations, sign up now by clicking on the donate button.  You can also becoming  a fundraiser on the race registration website. Your name will be engraved on the Look Good Feel Good Academic tree of life placard for fundraisers and donors who raise $500.00 or more  visit
 www.divinemercyfamily.org/donate

To give a gift that keeps on giving consider gifting us with an estate, land or ranch to build our permanent home.

 Become a recurring donor, give a gift in honor of a loved one or an endowment to promote education of young girls and young adults.

For inquires/Sponsor/vendors Contact Race Director by email: divinemercyff@gmail.com

 

 

Race and Course is timed and certified by USATF

Join our dedicated and advanced  Runners who have gone on to participate  in New York Marathon and Boston Marathon.

 

What to expect Before Race Day: Thursday October 9, 2025

Pick-up your race Packet including race T-shirt, Race bib and goodies

Venue: Sport Basement 2727 Milvia St., Berkeley CA 94703

Time: 4;30 PM to 7:00PM ( PST)

 

Race Day- 10/11/2025

6:50am to 7:45am - Check in and bib pick up

8:00 am - Race start (10K, Half Marathon, Marathon)

9:00 AM - (5K, 1 mile)


After Race treat yourself to drinks, water, snacks and Togo Sandwiches   

 

Continue to make a difference. 

We love you.  Take Selfies along the route and share.

Thank you for participating in the 8th annual Look Good Feel Good Race

Share your experience and join us on Facebook

 https://www.facebook.com/groups/lookgoodfeelgoodfamily

 

The Best part in participating in the 8th annual Look Good Feel Good Race is winning the famous wine 

by music icon John Legend

John Legend and his team created a timeless tasting wine. You will have the opportunity to taste it.

Register for the Look Good Feel Good Race and be in the draw to taste the best wine ever, called the LVE wine.  The wine is one of the collections from the iconic musician- John Legend.  John’s vineyard and his pursuit of excellence lead to the production of the best wine with roots deep in the Napa Valley.  An Award-winning wine known for beautiful balance, fitness and power. Whether you are travelling, eating or having a romantic evening you will fall in love with LVE wine.  Fans say that the music of John Legend pairs well with wine.

This LVE wine created by John Legend stands for Legend Vineyard Exclusive.  This means “Love” without the “o”.  Enjoy!

name: Lookin' for a Cure Palo Alto
description:
Description

Join Us in the Pursuit of a Cure at the Lookin' For A Cure Palo Alto 5K!


Every year, Lookin' For A Cure 5k events light up cities across the United States. These events are not just about running, they are about igniting awareness, and unity in the fight against Ocular Melanoma. By participating, you're not only support groundbreaking research but also bringing together individuals affected by Ocular Melanoma.We are Lookin' For a Cure" in Palo Alto. Join A Cure in Sight on Saturday July 12th, 7AM-11AM at: 2452 Watson Ct. Palo Alto, CA US 94020. Help raise awareness and support the fight against Ocular Melanoma, the most common eye cancer in adults in the United States.  

A Partnership for Progress
