name: Los Angeles Sunset Trail Relay | 5K & Kid Run
description:
Get ready for an unforgettable evening of trail running at the Los Angeles Sunset Trail Relay & 5K! This race brings together adventure, teamwork, and breathtaking views in one epic event. As the sun sets over the city, you'll traverse scenic trails, soak in stunning skyline views, and take on a thrilling course through the heart of Griffith Park.

🏃 10 Mile Relay – Teams of 4! Gather your crew, with each runner completing the same scenic loop before passing the baton. It's the perfect mix of teamwork, strategy, and fun!

 

🏃 5K Solo Race! A thoughtfully designed route that balances challenge and enjoyment — perfect for experienced trail runners and those new to the sport.

 

Whether you're racing with a team of four or taking on the 5K solo, this event is the perfect way to push your limits, connect with fellow runners, and embrace the magic of trail running under the evening sky. With well-stocked aid stations, an enthusiastic volunteer crew, and an electrifying atmosphere, you'll have everything you need to make this race one to remember.

So grab your teammates, lace up your trail shoes, and join us for an incredible night of running, camaraderie, and unforgettable moments! Register now and experience the Los Angeles Sunset Trail Relay & 5K like never before!

 

Each Participant receives:

  • Scenic, and well marked courses

  • Panoramic views of Griffith Park, the LA River, and Glendale.

  • Ultra-soft, ultra-comfy premium gender specific short sleeve t-shirt*

  • Unique Finisher’s medal for all participants

  • Prizes from our sponsors awarded to the top 3 teams (Relay Only).

  • Exclusive Captain, and Anchor Badge for Last Leg Runners (Relay only)

  • Special Award for Overall and Age Grade Division Winners (5K only)

  • Special Awards for the Largest club, Corporate team, and the team with the funniest name (Relay Only)

  • Free Downloadable Race Photos from our experienced photography team

  • Live Music

  • Chip time results

  • Course Aid Stations with medical staff

  • Custom Bibs

  • Enthusiastic Volunteer Support

  • Finish Line Fruit, Snacks, Refreshments, and Full Body Wipes

  • Flexible deferral and transfer options

  • Access to the exclusive Los Angeles Sunset Trail Run sale at Fleet Feet Burbank

  • Lifelong memories with friends!

name: Los Penasquitos Canyon Adventure Race
description:
Step into Los Peñasquitos Canyon Preserve — a 4,000-acre wild escape tucked inside San Diego, where creek crossings, waterfalls, and rugged canyon trails set the stage for your next adventure.

This event offers three unique ways to explore:

  • Adventure Race (foot + bike): Test your endurance and navigation across multiple disciplines for the full challenge.
  • Orienteering Score-O (on foot): Use your map and compass to find as many checkpoints as you can before time runs out.
  • MTB Orienteering Score-O (on bike): Ride fast, think sharp, and navigate twisting canyon trails on two wheels.

Whether you’re a first-timer eager to try orienteering or a seasoned racer chasing every control, this course delivers both fun and challenge. With over 7 miles of canyon terrain, diverse wildlife, and historic landmarks, every checkpoint is another discovery.

Grab your map, trust your instincts, and choose your adventure — will you run, ride, or do it all?

 

Event Team:

  • Event Director: Mark Prior
  • Course Setter: Ashley Young
  • Visit the Volunteer page to learn how to help with the event.
    • See "Volunteer" at the top right of the page. 🔝
    • Volunteers get up to a $20 credit for a race to cover their registration fee.
    • Volunteer roles explained in detail

Format: Adventure Race, Score, and MTB 

Map:  scale  1:10000  |  3m contours

Courses: Adventure Race, Score, and MTB (mountain bike)

​Starts: 9am and 11am

Time Limit: 4 hours for the Adventure Race, 2 hours for Score-O, 2 hours for MTB Score-O

All competitors must return to HQ and download by 1pm so we know you are safe. If you don't check in before leaving, volunteers will search the course to ensure you are accounted for and not lost. Please check in before you leave.

Scoring: Electronic punching will be offered. All participants must bring, rent, or purchase one. Controls will be AIR+ enabled. 

E-Punches: Rental electronic punches will be available for $5. Alternatively, you can purchase your own e-punch at our gear store for delivery to the event (use "000000" when registering).

Clinics:  An introductory clinic will be offered at 8:45 am and 10:45am. An experienced orienteer will teach you the basics.

Registration: All participants must pre-register. All standard SDO registration policies apply.

Fees:

  • $20 for adults, $10 for juniors (under 21)
  • $5 early bird discount through midnight, Saturday, October 4th.

Closes: Registration will close at 10 am on Friday, Oct 24th, or when we reach our limit

Entry Limit: To comply with San Diego parks usage policy, this event is limited to 50 participants in the morning and 50 in the afternoon, so sign-up fast before all the slots are filled. See the "Find a Participant" tab to see the registration list.

HQ Location:  32.94092378309307, -117.18205789755295  - Elizabeth Rabbit Park

Public Transportation: none nearby.

Parking: Parking at HQ is very limited. Overflow parking is available north of HQ on Del Vino Ct and Rancho Toyon Pl. Read signs carefully. 

San Diego Orienteering: Home page  |  Events

Map:  scale  1:10000  |  3m contours

Courses: Adventure Race, Score, and MTB (mountain bike)

​Starts: 9am and 11am

Time Limit: 4 hours for the Adventure Race, 2 hours for Score-O, 2 hours for MTB Score-O

Scoring: Electronic punching will be offered. All participants must bring, rent, or purchase one. Controls will be AIR+ enabled.

Fees:

  • $20 for adults, $10 for juniors (under 21)
  • $5 early bird discount through midnight, Saturday, October 4th.

Public Transportation: none nearby.

Parking: Parking at HQ is very limited. Overflow parking is available north of HQ on Del Vino Ct and Rancho Toyon Pl. Read signs carefully.

name: LSA's Run Home 2026
description:
This is a fundraiser for Life Services Alternatives which provides homes and services for the I/DD community in the Bay Area.

 

Please register to race and donate, or just donate!

 

Life Services Alternatives Run Home

Life Services Alternatives celebrates 22 years after opening their first home with a Live Race Event

  • Race Distances -- 5K, 10K

  • Virtual Run Distances - 5k, 10k - for those who are unable to join on race day.

 

Register early before price goes up and to secure your T-shirt (Shirt sizes subject to availability).  Take advantage of $5 early bird special discount until June 3rd. 

 

Register for LSA's Run Home Here!

Life Services Alternatives, Inc sponsors this race and is the beneficiary. All participants are encouraged to donate and or raise funds for the Life Services Alternatives cause. If you are not a runner or are unable to run you are still available to donate to Life Services Alternatives!

 

About Life Services Alternatives

Life Services Alternatives provides exceptional community living and programs for adults with developmental disabilities. 
 
In our county, there is a housing shortage for adults with development disabilities. In the past 4 years, over 40 programs have closed due staffing issues, low government rates and the high cost of living in the Silicon Valley. A high percentage of adults with developmental disabilities live at home with their parents. Unfortunately, parents age, have health issues, or they can no longer care for their adult child. Parents worry about who will take care of their adult child when they no longer can.
 
Life Services Alternatives helps to alleviate those worries. We opened our first three homes in 2004 in Santa Clara. It was a goal of Life Services Alternatives to establish homes where residents could grow and thrive in a non-institutional setting.  We currently have 15 licensed homes throughout Santa Clara County (San Jose, Campbell, Santa Clara and Morgan Hill) that are home to men and women who are developmentally disabled. Our residents’ range in age from 20 to 80 years old with a wide range of disabilities. 16th home is in the process of renovation and retrofitting to meet the community home standards. Five of our fifteen homes are for individuals who have special health care needs and intensive support needs. Our remaining nine homes, are home to residents who need 24-hour a day, non-medical care and supervision. It is Life Services Alternatives goal to continue to open new homes in our county where residents can live their best possible lives. Your support is needed to reach our goal. Your donation is greatly appreciated and will help change the lives of a developmentally disabled adult.

name: LUCHA RUN
description:
Get ready for the 2ND Annual Lucha Run—a lively, family-friendly event to finish the year with a bang! Bring your best "luchador/a" costume and join us for either a 6K run or a 3K (2-mile) walk. It’s a celebration of fitness, fun, and flavor for all ages!

  • Fun and Festive Atmosphere: Show off your best lucha-inspired costumes, and bring your friends and family to cheer you on.
  • Post-Race Fiesta: Celebrate at the finish line with delicious tacos, hot chocolate, and "pan dulce" waiting to refuel you.
  • Support Local Fitness: As with all Reyes Racing events, this run brings the community together to stay active and celebrate the joy of movement.

BIB PICK UP:

Sat, Dec 6th from 2:30-5:00pm at Fresno Fleet Feet

Sun, Dec 7th (race day) from 7:30-8:45am at Woodward park (Mt. View shelter) 


Lucha Libre "mascaras" available for sale for $10-$15 for anyone who would like to buy one during bib pick up on Saturday and Sunday (race day).

name: Lunar New Year Run 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
🏇🐎 Gallop Into the New Year! 🐎🏇
✨ Step into the Year of the Horse with purpose, energy, and community spirit! ✨
Celebrate culture, fitness, and fresh starts with the Lunar New Year’s Run, which is your chance to embrace the bold spirit of the horse - symbolizing energy, freedom, and forward momentum.

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

name: Mammoth Bar Trail Runs
description:
"Standard distance. Mammoth vert."

Mammoth Bar Trail Runs take place on the single-track and double-track trails of Mammoth Bar OHV Area in Auburn State Recreation Area, in the Endurance Capital of Auburn, California.

Mammoth Bar is known for its steep climbs and descents, as well as it's beautiful American River Canyon views.

These are not your average courses. You get more vert per dollar! Yay!

Mammoth Bar is a new event put on by Skybreaker Racing's Race Director under the Singletrack Running umbrella.

name: MaraFUNrun 5K
description:
Runnin’ for Rhett hosts the MaraFUNrun in Land Park this year!

3,000 youth athletes from the Sacramento area take part in a 5K race celebrating the completion of six weeks of participation in our after-school Youth Fitness Program. You can support our local youth by joining us! Register to run, walk, or jog with the kids in our community 5K, volunteer your time, come out to cheer, or make a donation to help keep our Youth Fitness Program free for these youth athletes. It’s also the perfect shake-out before the big Marathon on Sunday.

name: Martha's Village & Kitchen 19th Annual Thanksgiving Day 5K
description:
Martha's Village & Kitchen Thanksgiving Day 5k is an annual, family-friendly, run/walk fundraiser in Palm Desert, CA. The goal of the 5K is to raise awareness about Martha’s Village & Kitchen’s services and to provide funds to support our mission to end hunger and homelessness in the Coachella Valley. Over 5,000 people attend the event including participants, spectators, and volunteers.

  1. Register yourself as an individual, start a team or join an existing team.
  2. Pick up your essential race gear on the packet pick-up days to be determined.
  3. Watch the KESQ News Channel 3 news team, feature stories about Martha's Village.  Segments will be recorded and available for viewing throughout the weekend.
  4. Gather family, friends or create your own team and get ready to run or walk!  
  5. Visit our sponsorship page on our website to learn more about the businesses that are supporting our community.
  6. Lastly, don’t forget to post pics and tag @MarthasVilllage or hashtag #MVK5K on Facebook, Instagram, and Twitter and show your spirit!

name: Martha's Village & Kitchen Spooktacular 5k/10k Event
description:
Join us for the first-ever Spooktacular 5K/10K on Saturday, October 11, 2025 at Ruth Hardy Park in Palm Springs! This Halloween-themed race is perfect for runners, walkers, and families looking to enjoy a fun and festive morning.

Event Highlights:

5K and 10K distances
Costumes encouraged – prizes for the best dressed!
Scenic course through Palm Springs
Finisher medals and race shirts for all participants
Local vendors, music, and photo opportunities
Proceeds benefit Martha’s Village & Kitchen’s Palm Springs Navigation Center, providing essential services and resources to individuals experiencing homelessness
Come for the run, stay for the spooky fun – and make a difference in our community!

name: Mash + Dash – 5K, 10K, 10-Miler, Half Marathon
description:
Still full? Perfect. Mash & Dash is here to help you run off that mountain of mashed potatoes with a morning of coastal miles and post-feast fun. It’s the perfect way to keep the holiday vibes rolling while giving those leftovers a little competition. Whether you’re out to burn off pie slices or just want an easy cruise by the water, this run is all about laughter, movement, and shaking off that Thanksgiving food coma.

Race Details

Start Location: 5400 E Ocean Ave, Long Beach, CA 90803
Parking: Parking in the lot is $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free.

Event Schedule

Friday
1:00-4:00pm – Early bib pick-up on the 2nd floor at Sports Basement Long Beach (store discount sent via email the week of the event & post-race)
2100 N Bellflower Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90815

Saturday
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens at the start
7:00am – Half marathon and 10-miler start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged in advance for half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Course

5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route
10m: The 5m route is used for the 10m (two laps) – 5m route
Half: The 5m route is run twice and the 5k route is run once for the Half – 5m route and 5k route

More About the Course

This is an out and back course, meaning you will begin and finish in the same location.

Our courses are not closed, which means that there are often runners, walkers, and others enjoying the day along with you. Safety is must and all runners must stay on the pedestrian side of the beach path. The course never goes off the beach path.

On-course support: Courses are well marked with two water stations and restrooms along the way. Turns will be clearly marked with chalk, a sign that says runner turn, and a flag.

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Awards: 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.
Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and earlier on Instagram. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, the San Fernando Valley, Orange County, and San Diego. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule

Have Another Question? Check our FAQ page, it's probably answered there!

name: May the 4th be with You- The Empire Strides Back  5K, 10K, & Half Marathon
description:
May the 4th Be With You – 5K, 10K, Half Marathon | Long Beach

The Empire Strides Back – Medals, Chip Timing, Photos, Costume Fun!

Join us for the May the 4th Be With You 5K, 10K, and Half Marathon in Long Beach, California! Chip-timed running event, medals for all finishers, free race-day photos, costume-friendly race atmosphere, flat coastal course, and family-friendly fun.

 

🏅 Everyone Gets a Medal – No Force Powers Required!
Empire Strides Back – May the 4th Be With You 5K, 10K, & Half Marathon
📍 5400 E Ocean Blvd Long Beach, CA 90803
🗓 Sunday- May 3rd, 2025

 

This is a chip timed event. Overall awards and Age Group Awards

 
👟 Start Times:
Half Marathon: 7:00 AM
5K & 10K: 7:30 AM
Bib Pick-Up: 6:15 AM – 7:35 AM at the Race Ready Athletics Tent
 
🚗 Parking:
Street parking is free. Lot parking is $2.00 per hour. Pay at machine in parking lot
 
🌌 Why You Should Join:
Ready to race through the galaxy? Whether you’re a Jedi, Sith, or Rebel runner, come show off your Force in this high-vibe, costumed run along the scenic Long Beach waterfront.

🎭 Costumes encouraged! Come dressed as your favorite hero, villain, or creature.
📸 Epic photo ops with galaxy props and backdrops.
🎶 Out-of-this-world vibes with music, cheering, and space-age fun.
 
💫 Distances for All:
Ignite your journey with the 5K
Fuel your power with the 10K
Go full galaxy mode in the Half Marathon
 
🎉 Event Perks:
🏅 Everyone gets a finisher medal
📸 Free race-day photos
🔄 Chip-timed results posted on-site
🚰 Water stations & restrooms on course
👶 Stroller-friendly and beginner-welcoming
 
🌞 Why CaliFlow Runs?
We’re runners putting on races for runners. Affordable, authentic, and always a vibe — we believe in good energy, fun themes, and creating an inclusive space for all paces. Whether you're here to PR or just play dress-up and stroll, you're part of the tribe.

 
🎟 Sign up now and let the Force (and your feet) guide you!
#EmpireStridesBack #CaliFlowRuns #MayThe4thBeWithYou #RunWithTheForce #GalaxyRunVibes #FinishLineFeels

name: MCRD San Diego Boot Camp Challenge
description:
Due to the federal government shutdown, the 2025 MCRD Boot Camp Challenge has been cancelled. We appreciate everyone’s support and understanding, and we look forward to welcoming participants back at a future event once normal operations resume.

All paid participants will automatically receive a full refund for their 2025 Boot Camp Challenge registration. No action is required. Please allow two weeks for the refund to be processed, depending on your financial institution.

For updates, please check this page and our official social media channels.

 

 

This special year marks the 250th anniversary of the United States Marine Corps, celebrating a legacy of honor, courage, and commitment—right here at Marine Corps Recruit Depot San Diego.

The Boot Camp Challenge and Festival is a day long adventure, which includes a 3-mile race using the fabled Marine Corps Recruit Training Area. Many of the same obstacles (tunnel crawls, log hurdles, 6 foot climbing wall, cargo net crawls) used by the young men and women in their quest to become a U.S. Marine. In addition, live music, fun giveaways, and a Ooh-Rah good time await you as you enter the gates of the fabled Marine Corps Recruit Depot. Admission is free to the festival, register for the Challenge. See how the Marines are made!

The 3-mile course features over 60 Marine Corps Drill Instructors encouraging and motivating runners along the course. This is an invitation from MCRD San Diego to the community to experience a truly unique opportunity to be a Marine for the day, using a fun race format. The course is designed for all fitness levels, no penalty for missed or incomplete obstacles. Great corporate team builder opportunity! 

New this year! For the first time in BCC history, participants 18 and older have the chance to win a Harley-Davidson motorcycle and riding lessons, courtesy of San Diego Harley-Davidson. Must be present to win!

name: Memorial Day 5K, 10K & Kids 1 Mile Run/Walk
description:
This favorite Memorial Day running event takes place near the beautiful Diamond Valley Lake in Hemet, CA. This flat, out, and back course is perfect for your next PR or for those just starting their journey. Runners and walkers of all experience levels are invited to come out and enjoy the Memorial Day festivities! With a 5K Run/Walk (3.1 miles),10K Run/Walk (6.2 miles), and our iconic Kid’s Run (1 Mile), there is something for everyone!

Why Run The Memorial Day 5K, 5 Mile, 10K & Kids 1 Mile Run?

  • Flat & Fast Course in Hemet, CA 
  • Awesome and well-designed race bibs, shirts & medals
  • 10 minutes from Southern California Wineries
  • Lots of excitement in Old Town and Temecula’s Premier Mall
  • Locally owned & locally produced – Memorial Day 5K, 10K & Kids 1 Mile Race is a homegrown race!

  • Custom finisher’s medal
  • Chip Timing
  • Support stations 
  • Post-race refreshments
  • Finish line expo

 

Race Start Times:

10K: 7:30 AM

5K: 7:45 AM 

Kids 1 Mile: 9:00 AM

name: Midway Shelter Winter Run / Walk ~ 5k, 10k and Kids Run
description:
General Info - December 6th, 2025


Packet Pick up and Race Schedule:

  • December 3rd thru 5th, 2025: 10:00am - 5:00pm Lauren's Closet 1420 Park St / Alameda, Ca. 94501
  • December 6th: 
    • 7:30am ~ raceday registration opens
      8:30am ~ 10k starts
      8:45am ~ 5k starts
      9:45am ~ kids 1/2 mile run starts
      10:00am ~ 5k and 10k awards
       

Event Details: 


Join us for the annual Midway Shelter winter run. Event takes place at the Harbor Bay Ferry Terminal in Alameda on Bay Farm Island and supports a great cause. 


The run will take you along the beautiful shoreline of Bay Farm Island and is a flat out and back with views of San Francisco and the Alameda Main Island. This year we plan to utilize the streets of Harbor Bay Parkway to account for the increase in race attendance. 


The Kids run for 12 and under will be a 1/2 mile course. Kids run will start at 9:45am and will follow a circular loop out and back on the shoreline trail. There is plenty of parking at the Ferry terminal and we will have snacks and drinks when the race is over. 

Midway Shelter provides emergency shelter to homeless women and children and is operated through a partnership with Alameda Homeless Network and Building Futures – learn more about our work by checking out our two websites, below!

Founded in 1989, Midway Shelter of Alameda provides a safe and supportive environment for women and children experiencing  homelessness. By pledging any dollar amount, in addition to your registration, you can support the Midway Shelter provide a safe place for women and their children. Your donation is tax deductible as the Alameda Homeless Network operates as a 501(c)3 Tax ID number 94-3078153)

 

http://midwayshelter.org/donate.htm
www.bfwc.org
 

AC Transit Site: https://www.actransit.org/

Bart Website: https://www.bart.gov/

The Mission Inn Run, a signature Riverside event and key fundraiser for the Mission Inn Foundation, has been a Southern California Tradition for nearly 50 years. This historic race has traditionally launched in downtown Riverside, winding through the parks, landmarks and historic neighborhoods of our town. Proceeds support the nonprofit Mission Inn Foundation and Museum.

Races include the 5K, 10K and ½ Marathon with dedicated 5K Walk (perfect for the kids and pups!) Everyone from competitors to casual strollers are invited to join us!

•      All participants will receive the 2025 limited edition dry-tech T-shirt 
•      All participants will receive 2025 finisher medal 
•      All participants will receive limited edition non-woven reusable tote bag
·      Walk & Wag partnership with Mary S. Roberts Pet Adoption Center w/ pet bandana, pop-up dog park and more
•      All teams of 5 or more receive a $5/discount per member
•      Earn up to $20 off your registration by referring 5 or more friends (codes available after registration)

The Mission Inn Run, a Riverside tradition since 1977, is the primary fundraiser for the Mission Inn Foundation, a 501c3 non-profit museum organization. The Mission Inn Run is the trademarked intellectual property of the Mission Inn Foundation.  There is no affiliation with the Historic Mission Inn Corporation, nor does the Historic Mission Inn Corporation benefit from or support this event.  All funds raised go to the Mission Inn Foundation, a 501c3 non-profit organization.  For more information about the Mission Inn Foundation, please visit www.missioninnmuseum.org

name: Miwok 100K
description:
The Miwok 100K is one of the most beautiful and iconic trail ultramarathons in the world. The course is hilly (11,800 feet of gain) but runnable, with spectacular views of San Francisco and the Golden Gate Bridge, Sausalito, Mount Tamalpais, the ancient redwoods and the Point Reyes National Seashore.

The course features single-track trails and dirt roads with about a mile of paved road. The race is competitive at the front, and a rewarding challenge for all. Less than an hour from San Francisco, the Start/Finish is in the town of beautiful Stinson Beach, nestled against Mount Tamalpais, with its excellent cafés, a small market, lodging, and more.

Course marking is excellent, and you’ll be supported by some of the best volunteers on a race course anywhere. We hire professional medical for all aid stations for those occasional skinned knees and such. Our 2026 runners will receive a custom Miwok 100K finisher’s medal and a Miwok 100K mug.

100K Team Relay is also back for 2026

We have 3 options for you to participate in our event:

1. Miwok 100K on May 2, 2026 (When the race is full, you will be placed on a Waitlist. Your card will not be charged until you are offered a spot, and accept it. Registered runners who drop prior to February 1 will receive a $110 (40%) refund.) 

2. Miwok 100K on May 2, 2025, PLUS an 18 week training plan from coach Race Director Magda Boulet

3. Miwok 100K Team Relay on May 3, 2025 (must have 4 participants per relay)

Please make sure you sign up for the correct event!

name: MJC Turkey Trot 5k Run and Gobbler Walk
description:
****Results can be found at www.paceyourselftiming.com then click on the “Events” tab


***PARK IS ON THE CORNER OF TIOGA DRIVE AND LEIGION PARK

 

WALK-IN REGISTRATIONS ONLY STARTING ON WEDNESDAY 11/26
***RACE DAY REGISTRATION RATES INCREASE ONCE PRE-REGISTRATION CLOSES, SO SIGN UP TODAY!!!

***PLEASE REMEMBER TO BRING IN CASH FOR RACE DAY SIGN UPS. VENMO IS ALSO AVAILABLE

 

Packet Pickup:

  When: Wednesday (11/26) from 2-6pm 
                

  Location: Fleet Feet Modesto - 1427 Standiford Avenue A

  AND/OR

  Race day morning up to 30 minutes before the start of the first kid's race

 

***All Proceeds Benefit MJC's Track and Field and Cross Country Programs

 

Exercise with friends and family before indulging on your Thanksgiving meal!

 

Course: The 3.1 mile course is on a paved path with some grass and dirt. Please no strollers, headphones, or dogs in the 5K run.

The 1/2 mile kids run will be on grass, 1/4 of a mile out and 1/4 of a mile back.

Gobbler Walk: An event for just walkers on the same 5k course. Strollers/dogs are welcomed.

Awards: Given to the top three male/female in the 5k. All kids who participate in the kids run will receive a medal.

Top 3 finishers in 5k fun run in age groups:

0-13, 14-19, 20-29, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, 60-69, 70+

Overall male and female finishers will receive a medal.

There will be no official results for the Gobbler Walk, but a timer will be displayed at the separate Gobbler Walk finish line for your convenience.

Post race refreshments will be available.

T-shirts will be provided and will be guaranteed to the first 500 entrants.

name: MLK Freedom Run 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
Join in our annual Martin Luther King Jr. Day Run! Today, we gather to honor the legacy of Dr. King and his enduring commitment to justice, equality, and peace. As we lace up our shoes and hit the pavement, let’s reflect on his powerful message of love and resilience.

This event is not just about fitness; it’s a celebration of community, a call to action for social change, and a reminder of the work still to be done. Together, we can honor Dr. King’s dream and inspire one another to continue striving for a better world. Let’s run with purpose and passion!

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

name: Modesto Marathon
description:
2026 here we come!

The Grafitti Classic Car theme will be back again with more cars and more entertainment. 

Visit our website for event details.

Our Cause

Proceeds benefit the Teens Run Modesto program, which challenges area youth, especially those at-risk, to experience the benefits of goal-setting, character development, adult mentoring, and improved physical fitness through a structured training program culminating in the running and completion of the Modesto Marathon.

name: Monster Dash 5k - Hosted by PCS MVP Club - Quincy Site
description:
Plumas Charter School Quincy Site is holding its annual Monster Dash 5k on Sunday, October 19th, at Feather River College to raise $10,000 for K-12th grade students and teachers.

The event will include a 5k run, costume contest, music, and refreshments. All currently enrolled PCS students can participate for free. Proceeds will support a wide range of student enrichment opportunities, including educational field trips that bring learning to life, engaging assemblies with inspiring speakers, and vital school resources such as updated technology, classroom supplies, and learning materials.

DAY OF REGISTRATION AVAILABLE AT THE EVENT! CASH, CHECK AND CREDIT CARD WILL BE ACCEPTED.

name: Monterey Bay Half Marathon Course Preview
description:
Fleet Feet Monterey is excited to invite you to our Monterey Bay Half Marathon Course Preview event on Saturday, October 18th, at 8am. You'll get to run up to 10 miles of the breathtaking Monterey Bay Half Marathon Course and become acquainted with major portions of the course, and you'll also have the opportunity to get to meet some of your pacers for the race. This will be an open course meaning the traffic will not be stopped.

For this course preview we will have 1 aid station with NUUN hydration and water. Return to Fleet Feet for some free post-run donuts, pick up your free race prep checklist and race visualization guide, and let experienced Fleet Feet staff help you gear up for your big day.

name: Monterey's Breast Cancer Awareness Run
description:
In the journey to end cancer as we know it, every step makes a difference. On October 11th, Fleet Feet Monterey, is hosting their 4th Annual Breast Cancer Awareness 5K Walk and Run. Lace up those shoes and show up with like-hearted people who care as we take steps together to support cancer research, increase awareness about and access to screening and treatment, and honor the legacies of those who have courageously lived with breast cancer and other estrogen-related cancers. 

The first 50 participants to check in the morning of the event will receive a FREE pair of Jogology socks and a goodie bag from Brooks! You can register at the event, however for the efficiency and flow of the morning we highly recommend registering before hand. 

Join us in making a difference step by step! Our 5K event is completely FREE but we encourage donations to support the Monterey County Breast Cancer Assistance Group. Our goal is to raise $3000, surpassing last year's achievement.

The event kicks off at 8:15 am with doors opening at 7:45am at Fleet Feet Monterey. The 5K will be an untimed community walk and run, promoting solidarity and support. The course will begin and end at Fleet Feet Monterey, taking participants on an out-and-back route.

Let's lace up our sneakers and come together for a great cause!

Schedule:
7:45am - Doors open
8:00am - Event officially begins: Write Who you 
8:20am - 5K begins
9:00am - Post-Run breakfast, giveaways, photo booth

Brooks Bra Demo: 

We are encouraging you to bring a used/old bra to be donated! Brooks is bringing a few of their bras for you to test run in during your run or walk!

name: Moorpark Groundhog Day 5k/1M
description:
Benefiting Moorpark High School’s cross country and track programs, the Groundhog Day event consists of two events. Starting at the high school, the 5k is a fast, chip timed road race with an exciting finish at the beautiful Moorpark High School stadium. All ages and abilities are welcome.  All participants age 11 and under who complete the 5k will received a finisher medal.  There will also be a “Catch the Groundhog” 1 mile fun run for kids 11 and under which will be held on the track with finisher medals for all. Registration fees include a t-shirt for all runners (shirts are only guaranteed if you register by Sunday 1/25/26).

Post-race festivities include the awards ceremony with age group medals plus refreshments, vendors, and a raffle of wonderful prizes donated by local businesses.

name: Moraga Turkey Trot-2025
description:
We have briefly re-opened registration through 11:59pm on NOV 27th. We have had a huge response to the event, so Tees/Schwag are unlikely at this point, but if you would like to register, run, compete for prizes and enjoy the fun, please do so!  Anyone on the course should be registered, bib'd and have signed the waiver. 

--Day-of Registration is Not Available- See Below for day-of bib pickup info--

 

The Moraga Chamber of Commerce welcomes back the Moraga Turkey Trot this year!  Get your stretch pants, headbands and running shoes ready and join all the other turkeys (real and human) for this great start to your Thanksgiving morning! We are excited to TROT OUT this family-friendly event on the cart path at the Moraga Country Club. Roll out of bed and come trot along in your activewear, your PJs, with a pram or in your most festive turkey regalia. (1 Prize for BEST COSTUME!) This year’s race will offer “unofficial” timed 5K and 1.5m races with proceeds benefiting the food bank. Runners, walkers and lollygaggers of all ages are welcome! 

 

Advance sign-up is required. Unfortunately we are not set up for on-site registration. Registrants receive a T-shirt (sizes & tees not guaranteed after 11/17), a numbered running bib and goodies! Look forward to random prize drawings, a race winner gift basket, best costume prize and treats supplied by local businesses! This year's event will have digital timers for self-timing at the start and finish. Come enjoy this wholesome tradition and celebrate Thanksgiving morning as a community! You do not need to be a Chamber or Club member to participate. 

  • 5K - START TIME (8:15a)
  • 1.5m - START TIME (8:30a)

Parking will be limited and traffic laws enforced. Arrange for carpool, drop-offs and walking over, whenever possible. Take Care and remember to be kind to one another!

name: Morgan Hill AAUW Wildflower Run
description:
The AAUW Wildflower Run raises money for scholarships and leadership programs for women & girls and community grants. (For information about our organization, go to www.aauwmh.org.) 10K USATF Certified Run, 5K Run, 5K Walk, and 5K stroller/baby jogger category are all on country roads with chip timing. The Kids' 2K  Run (ages 5-11) and our new, "all inclusive, non-competitive" 2K Fun Run/Walk for everyone for ages 2-102 are both on a school track.  
Country setting surrounding Morgan Hill with flat terrain on paved roads. Flat and fast for runners wanting to improve their personal record times. Water available at start and finish of race, with 1 water stop on the 5K route and 3 water stops on the 10K route. Strollers are welcome everywhere except on the school's track. No pets permitted on school grounds.
NOTE: The event is an "open course", so you will need to stay to the side of the road as some vehicular traffic is expected.
Register early to be guaranteed a unique, 2026 T-shirt in your size.  In addition to your limited edition T-shirt, we offer bonus baby-T's for the stroller event (while supplies last) and themed medals for youth. See wildflowerrun.org for details.
We offer discount pricing options for groups, as follows:
  •  
  • groups of 10 or more (request a $5 off per person “coupon code” for your group in advance of registering; enter the code at checkout).
  • school teams (within boundaries of MHUSD) – if your principal has agreed to sign up your school for the "school competition", your school will have a unique school "coupon code" for $5 off any race for student/family/staff; enter the code at checkout.

name: Morgan Hill Veterans Day  Run
description: The Morgan Hill Freedom Fest is proud to host the Veterans Day 5k & 10k and 1 mile children's Run to honor the men and women who have served or are currently serving in the armed forces of the United States.  You will have the opportunity to walk and run with these honorable men and women during the race and express your appreciation for their service as you finish the course with them. We encourage participants to take a moment and say, “Thank you for what you’ve done!” Small gestures mean a lot to those who have sacrificed so much. All proceeds from the  race will go to the Veteran organizations listed on our Partners page.  We hope to see you there!

We encourage participants to take a moment and say, “Thank you for what you’ve done!” Small gestures mean a lot to those who have sacrificed so much. All proceeds from the  race will go to the Veteran organizations listed on our Partners page.  We hope to see you there!

name: Motherlode Monster Dash 5k
description:
Lace up your sneakers… if you dare!

The Mother Lode is about to get a frightfully fast new tradition!


Mark your calendars for Saturday, October 25th at 8:00 AM and join us for the inaugural Mother Lode Monster Dash 5K & Costume Contest, starting and finishing at the historic Jackson Catholic Cemetery—the perfect place to rise and run!

This 5K run/walk welcomes all creatures—whether you’re lightning-fast like a vampire bat, steady as a shambling zombie, or somewhere in between. Along the way, you’ll soak in the golden autumn beauty of the Mother Lode before crossing the finish line for our ghoulishly great post-race party at 9:00 AM.

Park at the Jackson Catholic Cemetery on Cemetery Ln. in Downtown Jackson, and start and finish the race alongside the spirits of the dead.

🎃 Awards & Costume Contest – Prizes for overall speed demons, age-group champions, and the most spook-tacular costumes. First-place finishers will receive a homemade pumpkin pie made by Argonaut culinary students!

All participants will receive a custom T-shirt, designed by an Argonaut art student.


👟 Bib Pick-Up – Race-day check-in begins at 7:00 AM right at the starting line.  


🦇 All abilities welcome—run, walk, or zombie-shuffle your way to the finish!

Don’t ghost us—register now before it’s too late! 

Run for a Cause – 100% of proceeds support the Argonaut Cross Country program.

name: Mountains 2 Beach Marathon and Half
description: Uniquely situated and completely surrounded by beautiful mountains, the city of Ojai holds the start of the Mountains 2 Beach Marathon while the half starts closer to the beach. This point to point race winds through the Ventura River Valley as it makes its way to the pristine beaches of the last great surf town in California, Ventura. Runners will love the gradual downhill nature of the race, which is prime to make you faster but not hurt the knees, and the amazing weather of the area. After a final tour of beach front Ventura, runners and their families are treated to a finish line party only steps away from the surf and the shops and restaurants of Historic Downtown Ventura. As a certified Boston Qualifier, the courses, the race and the surrounding communities make for the perfect destination marathon and half.

name: Move4U 5K Run/Walk for Parkinson's, Dystonia, & Movement Disorders
description:
The Parkinson's and Movement Disorder Foundation (PMDF) and the National Spasmodic Torticollis Association are hosting the MOVE4U 5K Walk/Run Fundraiser at Mile Square Park in Fountain Valley, California. The proceeds will empower the PMDF and the NSTA to significantly further their mission of advancing crucial research into the causes, treatments, and cures of Parkinson's disease and other movement disorders like dystonia. Your support will improve the lives of patients and also play a vital role in raising awareness.

REGISTRATION INCLUDES

– Free hat provided for attendees

– Raffle Prizes

– Sandwiches and Cookies from Katella Deli in Los Alamitos

– Water

 

5K Run Top Three Prizes

1st place prize $300

2nd place prize $ $200

3rd place prize $100

name: MPSF Open Water Championships - Masters/Open 5 Kilometer and 1 Kilometer Open Water Swim
description:
The 3rd MPSF Open Water Swimming Championships will be contested Saturday, October 18, 2025 at Marine Stadium in Long Beach, Calif.  Be a part of the third intercollegiate conference championship in open water swimming.  

The MPSF Championships in OWS could potentially lead to an NCAA Championship in the sport.  Open water swimming has been in the Olympics since 2008.  Alumni from institutions eligible for MPSF membership in OWS have participated in every one of these Olympic competitions and have medaled in both the men’s and women’s events.  The Marine Stadium will host Rowing and Canoeing during the 2028 Olympic Games.  Long Beach will also host the Open Water Swimming and eight other sports events for the 2028 Olympic Games.  

The Open 5 Kilometer and 1 Kilometer Open Water Swim participants are encouraged to affiliate with the MPSF member institution that they swam collegiately for, currently attend or graduated from.  Don't forget to wear your team colors.

Additional race information can be found athttps://mpsports.org/tournaments/?id=49

name: MVRRC 12th Annual Jingle Bell 5k Run & kids 1 mile race
description:
Moreno Valley Road Runners Club will be celebrating our 12th annual Jingle Bell fun run at Lake Perris State Recreation Area, Dam 17801 Lake Perris Drive, Perris, CA 92571. On December 13, 2025, at 7:30 am.

What: Don’t miss Southern California’s best Jingle Bell tradition! Run/walk a 5K before you open gifts. There will be a 1-mile kids' race (ages 12 and under). Everyone is welcome!

Where: Enjoy a historic course along the Dam, referred to as The Lake Perris Dam. You’ll pass by such a notable lake. What a great way to see the beautiful lake in the morning.

Course: The race starts and finishes at the Dam Area. This is a flat, long course with no traffic.

When: December 13, 2025, at 7:30 am. Packet pick up on race day only.

Race Start Times: The kids’ 1-mile race starts at 8:15 AM, and the 5K starts at 8:30 AM.

Awards: Top 3 boys and girls in the 1-mile race, Top 3 open Males and Females in the 5K.

Prizes: Medals will be given to all participants. The first 50 sign-ups will receive a t-shirt.

Fees: The kids' one-mile race is $5.00, the 5-K race is $20.00. All payments are the same on race day. We take cash, Venmo, the Cash app, and Zelle on race day. The entrance to the park will be $10.00.

For more information, don't hesitate to get in touch with Race Director Henry at mvrrc@hotmail.com or via text at 951-396-5896

MVRRC would like all participants to donate any open gifts for the children in need for Christmas. Thank you.

Instructions on how to get to the Jingle Bell Race at Lake Perris, from the Perris side, after you pass security, you want to make a right on Alta Calle, the first entrance before lot number one. From the Moreno Valley side, you want to drive till you pass Lot Number One. Once you pass the lot, you want to make a left on Alta Calle before the exit on the Perris side.

name: Nail the Rail Half Marathon, 10K & 5K
description:
Join us for a stroll along the Sacramento Rail Trail.  A converted Southern Pacific Railroad track that starts at the base of Shasta Dam and runs for over 11 miles.

Enjoy a the view along the Sacramento River/Keswick Lake in the cool of the morning.  Trail is very flat and fast.

Field is limited to 350.

Races include a half marathon, 10K and 5K.

Finisher awards to Half marathoners.  Awards 3 deep in age groups, plus overall awards.

Start/Finish will be from the Chappie OHV area at the base of Shasta Dam.  Once you cross Shasta Dam you will follow the road down to the OHV area.

Race day registration and packet pickup opens at 7am at OHV area.

Packet pickup and registration on Friday the 25th from 11am to 3pm at Redding Fleet Feet Store at 1376 Hilltop Dr.

Start times:

Half Marathon - 8am

5K & 10K - 8:15am

Cutoff time of 3hrs 30 minutes for half-marathon.

name: Napa Valley Turkey Chase
description:
Welcome to the Turkey Chase, Napa's only Thanksgiving Day 5K/10K! 

The Napa Valley Turkey Chase is a fun family event! Race, jog or walk this fast, paved course around the Napa Valley College and the Napa River Trail and work up your Thanksgiving appetite!

The start & finish line are located in lot J behind the Napa Valley College track. Lot J will also be the staging area for packet pick-up, day of race registration, booths and toilets. There is NO PARKING in lot J .

PLEASE NOTE: THERE ARE COURSE CHANGES THIS YEAR!

The 10K course runs a counterclockwise loop through the college and then meets the Napa River Trail. Runners will go north to a turn around under the Imola bridge near mile 2. Then they will run south to Kennedy Park where the course makes a small counterclockwise loop near the skate park and then retraces the route back up the river trail. The 10K course then meets back up with the 5K by the baseball field and finishes back in lot J.

The 5K course runs the same counterclockwise loop through the college and then connects to the Napa River Trail. Runners will immediately proceed south past mile 2 and turn at the baseball field to head to the finish back in lot J. Both courses have been measured by wheel and GPS, but it is not a USATF certified course.

name: Nelson Family Vineyards Wine Run 5k
description:
Like Running or Walking?  Love Wine?  This race is for you! 

Join us on Saturday, April 18, 2026 at 11:00am for a super fun annual event that features the amazing hospitality and scenery of Nelson Family Vineyards! For 70 years the Nelson family has farmed the land they live on, with the traditions of farming passed on to four generations. Through many seasons of tending and harvest, Nelson Family Vineyards has embraced the truth that great wines are born in the vineyard. So, whether you are looking to run, walk or just enjoy the wine this race is a sure thing for a great time and an incredible experience! This race is timed and scored by J3 Timing.  Results will be posted at www.J3Timing.com. 

Registration Includes:

  • T-shirt:  Super Soft Ring Spun Cotton t-shirt included! 
  • Wine Glass: Shatterproof, Collapsible, and Portable!
  • Finisher Medal: Doubles as a Wine Stopper!
  • Race Bib: Chip timed 5k run/walk
  • Results Posted Online
  • ...and of course, a pour of wine!

name: New Year New Me Run 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
🎉 Start Your Year on the Right Foot! 🏃‍♀️🏃‍♂️
Join the New Year New Me Run - New Beginnings Starts Today!

Kick off the new year with energy, excitement, and a community of runners ready to chase their goals. Whether you're a seasoned racer or just starting out, this run is for YOU!

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

name: New Year's Day Dash – 5K, 10K, 10-Miler, Half Marathon
description:
Start your year on the right foot with the New Year’s Day Dash on January 1, 2026 in Long Beach. Whether you’re starting a new training goal, kicking off a resolution, or just looking for a fun way to welcome the year, this race is the perfect blend of fresh energy and festive spirit. Enjoy a beautiful course along the shoreline, the camaraderie of fellow runners, and the satisfaction of logging your first miles of 2026 before most people have finished their coffee. Make this your tradition and dash into the new year with us

Race Details

Start Location: 5400 E Ocean Ave, Long Beach, CA 90803
Parking: Parking in the lot is $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free.

Event Schedule

Wednesday
3:00-5:00pm – Early bib pick-up on the 2nd floor at Sports Basement Long Beach (store discount sent via email the week of the event)
2100 N Bellflower Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90815

Thursday
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens
7:00am – Half marathon & 10m start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10m)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Courses
5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route
10m: The 5m route is used for the 10m (two laps) – 5m route
Half: The 5m route is run twice and the 5k route is run once for the Half – 5m route and 5k route

More about the Course
The beach path is an open course, so you will encounter others using it. When we start the race, please stay on the right side of the beach path. The right side is for pedestrians and the left side is for cyclists.

On-Course Support
A fully stocked water station is located at the Belmont Pier. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, gatorade, gels, and fruit snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk, a runner turn sign, and a flag

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Awards: 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.
Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and earlier on Instagram. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, Santa Monica, and Fountain Valley. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule.

Have Another Question? Check our FAQ page, it's probably answered there!

Thursday
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens

name: New Year's Run 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
🎉 Start Your Year on the Right Foot! 🏃‍♀️🏃‍♂️
Join the New Year's Run - New Beginnings Starts Today!

Kick off the new year with energy, excitement, and a community of runners ready to chase their goals. Whether you're a seasoned racer or just starting out, this run is for YOU!

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

Join the New Year's Run - New Beginnings Starts Today!

Kick off the new year with energy, excitement, and a community of runners ready to chase their goals. Whether you're a seasoned racer or just starting out, this run is for YOU!

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

name: Night of the Living Runners – 5K, 10K, 10-Miler, Half Marathon
description:
Race Details

Start Location: 5400 E Ocean Ave, Long Beach, CA 90803 – Google Maps
Parking: Parking in the lot is $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free. See map at the bottom of this email.

Event Schedule

Friday, October 10th
4:00-6:00pm – Early bib pick-up on the 2nd floor at Sports Basement Long Beach (store discount sent via email the week of the event & pos event)
2100 N Bellflower Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90815

Saturday, October 11th
6:20am – Late bib pick-up opens at the tables closest to Claremont Ave
7:00am – Half marathon & 10m start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10m)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for 10m and half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Courses

5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route
10m: The 5m route is used for the 10m (two laps) – 5m route
Half: The 5m route is run twice and the 5k route is run once for the Half – 5m route & 5k route

More about the Course:
The beach path is an open course, so you will encounter others using it. When we start the race, please stay on the right side of the beach path. The right side is for pedestrians and the left side is for cyclists.

We will have tent set up west of the Finish Line for spectators to watch you run. See map at the bottom of this email. We do not have shade or seating in the festival area for them.

On-Course Support:
A fully stocked water station is located at the Belmont Pier. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, gatorade, gels, and fruit snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk, a runner turn sign, and a flag

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Awards: 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.
Results: A link for race results and photos will be sent within 24 hours of the event. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, the San Fernando Valley, Orange County and San Diego. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule.

Have Another Question?
Check our FAQ page, it's probably answered there!

name: No Foolin' Foot Race
description:
Explore San Carlos' outstanding trail system as a runner in the fourth annual No Foolin' Foot Race! There's something for everyone with four challenging events through Big Canyon, Eaton and Pulgas Ridge. 

  • 1K (~350ft of climbing) - Perfect for adventurous kids age 5-10

  • 5k (~530ft of climbing)

  • 10k (~1,500ft of climbing)

  • Long Course NEW this year! (15-18K with ~2,500ft of climbing)

Registration opens September 27, 2025. Early bird pricing available through March 18, 2026.

Consider yourself warned: This race is no joke! Our courses are technical, grueling and loads of fun. To that end, we will be hosting training runs in early March. Join our Strava Club for updates.

Start and Finish Festival at Crestview Park. Professional timing; Tech-Ts and free runner photos for all participants; Awards in multiple categories. 

All proceeds benefit maintenance and improvement of San Carlos open space trails. 

Brought to you by the Parks and Recreation Foundation of San Carlos and the City of San Carlos with support from A Runner's Mind.

name: North Kern Cancer Run/Walk and Festival
description:
SIGN UP FOR EARLY REGISTRATION!

Gather your friends, family and coworkers and join us for the 2025 North Kern Cancer Run/Walk and Festival at - Delano Heritage Park Museum 330 S. Lexington St., Delano, CA 93215!

This exciting challenge allows you to raise funds and awareness for those battling cancer all while having fun!  

100% of the funds will benefit the Kern County Cancer Foundation to assist local patients with medical bills related to cancer treatment as well as assist children with cancer who must travel for treatment.  For more information on our programs and services. visit us at www.kerncountycancerfoundation.org

This is our 2nd Annual NORTH KERN CANCER RUN/WALK and FESTIVAL Event and we can't do it without you!

It will be held Saturday, October 11th from 8am - 12pm at Delano Heritage Park Museum 330 S. Lexington St., Delano, CA. 93215
Early registration is $10, then the cost goes up to $20 September 1, 2025.
Children registration is $10 ages 3-11.
North Kern Cancer Run/Walk T-Shirts can be purchased for $20 with a deadline of 09/26/2025.
Survivors are FREE and there will be a special designated area for them. (Even if you're on treatment, you're a SURVIVOR)
This race will be timed for all registered runners and awards will be given.  Top fundraising teams and individuals will also receive awards.

We are trying to raise as much funds as possible for Kern County cancer patients who need financial assistance and transportation during treatment.  

Some T-shirts will be available for sale at the event.  Donations are always welcome.

description:
It’s Back — The Annual Northgate Market 5K!
We’re thrilled to welcome you to this beloved community tradition, benefiting the Familia González Reynoso Foundation. This incredible organization supports higher education, human services, schools, orphanages, scholarships, and grants that change lives.

Come join the fun at Angel Stadium, where you’ll get the unforgettable chance to run on the field and see yourself on the Jumbo-Tron — all while enjoying a vibrant Día de los Muertos theme.

Every race entry includes:

  • Commemorative race shirt
  • Finisher medal
  • Finish line photos & video
  • Access to the post-race expo

Come run, celebrate, and make a difference — together, we can support those in need while creating memories that last a lifetime!

Register before September 30th (at 12:00am) to guarantee your race-shirt size!

name: NURSES ROCK Run/Walk
description:
Will you run and be their heroes by joining the Nurses Rock Run-Walk 5K-10k & BONNIE CHALLENGE?

We have all learned how incredibly valuable our nurses are to our health care system.  Help us give back to those aspiring nurses through supporting the Bonnie Fang Foundation in our search to support those to keep us alive.  In 2026 we will be offering the live experience and a virtual run to provide the perfect opportunity and flexibility to participate safely while interacting with our nursing and running community live & online to support a great cause.  

Sign up TODAY and join us as we culminate your work on running and our audience of future nurses.  

Whether you run or walk, by yourself or with friends, you will make a HUGE IMPACT for our nurses and the future of the nursing profession!

As we continue with our planning, your support or donation of any kind is always appreciated in that it will go towards helping more amazing nursing students while bringing awareness to the nursing shortage that impacts each and every one of us. 

They are our heroes and you are theirs.  Register NOW and let's get moving!

*START GETTING YOUR GROUPS TOGETHER! AWARDS FOR OUR TOP 3 LARGEST GROUPS!

Directions to Frank G. Bonelli Park
120 Via Verde, San Dimas, CA 91773

Bonelli Park is located on the Northeast corner of the 10 and 57 Freeways in San Dimas, CA.

From San Diego, 5 north to 57 north, cross over the 10 freeway and exit Via Verde Dr.
From Redondo Beach, etc. 10 East to 57 North and Exit Via Verde
From Pasadena-210 to 57 and exit Via Verde
From the East-10 to 57 North and exit Via Verde

Take the Via Verde Dr. Exit off of the 57 Freeway. Head East, down into the park. After entering through the gate, take the second left into the parking lot, additional parking is further east on Via Verde.

*Please note that there is a separate parking fee of $12 for Bonelli Regional Park

name: Oakland Tech 5km Fundraiser Race and 1 Mile Fun Run/Walk
description:
Support Oakland Tech Students and Programs
Join us for a 5K trail race or 1-mile fun run/walk in beautiful Joaquin Miller Park on November 2, 2025 (end of Daylight savings time.) The course winds through towering redwoods and offers both a scenic stroll for casual participants and a challenging route for competitive runners.

This event is a fundraiser for the Oakland Tech PTSA, which provides invaluable funding for student programs and activities. Every dollar makes a difference for our students. The PTSA supports the Oakland Tech Cross Country team by covering costs for meet entry fees, training equipment, nutrition, and travel — all essential for helping our runners perform at their best.

Oakland Tech Cross Country athletes have a proud tradition of success, with both varsity cross country teams winning the Oakland Championship for the past three years. Your participation helps continue this tradition of excellence.

Sign up for the race or make a tax-deductible donation to show your support for Oakland Tech students.

Bib pick-up: Saturday, November 1nd, 2pm-4pm @ Transports or Sunday, November 2rd, 8:30am @Joaquin Miller Meadow

Date: November 2rd, 2024

  • 1 mile Fun Run/Walk Race Start: 9:00 am
  • 5 km Trail Race Start: 9:30 am

Can't run but want to support us? Donations are tax-deductible. Tax ID: 94-6174624
