name: Oh The Places You'll Run – 5K, 10K, 10-Miler, Half Marathon
description:
Congratulations, today is your day, you're off to grab miles, you're off and away! This weekend we run in honor of Read Across America Day!

Race Details

Start Location: Alamitos Beach, 780 E Shoreline Dr. Long Beach, CA
Parking: Parking in the lot is $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free.

Event Schedule

Friday
4:00-6:00pm – Early bib pick-up on the 2nd floor at Sports Basement Long Beach (store discount sent via email the week of the event)
2100 N Bellflower Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90815

Saturday
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens 
7:00am – Half marathon & 10m start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10m)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Courses

5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route
10m: The 5m route is used for the 10m (two laps) – 5m route
Half: The 5m route is run twice and the 5k route is run once for the Half – 5m route and 5k route

More about the Course

The beach path is an open course, so you will encounter others using it. When we start the race, please stay on the right side of the beach path. The right side is for pedestrians and the left side is for cyclists.

On-Course Support: A fully stocked water station is located at the Belmont Pier. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, gatorade, gels, and fruit snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk, a runner turn sign, and a flag

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Awards: 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.
Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and earlier on Instagram. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, the San Fernando Valley, Orange County, and San Diego. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule.

Have Another Question? Check our FAQ page, it's probably answered there!

name: Ojai Family Fund Turkey Trot 2025
description:
3 Mile Fun Run Turkey Trot raising funds to support the Ojai Family Fund which works to create equity in education through funding assistance for OUSD low income families.  Run to compete or run for fun!  Costumes welcome

$25 per entrant or $50 per family. For a family, please enter the person registering as entrant one (for example, Jane Doe) for the second entrant you can enter "Family" as the first name (for example, Family Doe).  PLEASE NOTE: only 2 timing bibs are registered for each family group.  If you wish to have more than two members receive accurate timed races, please email us after registering at ojaifamilyfund@gmail.com

name: On Track Running Turkey Trot
description:
Join On Track Running, Simi Valley’s neighborhood running store, for our first annual Turkey Trot 5k race!

Celebrate Thanksgiving with a flat and fast, chip-timed 5K race!

📍 Thursday, November 27th, 2025
📍 8:00 AM start at 4590 Ish Drive, Simi Valley

All runners are welcome, whether you're chasing a PR or just running for the fun!

🎽 The first 200 registered participants will receive a free race shirt and medal.
🏅 Age group awards for top finishers.

Packet Pickup & Registration:
• Wednesday, November 26th from 1-5 PM at On Track Running
• Race day registration available from 6:30–7:15 AM on site

Bring your friends and family. We’re making it a morning of community, movement, and lighthearted fun!

Course: We’ll start at the store, loop around the building, then head down Ish and turn left to join the bike path alongside the wash. The course is an out-and-back on the wash, with a few harder turns at the water station and at the turnaround point, before heading back down the street and around the building to finish.

Follow us on Instagram @OTRunning and join us on Strava to connect with our crew.
We can’t wait to see you there!

name: Operation Megaphone
description: Operation Megaphone, also known as "OMP", is an annual worldwide event designed to connect military teens from around the world to discuss key issues that affect military teens, promote communication across all military services, and provide opportunities for teens to give back to their communities. Teen led and adult supported, OMP is a great opportunity for your teens! A fun filled night of games, activities, movies, sports, dinner and more!

name: Orange County Superhero 5K Run Walk Health & Safety Expo
description:
This event is a fun-family event with a 5K Run/Walk, Health & Safety Expo, Food & Entertainment, and fund-raising opportunity to help support programs and direct services at the Crime Survivors Resource Center. Awareness. Prevention. Advocacy. Healing. 

Awards

Top Male/Female in the following age group. 12-UNDER, 13-19, 20-29, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, and 60+              

Contact: info@superherorunwalk.org | (844) 853-HOPE | (949) 872-7895 | www.superherorunwalk.org

Photos from previous years event: Click Here

WHAT IS A VIRTUAL RACE REGISTRATION? A virtual race is a race that can be run (or walked) from any location you choose. You can run, jog, or walk on the road, on the trail, on the treadmill, at the gym or on the track (or even at another race). You get to run your own race, at your own pace, and time it yourself. Run on your own, or with friends! Your race bib, shirt and medal will be shipped directly to you. And your registration fee and fundraising efforts will go directly to help support victims of crime through our survivors hope fund. Register Today!

Event Fee

$40.00 Pre Registration | $50.00 Day of Registration -- Includes Shirt, Medal, Goody Bag to First 500 Pre Registered, Food ,Drinks, and Entertainment  

Race Schedule

7 am - 11 am: Health & Safety Expo
7:00 am - Registration Opens
8:15 am - Warm Up
8:30 am - Special Guest Presentations
8:45 am - Survivors Dove Release
9:00 am - 5k Run/Walk Starts ( You can run, walk or jog).

Vendor Form

Submit Vendor Form Online - Click Here to Submit 2026 Form

Other Event:

Los Angeles Superhero 5K Run/Walk - Sign Up Here

NO REFUNDS — RAIN OR SHINE
(all registrations are donations to support crime survivors)

name: Palisades Will Rogers 5K Run
description:
For 47 years, the Palisades Will Rogers 5 & 10K Run and Kids’ Fun Run has been a centerpiece of the Palisades’ 4th of July celebration.   The Palisades Will Rogers 5&10K Run Foundation and it’s Presenting Sponsor, Providence Saint John’s Health Center, is doing everything they can to support the recovery effort in the aftermath of the unprecedented fire.   Although the fire destruction and residues have made it unfeasible to hold the event at our traditional location, we are holding a 5K Run and Kids’ Fun Run at Venice Beach this year.  We look forward to neighbors and friends joining us to celebrate all that makes the Palisades such a special community, and enjoy a healthful start to the 4th of July in a safe environment.

Race proceeds this year will go toward rebuilding the Pacific Palisades Park & Community Center, as the Palisades centerpiece for neighbors of all ages to gather and recreate together.  The Palisades Will Rogers 5&10K Run Foundation is also accepting direct donations toward that effort.  Donations may be made through the Foundation’s website at RunSignUp.com, or by mail to Palisades Will Rogers 5&10K Run Foundation, P.O. Box 601, Pacific Palisades, CA 90272.

Sign up now…See you on the 4th of July!

Race Committee

name: Palm Springs Health Run & Wellness Expo
description:
The Palm Springs Health Run & Wellness Festival has now become one of the largest events of its kind in Southern California and follows a spectacularly beautiful path in and around Ruth Hardy Park with picture perfect views of the San Jacinto Mountain Range. Hot, hip and fun is how describe the desert oasis of Palm Springs.

This USA Track and Field certified 10K and 5K event has caught the attention of serious runners and nationally recognized health and wellness speakers.

The Expo has grown substantially since its inception and now has over 100 vendors showcasing the latest in nutrition and exercise techniques, KESQ News Channel 3 Food Challenge, LifeStream Blood Bank Drive, rock climbing wall, walk on water and Aerial performers.

Not only is the event a way for health conscious individuals and families to come together, but it has now become a major fundraiser.

description:

name: Palm Springs Tram Road Challenge
description: Take on the Challenge! At the Palm Springs Tram Road Challenge, you'll climb almost 2,000 feet from the desert to the mountains in just 3.7 miles! You'll start at the intersection of Tram Way and Highway 111, with stunning views of the San Jacinto Mountains in front of you and the Coachella Valley behind. Choose to run your way up or take it easy for a nice uphill walk. No matter how you get there, when you reach the finish line, you'll enjoy a post-race festival with food, drink, booths, entertainment and awards for the winners. All participants receive a stylish finisher medal, cool race t-shirt, tasty post-race food and drink, and a bus ride back down the hill!! Awards for the top three in each age group will be given out to those registered in the Awards Eligible category, but everyone will be professionally timed! Sign up today and get ready to take on the challenge of a lifetime!

name: Paseo de Mariposa Trail Race
description:
Paseo de Mariposa Trail Race
 

April 19, 2026 – Mariposa, California

 

A Note from the Race Director
 

Hello everyone! My name is Nate Moore, and I’m excited to share that I’ll be directing the 2026 Paseo de Mariposa Trail Race through my company, San Joaquin Running Co.
We love supporting local community events, especially those that celebrate trail running and the unique beauty of our region. Our goal is to carry forward the traditions that make this race special, while adding the same energy and care we bring to our other events.
Through San Joaquin Running, I help organize a variety of races across the Central Valley and Sierra foothills, including the Shadow of the Giants 50K, Pincushion Hill Climb, McKenzie Preserve Half Marathon, Sycamore Island 5K/10K, and others. Each event is built on the same foundation: creating tough, fun, and memorable experiences for runners of all ages and abilities.
I’m truly honored to help guide the Paseo de Mariposa into its next chapter. Together, we’ll keep this race a family-friendly tradition that highlights the heart of Mariposa and the adventure of trail running.

 

About the Event
 

Nestled in the Sierra Nevada foothills, just outside Yosemite National Park, Mariposa is rich in history and natural beauty — the perfect setting for outdoor adventure. On Sunday, April 19, 2026, join us for the seventh annual Paseo de Mariposa Trail Run, featuring 5K and 12K courses that begin at the historic Mariposa Courthouse (built in 1851, the oldest courthouse west of the Rockies still in use).
This family-friendly community event celebrates health, wellness, and active lifestyles. In support of our mission to engage youth in outdoor activity, all children under 18 can participate in any race for free.

 

Race Distances
 

5K – Family-Friendly & Beginner-Friendly

Shortest and most accessible option.
Starts at the courthouse, with sections on paved roads, a short climb past the high school, and a dirt fire road turnaround.
Perfect for families, walkers, and those new to trail running.
 
 

12K – The Big Adventure

Longest and most challenging route.
Features steep descents, a creek crossing, and a tough single-track climb to Slaughterhouse Road and the Flume Trail.
Stunning views along rugged single-track with significant elevation gain.
No strollers permitted; youth under 13 must be accompanied by an adult.
 

Safety & Support
 

Aid stations will be positioned across all distances.
Mariposa County Search and Rescue will be on site for runner safety.
Trails include technical terrain — rocks, roots, and climbs — so please run or hike your route ahead of time if possible. Bringing a buddy is always recommended.
For everyone’s safety: no dogs are permitted on any route.
 

Why Join?
 

The Paseo de Mariposa is more than a race — it’s a celebration of community, family, and the outdoors. Whether you’re chasing a personal best, enjoying a scenic hike with friends, or introducing your kids to trail running, this event is designed for all ages and abilities.

 

✨ Mark your calendars for April 19, 2026!

We can’t wait to see you in Mariposa for an unforgettable day on the trails.

name: Patagonia Salmon Run 5K
description:
Patagonia is excited to announce the 29th Annual Salmon Run, to be held November 16, 2025.

This year marks the 29th Annual running of the salmon and we are going to make it better than ever. As a reminder, this race always sells out, so make sure you get your registration in.

This year's race beneficiary will be South Coast Habitat Restoration, a local non-profit organization based in Carpinteria that is dedicated to environmental stewardship and habitat enhancement. South Coast Habitat Restoration is actively supporting fish restoration for steelhead trout and locally is working on a fish passage project in the Ventura River watershed at the Wheeler Gorge campground removing four migration barriers and installing two bridges. 

Additionally, we want the Salmon Run to be a Zero-Waste-Event to mitigate sending anything to the waste stream that doesn't have to. We will send out details on how to prepare for this closer to the day of the race, but plan to bring your own water bottle and coffee mug.

We will have Salmon Run Miir cups available for purchase onsite!

 

Please note: 

For race participants, the Patagonia Store located at:

235 W. Santa Clara St

Ventura, CA 93001 

Is excited to offer a 25% off discount if racers bring their bib into the store.  This is a onetime use offer on full priced Patagonia items only and valid from 11/16/2025 through 11/22/2025.

name: Pie Pursuit
description:
Pie Pursuit 5K — Run for a Cause, Stay for the Fun
Join the 746 Sports Foundation for our inaugural Pie Pursuit 5K, a community-centered fun run with a festive twist! Participants are encouraged to dress in their favorite costumes — from turkeys to pilgrims — and take part in a lighthearted 5K that features family-friendly pie-toss zones along the course.

This unique event is more than just fun and games — it's a fundraiser with purpose. All proceeds directly support local youth through scholarships, free sports events, and community programs organized by the 746 Sports Foundation.

 

Participants will enjoy:

  • Official timed results for those wanting to track their pace

  • Custom Pie Pursuit race shirts and finisher medals

  • Prizes awarded for best costumes, fastest finishers, and most pie-covered runners


Whether you run, walk, or get covered in whipped cream, your participation helps empower the next generation right here in Shafter.

 

Because every pie thrown is a step toward stronger community roots.

name: Pincushion Hill Climb
description:
1 mile. Straight up. This will be a chip timed hill climb starting at the San Joaquin River Trailhead in the South Finegold picnic area (Millerton Lk SRA; end of Sky Harbor Rd) and finishing at the top of Pincushion Mountain. There will be a special prize for the Top 3 Male and Female finishers, age groups winners will receive awards as well as Clydesdale/Athena division winners. All runners will receive a custom finisher award and event shirt. 

Pincushion Hill Climb: Mountain Goat Edition! The Mountain Goat race is for those who like to go the extra mile or miles. Your first run up will be timed and scored for the regular event then you have until 12pm (4hrs total) to complete as many trips up to Pincushion Peak as possible. Your first trip down you must take the long way (just over 1.5 miles) after that you may descend the same route you take to the top. You must complete at least 2 trips to the top in order to be considered a Mountain Goat. You will receive a special finishers award and the top Male & Female runners will receive an additional award.

name: Pink and Purple Golf Tournament
description:
Swing in honor of breast cancer or domestic violence victims at our 18 Hole Tournament– Scramble Rules apply! Dress in pink and purple golf attire. Event registration includes a buffet lunch at the Golf Clubhouse and prize opportunities.

Lunch buffet will be fried chicken with mashed potatoes, veggies, rolls and a fountain drink. 

Prizes for longest drive, closest to the pin, overall winning team, and opportunity drawings at lunch time. 

Pre-arranged foursomes encouraged, however open to all singles, doubles, etc (will be paired up with others to create a foursome). Towards the end of registration, you will be asked for your team name. Please make sure all players input same team name to be paired up together.

description:

name: Pleasanton Rotary Halloween Spirit Run
description:
Join us on Sunday, October 26 for this year's event! 

Registration opens: July 23. From July 23 to August 1st, all race entries are discounted as part of our registration launch! Sign up during this timeframe for the lowest prices of the year. 

Start and finish in Downtown Pleasanton on Main Street. Wear a costume if you would like! 

5K/10K starts at 8:30 a.m.  5K and 10K events are timed; awards will be presented to overall winners as well as to top finishers in each age group. Kids Challenge (new 1/4 mile distance, plus a 100 yard dash) starts at 10:00 am. Kids ages 12 and under are welcome to participate. 

DryBlend short sleeved t-sleeve shirts for 5K-10K participants with option to upgrade to a long sleeve technical shirt for $7.00. Kids Challenge entry includes a short sleeve DryBlend t-shirt. Participants may opt out of t-shirt if they wish. 

To celebrate our 32nd running of this event, finisher medals will be awarded to all 5K, 10K, and Kid's Race participants.

Proceeds

Proceeds support scholarships for Pleasanton students and community & international projects of The Rotary Club of Pleasanton.

Leashed Dogs

Well-behaved dogs are permitted in the 5K or 10K; all dogs must start in the back of the pack at the starting line, be on a non-retractable leash, and be cleaned up after by their human. Dogs attending the event should be comfortable in crowds as well as around other dogs. 

Strollers

Strollers are allowed in both the 5K and 10K; we ask that you start towards the back. 

Packet Pick Up

Pre-race Packet Pick Up will be held  on Saturday, October 25, 2025 - at Fleet Feet Pleasanton (234 Main Street) from 10:30 am to 2:30 pm.   Participants may also pick up their bib and tshirt on race morning (10/26) near the start/finish line starting at 7 am and continuing through 8:15 am (through 9:45 am for Kids Challenge entrants).

Photo ID is not required to pick up packets and you may pick up for friends or family. 

In-Person Registration

Participants may register in-person at Packet Pick Up (Saturday, October 25, time and place TBA) or on race morning (Sunday, October 26, 7:00 am to 8:20 am at the start/finish area adjacent to Workbench Hardware - 652 Main Street, Pleasanton). Those registering in-person may present payment in the forms of debit/credit card or cash. Personal checks are not accepted.

Awards & Age Groups

Custom medals will be presented to the top three male and female finishers in the 5K and 10K in each age group. Overall winners will also receive a prize. Age groups are: 10K / 13 and Under, 14-18 yrs., 19-29, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, 60-69, 70+. 5K age groups are: 9 and under, 10-13 yrs., 14-18, 19-29, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, 60-69, 70-79, 80+.

Race Results

name: Plymouth Rock n Run
description:
Get ready to lace up your running shoes and join the fun at the most exciting event in Anaheim, CA!

It's all happening on Thanksgiving Day, at  La Palma Ave, right in the heart of beautiful Yorba Regional Park. We've got a fantastic day of activities and races planned for you, so let's dive into all the exhilarating details:

Event Highlights:

🏃‍♂️ USATF-Certified Courses: We've got both 5k and 10k courses that'll take you on a thrilling journey along La Palma Ave and the enchanting Santa Ana River Trail, all while you soak in the natural beauty of Yorba Regional Park.

⏱️ Chip Timing: For those competitive spirits, we've got chip timing for the 5k and 10k run/walk events. Race against the clock and challenge yourself to a new personal best!

👦👧 Kids' Fun Run: Calling all young runners! We've got a Kids 1k fun run for those aged 10 and under, and even a 100-yard tot trot for the little ones aged 4 and under. It's a blast for the whole family!

name: Polar Bear Run 5K, 10K, and Half Marathon
description:
Are you ready to embrace winter in all its glory? The Polar Bear Run is calling all runners, adventurers, and cold-weather warriors!
 

Why Calilflow Runs?
CaliFlow Runs is dedicated to creating inclusive, energetic, and community-driven running events that celebrate you. We bring people together to promote health, wellness, and positive vibes through races that are accessible, fun, and infused with the unique culture of the Golden State.
 
Who Can Participate? Everyone - Runners, Walkers, Strollers - All are welcome
 
About Our Courses: Our courses are open, which means you'll be sharing the path with other runners, walkers, and beachgoers. Safety is our top priority, so please stay on the pedestrian side of the beach path. The courses are well-marked, with water stations and restrooms available along the way.
 

Course Information: https://www.caliviberuns.com/w/CaliVibeRuns/Page/SantaMonicaCourse
 
Bib Pick-Up and Start Times:
Bib Pick-Up: 6:00 AM End 7:35 AM at the Race Ready Athletics Tent
Half Marathon Start Time: 7:00 am
5K, 10K, 15K & 10 Miler Start Time: 7:30 am

 
Start Location:5400 Ocean Ave
Long Beach, CA US 90803

Parking Information:
Street parking is free. Parking machines are $2.00 per hour.
 

Awards: 
The top 3 men and women in each distance will receive a medal.
Podium awards ceremony for 5K/10K at 8:45 AM
Podium awards ceremony for half marathoners at 9:30 AM
 
Frequently asked questions:
 https://www.caliviberuns.com/w/CaliVibeRuns/Page/FAQFrequentlyAskedQuestions

name: POMONA 5K & 10K
description:
Join us for the 9th Annual Pomona 5K & 10K on Saturday, October 18, 2025

The Pomona 5K/10K celebrates its 9th anniversary on Saturday, October 18, 2025. Take the chance to be a part of this historic milestone. With an average of 700 running participants and over 500 spectators in Downtown Pomona to cheer on all the runners, this event is a premier community event in the City of Pomona with a broad reach.


Visit the Health & Wellness Resource Fair from 8:00am through 12:00pm

In conjunction with the Pomona 5K & 10K, we are also hosting the Health & Wellness Resource Fair at Shaun Diamond Plaza throughout the race and after. If you are not participating in the race, or if you finish early, please visit the booths at our Health & Wellness Resource Fair. We  created this complimentary event to highlight our community partners, provide accessible health services and promote wellness for resident of all ages. Visit the Health & Wellness Fair for information on what's happening in the community, free health screenings, wellness education, and direct connections to valuable healthcare and support services.


Our Background

The Pomona 5K was born in 2016, with the vision of creating a community-driven running event in the heart of Downtown Pomona. The Pomona 5K is a partnership between Pomona Valley Runners, a local running group, and various community organizations including God’s Pantry, a community-based nonprofit organization. This event has been coordinated by a core group of dedicated community leaders from Pomona who volunteer their time to put on this event from the ground up.

SCHEDULE

FRIDAY, October 17, 2025 | 350 N Garey Ave
  • 6:00 PM- 8:00 PM            |            Registration & Packet Pick Up / Check-In


SATURDAY, October 18, 2025 - RACE DAY | Shaun Diamond Plaza
  • 6:30AM                              |          Registration
  • 7:15 AM                             |          Welcome 
  • 7:30 AM                             |          Toddler Trot
  • 7:45 AM                             |          Warm-up
  • 8:00AM                              |          5K & 10K Race
  • 9:30 AM                             |          Division Winners
  • 8:00AM - 12:00PM           |          Health & Wellness Fair

name: POMONA 5K & 10K
description:
Join us for the 9th Annual Pomona 5K & 10K on Saturday, October 18, 2025

The Pomona 5K/10K celebrates its 9th anniversary on Saturday, October 18, 2025. Take the chance to be a part of this historic milestone. With an average of 700 running participants and over 500 spectators in Downtown Pomona to cheer on all the runners, this event is a premier community event in the City of Pomona with a broad reach.


Visit the Health & Wellness Resource Fair from 8:00am through 12:00pm

In conjunction with the Pomona 5K & 10K, we are also hosting the Health & Wellness Resource Fair at Shaun Diamond Plaza throughout the race and after. If you are not participating in the race, or if you finish early, please visit the booths at our Health & Wellness Resource Fair. We  created this complimentary event to highlight our community partners, provide accessible health services and promote wellness for resident of all ages. Visit the Health & Wellness Fair for information on what's happening in the community, free health screenings, wellness education, and direct connections to valuable healthcare and support services.


Our Background

The Pomona 5K was born in 2016, with the vision of creating a community-driven running event in the heart of Downtown Pomona. The Pomona 5K is a partnership between Pomona Valley Runners, a local running group, and various community organizations including God’s Pantry, a community-based nonprofit organization. This event has been coordinated by a core group of dedicated community leaders from Pomona who volunteer their time to put on this event from the ground up.

name: Pre Reg 2027 Heroes 4 Hearing 5K
description:
This is the registration page for 2027 - if you are looking for info on the Aug 16th 2026- please go to 

https://runsignup.com/Race/CA/FountainValley/Heroes4Hearing

 

Place

Shoreline Aquatic Park
200 Aquarium Way, Long Beach, CA 90802

HearAid Foundation presents our 6th Annual Heroes for Hearing 5K Fundraiser.

Be inspired by heroes overcoming their hearing loss. Run with heroes who bring the gift of hearing. Become a hero.
  
 
Join us on Sunday, August 15th, 2027 in Long Beach, California (or virtually) as we celebrate our recipients and those who helped give the gift of hearing! Let’s run and walk together so we can keep on giving this precious gift. 

Join us for an exhilarating run along the marina and water front in Long Beach, California. Whether you're up for a 5k or the Kids Run, this event promises a memorable experience amidst the natural beauty of the sea.

Event Details:

Bib Pickup: Starts at 7 am
Race Start Times:
5k: 8 am Kids Dash: 9:15 am

Course Description:

Course Time Limit: 1 hours and 45 minutes. You must cross the finish line by 9:45 a.m.

What You Get:

All participants will receive a finisher's medal, finish line treats, and free downloadable race photos.
Race results will be posted on our website within 12 hours of the race.

Gear Check: Personal items can be stored with our staff .

Water Station on the course, with water and electrolyte beverages.

Race Photos: Our course photographer will capture your journey, and you can download your photos for free within 24 hours of the event.

Results: Published on RunSignup within 2 hours of the race.

Refund and Deferral Policy:

Unfortunately, we do not offer refunds, please purchase the inexpensive insurance if you think there is a chance you might need to back out and will want a refund instead of considering it a donation to the charity. 


Who Can Register:

Everyone is welcome! Our races are open to participants of all ages, abilities, and races. Whether you're an experienced runner, a casual jogger, or a first-time walker, you're invited to join us. Parents can bring their children and strollers, as we believe in creating an inclusive and welcoming atmosphere for all. Come and be a part of this fun and rewarding race experience!

We look forward to seeing you adjacent to the aquarium for a day of fitness, fun, and camaraderie. Get ready to lace up your running shoes and create lasting memories in this beautiful setting!

name: Pre Reg 2027 Torrance Memorial Medical Center, BRA Run, Los Angeles
description:
Day of Event

Our 14th Annual 5K & 13K are held on a fully paved course next to the sand in Playa Del Rey on August 30th, 2026

6:00am: Parking Lots Open (LA County charges $13, bring cash). The line backs up so arrive early. 

7:00am: Registration and Vendor Booths Open

7:05am: Warm up for Bike Tour

7:10am: Bike Tour Starts 

7:30am: Costume Contests

7:40am: Warm Up for 5/13k

8:06am: National Anthem 🇺🇸

8:10am: 13K start (2 hour time limit, 15 min per mile pace or faster)

8:30am: 5K start

10:00am: Kids Run starts (time is approximate and depends on when the last 13K walkers are off so kids can run clear)

10:10am: Awards Ceremony

Share your photos on social media! We are @brarunla and @runmercury and our official hashtag is #brarunla. We will be resharing your posts whenever we can.


Charity

In its 14th year, The BRA Run supports Evelyn’s BFF, a charity that helps breast cancer survivors get back to their new normal while supporting counseling, reconstruction, and other items that people are often not able to get covered by their insurance. Most of our grant recipients have bills going into 6 figures! This event is the biggest fundraiser for this all volunteer organization and determines how many people they can help this year.

Evelyn, the founder of the Evelyn's Breast Friends Forever (BFF), a 501(c)3 non-profit public benefit charity foundation, started this event in 2013 and in her honor we have a 5K and a 13K at the BRA Run. We have the unusual distance of 13K because women have a 1 in 8 risk (or 13%) of having breast cancer in their life. A 13K is also slightly more than 8 miles.

Join us for Evelyn's party so we all can help other breast cancer survivors and their families. Our event spreads awareness of breast cancer reconstruction to the community by encouraging men and women to run and walk in their BRA (Breast Reconstruction Awareness) in honor and in memory of those who have been diagnosed with breast cancer.

Donate to Evelyn's BFF.

Costume Contest

Dress up in celebration of the BRA Run! Our participants get creative with their attire and we have awards to celebrate. Wear a decorated bra (sports bra, lacy bra, nursing bra, any type of bra) or dress up your shirt! You can wear the bra on its own or over a shirt. Looking for ideas? Here are some of last year's costumes.

Winners will be announced in the following categories:

Female Individual: Best Decorated Bra
Male Individual: Best Decorated Bra
Team*: Best Dressed

*Teams must have 5 or more people to enter the team competitions.

Make it a Virtual Run/Walk

Can't make it in person but want to be a part of the event and support breast cancer survivors? Sign up for the virtual run and we will mail you a bib, shirt and medal.

Beach to City Challenge

Want to nab an additional medal? Take part in the Beach to City Challenge with the Greta Garbo medal!

Greta Garbo, the cinematic legend and breast cancer survivor, called Culver City home, so we celebrate her with a special medal. If you run both the BRA Run and Screenland 5k (in Culver City) back-to-back, you can claim this bonus bling!

If you ran Screenland 5k 2025 and BRA Run 2025, you can claim your medal at BRA Run 2025
If you run BRA Run 2025 and Screenland 5k 2026, you can claim your medal at Screenland 5k 2026

You can only claim the bonus medal once a year.

Sign up for Screenland 5k 2025 to ensure your Greta Garbo medal. If you register for Screenland 5k at the BRA Run finish line, you'll get a discount on registration.

A list of those who qualify for the medal will be published on the BRA Run website in August before the event. Check to make sure your name is on it!

Thank you so much to ©Harriet Brown Inc. for working with us to bring you the iconic images of the great Greta Garbo that are used in our challenge medals.

name: Pre Reg 2027 Wrigley River Run & Tadpole Trot Presented by Long Beach Clinical Trials
description:
This page is for the 2027 Event, for the event on June 6th, 2026 please visit www.wrigleyriverrun.com for full event information.

The start/finish, expo area and bib pick up will be located in the parking lot of Westland Real Estate Group/Long Beach Beer Lab, at 520 W Willow St, Long Beach, CA 90806.

There is special pricing of only $10 for youth 17 & under who want to do the 5k or the 10k.

The Half Combo is a total of 13.1 miles and includes a 5k and 10 Mile Entry. You will receive a half marathon time as well as a time in each event. You will also receive a bonus medal. There are no age group awards for the Half Combo.

If you have a group of 6 or more contact us about your options for a group discount.

The Wrigley River Run is the Long Beach Neighborhood Foundation’s signature event and is designed to promote community involvement, education, tolerance, and a healthy non-violent lifestyle.  All funds generated from the event are used to benefit youth organizations in Long Beach and the surrounding communities.

name: Pre Registration 2026 - Beverly Hills Run of the Stars
description:
RUN through BEVERLY HILLS!

or

Join our VIRTUAL CHALLENGE and complete a 5k from ANYWHERE! 

 

Run with your team or group!   Special prizes for winning teams! 

 

This event supports NOT TODAY CANCER and their mission to find a CURE for devastating childhood cancers. 
 
Despite childhood cancer rates being on the rise, a desperately small amount of US Federal Funding for Cancer Research goes to children. 
 
When Mason was 9 years old he was diagnosed with T-Cell Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL).  His cancer was treated with chemotherapies that have been in use for decades, because there is a devastating lack of funding for new treatments with better outcomes!  
For two years, Mason and his family used the slogan “Not Today Cancer'“ as their mantra and when he died from the disease, the journey continued and this local non-profit was founded in Mason's honor. Scientists are close to a cure to help children like Mason and you can help! 
 
NOT TODAY CANCER 

 

Packet Pick Up, where you can get your shirt and bib, on Saturday, the day before the race. Time and Location TBD. 

If you are having someone else pick up your bib, shirt, and bag, they will need two things. A printed copy of your ID and a printed signed copy of the waiver. You can download and print the waiver here.  No bibs will be given out without this. The lawyers and our insurance company require us to be strict on this, sorry for the inconvenience.

If you are unable to join us the day before, you can pick up your bib and shirt on race day in the festival area but get there early and be prepared to wait in line on race day.
*Reminder: Please wear your bib on the front of your clothes so that your photos can be tagged and so we know you are with the event.*

DAY OF RACE INFO: https://www.nottodaycancer.care/ntc-run

RACE PARKING:  TBD

Race Day Schedule:

TBD

name: Pre-Registration 2026 Plymouth Rock n Run
description:
Please visit https://runsignup.com/Race/CA/Anaheim/PlymouthRocknRun to sign up for the 2025 Plymouth Rock n Run or to view results or photos. This site is only for 2026 early registration. 

 

Get ready to lace up your running shoes and join the fun at the most exciting event in Anaheim, CA!

It's all happening on Thanksgiving Day, at  La Palma Ave, right in the heart of beautiful Yorba Regional Park. We've got a fantastic day of activities and races planned for you, so let's dive into all the exhilarating details:

Event Highlights:

🏃‍♂️ USATF-Certified Courses: We've got both 5k and 10k courses that'll take you on a thrilling journey along La Palma Ave and the enchanting Santa Ana River Trail, all while you soak in the natural beauty of Yorba Regional Park.

⏱️ Chip Timing: For those competitive spirits, we've got chip timing for the 5k and 10k run/walk events. Race against the clock and challenge yourself to a new personal best!

👦👧 Kids' Fun Run: Calling all young runners! We've got a Kids 1k fun run for those aged 10 and under, and even a 100-yard tot trot for the little ones aged 4 and under. It's a blast for the whole family!

🥇 Awesome Awards: The top male and female finishers in both the 5k and 10k races will receive special awards. Plus, medals three deep for top runners in 18 different age categories. Everyone's a winner!

🏅 Custom Finisher Medals: You won't want to miss our custom-designed diecast finisher medals for all 5k/10k and kids run/trot participants. It's a race souvenir you'll cherish!

👕 Stylish Shirts: Participants in the 5k and 10k get cool shirts in adult unisex, women's, and youth sizes. Show off your accomplishment in style!

👫 Team Spirit: Gather your friends and form a team of 8 or more – you'll enjoy fantastic discounts! There are also team competitions with awards for the biggest, fastest, and highest fundraising teams.

🎉 Finish-Line Festival: The fun doesn't end at the finish line! Join us at the finish-line festival for a costume contest, live music, delicious food, freebies, and tons of entertainment for adults and kids of all ages. It's a celebration like no other!

PACKET PICK-UP 
Multiple options are planned for the Saturday, Tuesday and Wednesday leading up to the race day. Check out the bib pick up tab for the latest details as they are confirmed and follow us on social media for the fastest updates.


LOCATION/PARKING 
The event staging area is located at the west end of Yorba Regional Park (7300 E La Palma, Anaheim Hills, CA 92807), just past the softball fields near the 5k/10k start line. 

Parking is available inside Yorba Regional Park. name: Pre-Registration Screenland 5K 2027
description:
This is only the Early Registration page for the 2027 event, please go to

https://runsignup.com/Race/CA/CulverCity/Screenland5K  or https://www.screenland5k.com for more information about our event on March 1st, 2026 and to sign up.

Follow the yellow brick road with Dorothy, Toto and the Munchkins pursued by the Wicked Witch of the West, experiencing legendary movie and television experiences. Finish on the red carpet with Scarlett O'Hara, Rhett Butler and paparazzi at our start studded Annual family fun 5K adventure in the Heart of Screenland.

All participants will receive commemorative bib, official time, medal and shirt and on course support and entertainment, entrance into the post race party and free downloadable event photos among many other perks.

Beach to City Challenge

Screenland 5K + BRA Run = Bonus bling featuring the fabulous Greta Garbo! 

This cinematic legend and breast cancer survivor called Culver City home, so we are celebrating her with the Beach to City Challenge! 

You must do both events back to back. You can do the 5K at Screenland and then either the 5K or the 13K at the BRA Run and you will be able to claim the bonus medal at the finish line festival of the BRA Run in August at Dockweiler Beach .  If you missed Screenland in the spring, you can start the challenge at BRA Run in August and finish it at Screenland the following year.

We update the list of those who are qualified on the BRA Run website in August, before that event. You can check there to make sure we have you on the list after you register.

Sign up for both events at the same time or register for the BRA Run at the finish line festival after the Screenland 5K, and get a discount on registration.

More info about the BRA Run 5k & 13K  at www.BRArunLA.com.

name: Project Youth OC - 2025 OC Marathon
description:
Join Us for the 2025 OC Marathon and Support Project Youth OC!

Since 2004, Project Youth OC has proudly partnered with the OC Marathon as an official Charity Partner. This year, we're celebrating 21 years of making a difference through this incredible event!

The OC Marathon offers something for everyone:

  • 5K Walk/Run: Saturday, May 3, 2025, at the OC Fairgrounds.
  • Marathon & Half Marathon: Sunday, May 4, 2025, starting at Fashion Island and finishing at the OC Fairgrounds.When you join our team, you’ll help empower youth and strengthen families across Orange County.

Every dollar raised through peer-to-peer fundraising goes directly toward life-changing mentorship, education, and support services for over 1,500 youth and their families each year.

Together, we can run, walk, and fundraise for a brighter future!

Thank you all for your support!

name: Pulp Fiction: Royale with Speed 5K, 10K & 13.1
description:
November 8, 2025 | 7:00 AM Start | Canoga Park, CA | In-Person & Virtual Options

Say what again? Join us for a Tarantino-inspired race experience that brings cult-classic energy to the streets of Canoga Park. Whether you're running for redemption, milkshakes, or the Gold Watch, this is your chance to bring your cinematic swagger to the start line.

Run solo, with your Wolfpack, or in costume (highly encouraged). Each registration includes a themed race bib, medal, and downloadable finisher photos.

  • The Ezekiel 5K 🏃‍♂️ For those who walk the righteous path… but still want brunch after.
  •  Jack Rabbit Slim’s 10K 🕺You’ll be dancing like Uma by mile 4.

  • The Gold Watch Multiverse Challenge (Virtual) ⌚️Run anywhere, anytime, with a nod to Butch’s fateful heirloom.

---

All finishers will receive:

  • Custom race bib
  • Signature themed medal
  • Free downloadable finisher photos
  • Access to our pop-up “briefcase photo booth”

---

📍 Location:

6846 Owensmouth Ave, Canoga Park, CA 91303

🕖 Start Time: 7:00 AM

---

Whether you’re chasing redemption, cheeseburgers, or cinematic glory — there’s a race distance (and a line from the script) with your name on it.

Register now — before the clock strikes Gold Watch.

---

This race is a fan-made parody event inspired by 80s pop culture and is not affiliated with or endorsed by any official trademark holders.

Say what again? Join us for a Tarantino-inspired race experience that brings cult-classic energy to the streets of Canoga Park. Whether you're running for redemption, milkshakes, or the Gold Watch, this is your chance to bring your cinematic swagger to the start line.

Run solo, with your Wolfpack, or in costume (highly encouraged). Each registration includes a themed race bib, medal, and downloadable finisher photos.

  • The Ezekiel 5K 🏃‍♂️ For those who walk the righteous path… but still want brunch after.
  •  Jack Rabbit Slim’s 10K 🕺You’ll be dancing like Uma by mile 4.
  • The Quarter Pounder 13.1 🍔 You earned that $5 milkshake.
  • The Gold Watch Multiverse Challenge (Virtual) ⌚️Run anywhere, anytime, with a nod to Butch’s fateful heirloom.

---

All finishers will receive:

  • Custom race bib
  • Signature themed medal
  • Free downloadable finisher photos
  • Access to our pop-up “briefcase photo booth”

---

📍 Location:

6846 Owensmouth Ave, Canoga Park, CA 91303

🕖 Start Time: 7:00 AM

---

Whether you’re chasing redemption, cheeseburgers, or cinematic glory — there’s a race distance (and a line from the script) with your name on it.

Register now — before the clock strikes Gold Watch.

---
Parody Disclaimer
This race is a fan-made parody event inspired by 80s pop culture and is not affiliated with or endorsed by any official trademark holders.

name: Race to the Flagpole
description:
The Race to the Flagpole is a community oriented race through beautiful wine country in Livermore California. The event is organized by the Livermore Granada Boosters, a local organization that has been celebrating the excellence of scholar athletes in Livermore since 1949. 

We accomplish our mission by promoting scholar athletic events with thousands of photos/video posted on our website, social media, and newsletter. Throughout the year, we recognize top individual and team achievements with Wall of Fame photos, posted throughout the community. At the end of each school year we host our Olympian Banquet for all varsity athletes and coaches. At this event, we recognize high character athletes of Livermore and Granada High Schools in 70 Varsity Sports. We induct past athletes into the Livermore Hall of Fame and award $16,000 in Scholarships to the top boy and girl student athletes from each high school.

All proceeds from the Race to the Flagpole supports these activities.

name: Raincross Color Run Celebrating the Day of the Dead
description: Welcome everyone to Riverside's second annual Raincross Color Run on October 25, 2025! This year, we will be celebrating the Day of the Dead at Hunter Hobby Park. This run/walk event for all ages will include a 3 lap, 2.1 mile course where every participant will get a white t-shirt to be "decorated" at color stations throughout the course. Each finisher will receive a uniquely Riverside, locally designed, Day of the Dead wood medal. The event will include a festival area with themed activities, face painting for the kids, and local food trucks and vendors. This event will be fun for the whole family. This event is limited to 1,000 participants, so sign up early! Come celebrate friends and family at this fun filled event!

name: Ramona Wine Country 5K
description:
Be sure to grab your family, friends, coworkers and come join us for one of the most fun filled events in Southern California, the Ramona Wine Country 5k. It takes place at the breathtaking Backcountry Gardens and is part trails with a splash of mud run plus a healthy dose of Mother Nature’s obstacles mixed in for fun. You’ll also find some hills, streams, boulders and much more. Not your average 5K! Everyone can do it as long as you have the drive and determination to keep going, not quit and in the words of Joe Dirt, “keep on keepin’ on." 

It’s a 1.5 mile two loop course. If two loops are too many, feel free to enjoy the single loop option. 

Oh, and don’t miss out on the Charity Solo & Team Beer Mile after the 5K is finished. All you gotta do is drink 4 beers and run 4 x400 meters Fastest individual or 2-4 person team earns the bragging rights.  

Once the fitness is over, you’ve gotta then join us across the road at the award winning Ramona Ranch Winery for a FREE wine tasting, after party with live music, and killer pizza for purchase from the Pizza Trolley. If you didn’t know, Ramona Ranch is also San Diego’s only Certified Sustainable Vineyard and Winery.  

REGISTRATION INCLUDES;
- FREE Ramona Ranch wine tasting
- Finisher’s medal
- Race swag
- Ramona Radio playing tunes
- Pizza for purchase from the Pizza Trolley
- FREE Parking 

A portion of the proceeds help support the life changing OPERATION REBOUND – FRONTLINE TO FINISH LINE: CAF’s Operation Rebound® program strengthens the mental and physical well-being of veterans, military personnel and first responders with permanent physical injuries by providing them opportunities to use sports and fitness to re-integrate into our communities and by empowering them through sports.

name: Red Wave 5K
description:
2nd Annual Red Wave 5K

The Red Wave 5k and 1.5 mile run is a fundraising event to benefit Red Wave Indoor. Red Wave Indoor is a percussion ensemble at Fresno State that participates in the competitive activity known as winter percussion. Each spring, Red Wave Indoor will compete in competitions locally and throughout California, culminating in the WGI Percussion World Championships in Dayton, OH where hundreds of other groups compete in the 3-day event. Proceeds from the Red Wave 5K help make this all possible!

Race Information

Registration is now open! The 2nd Annual Red Wave 5K is Saturday, October 11 at Fresno State.

Packet pickup will be Friday, October 10, from 12-3 pm at Fleet Feet Fresno, located at 9447 N Fort Washington Rd #106, Fresno, CA 93730. Late pickup morning of the race at 7:00 am.

Participants will receive a t-shirt. Awards will be given to the top finisher of each age group, as well as the first male and female finishers overall.

We look forward to seeing you there! Go ‘Dogs!

About Red Wave Indoor

Founded in 2017, the group performs at local, state, and national competitions every winter. The ensemble seeks to further the growth of young adults in the Central Valley through performance in the pageantry arts. For more information about Red Wave Indoor, please visit their website.

Members of Red Wave Indoor are required to pay membership fees to offset the costs of instructional staff, program designers, transportation, and so much more. In conjunction with the Friends of the Bulldog Marching Band, a non-profit organization that supports the athletic band programs at Fresno State, the goal of this event is to lessen the monetary burden placed on students and allow them to focus on getting the most out of their experience.

description:
Thanksgiving Day 5K run and Kids 1K run in beautiful Redlands, CA.

The race course will start at the intersection of University St. and Brockton Ave. (near University of Redlands Ted Runner Stadium) and weave through the streets in and around the University of Redlands. 

ALL PARTICIPANTS THAT REGISTER ON OR AFTER WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 26 ARE NOT GUARANTEED A T-SHIRT.

name: Redondo Beach Super Bowl Sunday Race
description:
Join more than 8,000 race enthusiasts at Southern California’s greatest Super Bowl Sunday Celebration! Now in its 48th year, the Redondo Beach Super Bowl Sunday Race is a great way to celebrate the biggest day in sports and enjoy the picturesque sites of Redondo Beach: the Pacific Ocean, the Redondo Beach Historic Pier, the Marina in King Harbor, the Wyland whale mural, ocean breezes, fresh air and beautiful Southern California winter weather. Run, walk, or stroll in the Redondo Beach Super Bowl Sunday 10K Run, 5K Run/Walk, 5K Stroller Walk, Big Game Challenge, Kids 1K or Baby Buggy 10K. 

Participants and guests can also enjoy great food, beverages and a variety of running accessories at the 2-day Health & Fitness Expo.  
Start your Super Bowl Sunday on a healthy, fun and festive note and finish in plenty of time to enjoy America’s Classic - Super Bowl!

You can pick up your race bib and shirt at the Health and Fitness Expo:
Saturday, Feb. 7, 10:00 a.m. - 4:00 p.m.
Sunday, Feb. 8, 6:00 a.m. - 11:00 a.m.

Expo & Start/Finish Lines Located at:
200 Portofino Way
Redondo Beach, CA 90277


For a full list of frequently asked questions, feel free to visit:  https://redondo10k.com/faqs/

name: Reentry Resource Center’s Rise Up and Run 5K
description:
The County of Santa Clara Reentry Resource Center and its partners are hosting a 5K run/walk to raise money to support the immediate needs of justice-involved people (clothing, food, hygiene, transportation, etc.). The in-person 5K will take place on Saturday, October 18th at Hellyer County Park with a race start time of 9:00AM. Participants who choose the virtual option can run or walk the race on the day and time of their choice between October 18, 2025, and November 1, 2025. Runners will receive a Rise Up and Run race shirt and medal. 

 

Packet pickup information will be coming soon.  

 

Help support this effort by registering for the race, sponsoring other participants to run or donating to buy new clothes for those reentering our community from jail or prison. Many of these individuals have no clean clothes in which to start their reentry journey.  

 

Here are some ways you can help:

  • Register and run the race!
  • Sponsor a race registration for an individual or a family.
  • Donate monetarily to buy new clothes for individuals released from custody.
  • Buy or donate new clothes for reentry clients leaving custody.

 

Every day at the County of Santa Clara Reentry Resource Center we see clients ready to make dramatic changes in their lives. But having a felony record can be almost as restrictive as being incarcerated. Access to jobs, housing, and other opportunities becomes incredibly limited due to employment and housing restrictions and social stigma. 

 

Yet despite these challenges, we see clients determined to clear those hurdles. They are taking college credit classes, working their way up from minimum wage jobs to management positions and union apprenticeships and some are entering peer mentoring and counseling professions to help those who are following in their footsteps. 

You can help support individuals who are just starting this journey to change their lives and share their talents with our community. Each person you help to rise up makes our community stronger. 

 

If you would like more information about the County of Santa Clara Reentry Resource Center, please visit www.sccreentry.org or email Juan Guevara at juan.guevara@ceo.sccgov.org.

 

We look forward to partnering with you for social change.

name: Resolve2Run
description:
Resolve2Run team

This run benefits the Chicago Park School PTA, the Chicago Park 4-H Club, and the Peardale/Chicago Park Firefighter’s Association.
Course: Begins across the street from Chicago Park School, winds through beautiful back country roads and trails, along Rollins Lake shore, and parts of the Old Emigrant Trail,(dirt & paved terrain). No dogs are allowed on course. After Dec 19, registration does not include a race t-shirt.

The Resolve2Run 5K/10K/Walk is an annual fundraiser for the Chicago Park 4-H Club. Our club, the oldest continuously running 4-H Club in California, has been firmly planted in this community since 1929. We are committed to the youth of Nevada County, providing amazing opportunities for our 100+ members to learn and grow through our many projects, such as raising animals (beef, sheep, swine, goats, rabbits and poultry), sewing, fine arts, crafts, aeronautics, website design and development, biking, survival skills, cooking and much more. We have an emphasis on serving our community and giving back through service projects such as our Annual Fire Safe Clean Up for the elderly who are unable to care for their property. We also partner with Chicago Park School PTA and Peardale-Chicago Park Volunteer Firefighters to provide this run which is an opportunity to start the new year with healthy habits. We felt that it was important to have a run available at the time when people are making resolutions, giving them the chance to begin right away, starting with this race.

Funds raised through this event enable us to keep the enrollment costs for our members reasonable, enabling more youth to participate. We also provide scholarships for graduating seniors who have excelled in leadership and service within our community. We are participants in buying animals at the Nevada County Fair’s Youth Livestock Auction, enabling more youth to succeed in their projects and making sure they’re able to participate in the following year, as well as we’re buyers at the DC Delegates Cake Auction each year enabling youth to spend a week in our nation’s capitol learning about government and history.

We appreciate all those in our community who have supported us and we hope to reciprocate in as many ways as possible!

name: Rest. Resist. Run. Rise.
description:
The Rest. Resist. Run. Rise. campaign is a collaborative initiative between A Sista’s Touch (AST) and DNPs of Color (DOC), designed to raise awareness, increase community engagement, and secure donations in support of AST’s programming focused on protecting, empowering, and celebrating Black women and girls.

Serving as the culminating activity for the DOC 5th Annual Conference, the Virtual 5K will be hosted on Sunday, October 19, and is open to the entire community. The campaign unites the themes of rest, resistance, physical movement, and social uplift—centering holistic wellness and systemic change.

DNPs of Color (DOCs), is a 501c3 nonprofit nursing organization, whose mission is to increase diversity in doctoral studies, clinical practice, and leadership for nurses. DNP, short for Doctor of Nursing Practice, is the highest level of education a nurse can attain, which focuses on clinical practice. DNPs influence healthcare outcomes through healthcare policy, organizational leadership, and translating nursing research into evidence-based practice. 

The DNPs of Color 5th Annual Conference will be hosted on October 16th-19th in Oakland, California, the first time on the West Coast. This event is your opportunity to connect, learn, and lead in a community dedicated to advancing diversity in nursing.

A Sista’s Touch is a tax-exempt (501c3) nonprofit public benefit corporation, whose mission is to cultivate and celebrate Black Excellence through the personal inspirations of African American women, with a foundational focus on OUR adolescent girls. The aim of A Sista’s Touch is threefold: To Edify, Elevate, and Celebrate Excellence.

name: Ride 4A Reason 2026
description:
Ride 4 A Reason has 3 different routes for cyclists of every level and experience, and there's always a virtual option for those that prefer to ride with us in spirit! 

110 Miles - Ride all the way from Oakland to Sacramento!  The century ride begins at Oakland Technical High School and passes through beautiful bay area communities on the way to Sacramento. 

68 Miles - Start in Suisun City and enjoy some of the most delightful miles of R4R.  This route begins at the Suisun City train depot, and riders can choose a shuttle bus from Oakland Tech (leaves at 8 AM) or take the train/drive a car to the Suisun City train station. 

45 Miles - Our most family friendly route starts in Vacaville and has less than 600 ft of elevation gain, making it a perfect ride for anyone who is newer to long-distance cycling. This route begins at a park in Vacaville, and riders can take a shuttle bus that leaves at 8 AM from Oakland Tech to the ride start.

All rides end in Sacramento at the State Capitol with a catered lunch and a rally to celebrate the riders and highlight the need for more education funding.  Riders can choose to reserve a seat on the shuttle bus back to Oakland Tech or take Amtrak back to Oakland/Jack London Square.

name: Ride Santa Barbara 100
description:
Ride Santa Barbara returns for its 14th year!

RideSB100 offers four distinct courses to suit a range of cycling abilities – each course offering a world-class Santa Barbara cycling experience! 🚵🏻‍♂️

All courses start along the beach and follow the beautiful Santa Barbara beachfront before turning inland to experience all Santa Barbara has to offer. Cyclists will wind through some of the most exclusive neighborhoods in the country; experience the rolling foothills lined with citrus and avocado orchards and climb some of the most famous mountains in the country, all while experiencing some of the most beautiful views in southern California.

 

All cyclists will receive:

  • Official 2025 RideSB100 t-shirt
  • Official 2025 RideSB100 water bottle
  • Official RideSB100 musette bag with sponsor goodies
  • Fully supported aid stations
  • Mechanical support
  • Finish Line Festival with lots of food and beer
  • All Gibraltar Challenge finishers will receive a coin at the top of the hill.
  • Age group medals for Gibraltar Challenge
  • Option to buy event Jersey $99; Bib Shorts $99
  • And more!

All riders will receive an overall chip time and riders who participate in the Gibraltar Challenge will be ranked for the King and Queen of the Mountain (KOM/QOM) Jersey awards! 

 

RIDES*

 

100 mile

  • Over 9,700′ of climbing | Start Time: 7:00 AM
  • Recommended for experienced cyclists only 
  • Tackle a challenging ride that begins at Chase Palm Park, rolls through Carpinteria, and continues into the scenic Lake Casitas region. Climb Toro Canyon and Ladera Lane before testing your legs on the Gibraltar Climb Challenge, a timed 6.1-mile ascent with an 8% grade and over 2,500 ft of elevation gain. Descend, then join the 100KM Coastal Route along Cathedral Oaks through Isla Vista and past UCSB, finishing back at Chase Palm Park.
  • Includes a timed hill climb segment up the famous Gibraltar Road  – with a KOM/QOM jersey awarded to the 1st place winners in each age group!
  • For more information, go to ridesb100.com/100-mile/


100 KM + Climb

name: Ride the Point
description:
Ride the hidden, unridden, and forbidden San Diego to support pancreatic cancer research! 

Cycle through scenic areas of San Diego on November 8th to support pancreatic cancer research in the 12th Annual Jim Krause Memorial Charity Cycling Ride the Point. The ride starts and ends at Liberty Station and includes exclusive routes through Point Loma, Ocean Beach, Mission Bay La Jolla, Torrey Pines, and Sorrento Valley. This ride takes participants through historic neighborhoods and past some of the most scenic areas of San Diego, some that are only open once a year for this event. The event has volunteers along the route, SAG, and five fully stocked rest stops to support the riders.   

Ride the Point has three distances to accommodate diverse levels of cycling experience. The 5-mile Family Fun Ride is a relatively flat course on bike paths along beautiful San Diego Bay and is perfect for cruisers, beginning riders, challenged athletes, and families. The 25 and Metric Century are street rides with exclusive routes and challenging climbs around scenic San Diego. This is a boutique ride limited to 600 riders to ensure an unforgettable experience. The public is invited to the free healthy lifestyle expo at Oggi’s in Liberty Station from 9 am until 2 pm with local vendors, music, and refreshments.

name: Ride The Vines
description:
Pedal Through Temecula’s Scenic Beauty for a Cause on October 19th, 2025

Join us for Ride the Vines 2025, an unforgettable charity bike ride through the stunning Temecula Valley, proudly hosted by Bike Temecula Valley and co-sponsored by the City of Temecula. Whether you’re a casual rider or an experienced cyclist, this event offers a route for everyone – all starting and finishing at the parking lot by the Stampede in Old Town Temecula

Choose Your Ride



50-Mile Wine Country Ride: Take on the ultimate challenge with a sweeping tour of the valley’s renowned vineyards and rolling hills. This ride starts at 7:30 am

30-Mile Road Ride: Adventure through Temecula’s picturesque wine country on a rolling route, ideal for road and e bike riders. This ride starts at 8:30

18-Mile Guided Group Ride: Enjoy a scenic and social tour through Temecula using bike trails wherever possible. Perfect for casual riders and families. This ride starts at 9:30 am

Early Bird Pricing through 10/1

Bike Village in Old Town Temecula in the parking lot by the Stampede

Before and after your ride, explore the Bike Village in Old Town Temecula. This family-friendly hub will feature:

A bike skills course to sharpen your handling abilities.
Bike safety information to keep you riding smart and safe.
E-bike demos where you can test ride the latest models.
Games for kids to keep the little ones entertained.
After Party at Baily’s in Old Town Temecula

Cap off the day with an epic after party at Baily’s in Old Town Temecula. Enjoy live music by The Other Side, along with delicious food and drinks available for purchase.

Ride with Purpose

Proceeds from Ride the Vines 2025 will benefit four impactful local charities:

Mission Hope – Supporting individuals and families in need.
Caught with Your Helmet On – Promoting bike safety for children and teens.
Temecula PTA – Enhancing educational programs for local students.
Walk 'n Rollers – founded to encourage children to be more active

name: Ring Out the Old – 5K, 10K, Half Marathon
description:
CHOOSE YOUR MEDAL RUN! Join us for the exhilarating "Ring out the Old" race, featuring a range of distances to suit every runner's preference. Runners have a chance to earn a unique "old" medal from High Tides Runs or our esteemed parent company, Mercury Runs. Our coveted High Tides Runs are available here!

Race Details

Location: Woodley Park, 6076 Woodley Ave, Encino, CA 91316
Parking: Free parking in the lot; more is available on Woodley Ave

Event Schedule

6:20am – Bib pick-up opens
7:00am – Half marathon & 10k start
7:30am – 5k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10k)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Courses

5k route: Runners do one loop – route here
10k route: Runners do one loop – route here
Half Marathon: Route is the 10k route PLUS an added out and back to make it the full distance. Runners do two laps – route here

More about the Course
The race routes go across the grass, under the road through a tunnel, and enter the park. The 5k loops the lake and returns. The 10k and half head to the other side of the park, going under the bridge, and then journey back along a different path.

Our courses are on open paths so please be considerate of other park users!

On-Course Support
Multiple water stations are located along the routes. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, electrolytes, and other snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk and runner turn signs

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Awards: 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.
Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and earlier on Instagram. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, Santa Monica, the San Fernando Valley, and Orange County. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule

Runners have a chance to earn a unique "old" medal from High Tides Runs or our esteemed parent company, Mercury Runs. Our coveted High Tides Runs are available here!

Race Details

Location: Woodley Park, 6076 Woodley Ave, Encino, CA 91316
Parking: Free parking in the lot; more is available on Woodley Ave

Event Schedule

6:20am – Bib pick-up opens
7:00am – Half marathon & 10k start
7:30am – 5k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10k)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Courses

5k route: Runners do one loop – route here
10k route: Runners do one loop – route here
Half Marathon: Route is the 10k route PLUS an added out and back to make it the full distance. Runners do two laps – route here

More about the Course
The race routes go across the grass, under the road through a tunnel, and enter the park. The 5k loops the lake and returns. The 10k and half head to the other side of the park, going under the bridge, and then journey back along a different path.

Our courses are on open paths so please be considerate of other park users!

On-Course Support
Multiple water stations are located along the routes. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, electrolytes, and other snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk and runner turn signs

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Awards: 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.
Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and earlier on Instagram. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, Santa Monica, the San Fernando Valley, and Orange County. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule

name: Rio Bravo Rumble 5k/10k
description: It’s once again time to lace up your shoes for the 2026 Rio Bravo Rumble. If you have been part of this event before then you know you’re in for one heck of a time. For those newbies out there looking to take part for the first time, you’ll soon understand why this event continues to grow each year. This is not a flat course.  This is 100% on dirt.  This will be a memorable day for you.  This is the 21th year of this event benefiting Bike Bakersfield, our community advocate for active transportation.

name: Rising Stars 5k
description:
Empower Southern California Neighborhood Superstars!

Help our Elite Amateur Boxers reach the National Championships! The cost of travel and competition often keeps talented youth from achieving their dreams.  Join us for The Rising Stars 5k and make a difference in their lives!  100% of the proceeds raised will go towards travel and accommodations. This 5K is virtual and can be ran anywhere on Saturday November 15th 2025. Registered participants will receive a 5K medal. The 100 Registrants will receive a Rising Stars 5K T-Shirt.

name: River Valley's 2nd Annual Jingle Bell Jog
description:
Join the Jingle Bell Jog 5K Run/Walk and embrace the holiday season!

 

This year, we are raising funds for RVHS Senior, Phoenix Danielson. A portion of the proceeds from the fundraiser will go directly to the Danielson Family to help with Phoenix's fight against Leukemia. 

Dress up in your favorite festive attire, lace up your running shoes, and jog through the streets
of Yuba City. “Believe in the magic of the season” as you participate in this jolly event. 

Registrations after November 25 are not guaranteed a T-Shirt

Packet Pick Up December 5th  from 4pm-7pm at the RVHS Library.

name: Riverpark 5k Summer Series
description:
Join us for the 2nd Annual Riverpark 5k Summer Series!  This is a run/walk event, with the course being located on a bike path and sidewalk.  5k event starts at 6:00pm each week, and Free Kids 1k is at 5:45pm.  The starting and ending point is located at Windrow Park.  Each race is limited to first 150 registrants!

T-Shirts will be for sale at the event, or online for $20 or FREE T-shirt by registering for at least 2 of the 3 races. 

As this is a series, awards will be given to the top 3 in each age category at the conclusion of Week 3 (7/24) at Window Park.

Choose to participate with us for 1, 2, or all 3 weeks!  Plus, there is a discount for registering for all 3 races (full series)!  Each finisher in the Kids 1k races receives a finisher medal!  100% of the proceeds go towards Rio Mesa Cross Country and Track teams.

Course map is located here.

Check-in for bibs will be located in the park starting at 5:00pm each week.

Series Points for Riverpark 5k:

Age Group Points are given based on what place you get in your age group each week (please note age is based on your age on the last day of the series). If you don't place in the top 9 in your age group, you get 1 point for participating each week. Age groups are: 1-12, 13-19, 20-29, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, 60-69, 70+.

1st Place - 10 Points

2nd Place - 8 Points

3rd Place - 7 Points

4th Place - 6 Points

5th Place - 5 Points

6th Place - 4 Points

7th Place - 3 Points

8th Place - 2 Points

9th or greater Place - 1 Point

For all inquiries, please email rapidorunning@gmail.com

name: Rock & Run
description:
You're Invited to join us for Rock & Run 2025 on Roctober 12!

October 12, 2025
Rock and Run describes the unique experience that awaits you as you meander through a 125 year-old, environmentally responsible, operational hard rock quarry. This is a 10K Run or 5K Walk/Run as you have never imagined. See the working quarry face, the ancient granite deposit, the massive equipment that processes it, and the natural surroundings, as you take the challenge of the Rock and Run with an Open House immediately following. This event will benefit Aromas School.

Race Number pickup will open at 7:00am and the race will start at 8:00am.   Please plan on arriving on time to pick up your number before the race so that we can start on time.  

Online registration will close at 6:00pm on Saturday, October 11.

name: Rock It in Chino Hills 5K & 10K
description:
Run it, hike it, and conquer the trails of the stunning and expansive Chino Hills State Park! Choose the 5K or 10K to challenge yourself with the beauty of trail running or hiking, all while soaking in the tranquility and scenic views, with trails stretching as far as the eye can see on most of the course. name: Rose Bowl Turkey Trot
description:
We are back for the 8th annual Rose Bowl Turkey Trot, a family favorite tradition 5k race on Thanksgiving morning around the Rose Bowl Stadium. All are invited whether you have two legs or four! All entry fees for 2025 will be 100% tax-deductible and will go directly to the Rose Bowl Legacy Foundation. Trot before you gobble and help preserve, protect, and enhance the Rose Bowl Stadium! To learn more about the Rose Bowl Legacy Foundation, visit https://www.rosebowllegacy.org.

Each participant will have an opportunity to donate after checkout. This year, the Rose Bowl Stadium is partnering with Pasadena Unified School District through the Pasadena Educational Foundation Eaton Fire Response. This effort will provide financial support to assist with the financial impacts associated from the recent Eaton Fire. 

The race is on Thanksgiving morning at the Rose Bowl Stadium! A timed race will go through a 3.1-mile course. All participants will receive a race bib and medal. The race will start and finish at the top of Lot K. The course itself will run around the Rose Bowl Loop. On race day bib pickup will begin at 6:30 AM. We highly encourage you to pick up your bib in advance on Wednesday, November 26th from 12:00 PM - 5:00 PM in Lot K at the Rose Bowl Stadium.  

Reminder: This race is all ages and children under the age of 12 must be accompanied by a registered parent/legal guardian at all times. 

Don’t forget to post photos of your trot and tag @rosebowlstadium and @rosebowllegacy and use hashtag #RoseBowlTurkeyTrot

 

FAQs:

Q: What does my registration include? 

A: Your registration includes access to the onsite race, a race bib, finishers medal. 100% of your ticket registration is tax deductible and goes towards the Rose Bowl Legacy Foundation. 

Q: What time does the race start?

A: The race begins promptly at 8:30AM. 

Q: How old do I need to be to participate?

A: Trotters can participate at all ages! 

Q: Where will the start line and registration table be?

A: In Lot K on the corner of West Dr. and Seco St. 

Q: Where do I park, and do I have to pay?

A: Parking will be free and in Lot K.

Q: Can I bring pets to the race?

A: Yes! You may bring dogs as long as they are on a leash.

Q: Will there be water stations?

A: Yes, a water station will be set-up halfway around the route, but we suggest you bring your own water as well.

Q: Will the event be rain or shine?

A: Yes, it will be rain or shine but hopefully shine 😊

Q: Should I wear a costume? 

A: Yes, costumes are highly encouraged to get into the Thanksgiving spirit!

Q: I have a small child. Can I race with a stroller? 

A: Yes! In the spirit of family involvement strollers are encouraged! We kindly ask participants with strollers to allow other racers to pass safely. 

Q: Can I come to packet pickup and gather someone else's packet for them?

A: Yes.

name: Rotary Mission Ten - Half Marathon, 10 Mile and 5K
description:
Race Day Registration and Packet/Bib pickup begins at 7:15am

This event is in its 42nd year. It is sponsored by the Rotary Club of Hollister and all proceeds go to benefit local scholarships and charities. San Juan Bautista is a small California Mission town just off Hwy 101 approximately 50 miles south of San Jose. The four races: 1/2 marathon, 10 miles, 5k and 1 Mile kids fun run, all start and finish in front of the historic and beautiful San Juan Mission. The area is rural and the course takes runners through farm land and up the Anzar hills. Medals are awarded three deep in standard age categories. The 1/2 marathon and 10 mile races (both USATF Distance Certified) are particularly good training for upcoming spring marathons. Theme teams encouraged and trophies will be awarded to top teams. (Please keep costumes family friendly)

2026 Mission Race Times: Race Day January 31, 2026

8:15 am Half Marathon
8:30 am Kid's 1 Mile Fun Run
9:00 am Ten Mile
9:15 am 5k

Fees include Long sleeve dri-tech t-shirt and finisher medal. Great training for marathon base. All races except fun run timed w/awards.

name: RPV's Run For Myles
description:
Experience an unforgettable adventure along a picturesque road course with breathtaking views of the majestic Pacific Ocean. This nonprofit event starts and finishes at the Point Vicente Interpretive Center in Rancho Palos Verdes, CA, and directly benefits the preservation of the city's beautiful trails.

Participants are invited to enhance their impact by becoming individual fundraisers or by creating fundraising teams.

Parking is available at two locations:

Point Vicente Interpretive Center (Until 7AM ONLY)

31501 Palos Verdes Dr W
Rancho Palos Verdes, CA 90275

Rancho Palos Verdes City Hall

30940 Hawthorne Boulevard
Rancho Palos Verdes, CA 90275
(*Shuttles will transport participants from City Hall to and from the Point Vicente Interpretive Center.)

The event kicks off at 7 AM with registration open to the public for check-in. At 7:45 AM, announcements are made, and a warm-up session takes place to prepare participants. The 10K race begins promptly at 8 AM, followed by the 5K race at 8:15 AM. At 9:45 AM, the Kids’ Fun Run race takes place. Afterward, at 10:15 AM, there are announcements and awards to recognize outstanding participants.
