name: Run Against Breast Cancer 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
🎀 Join the Fight: Breast Cancer Run! 🎀

Lace up and make a difference at our annual Breast Cancer Run! Together, we can raise awareness and funds to support those affected by breast cancer. 

Enjoy a spirited day filled with community, inspiration, and hope. Let’s unite for a cause that touches us all and run for a future without breast cancer! Sign up now and help us make a lasting impact!

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)

name: Run Deo Run Turkey Trot 5K
description:
Join us for the 8th running of Run Deo Run as we raise funds for LAFR's Carl Maravilla Scholarship and Let's Go Run programs.  Run Deo Run Turkey Trot features a flat 5K on the trails of Griffith Park. 

Location & Date
Run Deo Run Turkey Trot 5K will be on Sunday, November 30, in Griffith Park. The start/finish area is the Pecan Grove Picnic Area near the LA Zoo/Autry Museum.  The 5K is a mostly flat out and back course along the main trail.

Start Time
Run Deo Run Turkey Trot 5K will start at 8:00 AM.

Virtual Race
If you can't join us race day, please join us by registering for the virtual option.  We will ship your race shirt/medal.

About LA Frontrunners
Los Angeles Frontrunners (501c3) is a running and walking club for members and friends of the LGBTQ+ community.  In addition to running, walking, more running (and lots of eating), LAFR raises funds and collects goods to donate to local charities. Past beneficiaries include; The Rescue Train, Westside Food Bank, SRLA, PAWS/LA, Life Worth Saving, Friends of Griffith Park, InsideOut Community Arts, Friends of Project 10, Angel City Pit Bulls, The Breakfast Club at St. Thomas the Apostle, and the Don Thompson Scholarship at the USC Film School.

name: Run Deo Run Turkey Trot 5K
description:

Run Deo Run Turkey Trot 5K will be on Sunday, November 30, in Griffith Park. The start/finish area is the Pecan Grove Picnic Area near the LA Zoo/Autry Museum.  The 5K is a mostly flat out and back course along the main trail.

Run Deo Run Turkey Trot 5K will start at 8:00 AM.

name: Run for Austin's Lungs
description:
Run for Austin’s Lungs is a family-friendly 5K walk/run held in honor of baby Austin, who is bravely battling chronic lung disease. Join us to celebrate his first birthday, raise awareness of his Chronic Lung disease, and support his ongoing medical care. Every step taken helps give Austin the breath of a brighter future.

The entire registration fee (minus the $4 processing fee) goes directly to Austin’s care. After you register, the site will ask if you’d like to make an additional donation—this can simply be left at $0, meaning your total charge will be $54 for race registration.

If you’d prefer to support Austin without registering for the race, you can do so by selecting the Donate button instead of Sign Up.

name: Run for Breast Cancer 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:

Lace up and make a difference at our annual Breast Cancer Run! Together, we can raise awareness and funds to support those affected by breast cancer. 

Enjoy a spirited day filled with community, inspiration, and hope. Let’s unite for a cause that touches us all and run for a future without breast cancer! Sign up now and help us make a lasting impact!

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.

Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race!

For all the Coffee Lovers, this run is for you! You’ll love the shirt we send you. Set a goal, bring a friend, and join this super fun 5K/10K/13.1 Half-Marathon! The first 5 runners, we'll send you some coffee.  😊 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

☕️ 🏃‍♂️ ☕️ 🏃‍♂️ ☕️ 🏃‍♂️ 

For all the Coffee Lovers, this run is for you! You’ll love the shirt we send you. Set a goal, bring a friend, and join this super fun 5K/10K/13.1 Half-Marathon! The first 5 runners, we'll send you some coffee.  😊 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

name: RUN FOR FREEDOM
description:
Join the Movement and break some chains. This is more than just a race—it's a chance to make a lasting impact in the fight against human trafficking.

Lace up for something bigger than a finish line.
Whether you're running, walking, or cheering from the sidelines, the EDEN 5K/10K is more than a race—it's a movement. The Run for Freedom helps raise funds and awareness to support anti-trafficking organizations. Your participation fuels change, provides resources, and empowers those on the frontlines to continue to bring hope to survivors.

Tentative schedule of the day

6:00-7:00 a.m. Vendor set-up

7:00-8:30 a.m. Registration/packet pick up

8:15 a.m. Warm Up

8:30 a.m. Speakers

9:00 am 5K/10k Run/Walk

11:00-11:30 Post race speaker program

7 a.m.-12.30 p.m. Vendor Expo & Entertainment

Scenic Lakeside 5k Course

Our 5K course takes you along a beautiful lakeside road at Bonelli Regional Park, with views of sparkling Puddingstone Lake and rolling hills all around. The route features a mix of flat stretches and a few gentle inclines to keep things fun and challenging.

As you run, you’ll be surrounded by mountain backdrops, lush greenery, and open skies—perfect for an energizing morning on the move. Bonelli Park is a favorite spot for local runners, cyclists, and nature lovers, and you’ll see why: the course combines scenic beauty with a welcoming, race-day atmosphere.

Whether you’re walking, jogging, or aiming for a personal record, this course offers a little bit of everything—lake views, shady sections, rolling terrain, and plenty of inspiration.

Scenic Lakeside 10k Course

Our 10K course begins on the same scenic lakeside road as the 5K, letting you take in the sparkling waters of Puddingstone Lake and the mountain views that make Bonelli Park so special.

At the halfway point, the course branches off to bring you onto park trails and rolling hills, adding a little more adventure and challenge. You’ll experience a blend of paved paths, natural terrain, and inclines that keep things exciting while still being very runnable.

With the combination of lake views, shaded sections, open trails, and mountain backdrops, the 10K is a rewarding course for both seasoned runners and those looking to push themselves a bit further.

Come ready for a mix of beauty and challenge—the 10K at Bonelli Park offers an unforgettable run surrounded by nature.

 

Registration Includes:
Race bib
Event shirt
Finisher’s medal

Together, we aim to raise $25,000

RAIN OR SHINE and NO REFUNDS

name: RUN FOR FREEDOM
description:
Join the Movement and break some chains. This is more than just a race—it's a chance to make a lasting impact in the fight against human trafficking.

Lace up for something bigger than a finish line.
Whether you're running, walking, or cheering from the sidelines, the EDEN 5K/10K is more than a race—it's a movement. The Run for Freedom helps raise funds and awareness to support anti-trafficking organizations. Your participation fuels change, provides resources, and empowers those on the frontlines to continue to bring hope to survivors.

Tentative schedule of the day

6:00-7:00 a.m. Vendor set-up

7:00-8:30 a.m. Registration/packet pick up

8:15 a.m. Warm Up

8:30 a.m. Speakers

9:00 am 5K/10k Run/Walk

11:00-11:30 Post race speaker program

7 a.m.-12.30 p.m. Vendor Expo & Entertainment

Scenic Lakeside 5k Course

Our 5K course takes you along a beautiful lakeside road at Bonelli Regional Park, with views of sparkling Puddingstone Lake and rolling hills all around. The route features a mix of flat stretches and a few gentle inclines to keep things fun and challenging.

As you run, you’ll be surrounded by mountain backdrops, lush greenery, and open skies—perfect for an energizing morning on the move. Bonelli Park is a favorite spot for local runners, cyclists, and nature lovers, and you’ll see why: the course combines scenic beauty with a welcoming, race-day atmosphere.

Whether you’re walking, jogging, or aiming for a personal record, this course offers a little bit of everything—lake views, shady sections, rolling terrain, and plenty of inspiration.

Scenic Lakeside 10k Course

Our 10K course begins on the same scenic lakeside road as the 5K, letting you take in the sparkling waters of Puddingstone Lake and the mountain views that make Bonelli Park so special.

At the halfway point, the course branches off to bring you onto park trails and rolling hills, adding a little more adventure and challenge. You’ll experience a blend of paved paths, natural terrain, and inclines that keep things exciting while still being very runnable.

With the combination of lake views, shaded sections, open trails, and mountain backdrops, the 10K is a rewarding course for both seasoned runners and those looking to push themselves a bit further.

Come ready for a mix of beauty and challenge—the 10K at Bonelli Park offers an unforgettable run surrounded by nature.

name: RUN FOR PIE 2025
description:
NOVEMBER 27th, 2025

Sponsored by: Brooks Running & Beckmann's

Come join us on Thanksgiving morning for our 13th annual Thanksgiving Day race! Run For Pie has become one of Santa Cruz County's favorite holiday traditions. Bring the whole family (or your pet turkey) out to run or walk a 5K. Run for Pie also includes a 1/2 mile Turkey Chase Race for kids. All participants get a slice of pumpkin pie at the finish. This event will benefit the Second Harvest Food Bank and the Soquel High School Track Team. With the high demand for this race every year, we have decided to cap registrations, so be sure to register your friends and family before our race sells out! 

Kids 1/2 Mile: All proceeds from this race will go to Second Harvest Food Bank. We are hoping to donate over 12,000 meals this year!

How to register for the Pie Mile Relay: The relay will consist of 4 individuals and each individual will need to register. When you are registering for this specific race, place your first name and next to your last name place your team name. This way we can keep track of full teams. 

Packet Pick Up: 

For a smoother and more enjoyable Thanksgiving morning, we strongly recommend picking up your race bib and shirt ahead of time. Here are the available dates and times for packet pickup:

Tuesday, November 25th (Fleet Feet Aptos): 3:00 pm - 7:00 pm

Wednesday, November 26th (Fleet Feet Aptos): 10:00 am - 6:00 pm 

RACE MORNING- Thursday, November 27th (Soquel High School): 7:40 am - 8:20 am

 

Race Start Times: 

Kids 1/2 Mile: 8:35 am 

5k Start Time: 9:05 am 

Pie Mile Relay Start Time: 10:15 am 

 

🎉 Exciting Event Highlights! 🎉

☕ FREE Coffee!
The first 400 participants will receive a FREE cup of coffee provided by The Loft Coffee – don’t miss out!

🎨 Kids' Coloring Station
Let your little ones get creative at our Kids Coloring Station, brought to you by The Art Factory.

📸 FREE Photo Booth Fun
Capture unforgettable moments with family and friends at our FREE Photo Booth – memories you’ll treasure!

Come join the fun — there's something for everyone!

Price Increase Dates:

September - November 26th: $45 

November 27th - November 28th: $55

Pricing Update:

Why the random price? Due to the new California Price Transparency Act, we are required to show the price with processing fees added. The price that it is displaying is the $45 + processing fee. We are sorry for any confusion. If you have any questions, please reach out to the race director, amber.melville@fleetfeet.com.

 AWARDS

 All races will be professionally chip timed, and awards will be given to the overall male and female winner for the 5K race. The first female and male winner will receive an engraved Fork, engraved pie plate and a pair of Currex insoles. We will also have awards for the Top Age Group winners 13-20, 21-30, 31-40, 41-50, 51-60, 61-70, 71-80, 81 - 90. 

We will have a Top Male and Female Winner who will receive a Custom Pie Plate and an engraved fork 

Pie Mile Relay team that wins will receive an exciting prize for each team member of the winning team.

Race Shirt Details: 

You can purchase a t-shirt during registration for $5. 

Questions: 

If you have any questions regarding Fleet Feet Aptos 12th Annual Run For Pie race, please reach out to the Race Director, Amber Melville (amber.melville@fleetfeet.com).

name: Run for the Beads - Mardi Gras Run 5K, 10K, & Half Marathon
description:
Get ready to let the good times roll at the Run for the Beads! This festive Mardi Gras-themed race is the perfect way to celebrate the season with friends, family, and your running shoes. Whether you’re a seasoned runner chasing a personal record or simply looking for a fun and colorful event, this race promises miles of smiles and vibrant energy.

Join us  for an unforgettable run in Santa Monica. Deck yourself out in Mardi Gras colors of purple, green, and gold, and prepare for an event packed with fun surprises, festive music, and plenty of beads!

Event Highlights:

Beads & Bling: Grab your Mardi Gras beads as you dash along the course!


Mardi Gras Vibes: Experience a festive atmosphere with live music, great vibes, and colorful decorations.


Photo Ops: Pose with vibrant backdrops featuring crowns, masks, and beads for the perfect race-day memory.


Post-Race Celebration: Celebrate your finish with live music, refreshments, and festive treats, including a taste of King Cake!


Race Options:

Distances: 5K, 10K, and Half Marathon


Bib Pick-Up & Start Times:


Bib Pick-Up: 6:00 AM – 7:35 AM (Race Ready Athletics Tent)
Half Marathon Start: 7:00 AM
5K & 10K Start: 7:30 AM


Important: There are no late starts. Please arrive early to ensure you're ready for your race!
 
 
Parking Information:

Beach lot parking is available. Price may vary $9.00 to $12.00. Please pay at matching in lot. Takes card only, no tap to pay. 


Additional Race Day Info:

Restrooms are located near the start line.
Water and aid stations every 2 miles.
Stroller and walker-friendly event.
Course is fully marked.

 


Weather & Safety:


This is a RAIN or SHINE Event
In case of severe weather, (Like tsunamis, titlewave, or zombie apocalypse),  updates will be provided via email and our social media channels.
 
Join the Community:

Tag us on social media with #CaliFlowRuns for a chance to be featured! Tune in on Fridays for a chance to win a free race by answering our #FreeEntryFriday questions.

name: Run for the Fallen 10K-5K-Kids Race at Merced College
description:
SUNDAY, NOVEMBER 9th at MERCED COLLEGE

Opening Ceremonies begin at 8:30am.  Kids Race starts at 8:45am and the 5K/10K starts at 9:00am... RAIN or SHINE.

                       

On Flag Day, June 14, 2008, a dedicated team of runners participated in the first Run for the Fallen and ran 4100 miles across America from Fort Irwin, CA to Arlington National Cemetery, one mile for every Soldier, Sailor, Airmen, and Marine killed since the War on Terror began. In 2018 on its tenth anniversary Honor and Remember expanded the initial run by creating America’s Run for the Fallen, the most comprehensive fallen veteran tribute to date. April 7th - August 5th, covering 6,000 miles over 120 days through 19 states honoring over 20,000 service members.

Each year since the first run across America, runners from around the world have joined Run for the Fallen in remembering our fallen. Over 50,000+ participants and over 200,000+ miles have been collectively run in remembrance of those heroes, organized in over 26 states.  Help us keep the memory of our local fallen heroes alive by joining us at Merced College on Sunday, November 10th.

The Merced Sunrise Rotary Club would like to invite you, your family, and your friends to this year’s Run for the Fallen and Field of Honor events.  On Sunday, November 9th, the FREE 5KRun/Walk & 10K Run will start at 9am.  The start and finish will take place near the main lawn where the Field of Honor is located at Merced College near M St./Yosemite Ave.  All participants will be chip-timed and eligible to receive a 1st, 2nd, or 3rd Place medal in all male and female Age-groups.  Those Age-groups are: 10 & under, 11-13, 14-18, 19-29, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, 60-69, and 70+.  Commemorative t-shirts will be sold for $25 on race day and only while supplies last, with all proceeds donated to the Merced Field of Honor.  We thank you for your support, in advance.

All participants are invited to attend a short ceremony at 8:30am where our local fallen heroes will be honored.  That will be followed by the start of the Kids Race at approximately 8:45am and the 5K/10K at 9am.  ONLINE REGISTRATION DEADLINE:  SATURDAY, NOVEMBER 8th at 6:00pm.  You may register on race day from 7:00am to 8:15am.  All those that pre-register must pick up their bibs between 7:00am-8:15am. To view the course map, click on the link below.   

Stay safe and we hope you will join us.  See you at the race!

In 2018 on its tenth anniversary Honor and Remember expanded the initial run by creating America’s Run for the Fallen, the most comprehensive fallen veteran tribute to date. April 7th - August 5th, covering 6,000 miles over 120 days through 19 states honoring over 20,000 service members.

Each year since the first run across America, runners from around the world have joined Run for the Fallen in remembering our fallen. Over 50,000+ participants and over 200,000+ miles have been collectively run in remembrance of those heroes, organized in over 26 states.  Help us keep the memory of our local fallen heroes alive by joining us at Merced College on Sunday, November 10th.

The Merced Sunrise Rotary Club would like to invite you, your family, and your friends to this year’s Run for the Fallen and Field of Honor events.  On Sunday, November 9th, the FREE 5KRun/Walk & 10K Run will start at 9am.  The start and finish will take place near the main lawn where the Field of Honor is located at Merced College near M St./Yosemite Ave.  All participants will be chip-timed and eligible to receive a 1st, 2nd, or 3rd Place medal in all male and female Age-groups.  Those Age-groups are: 10 & under, 11-13, 14-18, 19-29, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, 60-69, and 70+.  Commemorative t-shirts will be sold for $25 on race day and only while supplies last, with all proceeds donated to the Merced Field of Honor.  We thank you for your support, in advance.

All participants are invited to attend a short ceremony at 8:30am where our local fallen heroes will be honored.  That will be followed by the start of the Kids Race at approximately 8:45am and the 5K/10K at 9am.  ONLINE REGISTRATION DEADLINE:  SATURDAY, NOVEMBER 8th at 6:00pm.  You may register on race day from 7:00am to 8:15am.  All those that pre-register must pick up their bibs between 7:00am-8:15am. To view the course map, click on the link below.   

Stay safe and we hope you will join us.  See you at the race!

name: Run In The New Year 5k/10K/Half Marathon
description:
It's SoCal's HEALTHIEST LIVE PARTY!  LIVE BAND at  the START/FINISH and  the course! It's YOUR NEW YEAR'S CELEBRATION. WITH New Year's BLING!

Sunday, Dec. 28, 2025

  • 8:00 am Half Marathon Start

  • 8:15 am Kid's Dash

  • 8:30 am 5k/10K Mass Start

Early Packet Pick-Up: We encourage you to pick up the day prior

    • Date & Time: Saturday, December 27th, 11am to 2pm

    • Location: Road Runner Sports in Newport Beach 1835 Newport Blvd, Costa Mesa, CA 92627

    • Packet pick-up is optional, so if you cannot make it- don't worry. Packets can be picked up on race day starting at 7 am in LOT 25. The gates to the STATE PARK open at 6 am.

Write a New Year resolution on the back of your bib and RUN, JOG, or WALK it into the new year. 

The course is the flat and fast, paved, wide State Park path, watching and listening to the surf.! Whether an avid runner, jogger, first-timer, or walker, we are the something for every BODY & EVERYBODY best-themed race! Bring family and friends, or just yourself and shoes! Let's get 2024 off and  RUNNING. 

  Entry comes with a Run In The New Year CUSTOM 5K/10K T-Shirt

  Special LONG SLEEVE DESIGN T-shirt for Half Marathon Finishers

  And, a huge CUSTOM CAST finisher medal to all! HUGE!!

Make it a Post-race 5K/10K resolution party (Beach balls, New Year's Beanies, & party Champaign glasses will be for sale at the t-shirt table.

GEAR CHECK is available, if needed, at the Caren Ware Events BOOTH.  Put your bib number on a tag and pin to your gear.  

Professionally CHIP timed event by ITZ ABOUT TIME. Age division awards galore!

Entrance to Bolsa Chica State Park.

The event is in the farthest western lot- Lot 25, closest to Warner & PCH, but to enter the park use the following address: 17851 Pacific Coast Hwy.
**BRING $15 CASH (or a park pass) to make the gate line proceed quickly.  Credit cards slow the process.

FREE OR METERED PARKING: There is also parking behind the Jack and the Box (corner of Warner and PCH ) and an easy walk in.  DO NOT PARK in the shopping lot or at the gas station.

Race Day Schedule:

  • 6:00 am: Gates Open
  • 7:00 am: Race Day Packet Pick-Up Begins (Lot 25)
  • 7:30 am Half Marathon Start for those that will take more than 3 hours and 45 minutes to finish
  • 8:00 am: Half Marathon Start (Must cross the starting arch by 8:05 am)
  • 8:15 am: Kid’s Dash
  • 8:30am: 5K/10K Mass Start (Must cross the starting arch by 9:05 am)
  • 9:00am: 5K Awards Ceremony begins.
  • 9:30 am 10K awards
  • 9:50 announcing of overall Half marathon awards
  • Half marathon age division winners can pick up division awards at the table or wait until the 10:15 age division announcements. 

SPECIAL PANCAKE BREAKFAST!!!!  The famous KIWANIS pineapple/coconut pancakes at this EVENT!!!  $5 pre. $6 on race morning.  You can add pancakes to your registration on the last page.Plus, COFFEE . Visit the SOL Y LUNA  COFFEE BAR CART, Fresh baked cookies (GALLETINAS BOOTH),  fresh cut fruits,  and street tacos will be there.
BRING EXTRA MONEY FOR ACAI BOWLS!!!  Fresh made at the Acai Republic booth. 

8:00 am start for HALF MARATHON.  You have until 8:05 to pass under the arch.  9:00am start for 5k/10K.  You have until 9:05 am to pass under the arch.  All 5k/10K must start before the lead half marathoner finishes.   YOUR START TIME does not start until you cross under the arch. Fastest runners in the front, and those looking to place in their age group division. Wear your bib on the front.  Make sure you run the distance on your bib or exchange it for the correct one of your choice at the Solutions/Late registration table if you decide to change races.

Awards:

There are “In It To Win It” age categories 3 deep with 5 year age spans: 1-10, 11-14, 15-19, 20-24, 25-29, 30-34, 35-39 40-44, 45-49, 50-54,55-59 60-64, 65-69, 70-74, 75-79, 80-84 and 85 & over.

Course

Flat and fast, or slow and easy, make it the pace you want it. This 5K/10K course runs along the beach bike path at Bolsa Chica, Huntington Beach State Beach. Families can bring strollers but agree to use at their own risk.  Half Marathon Course: Flat, fast, perfect for PRs or training for your next marathon.  It is (2)Two loops of the 10k so you get plenty of aid stations, entertainment, and spectator friendly!! Aid Station Every 1.5 Miles

  • Water/Gatorade
  • Chargel/ Bananas  

FLAT!!! Great for first-time Half Marathoners or those wanting to PR!
Half Marathon Spectators - you can be at the finish line to see runners start then walk about 50 ft towards the runners to see them go on their second loop.

Restrooms:

Restrooms on RACE DAY: are located at each end of the parking lot.  A set by Sea Legs (east) and a set near  Warner Blvd on the west end of the parking lot.

name: Run LA "City of Angels" 5K/10K/13.1 FALL
description:
This exciting run is your chance to experience your city like never before. Whether you're racing for a personal best or just out for a fun stroll with friends, this event is all about celebrating the energy and spirit of the local City.
The course will guide you through iconic landmarks and hidden gems that make this City one-of-a-kind. As you race through the heart of it all, enjoy the sights, sounds, and community spirit that make this run a truly special experience!
Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

description:
Join us for a 4th of July celebration, the Run Like a Hero 5k presented by Chico Striders and Chico Running Club. Race proceeds benefit Chico Striders Run Strong Scholarship presented to graduating high school senior athletes. Our theme this year is Run Like a Hero- wear your favorite hero costume or best Independence Day attire!

Date: Saturday July 4th, 2026 @ 7:30am
Registration: Will be available until 11:30pm on July 3rd. No race day registration is available.
Location: Sycamore Field, Bidwell Park - (Google Map)
Parking: At Vallombrosa Way, CARD HQ parking lot on Vallombrosa Ave or Woodland Ave

Bibs and Timing: Bibs will be given to all race entrants. Packet pick-up will be at Fleet Feet Thursday July 3rd between 11am-1pm. Bib pick-up can also be done the day of the race at Sycamore Field, starting at 7:00am. Timing will be performed by Chico Running Club.

Discounted Registration: Chico Striders and Chico Running Club Members receive $10 off race registration, select the Striders/CRC option Team option. For non members please select No Team. Please do not register for the discounted race fee if you are not a running club member.

Refreshments: Drinks and snacks will be provided after the race. Please stay after completing the race to cheer on other participants as they cross the finish.

Volunteers: Not ready to participate? Volunteers are needed and welcome for this race. Please click on the volunteer tab in the RunSignUp menu to sign up.

Race Insurance: Is provided by a RunSignUp partner. Chico Running Club does not provide or administer race insurance should participants elect to purchase it.

name: Run Like It's Recess 5K
description:
Join us for the 14th Annual Run Like It’s Recess 5K Run/Walk, 1K, and Toddler Run

​

5K Start Time: 9 am

1K Start Time: 10:15 am

Toddler Run Start Time: 10:45

​

This annual event is hosted by Newcomb Academy PTSA, which serves Newcomb Academy (Grades K–8), a public school in the Long Beach Unified School District.  
A school fundraiser and a way to promote health and fitness to the entire area. This family-friendly event is open to all ages and fitness levels. Stroller and wheelchair friendly.  

​

​

​

Medals will be given to all finishers with awards for the top three 5K finishers in each age group. FREE shirt and goody bag guaranteed if registered by January 7th, 2026 at 11:59 pm, after that date your shirt may not be available.


The Course: Flat, fast, and scenic. It takes place at El Dorado Park East in Long Beach, near the train and playground area. If you’re looking to set a personal record or if you just want to take it easy and take in the scenery, this is the perfect course.

name: Run Rudolph Run
description:
Run Rudolph Run is the Monterey Peninsula's most treasured holiday run. Join us to raise awareness of and help defeat arthritis. Bring friends and family together to kick off the season of giving, decked out in holiday attire! Whether you are a serious runner, a costumed walker, or somewhere in-between, this special event is a great addition to your holiday season, oceanside in beautiful Pacific Grove. Dogs are welcome (however, must remain on a leash).

Date: Saturday, December 13, 2025

Time: 7:30am - 11:30am

Location: Lover’s Point Park, 631 Ocean View Blvd., Pacific Grove, CA 93953

Activities: 

1k Kids Elf Run
5k walk / run (timed optional)
Holiday costume contest for humans and pooches
Photos with Santa 
Children's fun zone

name: Run Run Rudolph 2 Mile Run/Walk
description:
RUN RUN RUDOLPH BENEFITS HANFORD'S POLICE ACTIVITIES LEAGUE - PAL

 

Register Now and experience the BEST 2 Mile Christmas Run/Walk around, it's a Winter Wonderland in Hanford!

This is a great way to enjoy the holiday season with family and friends, with an awesome route through Historic Downtown Hanford.

Come and experience the 2 Mile Run/Walk, it might just be the BEST 2 Mile, Costume Contest, Event in the Valley! It will also feature a Kid's Reindeer Run. You can even create a Team when you register. Your Team can be made of your family, co-workers, friends, or even with Santa's reindeers.

What a great way to start (or continue for many of you) a family tradition, and it's supporting Hanford's Police Activities League (P.A.L).

 

INCLUDED WITH YOUR REGISTRATION

  • Run Run Rudolph Long-Sleeve Sport-Tek Race Shirt (gender and youth specific)
  • Custom Run Run Rudolph Finisher's Medal 
  • Kids Race Finisher's Medal (Kids get Reindeer Antlers)
  • FREE Race Photos
  • SANTA Visit
  • Course is Closed - FAST & FLAT
  • Overall Male & Female 2Mile Awards
  • Age Group Awards 
  • Costume Contests, including Fur-Contest for your dog(s)
  • Chip Timed Race (Kids Race is not timed)

Packet Pick-Up: SATURDAY, DECEMBER 20th - Civic Center Park 317 N Douty Street, Hanford, CA 93230 (10:30am - 1:00pm)

Race Day Packet Pick-Up: SUNDAY, December 21st, at Hanford Civic Center Park, 317 N Douty Street, starting at 7:30am (Start/Finish Line)

Want to Become an Event Sponsor? Scroll down and click the "Become a Sponsor" link

RACE DAY SCHEDULE:

8:15am - Kids Reindeer Fun Run (All Kids Get a Medal!)

8:30am - 2 Mile Run/Walk (All Participants Get a Medal!)

name: Run SACRAMENTO "City of Trees" 5K/10K/13.1 FALL
description:
This exciting run is your chance to experience your city like never before. Whether you're racing for a personal best or just out for a fun stroll with friends, this event is all about celebrating the energy and spirit of the local City.
The course will guide you through iconic landmarks and hidden gems that make this City one-of-a-kind. As you race through the heart of it all, enjoy the sights, sounds, and community spirit that make this run a truly special experience!
Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

name: Run To Raise 44
description:
Run To Raise™ is an endurance-meets-impact initiative founded by venture capitalist and Marine veteran Paul Anthony Claxton.

Every year around October 15th, his birthday, he’ll run his birthday in miles in 24 hours. No frills, no hype, just grit. The mission: to prove that discipline, purpose, and execution outlast everything else.

This year’s run sets the stage for next year’s "Run To Raise 45" mile event, which will feature sponsorships, donations, and founder applications. All proceeds will go to a winning startup that exemplifies resilience, innovation, and impact.

Every mile represents a founder’s grind: the exhaustion, the setbacks, and the relentless forward motion. Run To Raise™ is where endurance meets entrepreneurship. It’s not just about running far; it’s about raising what matters.

name: Run Your Heart Out – 5K, 10K, 10-Miler, Half Marathon
description:
Race Details

Start Location: Alamitos Beach, 780 E Shoreline Dr. Long Beach, CA
Parking: Parking in the lot is $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free.

Event Schedule

Saturday
1:00-3:00pm – Early bib pick-up on the 2nd floor at Sports Basement Long Beach (store discount sent via email the week of the event)
2100 N Bellflower Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90815

Sunday
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens
7:00am – Half marathon & 10m start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10m)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for 10m and half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Courses

5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route
10m: The 5m route is used for the 10m (two laps) – 5m route
Half: The 5m route is run twice and the 5k route is run once for the Half – 5m route and 5k route

More about the Course

The beach path is an open course, so you will encounter others using it. When we start the race, please stay on the right side of the beach path. The right side is for pedestrians and the left side is for cyclists. 

On-Course Support: A fully stocked water station is located at the Belmont Pier. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, gatorade, gels, and fruit snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk, a runner turn sign, and a flag


Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Awards: 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.
Results: A link for race results and photos will be sent the day after the race. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, the San Fernando Valley, Orange County, and San Diego. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule.

Have Another Question? Check our FAQ page, it's probably answered there!

name: Run4Recovery 5K Run/Walk
description:
Run4Recovery 5K Run/Walk raises awareness and funding to support recovering alcoholics and addicts by providing Sober Living Scholarships—offering shelter, stability, and nourishment to those most vulnerable to relapse.

Through the Puente House Foundation (a 501(c)(3) non-profit), we provide safe housing for individuals who may be dealing with homelessness or are escaping environments filled with drug use and violence.

For many, this scholarship is the difference between life and death. It offers a path to reunite with family, rejoin society, and embrace a pro-recovery lifestyle.

name: Running Is For The Birds - 5K, 10K, Kids Run - Earth Day Celebration
description:
Amigos De Bolsa Chica, in conjunction with Bolsa Chica State Beach is hosting a run/walk/beach cleanup for Earth Day! 

Run for the Birds, Run for the Planet, Run for Earth Day!

Run and walk along the beach on a flat, fast, and paved course.  The event is at Bolsa Chica State Beach, Saturday April 25, 2026 -- all races start at 8:00 AM, but be there beforehand for FREE BEACH PARKING! 

You can register to run/walk a Plover Dash 5K, Brown Pelican 10K, Fuzzy Feathers fun run (for the kiddos), 5K Plogging (picking up litter while jogging), 10K Plogging, or a Beach Clean Up with State Beach!

Every participant in the Plover Dash 5K, Brown Pelican 10K, and Plogging events will recieve:

🏅 Custom Commemorative Medal – designed exclusively for this event.
👕 Limited-Edition Race Shirt – created by a local artist, featuring a different Bolsa Chica bird each year (a collectible piece of art you’ll want to wear proudly).
📸 Free Race Day Photos – downloadable and shareable, NO hidden costs.
🏆 Overall & Age Group Awards – recognition for top finishers in multiple categories.
⏱️ New & Professional Chip Timing – results automatically synced to Athlinks.
🎪 Finish Line Festival – with vendors, product samples, music, and HB community vibes.

🌴 Race Day Details
📍 Location: Lot 25, Bolsa Chica State Beach
🕖 Check-in: 7:00 AM - 
🏁 5K & 10K Start: 8:00 AM
🦜 Kids Fun Run: 9:00 AM
✅ FREE Beach Parking — but we encourage you to go green!
🚲 Bike to the event and enjoy our safe-keeping Bike Valet just steps from the start line.
🎒 Gear Check Available – store your personal items securely while you run.

**Fuzzy Feathers Kids Run participants recieve commemorative medals & special prizes for their participation**

Check in begins at 7am in lot 25 at Bolsa Chica State Beach.  5K and 10K begin at 8am.  Kids fun run starts at 9am.  

✨ Bonus Highlights

  • Environmental Impact – proceeds go to educational programs for children, schools, & the public; optional plogging categories combine running with cleanup.

  • Community Connection – a welcoming event for runners, walkers, families, and volunteers!

Proceeds help the Amigos de Bolsa Chica's (a 501c3 non-profit established in 1976) efforts to offer environmental leadership roles to all by providing community-based education programs centered on the Bolsa Chica that create greater awareness of coastal California's threatened biodiversity. 

There is a family friendly expo before and after the race, showing what the Amigos de Bolsa Chica is all about.  Look at Bolsa Chica Ecological Reserve water samples through microscopes, learn about the wetlands and the birds that visit there, and explore what we can do to protect the environment and the wildlife of the wetlands.

Join us this Earth Day — and make your miles matter. 🌎💚

description:

name: Ruth McKenzie Preserve Half Marathon | 10k | 5k | Kids Race
description:
The Ruth McKenzie Table Mountain Preserve (2960 acres) is located between Friant and Prather, on the north side of Auberry Road. The main gate is 3.3 miles uphill from the intersection of Auberry Road and Millerton Road.

The McKenzie Preserve was acquired in trust from The Nature Conservancy in 1998. The property had previously been placed in a trust by its owner, Ruth Bea McKenzie, who wanted it to remain in ranching and open space after her death.The McKenzie Preserve is primarily grassland and oak woodland that slopes upward toward the basalt lava table lands that give the preserve its name.

The preserve includes a significant portion of one of the flat-topped tables that are visible from the road. In spring, rain water collects in the table’s low spots, forming vernal pools. Since the basalt is impermeable, these pools hold water for several weeks or months until it eventually evaporates. The pools provide habitat for rare plants and crustaceans that “come to life” in the presence of the water. When the pools dry up in late spring, these crustaceans become seeds or cysts in order to survive the rest of the year. On the far side of the table formations, out of sight of Auberry Road, the land slopes steeply down to the San Joaquin River. These north-facing slopes sustain an excellent mix of pine forest and chaparral. The preserve also includes a 47-acre parcel along the creek on the south side.

name: San Bernardino County Sheriff's Mud Run
description:
****RACE DAY INFO****

On Saturday, October 18, 2025, the Sheriff's Athletic Federation will be hosting the annual San Bernardino County Sheriff's Mud Run. Please join us for our 5k mud run and 1k children's race.  

  • 5K RACE STARTS AT 9 AM
  • 1K KID'S RACE STARTS AT 12 PM

Please allow enough time to park (Free), pick up your timing bib, and prepare for the race. There will be vendors and food available for purchase. Our San Bernardino County Explorers will be duct-taping shoes for a donation and having a bag check for $5.00. All money from these services will benefit our explorer program.  There will be water stations throughout the course. At the end of the race, there will be an area to rinse off.

Awards will be given out before the start of the kid's race.  Awards are as follows.

  • Top Three Male Individuals
  • Top Three Female Individuals
  • Top Three Teams
  • Top SBCSD Station Team

name: San Diego 50 & Trail Runs
description:
SAN DIEGO 50M | TRAIL MARATHON | RELAY | HALF MARATHON | SUMMIT CHASE 10M | VALLEY 5M | STROLLER 5K | KID'S 1 MILE

                       

The San Diego 50M is a great introduction into ultra marathons or your first 50M distance, ideal for all running levels.

The San Diego Trail Marathon is a staple in the trail marathon events. Enjoy a fast trail while getting to summit its high point of Raptor Ridge. 

NEW Sand Diego Trail Marathon Relay is a new format to our classic Trail Marathon. Run 13.1 before passing off to your team mate to run the last 13.1 miles finishing at our Official Finish Line. * Note there will not be a shuttle. Easy Pick Up Drop Offs available at the Piedras Parking Trail Head Parking Lot.

The San Diego Trail Heavy Half Marathon is a beautiful courses for exploring new trails and accomplishing race goals as it gives you just that little more than a half marathon.

NEW Summit Chase 10M conquer and claim the CROWN on the fast out and back course up to the top of Raptor Ridge. The fastest time out and back claims the crown.

NEW Valley 5M our flat 5 plus mile event gives you a introduction distance and amazing valley views.

NEW Stroller Trail 5k our flat 5k (3.1 Mile)  event gives you a super flat course to get out with your little ones and enjoy the day.

The Elevated Youth 1 Mile is open to children 10 and younger. This is a non-timed run. All kids receive a finisher’s shirt/medal 

                                                           Whether you sprint, run, walk, jog, or hike this event you do not want to miss.

                                             We are a CUPLESS race series. Please make sure to bring some form of hydration vessel to carry hydration for your event. There will not be cups provided at aid stations.

name: San Diego Beach & Bay Half Marathon
description:
The San Diego Beach & Bay Half Marathon is an award-winning loop course along some of the best of San Diego’s coastline. Experience beautiful beaches to picturesque bays, you’ll run past SeaWorld, Belmont Park, Mission Beach, Pacific Beach, and Sail Bay — the best of San Diego in one unforgettable course.

With only 165 feet of total elevation gain, this is one of California’s flattest and fastest half marathons — perfect for chasing a  PR or enjoying the ultimate destination race in San Diego.

Register today and join us on April 11, 2026.

name: San Diego Holiday Half Marathon & 5K
description: The San Diego Holiday Half Marathon is a fast 13.1-mile course that starts on Penasquitos Drive in front of the Hotel Karlan (formerly, the Doubletree Golf Resort) then travels SW along Carmel Mountain Rd (your only ‘real’ hill at mile 1.5), along the 56 bike path and finishes at the beautiful Torrey Pines State Beach (pictured above!). The race includes a 711-foot net elevation drop along the “rolling” downhill bike path, which also makes it a personal best candidate. This popular winter half has been a sell-out event every year. Get your end-of-the-year PR!!!

name: San Diego MLK 5K Walk / Fun Run
description:
RESULTS:  Timed Race Results!

Walk, jog or run!  Join us on Harbor Dr. to celebrate MLK weekend in a healthy fashion with a scenic Embarcadero experience!  This 5K Walk / Fun Run celebrates the legacy of Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. and his dream to improve the equal participation of all in healthcare, education and workforce development.  We're inspired to help move our community toward a more healthy way of living.  What better way to do that than with the objective of completing a 5k.  Bring your family and friends (human and furry) to the Embarcadero and get moving with us!  See you at the starting line! 

 

We hope to inspire those who have never taken part in a 5K walk / run, to participate.  This event promotes health, fitness, and a general sense of well-being through a fun and engaging manner.

 

"School" option with age based pricing intended to be free for school age kids is active.  

 

We encourage you to post your photos on Social Media with #SDMLK5k.  

 

Registration includes the following. 

  • Official 5K walk / fun run Shirt.
  • Medal
  • Runners Bib
  • Chip race timing

 

5K details:

  • Start Line Location: 1492 N. Harbor Dr. (Corner of Harbor Dr. and Ash, near Waterfront Park.)
  • Start Time: 9:00AM
  • Finish Line Location:  (Corner of Harbor Dr. and Ash, near Waterfront Park.)
  • Scenic 3.1-mile course down Harbor Dr., crossing into Seaport Village continuing along the harbor coastline and looping around back to the start.  
  • Timing offered.

 

1 Mile Cruiser Walk / Run:

  • Start Line Location: 1492 N. Harbor Dr. (Corner of Harbor Dr. and Ash, near Waterfront Park.)
  • Start Time: 9:00AM
  • Finish Line Location:  1492 N. Harbor Dr. (Corner of Harbor Dr. and Ash, near Waterfront Park.)
  • Scenic 1-mile course down Harbor Dr., crossing into Seaport Village to loop around back to the start.
  • No timing.

 

Virtual participation:  (Anytime & Anyplace!)

For participants who can’t make it to the site but still want to participate and benefit the San Diego Alpha Foundation (501c3)!  Please sign up with the virtual option.  Complete your distance anytime & anyplace during race week and post your results to the virtual leaderboard.  Your race shirt and medal will be mailed to you within 2 weeks of the event date.  

 

Race packet pickup:

  • Date:   Fri. 1/16
  • Time:  3pm - 8pm
  • Place:  Neighborhood House Association (Kearny Mesa):  5660 Copley Dr, San Diego, CA 92111.

You can also pick up the day of the 5k onsite during check in.  

 
Sponsorship Opportunities:  Please visit us here.-->MLK Weekend Sponsorship Info.

 

San Diego Alpha Foundation is a 501(c)(3) organization.  EIN 46-3297383.  We support the Zeta Sigma Lambda Chapter of Alpha Phi Alpha Fraternity, Inc. in fostering brotherhood, promoting academic excellence, & providing unparalleled service to the community.

name: San Joaquin River Trail 10k/25k/50k
description:
Come out and run some of the best trails in the valley along Millerton Lake and the San Joaquin River. 

More info at: www.SanJoaquinRunning.com

Start/Finish: At the S. Finegold Pinic Area, located at the end of Sky Harbour Road in Friant, CA. Sky Harbor Road is located on the West side of Table Mountain Casino off of Millerton Rd. in Friant, Ca. Take Sky Harbor Rd North for approx. 6 miles and it will dead end at the South Finegold Picnic Area where parking is located. 

Start times: 50k – 0630am  •  25k – 0700am  •  10k – 0730am 

Packet Pickup/Check in: Race day at the Start/Finish area. Please arrive arrive early to get your bib, check in and hit the bathroom. NO RACE DAY ENTRIES.

Race Day Check In: 0540-0620am for 50k runners  •  0600-0655am for 25k runners •  0640-0725am for 25k runners <br /><br />

Pacers: Allowed for the 50k at Mile 16 (SJR Gorge/Aid Station #3&4)

Official cutoff for the Finish line will be 5:30pm 

Lodging: If you're traveling from out of town the nearest places to stay will be in Clovis, CA and Fresno, CA.

Camping: Camping is available on the North side of Millerton Lake and also near the 50k turnaround at the San Joaquin River Gorge Mgmt area, each is about a 30 min drive from the Start/Finish. No camping is available at the Start/Finish.

Refunds/Transfer: No refunds after 09/01/2024. Bib transfers are allowed until 10/01/2024.

Crew access: Crew access at San Joaquin River Gorge Management Area near the Ya Gub Weh Tuh Campground-Mile 14.5 for 50k 

Aid Stations: Aid stations will be almost every 5 miles along the course. They will have water, sports drink, gels, fruit, snacks and basic first aid. 

Drop Bags: Need to be marked "Drop bags" with bib# conspicuously written on it. They will be at San Joaquin River Gorge Management Area, Ya Gub Weh Tuh Campground.

Take Sky Harbor Rd North for approx. 6 miles and it will dead end at the South Finegold Picnic Area where parking is located. 

Start times: 50k – 0630am  •  25k – 0700am  •  10k – 0730am 

Packet Pickup/Check in: Race day at the Start/Finish area. Please arrive arrive early to get your bib, check in and hit the bathroom. NO RACE DAY ENTRIES.

Race Day Check In: 0540-0620am for 50k runners  •  0600-0655am for 25k runners •  0640-0725am for 25k runners <br /><br />

Pacers: Allowed for the 50k at Mile 16 (SJR Gorge/Aid Station #3&4)

Official cutoff for the Finish line will be 5:30pm 

Lodging: If you're traveling from out of town the nearest places to stay will be in Clovis, CA and Fresno, CA.

Camping: Camping is available on the North side of Millerton Lake and also near the 50k turnaround at the San Joaquin River Gorge Mgmt area, each is about a 30 min drive from the Start/Finish. No camping is available at the Start/Finish.

Refunds/Transfer: No refunds after 09/01/2024. Bib transfers are allowed until 10/01/2024.

Crew access: Crew access at San Joaquin River Gorge Management Area near the Ya Gub Weh Tuh Campground-Mile 14.5 for 50k 

Aid Stations: Aid stations will be almost every 5 miles along the course. They will have water, sports drink, gels, fruit, snacks and basic first aid. 

Drop Bags: Need to be marked "Drop bags" with bib# conspicuously written on it. They will be at San Joaquin River Gorge Management Area, Ya Gub Weh Tuh Campground.

name: San Joaquin River Trail Half Marathon & 10K
description:
Come out and run some of the best local trails and a half marathon course that will kick your butt. With approx. 2500' of elevation gain this course won't be your typical stroll in the park. Over 90% single track trail in the foothills, this course could easily become your new favorite. Awards will be given out to top 3 overall Male and Female and 3 deep in age-groups.

 

All Participants Receive: 
Custom Finisher medal
Custom event shirt
Custom Race Awards for Overall & Age Groups

Early Bib/Shirt Pickup
When: Friday, 28th From 3:30-5:30pm
Where: Fleet Feet Sports Fresno 9447 N Fort Washington Suite 106 Fresno, Ca 93730
 
Race Day Bib/Shirt Pickup 
When: Saturday, March 1st 6:30-7:50am in the Start Area
 
Race Location 
San Joaquin River Gorge Special Recreation Management Area
40060 Smalley Road Auberry, CA 93602
Click here for Google Map Directions
Parking
 
Please Carpool if possible. Parking is available near the Start/Finish in the Aholul Campground, additional parking is also available in the lower & upper parking lots and on cleared dirt areas along the roadside, not on the shoulder. 
We will have volunteers directing you upon reaching the Gorge Area
 
Please DO NOT park in the Equestrian Area. 
 
If you arrive late parking will be available down on Smalley Rd.
 
Please do not block the roadway or driveways.
 
 
Race Start Times 
Half Marathon: 8:00am
10k: 8:10am
 
Course Information 
Both the 10k and Half Marathon courses are challenging with steep hills and rough terrain. If you have not run in this area before please know that this course will take you much longer than a road Half Marathon or 10k. With that in mind please plan to carry a handheld water bottle and your preferred nutrition. 
 
Aid Stations: There will be one aid station for the 10k around mile 4. It will have water, GU Gels, Skratch and other snacks.
The Half Marathon Course will have Aid Stations at mile 4, 6, 9.6, & 11.7  
Please make sure any trash stays at the aid station, do not drop it along the course. 
 
Course Markers:  The course will be marked with the following: signs with directional arrows and orange ribbon. The course should be very easy to follow so long as you look for the markers.
 

 
Weather Forecast for Auberry, CA:

 
Awards
Both Half Marathon and 10k Finishers will receive a Finishers medal.
The Half Marathon & 10k will have awards for Top 3 Overall Male & Female finishers.
The Half Marathon & 10k will go 3 deep in 10yr Age Groups for men and women.
 
Post Race
Once you finish we will have refreshments waiting for you.
Please feel free to hang out and enjoy the area and cheer on your fellow runners as they finish.

(Distances are accurately measured using a Rolatape® surveyor's measuring wheel.)

name: Santa Anita Derby Day 5K
description:
Race like a champion before enjoying elite horse racing. This family-friendly event has something for everyone, so gather your loved ones and get ready for an unforgettable day!

Event Highlights:
  • Scenic Course: Run or walk a 5K through the picturesque Los Angeles Arboretum, surrounded by lush greenery and stunning botanical gardens, before finishing on the iconic Santa Anita Race Track.
  • Kids' Races: Young runners can join the fun with two options—a 6-furlong race for ages 7–12, or a quick Homestretch Dash for ages 6 and under—both on the legendary horse track.
  • Post-Event Entertainment: Enjoy the lively post-race expo featuring music, food, a complimentary beer for participants 21+, and the annual Spring Carnival.
  • Free Admission to Derby Day Horse Races: All participants receive complimentary admission and parking to the Derby Day horse races.
  • Medals, Shirts & Timing: Every participant gets a finisher medal, an official event shirt, and chip timing to track your performance.
    Important Information: Registration fees are non-refundable and non-transferable.

name: Santa Clarita Trail Race
description:
EPIC RACE IN THE GOLDEN HILLS OF SANTA CLARITA, CA
5K / 10K / HALF MARATHON / 28K

 

WELCOME RUNNERS
Step into the golden trails of California and join us for the Santa Clarita Trail Race—an unforgettable trail running experience for all levels, brought to you by New Global Adventures, creators of the popular VALENCIA Trail Race and SPACEROCK Trail Race.

 

Set in the historic Placerita Canyon, where gold was first discovered in 1842, this race takes you through some of the most stunning and diverse landscapes in Santa Clarita, CA. From challenging hills and winding trails to breathtaking panoramic views, you’ll experience why Southern California is home to some of the best trail running in the country.

 

Whether you’re aiming for a 5K, 10K, Half Marathon, or the ultimate challenge of the 28K, the Santa Clarita Trail Race offers the perfect race for your goals this November.

Don’t miss your chance to be part of this epic race experience—register today and secure your spot at the start line!

 

A GOLDEN TRAIL RACE EXPERIENCE

 

GOLDEN TRAILS
Glide along flowing singletrack trails and rugged access roads as you journey through the sun-kissed golden hills of Santa Clarita.

 

EPIC HILLS
Brace yourself for heart pounding climbs and exhilarating descents—these hills will push you beyond your limits and ignite your inner warrior.

 

360 VIEWS
Conquer the peaks and be rewarded with breathtaking panoramic views stretching across the stunning Santa Clarita Valley.

 

NATURE
Leave the concrete jungle behind and immerse yourself in nature’s beauty and reconnect with the peaceful, healing landscapes.

 

Learn more at SantaClaritaTrailRace.com

name: Santa Claus For A Cause 5K/10K
description:
Santa Claus with a Cause 5K/10K
📅 Saturday, December 6th, 2025
📍 Bolsa Chica State Beach – Lot 25, Huntington Beach, CA

Get ready for the ultimate Santa celebration at Bolsa Chica State Beach!
This isn’t just a race, it’s a full-blown Christmas experience.

You’ll run along the beach surrounded by falling snow, live carolers, festive music, and holiday cheer. Every runner receives their choice of a full Santa suit, cozy Santa beanie, or custom-designed race shirt, plus one of the biggest, most festive finisher Santa medal designed to double as a Christmas ornament.

And the best part? This race GIVES BACK. Proceeds from the event help gift staple goods, schooling, and hope to villages in Africa and Nepal, as well as supporting local health initiatives.

 
🎄 Race Day Fun & Schedule
Arrive early and soak up the holiday spirit. There’s so much happening before the race even starts!

6:30 – 8:15 AM: Registration and bib pick-up open at Lot 25. Walk-up registrations are welcome, so bring your friends!

7:00 – 9:00 AM: The REAL Santa 🎅 will be on-site for festive selfie photos (use hashtag #carenwareevents or tag us caren.ware.events). Lil Dickens Carolers will be singing, and snow will be falling to set the perfect holiday mood.

8:00 AM: Kids take center stage with the Ho Ho Ho Dashes (200m, 400m, ½ mile, and 1 mile). Cheer on the little elves as they dash through the holiday magic!

8:20 AM: Warm up with the Penguin Macarena! Everyone is invited to join in. Best Costume and Best Christmas Spirit awards are given out here, so come dressed to impress.

8:30 AM: MASS START for the 5K & 10K! Your official time begins when you cross under the start arch, but you must cross by 8:40 AM to be officially timed.

9:20 AM – 5K Awards Ceremony

9:40 AM – 10K Awards Ceremony

11:00 AM - Expo Festivities End

 
🎁 What’s Included
Your registration comes packed with holiday cheer! Every participant receives chip-timed results for the 5K or 10K, so you can track your performance. You’ll also get to choose your festive swag, whether you want to run in a full Santa suit, stay cozy in a Santa beanie, or sport a custom-designed Santa race shirt.

When you cross the finish line, you’ll receive one of the biggest custom Santa-at-the-beach medal that doubles as a Christmas ornament to hang proudly on your tree.

Throughout the morning, enjoy a lively holiday atmosphere with falling snow, live carolers, games, and photo ops with the REAL Santa. Prizes will be awarded for Best Christmas Spirit, Best Costume, and even Best Dressed Doggie, so bring your creativity and holiday cheer.

And don’t leave hungry, we’ll have food vendors on-site serving tamales, tacos, specialty coffee, cookies, fresh fruit and more. Plan on enjoying breakfast by the beach with us after your run!

And for the competitors, we have three-deep age division awards in five-year increments — from ages 1-10 all the way through 85+.

 
📅 Early Packet Pick-Up- Optional
Race Day Pick-Up: 6:30 – 8:15 AM at Lot 25
Early Pick-Up: Thursday, December 4th, 2025, 3:30 – 6:30 PM
📍 Road Runner Sports – 1835 Newport Blvd, Costa Mesa, CA
(No ID required, and you may pick up for others.)
 
🚗 Parking & Drop-Off
Bolsa Chica State Beach Lot 25 parking is $15 per vehicle (cash or state park pass recommended). The main gate opens at 6:00 AM — use the main entrance only.

Drop-off is available at the corner of Warner & PCH. Free public parking is also available in Sunset Beach (behind Jack in the Box) if you’d like to walk in.

Restrooms

Restrooms are open and located on each end of lot 25.

Strollers
Strollers are welcome! Please stay to the right and use at your own risk. Only registered participants with a bib will receive a finisher medal. Be sure your bib is worn on the front and visible to finish line staff.

Pets:

Friendly Pets are allowed and must be leashed at all times and accompanied by a Run /Walk participant.  Please use a leash of 5 ft or less, for the safety of all pets and runners.  Line up towards the back of the pack at the start and keep to the side of the race field on the course.

Weather

Rain or shine, the event will go on
 

 
🎥 More Than Just a Race
Santa Claus with a Cause is the race that GIFTS BACK. Your participation helps provide staple goods, education, and training to those in need around the world.

📺 Watch our global giving journey: YouTube: Caren.Ware.Events
📚 Visit the Caren Ware booth on race day for book signings of Finding Fit — an inspiring story about running through life’s challenges.

 
💡 Register today, join the celebration, and make this holiday season unforgettable, for you AND for others.
