You’ll run along the beach surrounded by falling snow, live carolers, festive music, and holiday cheer. Every runner receives their choice of a full Santa suit, cozy Santa beanie, or custom-designed race shirt, plus one of the biggest, most festive finisher Santa medal designed to double as a Christmas ornament.

And the best part? This race GIVES BACK. Proceeds from the event help gift staple goods, schooling, and hope to villages in Africa and Nepal, as well as supporting local health initiatives.

 
🎄 Race Day Fun & Schedule
Arrive early and soak up the holiday spirit. There’s so much happening before the race even starts!

6:30 – 8:15 AM: Registration and bib pick-up open at Lot 25. Walk-up registrations are welcome, so bring your friends!

7:00 – 9:00 AM: The REAL Santa 🎅 will be on-site for festive selfie photos (use hashtag #carenwareevents or tag us caren.ware.events). Lil Dickens Carolers will be singing, and snow will be falling to set the perfect holiday mood.

8:00 AM: Kids take center stage with the Ho Ho Ho Dashes (200m, 400m, ½ mile, and 1 mile). Cheer on the little elves as they dash through the holiday magic!

8:20 AM: Warm up with the Penguin Macarena! Everyone is invited to join in. Best Costume and Best Christmas Spirit awards are given out here, so come dressed to impress.

8:30 AM: MASS START for the 5K & 10K! Your official time begins when you cross under the start arch, but you must cross by 8:40 AM to be officially timed.

9:20 AM – 5K Awards Ceremony

9:40 AM – 10K Awards Ceremony

11:00 AM - Expo Festivities End

 
🎁 What’s Included
Your registration comes packed with holiday cheer! Every participant receives chip-timed results for the 5K or 10K, so you can track your performance. You’ll also get to choose your festive swag, whether you want to run in a full Santa suit, stay cozy in a Santa beanie, or sport a custom-designed Santa race shirt.

When you cross the finish line, you’ll receive one of the biggest custom Santa-at-the-beach medal that doubles as a Christmas ornament to hang proudly on your tree.

Throughout the morning, enjoy a lively holiday atmosphere with falling snow, live carolers, games, and photo ops with the REAL Santa. Prizes will be awarded for Best Christmas Spirit, Best Costume, and even Best Dressed Doggie, so bring your creativity and holiday cheer.

And don’t leave hungry, we’ll have food vendors on-site serving tamales, tacos, specialty coffee, cookies, fresh fruit and more. Plan on enjoying breakfast by the beach with us after your run!

And for the competitors, we have three-deep age division awards in five-year increments — from ages 1-10 all the way through 85+.

 
📅 Early Packet Pick-Up- Optional
Race Day Pick-Up: 6:30 – 8:15 AM at Lot 25
Early Pick-Up: Thursday, December 4th, 2025, 3:30 – 6:30 PM
📍 Road Runner Sports – 1835 Newport Blvd, Costa Mesa, CA
(No ID required, and you may pick up for others.)
 
🚗 Parking & Drop-Off
Bolsa Chica State Beach Lot 25 parking is $15 per vehicle (cash or state park pass recommended). The main gate opens at 6:00 AM — use the main entrance only.

Drop-off is available at the corner of Warner & PCH. Free public parking is also available in Sunset Beach (behind Jack in the Box) if you’d like to walk in.

Restrooms

Restrooms are open and located on each end of lot 25.

Strollers
Strollers are welcome! Please stay to the right and use at your own risk. Only registered participants with a bib will receive a finisher medal. Be sure your bib is worn on the front and visible to finish line staff.

Pets:

Friendly Pets are allowed and must be leashed at all times and accompanied by a Run /Walk participant.  Please use a leash of 5 ft or less, for the safety of all pets and runners.  Line up towards the back of the pack at the start and keep to the side of the race field on the course.

Weather

Rain or shine, the event will go on
 

 
🎥 More Than Just a Race
Santa Claus with a Cause is the race that GIFTS BACK. Your participation helps provide staple goods, education, and training to those in need around the world.

📺 Watch our global giving journey: YouTube: Caren.Ware.Events
📚 Visit the Caren Ware booth on race day for book signings of Finding Fit — an inspiring story about running through life’s challenges.

 
💡 Register today, join the celebration, and make this holiday season unforgettable, for you AND for others.

name: Santa Hustle Roseville
description:
The Santa Hustle Race Series is more than just a run—it’s a magical holiday experience filled with festive fun, Christmas cheer, and a whole lot of Santa spirit! Runners of all ages and abilities are invited to join this winter wonderland race, featuring a scenic course, holiday music, and sweet treats like candy canes and cookies along the way. Every participant receives a Santa hat, beard, and a cozy themed sweatshirt to complete their jolly look. Whether you're dashing through the snow for a PR or just in it for the holiday vibes, the Santa Hustle is the perfect way to celebrate the season with family, friends, and fellow festive runners!

The Santa Hustle® Race Series includes events in cities such as Chicago, IL; Detroit, MI; Nashville, TN; Indianapolis, IN; Milwaukee, WI; San Antonio, TX; Galveston, TX; Roseville, CA; Glendale, AZ; Athens, GA; Orlando, FL; and virtually! We’re also adding new cities in 2025, so stay tuned! Join thousands of Santa's running across the nation!

name: Santa Run Silicon Valley
description:
Join us for the 14th Annual Santa Run Silicon Valley, benefiting Christmas in the Park! 

This 5K Run/Walk is holiday fun for the whole family. You can dress up as your favorite holiday character or tradition, then make your way through San Jose for a festive afternoon celebrating the most wonderful time of the year! The flat, fast course begins on Santa Clara St. and concludes at Christmas in the Park, where you can enjoy the decorations and booths with your friends and family.

Santa Run Silicon Valley offers a 5K run/walk or a Kids Reindeer Dash. Both events are available in person or virtually. All 5K participants will receive our holiday-themed long sleeve tech shirt, ornament-style finisher medal, and race bib with timing chip. Kids Reindeer Dash participants will receive a festive short-sleeved t-shirt, an ornament-style finisher medal, a race bib, and milk and cookies at the finish line.

We're excited to announce that the Santa Paws 5K is now the Santa Runs Palm Springs! The event you all love with a new twist!

name: Santa To The Sea 1/2 Marathon, 1/4 Marathon & 5K
description:
Santa to the Sea is a nonprofit event born out of a desire to give back to the community. What started in 2003 as a toy drive to celebrate the relocation of the world’s largest Santa Claus from Carpentaria to Oxnard, has grown into a robust running event, toy drive, and community fundraiser. Santa to the Sea includes a half marathon, a Quarter Marathon plus a 5K run and 1K kids fun run. The Santa to the Sea Scholarship Fund partners with Gene Haas and Oxnard College Foundation to award $500 scholarships to local high school students and adults continuing their education at Oxnard College. 

Santa to the Sea offers families not only a weekend of fun, but also an opportunity to give back to those in need, just in time for the holiday season. The nonprofit event helps collect toys for underprivileged children throughout Ventura County while raising scholarship money for students at Oxnard College.

The Half Marathon gets underway at the giant Santa located along the Interstate Highway 101 (2801 Ventura Boulevard) and continues through the strawberry fields of Oxnard before heading to historic downtown Oxnard (where the Quarter Marathon starts) and ending at Marine Emporium Landing (where the 5k and kids 1k start and finish) in picturesque Channel Islands Harbor. There, visitors can enjoy the Finish Line Festival filled with a full day of activities including kids play area, a Santa’s Village, costume contests, food booths and live entertainment.

The Santa to the Sea Half Marathon, Quarter Marathon and 5k, is based in the coastal com­mu­nity of Oxnard, CA., and just 40 min­utes north of Los Angeles. Combine your athletic pursuits with a seaside weekend getaway during the annual Santa to the Sea Half Marathon, 1/4 marathon, 5K run and 1k kids fun run taking place the second Sunday every December.

name: Santa's Toy Trot – 5K, 10K, 10-Miler, Half Marathon
description:
Happy Holidays! It's time to jingle along from the start to the finish line!

Race Details

Start Location: 5400 E Ocean Ave, Long Beach, CA 90803
Parking: Parking in the lot is $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free. See map at the bottom of this email.

Event Schedule

Saturday
1:00-3:00pm – Early bib pick-up on the 2nd floor at Sports Basement Long Beach (store discount sent via email the week of the event & post-race)
2100 N Bellflower Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90815

Sunday
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens at the tables closest to Claremont Ave
7:00am – Half marathon & 10m start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10m)
Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Courses

5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route
10m: The 5m route is used for the 10m (two laps) – 5m route
Half: The 5m route is run twice and the 5k route is run once for the Half – 5m route and 5k route

More about the Course

The beach path is an open course, so you will encounter others using it. When we start the race, please stay on the right side of the beach path. The right side is for pedestrians and the left side is for cyclists.

We will have tent set up west of the Finish Line for spectators to watch you run. See map at the bottom of this email. We do not have shade or seating in the festival area for them.

On-Course Support: A fully stocked water station is located at the Belmont Pier. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, gatorade, gels, and fruit snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk, a runner turn sign, and a flag

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Awards: 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.
Results & Photos: A link for race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and earlier on Instagram. Race photos are free!

name: Santa’s Holiday Magic Run 5K, 10K, 1Miler & Little Elves 200-Yard Dash
description:
🎄 Santa’s Holiday Magic Run – Fountain Valley, CA 🎄
5K | 10K | 1-Mile Mistletoe Dash | Little Elves 200-Yard Dash
📍 Mile Square Park | Fountain Valley, CA
🕘 Start Time: 9:00 AM (5K & 10K)
🚪 Park Opens: 7:00 AM | 🎟 Bib Pick-Up Begins: 8:15 AM

Get ready to jingle all the way through beautiful Mile Square Park at the Holly Jolly Run — a festive and family-friendly race full of holiday cheer, candy canes, and good vibes! Whether you're racing for a PR or strolling in a Santa hat, there’s a distance for everyone! 🏃‍♀️🎅✨

🎉 We’ll even have jingle bells for your shoes so you can make this the merriest run ever! 🔔👟

 
🗺️ LOCATION & PARKING:  Click Here for Google Map Park Address
Mile Square Park – Fountain Valley
Enter through the main gate off Euclid, then make a left into the first parking lot on your left (Lot PA). Follow that lot to the next section and you’ll spot our cheerful set-up near the playground. 🎠
✨ Clean, open restrooms are available near the start line.

🚗 Parking Info 
Parking is $7.00 per car and yes — the rangers absolutely know you’re supposed to pay. Don’t test them… they’ve got ranger senses stronger than Santa’s sleigh radar. 🕵️‍♂️🦌


💵 You can pay cash or credit at the gate, but if you want to keep the line moving and avoid getting side-eyed by a ranger in a festive hat… bring cash. It’s faster, easier, and keeps the jingle in your step. 🎅💸🎄

 

Click Here to View Link to Park Map 

 
🏃‍♂️ THE COURSE: Click Here for a Link to the Course Map
The 5K and 10K feature one giant loop around the park, clearly marked with arrows, signs, and chalk. Please note this is an open course, so stay aware and jolly! 🎄

 
📅 RACE DAY SCHEDULE: Click here for a google map link to the start/finish
🎅 Start Time (5K & 10K): 9:00 AM
🌟 1-Mile Mistletoe Dash: Follows main race start
🧝 Little Elves 200-Yard Dash: After 1-Mile Dash

 
🎶 WHAT TO EXPECT:
🎅 Santa sightings & festive photo ops
🍬 Candy & seasonal treats
🔔 Jingle bells for your shoes!
🎶 Holiday music (Let's Catch that Holiday Vibe)
🧸 Goodie bags for all kids
🏆 Age group awards & medals for the top 3 men & women in each distance
 
Dress festive, bring your cheer, and get ready for a jolly good time with family, friends, and the entire Fountain Valley community. Races are rain or shine — just like Santa, we show up no matter the weather! 🎁❄️

name: SAR Wild Run
description:
An event for the entire family, join us for this Fresno County Search And Rescue FUNdraiser!  Starting 1/4mi North of the intersection of Dinkey Creek Rd. & Fishing Club Rd, on the South side of Shaver Lake, experience the beautiful Sierra scenery of Shaver Lake, breathtaking meadows, forests and cool streams all for a good cause. Participants receive a technical event shirt, unique medallion, chip timing and BBQ prepared by the Fresno County Sheriff's Search and Rescue Team!

The 10k Trail Run is a 20 point race in the CLASSIC Runner of the Year Series.

name: Scarecrow 2.0
description:
🎃 Join Us for Exeter’s 5th Annual Scarecrow 2.0! 🏃‍♀️🍂

What better way to welcome the cooler weather than with a fun run through beautiful Exeter? Starting at Exeter City Park, the course winds through our charming downtown—right alongside the scarecrows!

Bring the whole family and enjoy a morning of running, free food, live music, and small-town fun. Races take place Saturday, November 15, 2025—you won’t want to miss it!

🥐 Svenhards for the whole family!
Each finisher will receive a Svenhard's danish! Did you know Svenhard's is based in Exeter, CA?

Amenities:

Finisher Medal
FREE Race Photos
FREE Svenhards Danish
Scarecrow 2.0 T-Shirt
Chip Timing and Finisher Certificate
FREE drinks
Costume Contest
Live DJ and Music in the Park
Large Team Contest
VIP Brunch Ticket option from Cafe Lafayette
Age Group Awards
All male and female finishers will receive an award. Ages: 0-12, 13-19, 20-29, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, 60-69, 70+

Who We Support
A portion of funds from Scarecrow 2.0 along with your donations will be donated to the Boys & Girls Clubs of the Sequoias. Their Club serves more than 3,200 youth in Tulare County each year. Membership gives a young person access to nationally-recognized programs and a safe and positive environment to learn and grow.

Our Major Sponsor: Thrasher Masonry

name: Scream at the Bay!
description:
UPDATED TIME 2PM.

Need some free therapy? So do we. A large group of us are meeting up to scream into the bay. Yes, we’re allowed to let loose sometimes, and when do you really have a chance to do this without the neighbors calling the cops? 

This is our version of The Scream Club: a unique gathering where people come together to release stress and pent-up emotions by screaming collectively into the Bay.

Light snacks, drinks, and mingling after.

name: Screenland 5K
description:
5k Starts at 9:00 am.

Follow the yellow brick road with Dorothy, Toto and the Munchkins pursued by the Wicked Witch of the West, experiencing legendary movie and television experiences. Finish on the red carpet with Scarlett O'Hara, Rhett Butler and paparazzi at our star-studded 9th Annual family fun 5K adventure in the Heart of Screenland.  This year's costume contest theme is "Glitz, Glamour, Glory & Gold."

All participants will receive a commemorative bib, official time, medal, shirt, on-course support and entertainment, entrance into the post-race party, and free downloadable event photos.

Beach to City Challenge

Screenland 5K + BRA Run = Bonus bling featuring the fabulous Greta Garbo! 

This cinematic legend and breast cancer survivor called Culver City home, so we are celebrating her with the Beach to City Challenge! 

You must do both events back to back. You can do the Screenland 5K and then either the 5K or the 15K at the BRA Run and you will be able to claim the bonus medal at the finish line festival of the BRA Run on August 24, 2025 at Dockweiler Beach.  If you missed Screenland in 2024, you can start the challenge at Screenland in March and finish it at BRA Run in August.

We will be publishing a list of those who are qualified on the BRA Run website in August, before that event. You can check there to make sure we have you on the list after you register.

Sign up for both events at the same time or register for the BRA Run at the finish line festival after the Screenland 5K in 2025, and get a discount on registration.

More info about the BRA Run 5k & 13K at www.BRArunLA.com.

name: SD HipHop 5k
description:
SD HipHop 5K Run/Walk

October 20, 2024

Gather the family to come out and celebrate a fun and festive run/walk at the 7th Annual SD HipHop 5k. And we our proud to announce that we are also offering a virtual challenge.You can run, cycle, walk, swim or roll a certain distance in one day or a couple of days to equal  3.1 miles. Anyone of any ability can participate and it can be completed at any location, at your own pace. Please note that the Virtual Challenge event will not be an officially timed event.

Onsite registration will start at 6:00 am and will close at 7:45 am. The race will start promptly at 8:00 am. Runners and walkers are encouraged to bring their lounge chairs and canopies to attend the festival after the 5k Run/Walk.

Packet pickup location and time: Please find our Hip Hop 5K booth at 1655 Euclid Ave, San Diego, CA 92105 anytime between 10:30AM-3:00PM. 

 

Please note that registration fees are non-refundable. Additional race information can be found at www.sdhiphop5k.com

We also have sponsorship opportunities available. Please fill out the Sponsor form at www.sdhiphop5k.com. 

*This is a family-friendly and kid-friendly event. *T-shirts are give-aways and are given away to registrants until we run out

name: SeaWorld Howl-O-Sprint 5K
description:
Get ready to hit the ground running at SeaWorld San Diego's 2nd Annual Howl-O-Sprint 5K Run on Sunday, October 19th! Whether you run or walk, this 3.1-mile course will take you on a thrilling and chilling journey through the grounds of SeaWorld San Diego. Be on the lookout for Halloween surprises, themed photo moments, and delightfully spooky characters who pop along the route! With the park decked out for SeaWorld's Howl-O-Scream and Halloween Spooktacular events, there's no better way to experience SeaWorld and kick off your Halloween festivities!

In addition to the 5K Run, we offer a Kids Fun Run, a perfect opportunity for the little ones to join in on the fun. All participants will receive an official race shirt, race bib with timing chip for the 5K, a one-of-a-kind finisher medal, and eligibility for awards.

Halloween costumes are encouraged, so come dressed in your spookiest or silliest attire and prepare for a frightfully fun time! (Please note: masks are not permitted for this event.)

Join us for the 36th Annual Shadow of the Giants 20k & 50k, an unforgettable race through the scenic and historic trails of the Sierra National Forest. 

Time Limit for 50k: 8 hours - 9hours with an Early Start

Important Notice: Pets are not allowed on the trail, so please leave your furry friends at home.

Pre-Race Accommodations and Dinner
For those interested, we are offering the option to stay onsite the night before the race on Friday, June 6th at Camp Green Meadows in the dorms. Additionally, join us for our traditional pre-race lasagna dinner on Friday, June 5th at approximately 5:45 PM in the Green Meadows Dining Hall.

Race Day Schedule
50k Start Time: 7:00 AM
20k Start Time: 7:15 AM
Early Starts Available: 6:00 AM (Early starters are not eligible for overall awards, they are eligible for Age Group Awards)

Course Information
Detailed course maps and updates will be provided, closer to the race day

Aid Stations: Located roughly 5-7 miles apart, our aid stations will be well-stocked with food, Gels, Electrolyte drink, water, Coca-Cola, ginger ale, and a variety of sweet and salty snacks.

Guidelines:

No pacers.
No dogs.

Poles are permitted.
Fun and smiles are mandatory!

Post-Race Celebration
After the race, you’re invited to hang out at Green Meadows to cheer on fellow runners. Post-race food and beverages will be provided in the Dining Hall. Bring a chair, a pop-up tent or umbrella, and enjoy the camaraderie.

BIB Pickup

When: Friday, June 5th
Time: 3:00 PM - 5:30 PM
Where: Camp Green Meadows Outdoor School in Fish Camp, CA, in the Cafeteria
Race Day Bib Pick-Up:

When: Saturday, June 6th
Time: 5:40 AM - 6:45 AM
Where: Cafeteria at Camp Green Meadow Outdoor School
Note: No pets or dogs are allowed on the Green Meadows Campus, except for service animals.

Staying at Camp Green Meadows
Arrival: Do not arrive before 1:15 PM on Friday, June 5th
Check-In: Begins at 1:30 PM in the Cafeteria. Bunks are first-come, first-served. No check-ins after 8:00 PM.
What to Bring: Bedding, pillow, sleeping bag/blankets
Shared Space Etiquette: Respect others and keep noise levels down. Quiet time starts at 9:00 PM.
Facilities: Showers and restrooms available onsite.
Trash: All trash must be removed before departure.
Camping: Tent camping is not allowed on campus. There is dispersed camping in the area. 
Parking: Large or oversized vehicles like RVs are not permitted on campus. You may park on nearby Forest Service Roads.

Pre-Race Dinner
If you’ve purchased a ticket for our pre-race dinner, it will start around 5:45 PM - 6:00 PM in the Cafeteria at Camp Green Meadows. The dinner will include lasagna, salad, bread, and drinks. No additional tickets will be sold as meals are prepared based on pre-orders.

Parking Guidelines
Do Not Block Roadways: Ensure clear access in and out of Green Meadows.
Parking Locations: Once the parking lot at Green Meadows is full, you may park on the shoulder of the camp entrance or on the dirt road shoulder just before the camp entrance. Do not block roadways.
Alternative Parking: You may park off Jackson Road near the final turn down onto the single track that leads to the finish line. It’s a pleasant half-mile walk from there with no parking issues.
Changing Distances
You may switch to the 20k distance at any time up until race day. Changes can be made at bib pick-up or at the timing tent at the start/finish area.

Course Cutoff
The cutoff time for completing the 50k course is 3:00 PM. Early starters (6:00 AM start) have until 3:00 PM to finish, giving them a total of 9 hours.

Start Times for Saturday, June 6th, 2026
50k Early Start: 6:00 AM (Please be self-sufficient until Aid Station #2)
50k Regular Start: 7:00 AM
20k Start: 7:15 AM

name: Shark Attack 5K & 1 Mile Run
description:
CORONA 5K 

 

Get ready for an exhilarating race that combines the excitement of a 5k or 1-mile run with the support of a vibrant community! Whether you're a seasoned racer or a first-timer, get set to experience an electrifying event in a stunning setting, surrounded by an awesome crowd of fellow runners!

 

Race Details

 

Arrival

  • CHECK IN:  6:00 a.m. Registration will remain open on race day from 6:00 a.m. through 7:00 a.m.
  • OPENING CEREMONY: 7:15 a.m.

 

Parking

  • FREE PARKING located inside Green River Golf course (1 Main entrance to Golf Course)
  • Please park in the upper parking lot section (See address below)

 

Course Description

 

Experience the picturesque landscapes of the Green River Golf Course at the Shark Attack 5k! This flat, fast course features conditions ideal for pushing your limits and setting personal records.

 

MILE 1 -Start off with a fast first mile on a mostly paved pathway running parallel to pristine fairways. 

MILE 2 -The second mile offers a mixture of both paved roads and dirt trails. 

MILE 3 -The final stretch is near and will certainly allow you to finish your strongest. 

FINISH LINE - As you cross the finish line you’ll be welcomed into a grand celebration area where you’ll receive your medal and be greeted by fans, fellow participants, and a live DJ! Then enjoy a lively post-race atmosphere with music, snacks, and vendor booths. 

 

What to Expect on Race Day

 
  • All Finishers Will Receive Medals
  • Fun Community Event
  • Abundant High-fives and cheering as Santiago's Cross Country Superstars cheer you on along the course.
  • Scenic route inside
  • Receive a Dri- FIT shirt if registration is received by deadline. (Check @sharkattack5krun for t-shirt deadline)

name: Signal Hill Rotary Mutt Run 1K & 5K
description:
FINDING HOMES - ONE DOG AT A TIME

This is why we run!

2024 Event Photos

 

Run or walk at your pace with or without your dog.  The event starts at the Claremont Launch Ramp at 5350 E. Ocean Blvd and the course follows along the scenic Long Beach shoreline. Park at the 54th & Claremont lot.

Race packet pick up is at the starting line on race day.  Please arrive by 7:30 am to allow sufficient time before the race.

 

EVENTS

  • 5K Runner-only (humans only) race starts at 8:30 am
  • 5K Mutt run (runner/walker plus dog) starts at 8:30 am
  • 1K Mutt run (runner/walker plus dog) starts at 8:45 am

DOGGIE DO'S and DON'T'S

  • All breeds of dogs welcome, not just mutts
  • Dogs must be leashed and stay on the pedestrian path at all times
  • Dogs must be non-aggressive with people and dogs

FUN INCLUSIONS AND POST-RACE EVENTS

  • Adoption event by the Long Beach Animal Care Services at the finish line and post-race festival
  • High quality race t-shirt for 1K and 5K participants
  • Finisher medal for all participants
  • Awards for top three 5K finishers

WHY WE RUN

  • 70% of proceeds will support the Long Beach Animal Care Services
  • 30% of the proceeds will go toward the community project fund at Signal Hill Rotary

name: Silicon Valley PRIDE 3rd Annual 5K & 10K
description:
🏳️‍🌈 Run, Walk, or Sashay for PRIDE! 🏳️‍🌈

The Silicon Valley PRIDE 2nd Annual 5K is BACK! 2026 - We've added a 10K :)


📅 Date: Saturday, June 20, 2026
⏰ Time: 9:00 AM PDT
📍 Location: Hellyer County Park, 985 Hellyer Ave, San Jose, CA
🚗 Parking: $7 per vehicle (rideshare/public transport encouraged)

Let’s Make This Year’s PRIDE 5K Bigger & Better!

Lace up, throw on your best rainbow gear, and hit the course with runners, walkers, joggers, and fabulous strutters!

Whether you run, walk, jog, or sashay, this event is about community, inclusion, and FUN!

Choose Your Event

🏁 In-Person 5K & 10K (Ages 13+) – Join us at Hellyer Park!
🖥️ Virtual 5K & 10K – Run anytime, anywhere! (Swag delivered by USPS)


Why Sign Up?

All participants who register by May 29, 2026, will receive:
✔️ Limited-Edition PRIDE 5K T-Shirt
✔️ Chip-Timed Results (In-Person 5K Only)
✔️ A High-Energy, Fun-Filled Race Day Experience!

Spots are limited! Registrations after May 29th are not guaranteed a t-shirt.


Make a Difference!

Your participation helps support Silicon Valley PRIDE and creates a more inclusive and vibrant LGBTQ+ community.

Want to go further? Start a fundraising team or make a donation today!

Packet Pickup & Race Materials

📍 Billy DeFrank LGBTQ+ Community Center

📅 Wednesday, June 10th | 6:30 PM to 8:00 PM
📅 Friday, June 12th | 6:30 PM to 8:00 PM

💌 Virtual Runners: Swag will be mailed one week before the event!


Dress Up & Show Out!

Rock your boldest, brightest, most fabulous PRIDE outfit—or whatever makes you feel comfortable and confident!

Get Involved! Volunteer & Support

Want to be part of the magic? Sign up as a volunteer and help us create an amazing PRIDE 5K experience!

name: Silver Moon Race: Kings River
description:
The Silver Moon Race is about challenging yourself, taking your endurance ability, and miles to new heights. Perfect for those who want to elevate from half marathons to marathons to ultramarathons.

You'll run in beautiful scenic locations in a 12K or for 6, 12, 24-hours, or 100-mile race on an awesome lap course. Go solo or in a 4-person team relay with your favorite running friends.

The race is always timed on a weekend closest to the full moon. Starting right before sunset and running through the night under the vibrant glow of the full moon and stars into the sunrise the next day.

Where in the world is Reedley? It is one of our favorite hidden gems nestled in the San Joaquin Valley of central California where much of the fruit we enjoy is grown.

Experience running through a beautiful scenic farm with orchards, vineyards, under the canopy of oak trees, and along the majestic Kings River in Reedley.

Get ready to have the Silver Moon Race become one of your favorite running experiences. Register today to reserve your spot!

Learn more at SilverMoonRace.com/kings-river/

name: Sloth Run 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
🦥🏃‍♂️ The Sloth Run – Slow Is the New Fast! 🏃‍♀️🦥

Sloths will get there!

Tired of high-speed races and intense competition? Us too.
Welcome to the Sloth Run, where the pace is slow, the vibes are chill, and everyone's a winner (eventually).

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

name: Snow What Fun it is to Run - Night Glow 5K, 10K, 1 Miler, Kids Dash
description:
❄️ Snow What Fun It Is to Run – Night Glow Run 🎅✨
5K • 10K • Family 1-Mile • Kids Dash

It’s the most wonderful run of the year! ✨❄️ Bundle up, light up, and join us for an unforgettable night of glowing miles, twinkling lights, and holiday magic at Snow What Fun It Is to Run — a winter wonderland night glow run for the whole family!

Feel the crisp winter air on your cheeks as you run, walk, or dance your way through a sparkling course lined with festive lights and glow zones. Choose your distance — 5K, 10K, Family 1-Mile, or the Kids Dash (a separate 200-yard dash just for the little ones!) — and let the holiday spirit carry you to the finish line.

🎄 Event Highlights:
✨ GLOW batons for all participants to light the course in festive style
🏅 Finish-line medals for every finisher — no matter the distance - Chip Timing
📸 Free race-day photos and the best holiday photo ops around
🎅 Drop your letter to Santa in his special North Pole mailbox
☕ Cozy up with hot chocolate, fresh cookies, and holiday cheer at the finish
❄️ Snowfall at the finish line — because it’s not winter without snow!
🎥 A classic holiday movie kicks off at 6:00 PM on our giant inflatable screen — grab a blanket, a cookie, and some cocoa and enjoy the sweet winter vibes before the run!

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 This is more than a race — it’s a holiday experience the whole family will remember. From glowing miles to rosy-cheek smiles, Snow What Fun It Is to Run brings you all the holiday magic you can handle!

📍 Schedule:

✅ Check-In & Movie Start: 6:00 PM
🏃‍♂️ 5K & 10K Start: 7:00 PM
👨‍👩‍👧 Family 1-Mile Start: 7:15 PM
🎅 Kids 200-Yard Dash: 7:45 PM

name: SOCAL River Marathon - 26.2 - 13.1 - 10K - 5K
description:
The SOCAL River Marathon has four distances. Full Marathon, Half Marathon, 10K and 5K. 

This is a fun course in Southern California. This course runs on the Santa Ana River Trail from Yorba Linda to Huntington Beach State Park. This route truly spans Southern California from the dryer desert land to areas near Disneyland to the Beach. The course is primarily flat and straight but has a gradual downhill slant following the river to the ocean. This route is two years ago was cleaned up from homeless tents and is not fenced in nightly.

name: SoCal's Cinco De Miles 5K and 5 MILE
description:
Saturday. May 2, 2026 So Cal's Cinco de Miles 5k & 5 Miles

AT BOLSA CHICA STATE BEACH this year. 

It's a  FULL FIESTA party run! Live Mariachi.  Folclórico dancing. Festive food. 

Race, run, walk, or jog . Huge, unique custom cast medals with moving parts and a baby soft tech shirt fully designed front and back. NEW DESIGN each year. 

Come celebrate Mexican Culture with us. And be as victorious in your pursuit of health as those soldados were in their victory at the Battle of Puebla.  Sign up for 5K or 5 miles or run the 1-mile family fun run.   Have fun meeting people while celebrating culture. Running is universal.

RFIP CHIP TIMING and age division awards by Itz About Time.

COOL custom cast medals and Cinco De MILES authentic event t-shirts.  

EVERY PARTICIPANT RECEIVES: 

  • Custom Cinco de Miles cast medals
  • Cinco de Miles-themed event race shirts
  • Age division awards
  • RFID Chip timing by Itz About Time (itzabouttime.com)
  • Enjoy the music, the refreshments, and each other!
  • Caren Ware Events are designed for Every BODY and EVERYBODY! BEST THEMED ever races. 

RACE LOCATION:  This year at BOLSA CHICA STATE BEACH (lot 25.)

PARKING:  Come in the main gate at 17851 Pacific Coast Hwy, Huntington Beach, Ca. 92649 and turn right, going to the very last lot which is closest to Warner and PCH.  Have $15 in cash ready at the gate per car, or a park pass.  Credit cards slow down the entry process for other cars.   You can also find limited free and hourly parking behind the Jack in the Box on PCH and Warner and along that inner road in Sunset Beach, and jog into the state park on running sidewalk. 

EARLY RACE PACKET PICK-UP (for your convenience) or you may pick up the bib and shirt on race day at the race site.  You may pick up for others.  

Friday, May 1st .  Time and Location TBD

RACE DAY SCHEDULES:

6:30 am  Registration OPENS
               Shirts are given with bibs at registration.  Medals when you finish

7:45 am to 8:15 am Folclórico Performance, Dancing Horses, Mariachi Music

8:00 am START of Cinco de Mile fun run. (1 Mile) 

8:15 am START of Kid's Carrera. (400 yards) 

8:30 am Mass START of 5K/5 Mile

9:15 am Start of 5k AWARDS CEREMONY

9:30 am Start of the 5-mile AWARD CEREMONY

Bring EXTRA CASH FOR STREET TACOS, AGUA FRESCA, FRESH FRUIT, GALLETINAS AND SPECIALTY COFFEES.

FINISHER MEDALS to every Finisher

AGE DIVISION AWARDS:

5-year Age Spans:  3 deep with 5-year age spans:  5k and 5 Mile  1-10, 11-14, 15-19, 20-24, 25-29, 30-34, 35-39 40-44, 45-49, 50-54,55-59 60-64, 65-69, 70-74, 75-79, 80&over 

Top  3 Overall Trophies to Males & Females     Plus award to Oldest finisher. Youngest finisher. 

Pets: Friendly Pets are allowed and must be leashed at all times and accompanied by a Run /Walk participant.  Please use a leash of 5 ft or less, for the safety of all pets and runners.  Line up towards the back of the pack at the start and keep to the side of the race field on the course.

Stroller: Families can bring strollers, but agree to use at their own risk.  We do ask that you line up towards the back of the pack at the start and keep to the side of the race field on the course. Note, that only registered participants with a BIB will receive a finisher medal.

Please make sure your BIB is in the front and visible to our volunteers.  And watch for cyclists enjoying the same beach bike path you are running on.

The race will take place rain or shine.  RESTROOMS are in the public buildings at the end of each of the parking lots.

name: SoCal's Tiki Beach 5K & 10K Run/Walk
description:
🌺 Welcome to SO CAL's BIGGEST & BEST POLYNESIAN PARTY RACE! 🌺

Since 2014,  Tiki Beach 5K/10K has been a vibrant tradition on the beach, a chance to run, celebrate, and enjoy island-inspired music, food, and community. It's your end of the summer BEACH PARTY RUN!

🏖️ Experience the energy of the beach with live Polynesian drummers and dancers, bringing authentic rhythm and movement to your run. This isn’t just a race, t’s a festive send-off to summer! Coconuts, palm trees, grass skirts, and the TAPUA PRODUCTION drummers and dancers make this the BEST BEACH BASH, healthy RUNNER's Party!

🎽 Every participant receives a custom Polynesian-style race shirt and one of our signature Tiki finisher medals, a collectible highlight for your race journey. Have enough shirts?  Choose a custom beach towel while supplies last, or add to your collection by getting BOTH for only an additional $20.

🍍 Post-Race Fun: Enjoy coconut and Island inspired pancakes offered by IVC Circle K and Kiwanis of Irvine, specialty coffee, tasty street tacos , Bar b que sandwiches, fresh baked cookies, Hawaiian shaved ice, and Nekter Juice (available for purchase. You make pay with cash, credit card, or pre buy food vouchers) while you explore the expo area and capture those perfect beachside selfies. It's a FOOD FEAST while watching authentic Polynesian drummers and dancers. Support the causes.  KID'S READ will be giving out free books for those that purchase Kiwanis pancakes.  BIG J's So Cal Bar B Que will be offering mini sliders, or full bar b que lunches to eat, take home, or remain at the beach for a picnic!

 
Course:

Flat, scenic, out-and-back along the paved beach path with ocean views. Run fast or take it easy, the waves will be your soundtrack.
Timing: RFID Chip Timing by Itz About Time

Awards:

Top 3 male & female overall (5K & 10K)
Age group awards in 5-year divisions (up to 80+)
Special recognition for those completing 3+ Caren Ware Events this year
 
Schedule
6:30 AM – Vendor & Volunteer Check-in
7:00–8:30 AM – Registration & Packet Pick-Up (race-day available)

7:30 -8:30 Am LIVE POLYNESIAN dancers and drummers/ Tupua Productions/ An active EXPO

8:15 AM – Kid’s Dash & 1-Mile Fun Run
8:30 AM – 10K & 5K Start
9:20 AM – 5K Awards Ceremony
9:40 AM – 10K Awards Ceremony
6:30–10:00 AM – Polynesian-Inspired Expo Open
 
Early Packet Pick-Up
Saturday, Sept. 26 10am to 1PM  (Note: Earlier so we have afternoon time to set up the race) 
Sports Basement, 10800 Kalama River Ave, Fountain Valley, CA 92708
(You may also pick up race morning at the start line.)
 
Parking
Bolsa Chica State Beach, Lot 25 — $15 State Park fee (bring exact cash for faster processing)
Public parking available in Sunset Beach (walking required into park)
 

Restrooms

Restrooms are open and located on each end of lot 25.

Strollers
Strollers are welcome! Please stay to the right and use at your own risk. Only registered participants with a bib will receive a finisher medal. Be sure your bib is worn on the front and visible to finish line staff.

Pets:

Friendly Pets are allowed and must be leashed at all times and accompanied by a Run /Walk participant.  Please use a leash of 5 ft or less, for the safety of all pets and runners.  Line up towards the back of the pack at the start and keep to the side of the race field on the course.

Weather

Rain or shine, the event will go on
 
🌊 Whether you’re racing for a PR or jogging with friends, Tiki Beach is your lively, healthy way to wrap up the summer. Come for the run, stay for the rhythm, community, and celebration.

💙 A portion of proceeds supports Caren Ware Events’ global outreach projects, including families in the Himalayas and local community programs.

🍍 Post-Race Fun: Enjoy coconut and Island inspired pancakes offered by IVC Circle K and Kiwanis of Irvine, specialty coffee, tasty street tacos , Bar b que sandwiches, fresh baked cookies, Hawaiian shaved ice, and Nekter Juice (available for purchase. You make pay with cash, credit card, or pre buy food vouchers) while you explore the expo area and capture those perfect beachside selfies. It's a FOOD FEAST while watching authentic Polynesian drummers and dancers. Support the causes.  KID'S READ will be giving out free books for those that purchase Kiwanis pancakes.  BIG J's So Cal Bar B Que will be offering mini sliders, or full bar b que lunches to eat, take home, or remain at the beach for a picnic!

 
Course:

Flat, scenic, out-and-back along the paved beach path with ocean views. Run fast or take it easy, the waves will be your soundtrack.
Timing: RFID Chip Timing by Itz About Time

Awards:

Top 3 male & female overall (5K & 10K)
Age group awards in 5-year divisions (up to 80+)
Special recognition for those completing 3+ Caren Ware Events this year
 
Schedule
6:30 AM – Vendor & Volunteer Check-in
7:00–8:30 AM – Registration & Packet Pick-Up (race-day available)

7:30 -8:30 Am LIVE POLYNESIAN dancers and drummers/ Tupua Productions/ An active EXPO

8:15 AM – Kid’s Dash & 1-Mile Fun Run
8:30 AM – 10K & 5K Start
9:20 AM – 5K Awards Ceremony
9:40 AM – 10K Awards Ceremony
6:30–10:00 AM – Polynesian-Inspired Expo Open
 
Early Packet Pick-Up
Saturday, Sept. 26 10am to 1PM  (Note: Earlier so we have afternoon time to set up the race) 
Sports Basement, 10800 Kalama River Ave, Fountain Valley, CA 92708
(You may also pick up race morning at the start line.)
 
Parking
Bolsa Chica State Beach, Lot 25 — $15 State Park fee (bring exact cash for faster processing)
Public parking available in Sunset Beach (walking required into park)
 

Restrooms

Restrooms are open and located on each end of lot 25.

Strollers
Strollers are welcome! Please stay to the right and use at your own risk. Only registered participants with a bib will receive a finisher medal. Be sure your bib is worn on the front and visible to finish line staff.

Pets:

Friendly Pets are allowed and must be leashed at all times and accompanied by a Run /Walk participant.  Please use a leash of 5 ft or less, for the safety of all pets and runners.  Line up towards the back of the pack at the start and keep to the side of the race field on the course.

Weather

Rain or shine, the event will go on
 
🌊 Whether you’re racing for a PR or jogging with friends, Tiki Beach is your lively, healthy way to wrap up the summer. Come for the run, stay for the rhythm, community, and celebration.

💙 A portion of proceeds supports Caren Ware Events’ global outreach projects, including families in the Himalayas and local community programs.

name: Solano Turkey Trot 2025
description:
Solano Turkey Trot is a public benefit charity race in Solano County, California, comprised of 501(c)(3) partner organizations serving high risk children, families and seniors. We believe in a collective impact model with the goal of raising public awareness and education by holding fundraising and community events such as the Solano Turkey Trot. This annual event began on Thanksgiving Day 2009, with the vision of bringing a family-friendly 10K Run/5KRun/Walk to the local area. This event helps raise much needed funds to support the Solano Hearts United partner organizations in serving local families in need.

The two partner nonprofits include Meals on Wheels of Solano County and Suisun City Salvation Army KROC Center. The event is held in Suisun Valley in Solano County, with the main venue and start/finish line at Solano Community College. Our Race Director, Carol Gilpin, has been with us since our first race. Carol is the owner of Fleet Feet Sports in Vacaville and has been active through running, walking and triathlons for more than 35 years.

We are blessed to have this opportunity to “Give Thanks ♥ Give Back” to Solano County high risk children, families and seniors living in Solano County. Hope to see you bright and early on Thanksgiving morning!

For more information about Solano Turkey Trot, please contact us at solanoheartsunited@yahoo.com.

Refund Policy:
All entries are non-refundable and non-transferrable.

Sorry, No Refunds.

name: SPACEROCK Trail Race
description:
OUT-OF-THIS-WORLD TRAIL RUNNING


SPACEROCK: the final trail running frontier.
These are the voyages of trail runners around the world.
Your mission: to explore strange new trails, to seek out new life and new experiences, to boldly run where no one has run before.


Experience the exotic trails and sights of the world-famous Vasquez Rocks Natural Park in Southern California. Known as the backdrop from popular TV shows and movies including Star Trek, The Flintstones, Battlestar Galactica, Planet of the Apes, and many of our favorite classic westerns films. Now get a spectacular experience running the trails at the SPACEROCK Trail Race!

Learn more at and register at: SPACEROCKTrailRace.com

name: Splash Dash 5k/ A Wet or Dry Run 5k plus Duckie Dash/Wild Rivers in Irvine
description:
The WILD RIVERS SPLASH DASH 5K 
SUNDAY, AUGUST 24, 2025

 

A 'cool' Run.  Chose SPLASH DASH 5k (if you want to get to plunge through the wild river before the finish line.) Or the DRY RUN 5k (if preference is to not get wet)

It's your 'coolest' summer run/walk. With the coolest race BLING!  Choice of a custom event BEACH TOWEL or a custom event t shirt, and a huge custom FINISHER MEDAL for all participants. 

Plus the chance to win SUPER DUPER Age divisions medal awards. 

It is a SUPER DUPER FUN event.  Make it competitive, or choose to cruise it and have great fun! The last 600 yards of the SPLASH DASH you get to 'DASH' through the lazy river in 2 1/2 feet of water, going with the current!

***************************************************************************************

You also are eligible for a discounted entry into WILD RIVERS for Sunday, August 24 only.  Participants get in for $39.99.  A ticket must be bought online in advance . 

https://wildrivers.com/companies/splash_dash/

 SE code: SPLASHDASH for the price to drop from 79.99 to $39.99 when you check out online. https://wildrivers.com/companies/splash_dash/

 Show your bib at the gate. 

***********************************************************************************************************

WE are making this RACE A FOOD DRIVE!!!! 

EVERY PARTICIPANT MUST BRING AT LEAST 2 CAN GOODS OR $5 CASH donation FOR THE FOOD DRIVE .  The South County Outreach is an amazing NONPROFIT that serves over 400 people and families a month, providing nourishing ingredients and food items to make full and complete meals.  When people visit their Food Market, they are in control of the cart and what goes in it, just like in a local grocery store. Most needed items are: canned fruit, canned fish/meat, and jelly.

 

PICK your course!  Do you want to end the race running through the wild river (2 1/2 feet deep) and getting SPLASHED by its fountains?!  Sign up for SPLASH DASH.  If you are a dry lander and just want to run around the park (avoiding the WET part) sign up for the DRY RUN.  Both get separate sets of age division awards. The DRY RUN does 'cut' the course short, so we may weave you on a side loop at the end to make it a 3.1.  

EVERY PARTICIPANT RECEIVES: 

  • Custom Cast, Very ‘Cool," Huge and Unique Finish Medal

  • Custom Designed SPLASH DASH Beach Towel

  • Age division awards

  • RFID Chip timing by Itz About Time (itzabouttime.com)

  • AND BEST of ALL, the proceeds from Caren Ware Events helps spread health and hope to needs she RUNS into running around the world.

Enjoy the music, the refreshments, and each other!

 

ALL PARTICIPANTS MUST BE OFF THE COURSE by 9:30 and exit the park.  Age Division and overall awards begin promply at 8:45am for the overall winners and 9am for age division awards. The park will reopen to the public at 10am.  All runners and spectators will be exited by 9:30am from the park.  That gives you 1 hour and 30 minutes to finish the 5k course! 

 

CHECK OUT PATRIOTS AQUATICS WATER POLO CLUB & SWIM CLUB  They will have a booth at the event. 

This event supports WATER activity and Swimming Skills, VISIT THE PATRIOT'S Waterpolo club booth and learn about amazing swim lesson opportunities and to learn the sport and train for waterpolo.  They have the reputation of producing Junior Olympics! Become a champion in a sport!

  https://www.patriotaquatics.org/

 

VISIT THE SOUTH COUNTY OUTREACH booth and learn how your food or cash donation helps .

https://www.sco-oc.org/


Caren Ware Events are designed for Every BODY and EVERYBODY! So Cal's BEST THEMED RUNNING EVENTS.  

RACE LOCATION: 
WILD RIVERS WATERPARK, 10000 Great Park Blvd Irvine, Ca, 92618  

PARKING:  WILD RIVERS will be charging $10 to park.  Plan to carpool. Limited additional parking is available in Great Parks.  You can also be dropped off in their drop off lane.

COURSE:  Course runs around the perimeter of WILD RIVERS parking lot on a 2 loop course,  then enters the park through the back employee parking area.   It will weave through the entire water park and END in the 2 1/2 foot deep WILD RIVER to finish back at the START/FINISH ARCH. (DRY LAND option also.  You must make this choice prior to the run and have a DRY LAND bib on) 

The DUCKY DASH STARTS /FINISHES on the BRIDGE and runs THROUGH the kiddie pool wading area.  Diaper Dash runs it it and splashes in, and back. 400 M is one lap through kiddie pool. 1/2 mile is 2 laps.  All kids get towels and a finisher medal. 

EARLY RACE PACKET PICK is Saturday, August 22 from 10am to 1 pm at Road Runner Sports, 24291 Avenida de La Carlota, Laguna Hills, Ca. 92653.  This is Not mandatory. You may pick up for others.

 You may also pick up bib and shirt or towel at race site on race day beginning at 6:30am.

  Canned goods and donations will be accepted at pre packet pick up and on race day. . 

RACE DAY SCHEDULE:
6:30 am  Registration OPENS.  Canned goods at donations at the gate.  Registration tents INSIDE the main entrance. 
               Towels are given with bibs at registration.  Medals when you finish
7:45 am Duck Dash for kids.  3 distances.  You choose 200 yards. 400 years. 1/2 mile. 

               Does go through the water.  Through or to the Kiddie Pool. Start and FINISH is on the Bridge                 to the left of the registration tents.
8:00 am Mass Start SPLASH DASH 5k/ DRY RUN 5k
9:00 am Start of 5k AWARDS CEREMONY BEGINS through until 10am.  Takes place outside the exit behind the FINISH LINE.


REFRESHMENTS:
Bring EXTRA CASH FOR SPECIALTY
COFFEES, PANCAKES (FULL PLATE $15 EACH) SERVED BY THE WILD RIVERS FOOD SERVICES.

FINISHER MEDALS TO every Finisher

AGE DIVISION AWARDS:
Please make sure your BIB is pinned on the front and visible to our volunteers. 
5-year Age Spans:  3 deep with 5-year age spans:  5k and 5 Mile  1-10, 11-14, 15-19, 20-
24, 25-29, 30-34, 35-39 40-44, 45-49, 50-54,55-59 60-64, 65-69, 70-74, 75-79, 80 and over 

(for SPLASH DASH)

10 Year age spans for DRY RUN.  1-10, 11-14, 15-19, 20-29, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, 60-69, 70-79, 80 plus
Top 3 Overall Trophies to Males and Females for both DRY RUN 5k and SPLASH DASH 5k
Plus award to Oldest and Youngest finisher.

RESTROOMS: Are available inside Wild Rivers Water Park.

NO DOGS ALLOWED ON THIS RACE COURSE OR IN THE WATERPARK.

Strollers are allowed, but must stay toward the back and you must sign up for the DRY RUN.  They cannot be left at the entrance of the Wild River.  They have to be taken to the finish line.

Young children can wear floaties if you choose to carry them all the way on the course. 

 

 YOU MUST BE AWARE THAT ANY PHONES OR ELECTRONICS WILL GET WET. It's your responsibility to keep them in something waterproof.  Use at your own risk.

name: Splash Dash 5k/ A Wet or Dry Run 5k plus Duckie Dash/Wild Rivers in Irvine
description:
The WILD RIVERS SPLASH DASH 5K 
SUNDAY, AUGUST 24, 2025

 

A 'cool' Run.  Chose SPLASH DASH 5k (if you want to get to plunge through the wild river before the finish line.) Or the DRY RUN 5k (if preference is to not get wet)

It's your 'coolest' summer run/walk. With the coolest race BLING!  Choice of a custom event BEACH TOWEL or a custom event t shirt, and a huge custom FINISHER MEDAL for all participants. 

Plus the chance to win SUPER DUPER Age divisions medal awards. 

It is a SUPER DUPER FUN event.  Make it competitive, or choose to cruise it and have great fun! The last 600 yards of the SPLASH DASH you get to 'DASH' through the lazy river in 2 1/2 feet of water, going with the current!

***************************************************************************************

You also are eligible for a discounted entry into WILD RIVERS for Sunday, August 24 only.  Participants get in for $39.99.  A ticket must be bought online in advance . 

https://wildrivers.com/companies/splash_dash/

 Show your bib at the gate. 

***********************************************************************************************************

WE are making this RACE A FOOD DRIVE!!!! 

EVERY PARTICIPANT MUST BRING AT LEAST 2 CAN GOODS OR $5 CASH donation FOR THE FOOD DRIVE .  The South County Outreach is an amazing NONPROFIT that serves over 400 people and families a month, providing nourishing ingredients and food items to make full and complete meals.  When people visit their Food Market, they are in control of the cart and what goes in it, just like in a local grocery store. Most needed items are: canned fruit, canned fish/meat, and jelly.

 

PICK your course!  Do you want to end the race running through the wild river (2 1/2 feet deep) and getting SPLASHED by its fountains?!  Sign up for SPLASH DASH.  If you are a dry lander and just want to run around the park (avoiding the WET part) sign up for the DRY RUN.  Both get separate sets of age division awards. The DRY RUN does 'cut' the course short, so we may weave you on a side loop at the end to make it a 3.1.

name: Spring Valley 5K, Community Stroll, & Kids Sprint
description:
Join us for the First Annual Spring Valley 5K this Thanksgiving Day!

 

5K Run/Walk
Kick off your Thanksgiving with a tradition you’ll feel good about! Before the turkey and pie, join us for the Spring Valley 5K—a scenic trail run that’s as fun as it is challenging. Our out-and-back course packs in varied terrain, short but punchy climbs, and a one-of-a-kind urban trail experience.  Whether you’re racing for a PR or just soaking in the morning vibes, this trail adventure is the perfect start to your holiday.

Community Stroll
Not up for the full 5K? No problem! Our free Community Stroll invites everyone to be part of the fun. Enjoy a relaxed 1.5-mile course on smooth paved paths with gentle inclines and declines. No time clock, no pressure—just a chance to move, laugh, and connect with neighbors before the big feast.

Kids' Sprint
Little legs, big smiles! The Kids Sprint is a fast and fun 1/2 mile dash on a paved surface—perfect for our youngest athletes.

name: Squib Games Saga
description:
NBC Liberty Presents: Squib Games Saga 🦑
This is your invitation to play.

𖧋 △ ☐

Step into a thrilling experience inspired by the Korean series. Squib Games Saga features 8-10 challenges that will test your physical stamina, mental sharpness, and strategic thinking. Do you have what it takes to walk away with the prize, or will you be... eliminated?

Location: VADM Martin Liberty Center, 3 pm

 

FAQ's

Is this happening on base or is this an off-base experience?

This event is happening on base at the VADM Martin Liberty Center, BLDG 1507 (we are next to the gym). Games will take place on Field 1508, which is next to our center. Some games may also take place indoors in our facility.

Are any of the games extremely physically demanding?

Some games may require you to show your physical strength, speed, or endurance, however all games are within reasonable physical exertion/intensity. 

How long will the games last?

The length of the event will depend on how many starting players we have. We expect the games to last around 2 hours, but no more than 3 hours. 

What is the prize?

The winner will receive a cash prize (*must be Active Duty E1-E6 to win).

Is registration required?

Yes, please register via this page. Players will be contacted before the event with important event information and reminders.

name: Sri Chinmoy 6-Hour Race San Diego
description:
Challenge yourself and enjoy a beautiful morning run (or walk) on a 5-mile loop course around a serene lake.

Whether you're training for a Fall/Winter marathon or just want to test your endurance, this 6-hour race is an ideal choice. And it's a perfect distance for those seeking to go beyond the marathon distance.

In addition to the fuel and encouragement you'll get at the aid stations, you'll be able to leave your own gear/nutrition in a secure area so you can reach for it each lap or as needed.

Laps and mileage are counted via chip. Splits are given every 5 miles (one loop of the course). There are permanent markers at every 1/4 mile.

All paces welcome--see what you can do in 6 hours! Race is limited to 70 participants. 

All participants receive a medal and a Certificate of Completion. Awards are given to top runners in M/W Open, M/W 50-59, and M/W 60/Over.

name: St. Helena Hometown Harvest Festival 5K Race and 1mi Fun Run/Walk
description:
Please join Core Community Fitness along with St. Helena Parks and Recreation to start off the St. Helena Harvest Festival outside and moving! Join us for the 5k Race or the 1mi Fun Run/Walk on the morning of October 18, 2025!

5K Race winner packages, for the top male and female winner, will include a FULL WEEKENED GET AWAY in St. Helena, CA including a hotel stay, wine tastings, meals and a massage! (Must be 21 years or older to win).

We are offering family packages so you can all run together. We want to encourage ALL of you to get out, move and have fun with your family and your community! Up to 6 family members can run for just $80. 

Post race all bib runners for both races will receive fun swag, medals, hydration drinks and more! If you register before the end of September a Harvest Festival Race Shirt will be included in with your registration!

This year we are asking for donations for the Damian Maldonado Memorial Foundation.  Damian is a Napa Valley local passed away suddenly at the age of 17. In his memory, the Damian Maldonado Memorial Scholarship Fund has been established. Damian was a dynamic young man on his way to college. The scholarship will be funded to help students in Napa Valley fulfill their college dreams.

Damian was loyal to his family and friends, honored his heritage, and performed service to his community. Therefore, the scholarship committee will look to award scholarships to those similar in nature. This scholarship is open to all who qualify and it is not based on ethnicity, race or gender. 100% of donations will go to this wonderful local non-profit 501(c)3.

Celebrate St. Patrick’s Day with a fun and festive run that’s as much about the spirit of the holiday as it is about the finish line! Whether you're running, walking, or just along for the ride, this 5K/10K/13.1 is the perfect way to enjoy the day with friends, family, and fellow revelers.
Dress up in your favorite green gear—shamrocks, leprechaun hats, and everything in between—and join us for a race full of fun and good cheer!

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

name: Step Up for Accreta - Virtual Step Challenge & Fundraiser
description:
"Step Up for Accreta" is a 10-day step challenge event and fundraiser for National Accreta Foundation during the month of October - Accreta Awareness Month! Can you make it to 72,000?

Track your steps with your smart watch, smartphone or pedometer. Sign in at the end of the week and log your steps!

The event focuses attention on placenta accreta spectrum, one of the fastest growing life-threatening complications of pregnancy.

During Accreta Awareness Month, National Accreta Foundation encourages patients, survivors, medical professionals and public health advocates to spread the word about increased rates and risk factors associated with placenta accreta, including cesarean overuse. Funds raised during the month of October will support National Accreta Foundation's programs and efforts in these areas.

Placenta accreta currently affects as many as 1 in 272 births, putting the mom at risk of severe blood loss, preterm birth, hysterectomy, and other complications. Every mom deserves risk-appropriate obstetric care. Making this a reality requires increasing awareness of accreta, supporting and advocating for moms and babies, and connecting patients and providers with resources to help improve quality of care.

 
Join us:
Your first step is to Register.

Those who wish to fundraise and not count steps, you must register  but you do not have to log steps.  

Step with a purpose this October! See if you can get 72,000 steps in! That's 7,200 a day. 
Over 10 days, every step you take helps raise awareness of placenta accreta and supports the life-saving programs of the National Accreta Foundation. Whether you’ve experienced accreta firsthand, cared for someone through it, or are passionate about supporting families affected, your participation makes a difference. Together, we’ll walk, connect, and move with purpose—each step symbolizing strength, advocacy, and hope for the accreta community. Register, set a goal for yourself or your team, and share the reason why you step up for accreta awareness!

Registration includes:

  • Donation to National Accreta Foundation
  • Fundraising page to share your story and why accreta awareness matters to you
  • A digital bib
  • Accreta Survivor Bag Charm or Belly Logo Necklace

Top fundraiser at the end of the month will be crowned our 2025 Accreta Awareness Champion and receive accreta swag and a special certificate for their efforts!

Other Fundraising Level Prizes:

  • $250 will receive a NAF Koozie Cup
  • $500 will receive a  NAF Tote + $10 gift card to our Gear Store.
  • $750 will receive the choice of a NAF Embroidered Blanket or NAF Tote + $25 gift card to our Gear Store.
  • $1,000 will receive a new NAF Engraved Hydroflask Tumbler + $25 gift card to our Gear Store.

Make it fun:

  • Wear your accreta gear and take a photo while you participate and send it to us or tag us on social! 
  • Choose a location to get some extra steps and take a walk with your family, friends and/or local accreta sisters
  • Record a short video on why you are "Stepping Up for Accreta!" and use our #AccretaAwareness hashtag

name: Steps for Strength: Bay Area Young Survivors (BAYS)
description:
Bay Area Young Survivors (BAYS) is hosting its second annual Steps for Strength 5K and 10K at Campbell Park in Campbell, CA. The event kicks off at 8:30 a.m. with a health resource fair, followed by the 5K and 10K walk/run at 9:00 a.m. The 3.1-mile loop course is flat and scenic, winding through Campbell Park. The 6.2 -mile loop is mostly flat with a few inclines. Water stations will be available at the start/finish line and halfway point, with public restrooms at the finish. This 5K and 10K event will be a professionally timed race. 

 

This family-friendly event features a playground, music, a food truck, face painting, and more fun activities for kids. After the race, enjoy participant medals, the health resource fair, and snacks. All proceeds benefit BAYS and its free programs for young breast cancer survivors.

 

ABOUT BAYS:
Bay Area Young Survivors (BAYS) is an all-volunteer, 501(c)(3) nonprofit supporting young breast cancer survivors under 45 in the San Francisco Bay Area by providing emotional support and resources for life during and after cancer. Funds raised will help fund free programming offered to members such as: support groups, educational workshops, community meetups, and emergency financial assistance.

 

MORE INFORMATION

  • Create a TEAM with friends, family, or colleagues, or register as an individual to participate in-person or virtually!
  • Set a fundraising goal and help BAYS by encouraging your community to sponsor your run—or your team’s run.
  • Together, we can raise awareness and support for young adults with breast cancer in the Bay Area. Help spread the word about BAYS and the vital services we offer to those in need.
  • Can’t Attend the Steps for Strength on May 2, 2026 ? You can still make a difference by making a donation to BAYS! Click the yellow "Donate" tab at the top to contribute. Any donation, big or small, will be greatly appreciated and go a long way in helping us continue to offer free services to our young breast cancer members.

VOLUNTEER SIGN UP
Interested in Volunteering?

We have a variety of roles and skillsets needed for this exciting event! To sign up, use the link in the header.

 

SPONSORSHIP OPPORTUNITIES

Interested in Sponsoring? 

Become a sponsor and make a lasting impact at this incredible event! We offer a variety of sponsorship opportunities for your business or organization. Your support will directly benefit Bay Area Young Survivors (BAYS) and help provide essential resources for young adults with breast cancer in our community.

  • To sponsor, head to the Sponsors tab in the header, complete our     or email us at runwithbays@bayareayoungsurvivors.org
  • To learn more about sponsorship opportunities, please reach out to us. We’d love to discuss how we can collaborate for a great cause!

name: Sugar Daddy Race
description:
WELCOME TO THE SUGAR DADDY RACE!

Celebrate Father's Day by kicking off the weekend with an awesome race taking you on a scenic tour through the beautiful Santa Clarita Valley in a Half Marathon, 10K, 5K, or Kids race.

Get your PR on our fast, almost flat course on paved paseo trails. Created to bring runners together for a great race experience as you finish across the historic Iron Horse bridge into the finish line to earn our epic Sugar Daddy Race bling, plus receive yummy Ben & Jerry's ice cream to help cool you down from your awesome run! 

Learn more below or register today to secure your spot at the start line!

FAST COURSE
Runners get to enjoy the best of Santa Clarita's awesome paths and paseos taking runners on a spectacular tour around the Santa Clarita Valley on a very fast course. 
 
HISTORIC BRIDGE
All runners get to make the final push into finish line to run across the historic 120-year old Iron Horse bridge, making for a landmark race finish.
 
FAMILY FUN
The Sugar Daddy Race is for everyone, runners, walkers, hikers, there is even a Kids Fun Run for the little ones to get active and healthy to experience a race.
 
SWEET FINISH
In addition to earning an awesome medal, Sugar Daddy finishers will get a special ice cream treat to help cool them off after finishing the race.

Learn more at >> SugarDaddyRace.com

name: Summer Solstice Run : 5K & 10K – LONG BEACH
description:
🌞 SUMMER SOLSTICE GLOW RUN: 5K & 10K – LONG BEACH 🌊✨


“Run the Longest Day, Shine the Brightest Way!”

Celebrate the longest day of the year with an electrifying glow run along the scenic Long Beach coastline! As the sun sets, the party begins—race under the golden hues of twilight and light up the night with glow sticks, black lights, and high-energy music. Whether you’re running the 5K or 10K, this is your chance to embrace the solstice spirit with a vibrant community of runners.

💛 Wear bright colors to glow under the black lights!

 
📍 Bib Pick-Up & Start Times
📅 Race Day Check-In
🕕 6:00 AM - | Location: Race Ready Athletics Tent near the start line

🏁 Race Start
🕡 7:00 AM Half Marathon | 5K & 10K - 7:30 AM

 
🚗 Parking Information
✅ Street Parking: Free 
✅ Beach Lot: $2.00 per hour

 
🏆 Awards & Recognition


Cross the finish line and glow with pride! All finishers receive a medal
🥇 The Top 3 male & female finishers in each distance will receive special medals to commemorate their glowing achievement.

 
🔥 Why Join the Summer Solstice Glow Run?
🌅 Scenic Course: Run along the stunning Long Beach coastline, soaking in ocean views, palm trees, and sunset vibes.

🎉 Glow & Go: Run at dusk, glow under the black lights, and keep the energy high!

🎶 Post-Race Celebration: The party doesn’t stop at the finish line! Dance under the summer night sky with music, refreshments, and fun photo ops.

☀️ Embrace the Solstice Spirit: This isn’t just a run—it’s a celebration of light, life, and the joy of movement!

 
🔥 Get ready to glow, vibe, and celebrate the arrival of summer! 🔥

 

🌴 LET THE SUMMER BEGIN! 🌞✨

name: Sunrise Marathon 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
🌅 Rise. Run. Shine. – The Sunrise Marathon 2026 🌄

Start your day with purpose, peace, and a little pavement-pounding joy.
Join us for the Sunrise Marathon — a breathtaking early-morning race designed to energize your soul and awaken your senses.

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)
