Everyone is a superhero in their own way. From all the moms out there, to our front line workers, to even just those who are simply a friend to someone else. So for every superhero out there (that includes YOU), You make a Difference and we celebrate that with a fun run!

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

name: Support Blue Fresno
description:
Join us at this year's Support Blue Run to show your support for our men and women in law enforcement who protect our Valley!  By participating, you are helping to support the Fresno Police and Fire Chaplaincy, a non-profit dedicated to partnering with Fresno Police and Fire Departments and committed to being first to serve - providing spiritual and emotional support to first responders and the community.
The Fresno Support Blue Run campaign aims to:
  • Foster trust and confidence between our officers and the community they serve
  • Provide opportunity for our community to visibly show their support for law enforcement
  • Educate youth to enhance relationships and understanding with officers
  • Raise funds to provide staff and resources for the Fresno Police and Fire Chaplaincy programs who support our volunteer Police Chaplains and the Fresno Police and Fire Departments

Children 9 & under registering for the 5K/2M will receive a discount applied at checkout.

name: Tahoe Forest Health System Fall Fun Run
description:
Join the Tahoe Forest Health System for our Fall Fun Run! Get your steps in by celebrating health and wellness during Walk-tober, try out your first 5k, or push it for a new PR. This family friendly race will start and finish at the Truckee Regional Park, taking you down on the Legacy Trail and along the beautiful Truckee River. Costumes are encouraged! 

 

EVENT SCHEDULE:


7:30am to 8:30am – Packet/Bib pick up at the Truckee Regional Park Farmer's Market Lot 

9:00am – All races being, staggered by distance at the Truckee Regional Park Farmer's Market Lot

10:00am to 12:00pm - Music, Lunch for Purchase & Race Participant Beer or Hop Water from FiftyFifty 

12:00pm – Races Conclude

 

COURSE DETAILS:
All Races will start and end in the wood chip parking lot at the Truckee Regional Park near the start of the disc golf course. The races will take place on the Legacy Trail, the 1 mile and will contain a minor downhill section towards the river and uphill section back to the finish line, the 5k and 10k will have an additional section of uphill/downhill on a dirt path.

 

IMPORTANT NOTES:

  • The race course WILL remain open to other pedestrians. Please be mindful of your surroundings and attentive/respectful of other Legacy Trail users.
  • Please leave pets at home for this event. \Participants will be asked to stay on the right side of this walking/bike path for the entire race. \
  • There will be a water/first aid station available along the 5k and 10k course. 
  • All race participants will receive a finisher medal and a beer or NA beverage. 
  • Parking will be available, although limited, at the Truckee Regional Park – 10050 Brockway Rd, in Truckee, CA. Participants can also park near the Truckee Skate Park and Truckee Rodeo Grounds.

name: Take Flight Run
description: The Liberty High School(LHS) Boys Basketball team from Madera Ranchos is planning to attend a tournament in Hawaii in the fall and will be hosting a fundraising event. The Take Flight Run will be on October 11, 2025 at Liberty High School. This fundraiser will support this once-in-a-lifetime opportunity for the boys' basketball team. This tournament will assist the team with their development in basketball skills, team building, and experience. The tournament will serve as a great opportunity for growth, and it will be memorable!

name: Teaming Up Against Cancer
description:
Online registration closes on Thursday, March 13, 2025 at 11:59pm.  If you would like to come out to the event as a cancer survivor or general visitor, please feel free to do so...there is no charge.  The opening ceremony and survivor ceremony is at 9am on Saturday, March 15th.  Competitions are to follow.  Cornhole competition opportunities are available onsite for $20 per person.

Please scroll down to view Game Rules, Event Schedule and Event Map.

This exciting competition brings local businesses, service organization and families of all sizes together for a variety of fun and entertaining activities.  It's a great opportunity to promote teamwork and a sense of pride. All proceeds benefit the Kern County Cancer Foundation.

Teams will compete in a variety of fun and low-skill activities all while vying for the most accumulated points and ultimately, ownership of the "Ultimate Cancer Fighters" Team Cup.  Likely competitions include:  Connect 4, Giant Pong, Hoppin' World Cup, Obstacle Course Relay, Bigfoot, and Around the World.  

 

The 2025 Event Schedule, Game Rules, Team Roster and Event Map are at the bottom of the Competition Info section of this website.

This one-day competition will take place at Liberty Park 11225 Brimhall Rd. 93312 in Bakersfield on Saturday, March 15th 9am-2pm with awards and raffle to follow.

Each team consists of 10 members.  A group can enter more than one team if space allows.  If your company/club/family has paid for your team, please see your team leader for your registration code to waive your individual fee.

For more information or help with registration please call 661-825-8249 and speak with Alissa.

description: Are you ready for the Central Valley's SPRING Half Marathon, 10k and 5k events!  Run through picturesque trees and meadows on rolling groomed trails as you view beautiful vistas just minutes north of Fresno's River Park Shopping Center at Highway 41 just past Avenue 14.  The Tesoro Viejo Classic Half Marathon will take you away from busy city streets to tranquil paths through some of the most beautiful SPRING scenery which rivals any run in the State.

name: Thankful Paws Turkey Trot
description:
Join us for the first annual Turkey Trot – Thankful Paws 5K/10K Run on Thanksgiving morning at Rohr Park, in the beautiful city of Bonita, located in Chula Vista, CA.

This special day is dedicated to giving thanks to our pets—past and present—for the joy, love, and companionship they've brought into our lives and homes.

Enjoy a scenic course alongside a golf course and vibrant community park—perfect for both serious runners and casual participants. Whether you're chasing a PR on a fast course or simply looking for a joyful way to start your holiday, this event has something for everyone. We’re offering a 5K, 10K, Kids’ Mile, and our always-popular Doggy Mile!

Bring the whole family—including your four-legged friends—and kick off your Thanksgiving with a fun, active, and festive tradition.

All proceeds benefit Kane's Animal Rescue, a local nonprofit dedicated to giving abandoned and at-risk pets a second chance at life. So, while you're breaking a sweat, you're also making a difference.

Come trot with us, give thanks, and support a great cause—because every step helps save a paw.

 

Proceeds will benefit Kanes K9s & Animal Rescue! 

Kanes K9s is a local nonprofit animal rescue organization. Proceeds from ticket sales will be donated to the rescue.

name: Thanksgiving Turkey Gobble Trot 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
Get Ready to Wobble Before You Gobble!
Join us for the annual Thanksgiving Gobble Trot 5K Run/Walk

Before you dive into the stuffing and turkey this year, get a run/walk in with your family, friends, and community.
Burn some Calories, Make some Memories but spots do fill up faster than Grandma's gravy boat!
Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!

name: The 41st Annual Newark Mile 4k (2025)
description:
CXC4L is proud to announce that we will be hosting the Newark Mile again in 2026. The race will take place along its traditional 2.5 mile (4km) course along the Newark Days parade route (see course map below for more detail). We are pleased to be hosting the 41st running of this local Newark favorite in partnership with the Newark Days Celebration!

After the race, stick around to enjoy the rest of the Newark Days such as carnival rides, parade, live entertainment, food festival, beer & wine pavillion, car show, and an arts & crafts fair.

name: The 7th Annual Hermosa Beach 2 Mile Sand Run
description:
Join us for the The 7th Annual Beach Run aka the “Sandy Sauté”! A Legendary Hermosa Beach favorite. Whether you meet us at the Pier, or run virtually wherever you live, you’ll feel the vibe and the spirit of our community.

The 2 mile Beach Run is on the beach just north of the Hermosa Beach Pier. The course heads north in the sand for 1 mile out, then loops back to the finish line.

All Runners and Walkers will start at 2:00pm. Join us after the run for happy hour at one of the restaurants on the pier!

We love a good costume race, so this is your chance to ditch your regular race gear and dress up! Pants Off Racing’s philosophy has always leaned on the notion that no one races in pants (until yoga pants were invented). The top 3 male and female finishers will receive a prize package curated by several of our favorite retailers (lululemon, Vuori, Rainbow Sandals, Good, etc.). If you are feeling festive wear something that shows your spirit. We encourage fun running outfits and also have prizes for those that show their spirit!

As always, all proceeds go to support the families impacted by Pancreatic Cancer. Quick note, if you want to receive a race shirt make sure you add this item when you register for the race. We promise our shirts will be in your weekly rotation because they are the best quality. Also, there will be limited sizes and quantity for purchase on Race day.

We are hoping for a perfect day, and maybe even getting into the water after the beach run!

Please email us at pantsoffracing@gmail.com if you have any questions.

name: The Bertman Run
description:
Join us for a Fun Run (5k, 10k, Half Marathon or virtual run/walk) to raise crucial funds for Leukemia and Lymphoma Society (LLS) NOW CALLED Blood Cancer United in Honor of Bert Vicchio (Bertman)- race director's (Lianne Vicchio) dad. The fight to terminate blood cancer is ongoing and funds raised from the race will be donated to Blood Cancer United. 

Where: Historic Folsom Station North Park and Ride (diagonal from Practical Cycle on Leidnesdorff and Folsom Blvd, at the end of the light rail station and the parking garage) 

When: Saturday January 17th, 2026 8:00am

Course Description: This is an out and back course on the American River Trail starting at the park and ride lot. THIS COURSE IS open and available to other river parkway users. PLEASE always stay to the left as walkers/runners on the bike trail. There will be an aid station at the 10k turn around and another at the Half marathon turnaround. No aid station for the 5k course. There is NO official BATHROOM at race start, please plan accordingly. There are bathrooms on course/on the bike trail. 

Packet/Bib Pick-up is DAY OF ONLY. Starting at 6:55am, 1/17/26 at the Park and Ride lot. There are no official timing chips. Times will be logged manually. We hope in future years as this fundraiser grows, we will be able to add official timing to this race. 

Goodie bags, bibs, and morning treats will be ready for you at check-in. Medals will be awarded to all participants. Awards will be handed out for 1st place male and female in both the 5k, 10k and Half Marathon. NO medals or awards will be mailed out if not collected on race day. 

Racing with us Virtually? Register as normal and send us your pictures and tag us on Instagram @LLS_Bertmanrun

name: The Captain’s Runaround
description:
It's time for The Captain's Runaround!

For those not familiar with Captain’s, it is a timed race. Runners compete in 4-, 6-, or 8, or new for this year, 2 hour events to see how many miles they can complete.

This year, we are back at Jacob Myers Park in Riverbank.  While the loop is just shy of 1 mile, it is a fantastic place to spend the day. 

Embrace the short days of fall and take on Captain’s Runaround. You’ll be glad you did.

name: The Coffee Cruise  – 5K, 10K, 10-Miler, Half Marathon
description:
Join us for a jolt!

Race Details

Start Location: Alamitos Beach, 780 E Shoreline Dr. Long Beach, CA
Parking: Parking in the lot is $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free.

Event Schedule

Saturday
1:00-3:00pm – Early bib pick-up on the 2nd floor at Sports Basement Long Beach (store discount sent via email the week of the event)
2100 N Bellflower Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90815

Sunday
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens
7:00am – Half marathon & 10m start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10m)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for 10m and half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Courses

5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route
10m: The 5m route is used for the 10m (two laps) – 5m route
Half: The 5m route is run twice and the 5k route is run once for the Half – 5m route and 5k route

More about the Course

The beach path is an open course, so you will encounter others using it. When we start the race, please stay on the right side of the beach path. The right side is for pedestrians and the left side is for cyclists. 

On-Course Support: A fully stocked water station is located at the Belmont Pier. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, gatorade, gels, and fruit snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk, a runner turn sign, and a flag


Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Awards: 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.
Results: A link for race results and photos will be sent the day after the race. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, the San Fernando Valley, Orange County, and San Diego. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule.

name: THE CREATIVE CENTER FOUNDATION "SUPER BOWL SPRINT"
description: Get those running shoes ready! It's time to lace up for a great cause with Creative Center Foundation's Fourteenth Annual Super Bowl Sprint. Our goal with this 5K race & 2-mile walk is to raise funds needed to complete capital improvement projects at the Creative Center to ensure a safe and accessible environment for our clients. We invite you to join us to help make a difference! Proceeds from this event will be used for capital improvements to the Creative Center facility so that artists with developmental disabilities can continue to be empowered. Become a sponsor or register now, and let's make a positive difference in our community!

name: The Donut Fun Run 2025!
description:
Join us for the 3rd annual Donut Fun Run & Finish Line Festival! 

Saturday, October 18, 2025 @ 9am

Alameda Seaplane Lagoon Promenade

We kick off the day getting the crowd pumped-up for a scenic family-friendly 5k run along the historic Alameda Seaplane Lagoon, past the USS Hornet with incredible views of San Francisco, and back to the start where the festival begins.

The Finish Line Festival will feature a wide variety of food and craft vendors from all over Northern California, our now-famous Donut Eating Contest (open to our race participants), performances by the Dancing Donuts and other live entertainment and music, and a kids play area. 

 

Please note: Kids 10 and under run for free. You can add a finisher's medal and/or t-shirt at the time of registration. EVERYONE running in the race must register individually and sign the participation waiver.  

 

** All registration fees are NON-refundable. We are unable to issue refunds for any reason. Please purchase registration insurance at the time of registration and RunSignUp will help you process refunds. **

 

Bib & T-Shirt Pick-Up:

  • Wednesday, October 15 from 10am - 5pm @ Lauren's Closet (1420 Park St, Alameda, CA 94501)
  • Thursday, October 16 from 10am - 5pm @ Lauren's Closet (1420 Park St, Alameda, CA 94501)
  • Friday, October 17 from 8am - 8pm @ Donut Petit (711 Santa Clara Ave, Alameda, CA 94501)
  • IF you want someone to pick up your race packet on your behalf, they must be able to provide the full name you registered under, your home address, and phone number. Thank you. 

 

  • Before the race Saturday, October 18 from 7:30am - 9am @ Alameda Seaplane Lagoon Promenade for $5 pick-up fee 

Donut Eating Contest

To Register for the Donut Eating Contest, you must register for (and complete) the Donut Fun Run 5k race. Must be over 18 and a legal resident of California. For more information and to sign up please visit: https://forms.office.com/r/Fh1X6EN9aK. 

 

FAQ

  • Are kids on strollers or bikes allowed on the course?
    • Yes. Everyone who is not in a stroller is required to register for the race or they will not be permitted on the course. Children under 10 can register for free. Everyone running, walking, biking or scooting the course, regardless of age, is required to register for the race and sign the race waiver. We will stagger the start times on the day of the race and runners with strollers or accompanied by children on bikes or scooters will start slightly after to minimize hazards. Adults are not allowed on the course on bikes or scooters. 
  • Are dogs allowed on the course?
    • Yes. To minimize hazards on the course, any runner participating in the race with a dog will run after the runners and runners with children have gone. We will stagger start times in order to minimize issues along the course.
  • Are tickets refundable?
    • Tickets are non-refundable. The event organizers are not able to offer refunds. If you are unsure if you will be able to attend, please select race insurance for a small fee. RaceSheild Race Insurance processes all refunds. 
  • Do you have a virtual option?
    • I'm sorry we do not have a virtual option for the race at this time. 
  • Can someone pick up my race packet on my behalf?
    • Yes. If you would like someone to pick up your race packet on your behalf, they must be able to provide the full name you registered under, your home address and phone number. We cannot release race packets to anyone without them confirming this information.

name: The Encino Man Ice Age Dash
description:
January 10, 2026 · 7:00 a.m. PST · 6846 Owensmouth Ave, Canoga Park, CA

Dig out your loincloth and unfreeze your running shoes—it's time for The Encino Man Ice Age Dash! Inspired by the 1992 cult classic that gave us “wheezin’ the juice” and prehistoric high school vibes, this race is a hilarious, frozen-in-time celebration of thawed-out bros and SoCal slacker culture.

  • The Slurpee-Fueled Half Marathon🥤 Powered by sugar, sarcasm, and the spirit of Pauly Shore.
  • The Multiverse Frozen Fossil Fun Run (Virtual) 🧊 Join from your own glacier and still claim your medal. Bonus points for running in a fur vest.

---

Run any distance between Jan 10–12 and we’ll ship your medal right to your cave. No need to defrost.

This is a Jed & Ted’s Excellent Race—fun, fast, and full of nostalgia.

Sign up now. Because evolution waits for no one.


---

This race is a fan-made parody event inspired by 90s pop culture and is not affiliated with or endorsed by any official trademark holders.

name: The Ghostly Gallup – 5K, 10K, 10-Miler, Half Marathon
description:
Get ready to face your fears (and your personal best) at the Ghostly Gallup!

Race Details

Start Location: Alamitos Beach, 780 E Shoreline Dr. Long Beach, CA
Parking: Parking in the lot is $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free.

Event Schedule

Saturday
10:00am-12:00pm – Early bib pick-up on the 2nd floor at Sports Basement Long Beach (store discount sent via email the week of the event & post event)
2100 N Bellflower Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90815

Sunday
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens at the tables closest to Claremont Ave
7:00am – Half marathon & 10m start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10m)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for 10m and half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Courses
5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route
10m: The 5m route is used for the 10m (two laps) – 5m route
Half: The 5m route is run twice and the 5k route is run once for the Half – 5m route and 5k route

More about the Course:
The beach path is an open course, so you will encounter others using it. When we start the race, please stay on the right side of the beach path. The right side is for pedestrians and the left side is for cyclists.

On-Course Support:
A fully stocked water station is located at the Belmont Pier. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, gatorade, gels, and fruit snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk, a runner turn sign, and a flag


Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Awards: 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.
Results: A link for race results and photos will be sent the day after the race. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, Santa Monica, and Fountain Valley. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule.

Have Another Question? Check our FAQ page, it's probably answered there!

name: The HEART RUN Half Marathon & 5K /10K / Half Marathon
description:
BOLSA CHICA STATE BEACH. LOT 25  

Race Day Schedule:
 6:30 AM RACE DAY REGISTRATION begins
 7:00 am to 11 am FEBRUARY FESTIVAL EXPO.  Full of FUN.  Make your own Valentines. Be a Valentine. 
 8:00 AM START of the HEART RUN HALF MARATHON START (only)
 8:15 AM Kid's Dash
 8:30 AM Start of the HEART RUN 5k/10K Mass start
 9:00 AM Begins the Overall Race award winners, followed by division winners 5k  9:30 10K awards begins
9:45am Begins the Half Marathon Awards Ceremony

CELEBRATE Valentine's in a healthy HEART filled way! Choose 5K /10K/ or Half Marathon . Bring family, friends, or a sweetheart. Or, possibly meet one! It's a full fledged February celebration.  YOUR largest, and BEST February heart themed RACE !

You will get a bib and a 5K shirt or half marathon hoodie, and a custom medal that matches.  Everyone gets a finisher medal. Amazing and ample age division awards. also.  Top three overall awards.  The expo has a "full of heart " section. There is even a make-your-own Valentine card station.  

Also available as an add-on: A $6 food voucher ticket. This can get street tacos, tamales, a drink, and a tamale or a coffee drink from the coffee stand.   Or, home baked Valentine's cookies. Or you can bring cash for race morning.

TESLA TRUCKS & VEHICLES will be there to TEST DRIVE. You will need a copy or proof of a driver's license.

 Remember to also have $15 cash on hand if you are coming in the State Park gate to park. We encourage carpools.  There is free parking throughout Sunset Beach if you are willing to jog east and into that last LOT 25 on the corner of Warner and PCH. No car entrance is available at that far corner.  All vehicles coming into the Bolsa Chica State Park must come in the main gate in the mid-section.   

Awards:

 5K RUN/WALK: Age Group Awards for 1st, 2nd, and 3rd  TOP Overall Male/Female Trophy 1-10, 11-14, 15-19, 20-24, 25-29, 30-34, 35-39 40-44, 45-49, 50-54,55-59 60-64, 65-69, 70-74, 75-79, -over.80-84, 85-89, 90 plus

HALF MARATHON: Age Group Awards for Half Marathon 1st, 2nd, and 3rd  Top Overall Male/Female Trophy,1-14, 15-19, 20-24, 25-29, 30-34, 35-39 40-44, 45-49, 50-54,55-59 60-64, 65-69, 70-74, 75-79, 80-84, 85-89, 90 plus

Pick up BIBs and SHIRTS on Race Day at LOT 25.  Beginning at 6:30am. The gates to the STATE PARK opens at 6 am.

HALF MARATHON gets long sleeve ZIP up or PULL over HOODIES for the HALF MARATHON that say FINISHER on them.   Medals help commemorate FEBRUARY themes.     MAKE GOALS for yourself in February.

PLAN ON having a GOOD TIME!  It's the party you make of it.  Bring your zeal, energy , and our hope is this makes your February that much more special...because you are ! Check out how the proceeds help Caren Ware spread health and hope to the needs she has RAN into running a remote marathon on every continent. 

PARKING 

  Plan on paying $15 per car that enters the State Park gate, or...park in the many slots in Sunset Beach south of PCH behind the Jack n the Box on Warner and PCH and jog into LOT 25 of the state park. 

RESTROOMS are provided by the STATE PARK and are located on the FAR ends of lot 25.  Plan on taking a few minutes to venture to them.

name: The Hoag OC Marathon Running Festival
description: The Hoag OC Marathon Running Festival includes four different runs during the first weekend in May annually. The weekend of running begins at the OC Fair and Event Center on Saturday morning with the award winning Hoag Kids Run the OC when nearly 9,000 kids from over 150 Orange County schools participate. The afternoon kicks off with the CELEBRATE OC Festival with local sports teams, craft brews and some of Orange County's iconic brands and live music all day. Later in the day on Saturday, the OC 5K takes place with a fun, flat tour of the OC Fairgrounds and nearby Orange Coast College followed by the Celebrate OC Finish Festival. Sunday morning begins early in Newport Beach. The exceptional OC Marathon & Half Marathon course is a blend of chic coastal scenery, tranquil nature and sophisticated arts and shopping which equal the best of OC. Enjoy breathtaking views of the Pacific Ocean and cruise down historic PCH through the seaside village of Corona del Mar. Run above pristine wetlands of Upper Newport, the Arts District and shopping mecca of South Coast Plaza in the "Heart of the OC" to the supportive cheers of residents in the many diverse neighborhoods and finish with a huge party at the Sunday Celebrate Finish Festival at the OC Fair and Event Center.

Run above pristine wetlands of Upper Newport, the Arts District and shopping mecca of South Coast Plaza in the "Heart of the OC" to the supportive cheers of residents in the many diverse neighborhoods and finish with a huge party at the Sunday Celebrate Finish Festival at the OC Fair and Event Center.

name: The Jingle Bell Dash 5K, 10K and Half Marathon
description:
The Jingle Bell Run – A Holiday Race by the Beach!
📍 Bolsa Chica State Beach, Lot 25 – Huntington Beach, CA
📅 December 13, 2025
🏃 5K | 10K | Half Marathon

Get ready to dash into the holiday season with the Kris Kringle Jingle Run! Set against the breathtaking backdrop of Bolsa Chica State Beach, this festive race brings holiday cheer, coastal vibes, and plenty of jingle bells to go around! Whether you're here to race, celebrate, or just enjoy the holiday magic, this event is guaranteed to fill your spirit with joy!

 
🎄 What’s Included?
✅ Festive Finisher Medal – A custom-designed holiday medal for all participants!
✅ Exclusive Holiday Race Shirt – A special Christmas-themed shirt to wear all season long.
✅ Chip-Timed Event – Accurate timing for all runners.
✅ Age Division Awards – Celebrate your race-day victory!
✅ Top 3 Overall Male & Female Awards – For each race distance.

 
🎅 More Than Just a Race – Holiday Fun for All!
🎭 Costume Contest – Show Off Your Holiday Spirit!
Dress up as Santa, an elf, a reindeer, or even the Grinch! The most creative and festive costumes will win special prizes!

🔔 Jingle Bell Dash Challenge!
Every runner will receive jingle bells for their shoes! The challenge? Be the jolliest runner on the course! The runner who jingles the loudest wins a prize!

📸 Santa’s Photo Booth & Holiday Fun Zone!
Snap a picture with Santa, enjoy festive treats, and soak in the holiday magic at our post-race Holiday Fun Zone!

🎶 Live DJ Playing Holiday Jams!
Stay after the race for a coastal holiday party with music, games, and fun for the whole family!

 
🎟 Registration & Packet Pick-Up
Bib Pick-Up: 6:00 AM – 8:00 AM (Race Ready Athletics Tent)
🏁  Half Marathon Start 7:30 AM
🏃‍♂️ 5K & 10K Start: 8:30 AM

🚨 Important: No late starts. Arrive early to ensure you’re ready to run!

 
🚗 Parking Information
✅ State Beach Lot 25 – Bolsa Chica State Beach ($15 parking fee – carpool if possible!)
✅ Limited metered street parking available nearby.

 
🎅 Weather & Safety
❄️ Rain or Shine Event!
☀️ Expect cool coastal breezes – perfect for a winter run!
🌀 In case of extreme weather (Santa getting stuck in the sandstorm, a gingerbread house collapse, or a rogue reindeer invasion), updates will be sent via email & social media.

 
🎁 Spread the Cheer!
📲 Tag us with #CaliFlowRuns for a chance to be featured!
🎟 Tune in on Fridays for #FreeEntryFriday—answer fun questions to win a free race entry!

 
Don’t miss out on the most festive beachside run of the season! Sign up today and jingle all the way to the finish line! 🎅🏃‍♀️🎄

name: The Kayla Bernardi BEE Positive Fun Run Walk
description:
The Kayla Bernardi Bee Positive Foundation was started after Kayla lost her battle to leukemia in 2015. As a family we choose to stay focused on the positive and make a difference in our community. Kayla's nickname was Busy Bee and so it was a natural name to attach to her foundation. We raise money to spread throughout the community in her foundations name. We hope that attaching a "Bee Positive" message inspired people beyond the monetary donation. Losing Kayla continues to pain us in a way that is indescribable, raising funds in her name inspires us to continue her legacy and "Bee Positive" even on the hardest of days. Kayla’s birthday was January 31st, so every year we do a 5K Fun Run Walk to honor her legacy and raise money to spread throughout many communities.

Come out and have a GREAT time participating in a fun run/walk that will embrace the spirit of Kayla. After the run, we will keep the BEE Positive vibe going with the POST RUN BEE POSITIVE PARTY AT DUST BOWL BREWERY.
Please join us in Dust Bowl’s Turlock Beer Garden on January 25th, 2025 from 11am-2pm for music, corn hole, and a BEE Positive Vibe. The first 250 participants 21 and older with a bib from the 2025 Fun Run/Walk will get one complimentary beer or seltzer. Participants under 21 can enjoy a free soda or hop water. The food trailer, and outdoor bar will also be open for the occasion. Partake in a special edition Bizzy BEE beer brewed especially for this event!

name: The Krampus Cross Country 5K, 10K, or Naughty Nine Miler (LIVE or VIRTUAL)!
description:
Hide. RUN! Krampus is KOMING!

You have not run far enough. Nor have you run fast enough. Krampus is displeased. Pay penance to Krampus on Sun, 12/7/25 in San Francisco (or virtually from 12/5/25-12/8/25) and avoid incurring the wrath of Krampus!

  • Where: Ecology Trail Head @ the end of Barnard Avenue, San Francisco, CA, 94129 (or ANYWHERE for Virtual)
  • When: Sunday, 12/7/25. The 10K starts at 8AM. The 5K starts at 8:05AM. The Naughty Nine Miler starts at 8:10AM.
  • Course Maps:  Naughty Nine Miler Course Map, 10K Course Map, & 5K Course Map

The Swag:

All participants (Live or Virtual) receive...

  • An AWESOME race woodallion from Aravaipa Artwork
  • A SWEET Krampus lifestyle tee
  • A Krampus beer sampler stein 
  • Pre-race  bib & shirt pickup and BREWFEST at A Runner's Mind (3575 Sacramento St) on Friday, 12/5 from 4-8PM!
  • Post run beverages (bubbly water & soft drinks) & pre-packaged snacks including Jambar and Bellwether Farms yogurt.

PLEASE NOTE WE CANNOT SUPPORT REFUNDS, TRANSFERS, AND/OR CREDITS.

In the event of race cancellation due to wildfires, hazardous air quality, hazardous weather conditions, natural disasters, COVID and/or other global pandemics, or any 'act of God' that is beyond our control, we cannot support refunds, transfers, and/or credits. Please note this has only happened ONCE due to COVID in 2020, but anything is possible. Please make sure you are comfortable with these potential risks before you sign up. 

In the event of race cancellation due to any of the aforementioned, we will ship all race swag/items to participants and provide direction around navigating the course(s) on your own. We'll also provide direction around submitting your result. 

We also cannot support refunds, transfers, and/or race credits if you get injured in the days/week(s) leading up to race day, if your schedule changes in the days/week(s) leading up to race day, if a work trip comes up that makes it impossible for you to attend on race day, and/or any other professional or personal matter that arises making it difficult for you to attend in person on race day.

In the event of any of the aforementioned, we will ship all race swag/items to said participants and provide direction around navigating the course(s) on your own. We'll also provide direction around submitting your result.

name: The Long Beach Leprechaun Run - Kids Dash, 1 Miler, 5k, 10K, & Half Marathon
description:
Get ready to feel the luck of the Irish at Shamrocks by the Shore in beautiful Long Beach on Saturday, March 15th!

This is a Chip Timed Race

This festive St. Patrick’s Day run invites runners of all levels to a fun-filled 5K, 10K, or Half Marathon along the scenic waterfront.

Put on your best green gear and join the fun with Irish-themed cheer zones, a costume contest, and the chance to find golden coins hidden along the course for special prizes!

Celebrate your achievement at the finish line with a one-of-a-kind medal, festive refreshments, and photo ops with pots of gold and rainbows.

Bring the whole family—kids can join the Little Leprechaun Dash or explore the Shamrock Treasure Hunt for even more fun!

Don’t miss this lively celebration of fitness and Irish spirit—register today!

Bib Pick-Up & Start Times:
Bib Pick-Up: 6:00 AM – 7:35 AM (Race Ready Athletics Tent)


Half Marathon Start: 7:00 AM
5K & 10K Start: 7:30 AM

1 Miler - 7:45 AM

Kids Dash - 8:30 AM
Important: There are no late starts. Please arrive early to ensure you're ready for your race!
 

Start Location:
5100  E Ocean Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90803

Granada Beach - Rosies Dog Beach 

Parking Information:


Free street parking is available.
Metered parking is $2.00 per hour (credit card and coin payments accepted).

Additional Race Day Info:


Restrooms are located near the start line.
Water and aid stations every 2 miles.
Stroller and walker-friendly event.
Course is fully marked.

 

Weather & Safety:
This is a RAIN or SHINE Event

In case of severe weather, (Like tsunamis, titlewave, or zombie apocalypse),  updates will be provided via email and our social media channels.

Join the Community:
Tag us on social media with #CaliFlowRuns for a chance to be featured! Tune in on Fridays for a chance to win a free race by answering our #FreeEntryFriday questions.

name: The Main Street Monster Mile
description:
City of San Jacinto and the Boys & Girls Clubs of Inland Valley presents the Main Street Monster Mile!

Run a professionally timed flat mile course against your age group peers down Main Street in San Jacinto. 

Participants will start in waves according to age and there will be medals for age group and overall winners. (Age groups to be announced)

Join us at the finish line for awards and fun family activities!

name: The Marshmallow Dash – 5K, 10K, 10-Miler, Half Marathon
description:
Join us for a sweet treat of a race!

Race Details

Start Location: Alamitos Beach, 780 E Shoreline Dr. Long Beach, CA
Parking: Parking in the lot is $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free. See map at the bottom of this email.

Event Schedule

Saturday
1:00-3:00pm – Early bib pick-up on the 2nd floor at Sports Basement Long Beach (store discount sent via email the week of the event)
2100 N Bellflower Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90815

Sunday
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens at the tables closest to Claremont Ave
7:00am – Half marathon & 10m start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10m)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for 10m and half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Courses

5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route
10m: The 5m route is used for the 10m (two laps) – 5m route
Half: The 5m route is run twice and the 5k route is run once for the Half – 5m route and 5k route

More about the Course:
The beach path is an open course, so you will encounter others using it. When we start the race, please stay on the right side of the beach path. The right side is for pedestrians and the left side is for cyclists. 

On-Course Support:
A fully stocked water station is located at the Belmont Pier. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, gatorade, gels, and fruit snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk, a runner turn sign, and a flag


Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Awards: 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.
Results: A link for race results and photos will be sent the day after the race. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, the San Fernando Valley, Orange County, and San Diego. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule.

Have Another Question? Check our FAQ page, it's probably answered there!

name: The Master's University Winter 5K
description:
Since 2011, The Master’s University Winter 5K has been a favorite among local runners thanks to the welcoming atmosphere, scenic course, and community partnerships. This year we are continuing 2025's new features; the Kids 1K, and a more competitive 5K race – the 5K Challenge. name: The Napa Lapa
description:
The Napa Lapa Trail Adventure is Inside Trail’s first time-based run. This means that instead of running a pre-determined distance as fast as possible, you’ll be running for a pre-determined amount of time as far as possible. And what other place could be better than the beautiful, rolling hills of Napa’s Skyline Wilderness Park?

Skyline Wilderness Park is located in Napa, California. In 1979, the land beside the State Hospital was declared to be surplus and was to be sold to a private party. A group of concerned citizens got together and enlisted the help of various members of the community and government to allow the group to use the land as a park for the Napa Valley. The idea of a park was formed, a constitution was created, incorporation papers drafted, environmental impact studies made, etc. Since there has never been a private sector leasing state land for a park system, the State leased the land to the County of Napa which then subleased it to the Skyline Park Citizens Association. More on the history of Skyline Wilderness Park here.

Skyline park has 25 miles of multi-use fire road and singletrack trails of various skill levels. As a memorial to Martha Walker, the Martha Walker Native Habitat Garden in Skyline Park was created, inviting visitors to enjoy a unique presentation of flora from all over the State.

name: The Observatory Loop Relay
description:
On Thursday, February 26 the Leap Day/Observatory Loop Relay will return for year three. This is a 4 x Mile trail relay race, where teams of two, take on the one mile long Observatory Loop. Each team will run the loop four times, with team members alternating laps, and handing off a baton at the conclusion of each lap. (That means each individual runner will do the loop two times, with a break between each loop.) 

The race will start at 7pm. This means it will be dark during the race! Runners are required to race in headlamps. 

You can sign up with a partner or individually (and we will place you with a partner).

This event is open to runners of all ability levels.

name: The Rabbit Run 5k & OC Challenge Wild Hare 5k IRVINE
description:
IRVINE JEFFREY TRAILS . Race start /finish Jeffrey Trail Middle School

SATURDAY, April 4, 2025

RACE DAY SCHEDULE: 

  • 8:00 AM : The OC CHALLENGE WILD HARE 5K : Competitive race with age division
  • 8:35 am Top 3 Overall Awards 
  • 8:40 am Awards Ceremony for the Wild Hare
  • 8:55 am  THE BUNNY DASH kid's race    (200 yards- 5& under, 400 yards- 6 to 7, 1/2 mile- 8 and above)
  • 9:00 AM  THE RABBIT RUN 5k  All finishers get medals and a special EASTER PRIZE BAG when they finish.( You may use the bag to hide the prizes anywhere in the park or school to give your kids an Easter Hunt experience afterward)
 It's an EGGcellent RUN.  DO both 5ks.  Get two bibs and two Finisher Medals.  One Shirt

Chip timed by ITZ ABOUT TIME. If doing both.  Wear only the one bib each time you run and receive a different medal each run.  

Easter-themed goodie bags and BLING! Awesome soft, fully designed custom shirts. A finisher medal that opens!  An Easter bag full of prizes at the finish! Selfie Pictures with the Easter Bunny! 

BIB PICK IS RACE DAY ONLY . There is no early packet pick up for this race . 

Participants can pick up the day of event. Registration will open at 6:30 am on race morning and continue until the 9am race start. 

COURSE: It is out and back with a twist on a picturesque, landscaped running path.  You will be sharing the route with cyclists, other runners, and dog walkers.  If pushing a stroller, stay to the right.  .  Special appearance of the Easter bunny for great selfie photos!!  Run fast, or enjoy this event with friends &  family! Make your Easter have a healthy kick to it! 

PARKING: At 155 Visions Jeffrey Trail Middle School

And , what better to Spring into SPRING, than to run a Spring race with flower names for street names!

RESTROOMS will be located inside the school buildings to the SOUTH and NORTH of the expo area.  Follow the signs.

PROCEEDS from this event to benefit the formation of Ware in the World Foundation. Proceeds will be going to Miss Pam's Ranch, a working ranch that teaches troubled youth to ride, do chores, build esteem,  and set goals. Miss Pam RUNS her ranch from a wheelchair. We are still trying to raise funds to repair the travel chair we gifted her last year.   Plus, many other projects.  We are earning money to put on a Ware in The World 5k in Tanzania, Africa to inspire a village of youth to aspire in running.

description:

Course Maps: 5K Course Map, 10K Course Map, Half Marathon Course Map

name: The Rocky Hill Triathlon
description:
The Rocky Hill Triathlon returns for the 11th year in Exeter, California! We are the best kept secret in the Central Valley with a course that is challenging and showcases the foothills of the Sierra Nevada mountain range. Our fun course will help push you to new limits and you can earn some of the best swag to prove it! We will be offering two different distances on race day. The Short Course will have a 400 yard swim, 12.5 mile bike & 3.1 mile run. The Long Course will have an 800 yard swim, 24.8 mile bike & 6.2 mile run. New this year is the 10k course which is challenging with two climbs over Rocky Hill. Or choose the 5k which is less challenging

We are USAT sanctioned

Events

-Short Course
-Long Course
-10k
-5k


Why the Rocky Hill Triathlon?

  • Scenic Ride and Run into the foothills

  • FREE Race Photos

  • FREE Beer Ticket to VIP Pizza

  • Rocky Hill Trucker Hat (Triathlon)

  • All Finishers get a Pullover Hoodie

  • Towel (Triathlon)

  • Polar Cycling Water Bottle (Triathlon)

  • Finisher Medal

  • Epic Finish with Music

Age Group Awards

10 Year Age Group Awards for Male and Female short distance, long distance, 5k, and 10k 

Artletic Apparel Kits Available

Artletic has designed custom kits available during registration. A portion of sales will be donated to the Rocky Hill Triathlon
Artletic Store: https://runsignup.com/Race/Store/CA/Exeter/RockyHillTriathlon2023

Who we Support

The Rocky Hill Triathlon has invested more funds back into the Exeter community than any event. Since day one the board and race director have elected to volunteer their services unpaid. A large portion of your registration will used to benefit a park or project in the city of Exeter

name: The RODEO RUN 5K/10K
description:
The RODEO RUN at Huntington Beach State Park 

                       Bringing the WILD WEST Alive!                           

The Cowboy Western-Themed Running Experience 

                                                                      Sunday, March 15, 2026 Huntington State Beach

Western Music. Live horses. Line dance instructors. Cowboy or cowgirl it up!  We are celebrating everything WESTERN.  It’s not just a run, it is the cowboy round-up of the year.  Learn to rope station, and try your turn at 2 stepping.  Best-themed WESTERN wear event shirts.  Custom cast finisher medal that turns into a belt buckle! NEW MEDAL DESIGN each year!  Line dance warm-up area.   5K /10K age division awards.  Top three overall custom awards.  RFID CHIP TIMED by Itz About Time. There is a Wild West in all of us. An extraordinary Caren Ware Event.

Race Start Time  

  • 6:30 am Registration Opens/ EXPO begins. Same day packet pick-up and same-day registration sign-ups.
  • 8:00 am Little Cowpoke Dash (200 and 400 yards)  or 1 Mile Kid's Fun Run
  • 7:30 to 8:30 WILD WEST entertainment and LINE DANCING
  • 8:30 am 5K/10K Start
  • 9:30 am 5k awards
  • 9:45 am 10k Awards

Race Location:  Huntington State Beach, CA. (lot 10. Corner. This is the EAST entrance off of Beach Blvd. and Pacific Coast Hwy. to the Left.  Lot 10. 

  • 21601 Pacific Coast Hwy, Huntington Beach, CA 92646 is the google address.  But enter in the GATE on the corner of PCH and Beach Blvd at 6:30am.  To the EAST.  If you enter to the WEST you are heading into the City of Huntington  Beach lot.  The first lot on the left is the race! Early entry at 6am is at the Main gate on Magnolia and PCH. 
  • After the race, enjoy the fun amenities of Pacific City.  Limited spaces for metered parking on the street.  Parking in Pacific City.  State Park charges $15 for parking so Carpool!  or parking on the metered streets or in Pacific City Parking structure (use the 3/4 or a mile to the race as a warm up for the parking structure)

 Perfect selfie moments! ‘Corral’ camaraderie! Awards are 3 deep in 5-year age spans.  Plus top overall male and female trophies.

Pre-Race Day Packet Pick Up (Not Mandatory.  You can also pick up race morning at the race beginning at 6:30AM)
Date: Saturday, March 14h  11AM TO 1PM.  SPORTS BASEMENT 10800 Kalama River Ave, Fountain Valley, Ca. 92708
YOU CAN pick up for others. No id required.

RACE DAY SIGN UPS are available at RACE SITE  from 6:30 am to 8:15 am.  And RACE DAY PICK-UP AVAILABLE. 
Walk-up registration is welcome on race day. One person may pick up for other participants. Strollers and dogs on leases are allowed.

Registration Fee includes a Western-themed event shirt, a running bib, and the Best BELT BUCKLE  custom cast FINISHER MEDAL ever!  

AWARDS:

There are “In It To Win It” age categories 3 deep with 5-year age spans:
1-10, 11-14, 15-19, 20-24, 25-29, 30-34, 35-39 40-44, 45-49, 50-54,55-59 60-64, 65-69, 70-74, 75-79 and 80-84, 85 & plus.

Presented at 9:30 5K and 9:50 am 10K

PARKING: State Park charges $15 to enter, but you will get to park front row, right next to the event.  Carpool.  Limited meter parking on the street.  Arrive early. Or park at Pacific City and enjoy shops and a bite to eat afterward!

Course: Definitely flat and fast on the paved running path with views of the beach and the sounds of the surf crashing. Great atmosphere. 

PLEASE NOTE: The course IS open to the public and will be shared with CYCLISTS and other runners and dog walkers.

You choose your course tactics. Race…Jog…Stroll…or Roll. Families can bring strollers but agree to use them at their own risk.  Water at the 1 mile/2 mile and turn arounds for the 10K.  

The Cause: Caren Ware Events are the something for EVERYBODY and EVERY BODY races.  Our desire is to host enriching fun, healthy, outdoor options for your lives and, in turn, gift life-enhancing opportunities to others.  Activity helps health. It heals.  It makes life interesting. This is your opportunity to literally RUN a ranch. We are asking for additional donations to support MISS PAM’s Ranch; a ranch that has changed countless lives by a woman in a wheelchair. Do something real and really needed. Miss Pam’s ranch needs wheelchair accessibility. We are going to SPECIALLY BUY HER AN accessible restroom trailer for the ranch.  We can free up funds for ramps with your donations and help feed the animals on the ranch. Pick a project and fall in love with the great combination of kids and livestock. Caren Ware Events is forming the Ware in the World Foundation, which connects cultures through outdoor activities.  Providing hope, happiness, and enhanced life experiences.

Rain or Shine. 

BE Active. BE healthy. Saddle up and enjoy!

name: The Running Dead 5K Fun Run
description:
Running Dead 5K Fun Run 
Date: Sunday, October 19, 2025
Location: Civic Center/ City Hall | 34009 Alvarado-Niles Road, Union City, CA
Check-In: 8 am | Race Begins: 9 am 

They’re back! The Zombies are hungry and out for your flags! Join us this October as we run and dodge our way to the finish line at the Running Dead 5k Fun Run & Walk. This fun community event is a great way to get friends and family active while also celebrating the Halloween holiday. Award medals are handed out to the 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place winners of each registration category broken down by age group and gender Youth Ages 12 & Under, Ages 13-17, 18-29, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, 60-69, and 70+). We will also have awesome prize raffles for participants after finishing the race, with a special raffle held for those who survive the Zombie challenge.

Zombie Challenge:
All registrants can opt into this challenge by picking up a pair of flags at the main event area. The Union City Youth Commission will be spread out at select locations along the race trail dressed as Zombies, and they will be out to get your flag. Those who finish the race with at least 1 flag left on their hip will be entered into a special raffle to win a cool Halloween themed prize.

A limited amount of race shirts will be available on the day of the race. Make sure to get there on time to purchase.

* All pre-registrations for the race will be closed on October 18 by 4:30pm, however, we will be taking walk-up registrations on the day of the race starting at 8am October 19. Please come early! The race will go on rain or shine! 

Race Shirts

Race Shirts are not included in the registration fee. Race shirts can be purchase as a add on by September 27, 2024. 

Rain or Shine:

This race takes place rain or shine, make sure to dress for the weather conditions!

name: The Village's Sixth Annual Miles for Mamas Walk/Run-Santa Monica
description:
Join us for The Village's SIXTH Annual Miles for Mamas Walk/Run! 

Join our main event location in Santa Monica, California, OR participate on your own with friends in your own community by registering virtually.

All proceeds help new and expecting moms with limited means!  Ask your friends and family to sponsor your race.   Prizes for the top fundraising individuals will be awarded at the finish line.  

Run or walk-you choose!  A one mile walk in solidarity or a an unofficial 5k-we've mapped out the route for you!

Set up your fundraising goal now (we suggest $300) and create a unique URL to send to everyone you know.

Let them know you are WALKING THE WALK for moms in need.

Santa Monica event begins and ends at North Street Playground off of Highway 1! (West side of the highway)

Virtual event begins wherever you are!

More details will be provided closer to the event via email.  We can't wait to to walk the walk for moms in need with you!

name: The Wascally Wabbit Trail Race
description:
Formerly known as the Wascally Wabbit Half Mawothon, we've taken this race to the trails, on the Finegold Creek Preserve, operated and managed by the Sierra Foothill Conservancy. 

Feel the sense of satisfaction when you complete this race knowing that you've also helped a great cause. All race proceeds go to Kids Kasa Foster Care to help college-bound former foster children & Sierra Foothill Conservancy. With your support we have helped many former foster children attend higher education at a community college, four year university, or trade school.

Kids Kasa Foster Care Inc. was started in 2004 and is a non-profit 501-(c)-3 which has always worked toward helping children reunify with their families.  

About the Venue

The Austin and Mary Ewell Preserve at Fine Gold Creek was acquired by SFC in 2008. It protects 718 acres of land and one and one half miles of lower Fine Gold Creek starting where it flows into Millerton Lake. Like most foothill streams Fine Gold does not flow in the summer, but it does maintain several large pools of water even in the hottest months.

History
The Preserve was established with funding from Mr. Ben Ewell and family, the Pacific Gas and Electric Company, the Bureau of Reclamation, and the Wildlife Conservation Board (part of the California Department of Fish and Game).

Habitat
In addition to the riparian vegetation along the creek, the Fine Gold Preserve protects Valley Elderberry Longhorn Beetles, Western Pond Turtles, and one of the few southern Sierra populations of the Dutchman’s Pipe Vine Swallowtail butterfly.

Directions to the Austin and Mary Ewell Preserve at Fine Gold Creek
From Fresno, take Highway 41 north. 11 miles from the Friant on-ramp turn right on Highway 145. Go 3.3 miles to the first stop sign; keep going straight as Highway 145 becomes Road 211. Go 3.7 miles from stop sign; turn right onto Road 210. Go 2.5 miles; stay to the right on the  paved road, which becomes Road 216. Go .5 miles; you will see  a double-wide gate on the left. You will arrive at the race venue. Driving time is about 25 minutes from the Friant/Highway 41 on-ramp.

name: The Wild Turkey
description:
🏃‍♀️🏃‍♂️🌳 Join us for a Heartwarming Thanksgiving Trail Race Benefiting Folsom's Hope! 🌳🏃‍♂️🏃‍♀️

Gather your loved ones and lace up your running shoes because this Thanksgiving morning is about to get even more special! We invite your entire family to come together for a memorable experience at the WILD TURKEY 5k & 10k Trail Race. It's a chance to embrace the spirit of gratitude while supporting a wonderful cause that uplifts our community.

🗓️ Date: Thanksgiving Day, November 28, 2024
🕖 Time: Race starts at 9:00 AM for the 10k, and 9:15am for the 5k
📍 Location: Beals Point
🎗️ Beneficiary: Folsom's Hope

🌟 What to Expect 🌟

🍂 Breathtaking Trails: Immerse yourself in the beauty of nature as you traverse through Folsom Lake's picturesque trails. The crisp air and stunning scenery will make this a race to remember.

🏅 Distances for All: Whether you're a seasoned runner aiming for a personal best or a family looking to enjoy a leisurely walk, we have options for everyone. Choose between the 5k and 10k distances and conquer the trail at your own pace.

Free 1k Kids Run - Registration for this is 100% fee, you can pay for a tshirt, but it is not necessary. Kids fun run begins at 10:30am.
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Family Fun: Thanksgiving is all about togetherness, and what better way to celebrate than by sharing this experience with your family? From little ones to grandparents, everyone is welcome to participate. Strollers (5k) and furry friends on leashes are also invited!

🤝 Giving Back: By joining this event, you're not only promoting an active lifestyle but also supporting Folsom's Hope, a local organization dedicated to creating brighter futures for children and families in need. Your participation and any donations will make a real difference in the lives of those less in need.

🎉 Post-Race Celebration: After you've crossed the finish line, enjoy a heartwarming post-race celebration with refreshments, music, and the company of fellow participants. It's a chance to share stories, relish the achievements, and reflect on the true meaning of Thanksgiving.

🎉 Register Today! 🎉

Don't miss this unique opportunity to give thanks for the blessings in your life while supporting Folsom's Hope's mission.

Whether you're a seasoned runner or simply looking for a delightful family activity, the Folsom's Hope 5k & 10k Trail Race on Thanksgiving morning is the perfect way to kick off your day of gratitude. We can't wait to see you there, ready to run, walk, and make a positive impact together! 🦃🍂🏃‍♀️🏃‍♂️

name: Thrive San Diego Half Marathon & 5K
description:
The Kaiser Permanente Thrive Half Marathon & 5K returns for its 9th year!

We’re excited to THRIVE with you on Saturday, November 1, 2025! More than just a race, it’s an invitation for the entire San Diego community to “Thrive” together—staying active, eating healthy, living well, and giving back. All courses start and finish at Ski Beach in Mission Bay, offering fast, flat stretches with beautiful Mission Bay views and refreshing ocean breezes.

 
Half Marathon: 
  • Start Time: 7:15AM
  • Experience 13.1 miles of scenic San Diego beauty on a loop course that starts on Ingraham Street, winds along Mission Bay, and finishes at Ski Beach. Enjoy fast, flat stretches, picturesque bay views, and refreshing ocean breezes as you chase your personal best.
  • Go to thrivehalfmarathon.com/halfmarathon/ for more information.

 

Half Marathon Relay:
  • Start Time: 7:15AM
  • Take on the Half Marathon Relay with a partner and split the challenge of 13.1 miles! Each runner will cover approximately 6.5 miles before handing off the "baton" to your teammate at Telecote Shores. This scenic route along Crown Point starts on Ingraham St and finishes at Ski Beach in Mission Bay, featuring fast, flat stretches, breathtaking bay views, and refreshing ocean breezes.
  • For more information go to thrivehalfmarathon.com/halfmarathon-relay/.
 
5K:
  • Start Time: 7:30AM
  • The 5K is a scenic loop route along Crown Point that starts on Ingraham St and finishes at Ski Beach in Mission Bay.
  • For more information go to thrivehalfmarathon.com/5k/.
 
Entry Includes:
  • Exclusive Performance Tech Long Sleeve (Half Marathon & Half Marathon Relay) 
  • Official Thrive Short Sleeve Tech Tee (5K)
  • Racer Bib
  • Finisher Medal Unique to Each Distance
  • Chip Race Timing
  • Live Finish Results and Rankings
  • Award Winner Prizes
  • Overall & Age Group Awards
  • Access to Thrive Expo
 

Virtual Runners:
  • For runners who can’t make it to San Diego but still want to participate and benefit Make-A-Wish San Diego! Complete your distance anytime during race week and post your results to the virtual leaderboard.
  • For more information go to thrivehalfmarathon.com/virtual-runners/

 

Charity:

Run to benefit Make-A-Wish® San Diego! Join us in granting wishes for children diagnosed with critical illnesses. Donate today to show your support for Make-A-Wish® San Diego on Race Day.

 

For more information on Make-A-Wish San Diego, visit thrivehalfmarathon.com/charity/.

name: Tim & Jeannie Hamann Foundation Benicia Hand Up Turkey Trot
description:
Join us for the 9th Annual Benicia Hand Up Turkey Trot
                                            Benefiting The Tim & Jeannie Hamann Foundation


                                                            www.hamannfoundation.org


                              Giving A Hand Up To Patients Along Their Journey Fighting Cancer…


Since the inception of The Tim & Jeannie Hamann Foundation in 2014, the Foundation has granted over $1.5M to patients giving a HAND UP with rent and mortgage payments, gas & groceries, medical expenses, utility payments and other needs. The form of support is direct to the patients’ needs to help make a difference along their personal journey fighting cancer. The Tim & Jeannie Hamann Foundation continues to grow each year. This is the 9th Annual Benicia Hand Up Turkey Trot and we have various fundraising events throughout the year.


                                                                  Thanksgiving Day

name: Toddler Tuesday: Patrol Puppies and Firehouse Friends
description: Join us for a fun-filled morning designed just for little ones! Toddlers will get to meet a famous firefighter pup and explore a real firetruck up close. Kids can crawl, climb, and play on soft play mats and building blocks, making it the perfect mix of adventure and safe playtime.

name: Torrance Memorial Medical Center, BRA Run, Los Angeles
description:
Day of Event Schedule

Our 14th Annual 5K & 13K are held on a fully paved course next to the sand in Playa Del Rey on August 30th, 2026

5:15am: Parking Lots Open (LA County charges $13, bring cash). The line backs up so arrive early. 

6:15am: Registration and Vendor Booths Open

6:30am: Bike Tour Starts 

7:05am: Costume Contests

7:16am: National Anthem 🇺🇸

7:30am: 13K start (2 hour time limit, 15 min per mile pace or faster)

7:50am: 5K start

9:30am: Kids Run starts (time is approximate and depends on when the last 13K walkers are clear of the kids run course)

9:45am: Awards Ceremony

Share your photos on social media! We are @brarunla and @runmercury and our official hashtag is #brarunla. We will be resharing your posts all week post-race!


Charity

In its 14th year, The BRA Run supports Evelyn’s BFF, a charity that helps breast cancer survivors get back to their new normal while supporting counseling, reconstruction, and other items that people are often not able to get covered by their insurance. Most of our grant recipients have bills going into 6 figures! This event is the biggest fundraiser for this all volunteer organization and determines how many people they can help this year.

Evelyn, the founder of the Evelyn's Breast Friends Forever (BFF), a 501(c)3 non-profit public benefit charity foundation, started this event in 2013 and in her honor we have a 5K and a 13K at the BRA Run.

Join us for Evelyn's party so we all can help other breast cancer survivors and their families. Our event spreads awareness of breast cancer reconstruction to the community by encouraging men and women to run and walk in their BRA (Breast Reconstruction Awareness) in honor and in memory of those who have been diagnosed with breast cancer.

Donate to Evelyn's BFF.

Make it a Virtual Run/Walk

Can't make it in person but want to be a part of the event and support breast cancer survivors? Sign up for the virtual run and we will mail you a bib, shirt and medal.


Location

12000 Vista Del Mar
Dockweiler Beach
Playa Del Rey, CA US 90293

description:
The 2025 CMSAF Binnicker Memorial Run at Travis AFB will take place on Friday, October 24, 2025, at 0800 at Twin Peaks Chapel. Join AFSA Chapter 1320 for a 9K Run. The first 25 registrants will receive an official race shirt and challenge coin.

Packet Pickup is October 23, 2025, 511 Travis Ave, Travis AFB.

It's about much more than running. 

Supporting "Care for Alzheimer's"
The CMSAF Binnicker Memorial Run hosted by AFSA Chapter 1320 will benefit the memory care wing at Air Force Enlisted Village's assisted living residence, Hawthorn House, where military widows, retirees, veterans, and their family members with Alzheimer’s and dementia reside. Every dollar raised from this event will provide care and support for the residents there.

Go the Extra Mile
Go the extra mile by creating a fundraiser in conjunction with your run or walk. We call it the Extra Mile Challenge, and we’ll reward the top fundraisers. 

Race for FREE
Commit to fundraising $109 for the Air Force Enlisted Village, and we’ll refund you up to your registration costs.

Every dollar you raise will provide care and support for military widows, retirees, veterans, and their family members who live on our memory care wing at the Air Force Enlisted Village’s assisted living residence, Hawthorn House.

Event History
The inaugural CMSAF James C. Binnicker Memorial 9K was held in August of 2015 at Bob Hope Village in Shalimar, Florida. The idea for the event was suggested by Airmen from nearby Eglin AFB who were participating in the Air Force Marathon. The Airmen wanted to honor CMSAF Binnicker while training for their upcoming marathon. Since CMSAF Binnicker served as the 9th Chief Master Sergeant of the Air Force, it was only fitting the event was a 9K run.

About CMSAF Binnicker
CMSAF#9 James C. Binnicker served as the Air Force Enlisted Village's President and CEO from 2000 to 2015. Binnicker believed the residents should be treated with respect and dignity. He created The Mom Rule which all employees use to this day in working with residents or making decisions for residents. Binnicker's vision brought many additions to the Bob Hope Village campus to include the Garden of Hope, the Bob Gates Welcome Center, and Hawthorn House, an assisted living residence with an option for memory care for residents with Alzheimer's and dementia. Binnicker served as the 9th Chief Master Sergeant of the United States Air Force from 1986 to 1990. Read more about Binnicker HERE.

description:

name: Trunk or Treat
description:
Trunk or treat involves a community coming together so that children can trick or treat in a safe environment. Little monsters, witches, ghosts, princesses, superheroes, and other characters are invited to trick or treat trunk-to-trunk at NAB's annual Trunk-or-Treat! Families and commands are encouraged to bring their vehicles and decorate open trunks for costumed kids to visit for sweet treats and spooky snacks. Family and children participants will participate in Halloween costume contests, dancing, and music!

PLEASE ONLY REGISTER CHILDREN UNDER THE AGE OF 17 YEARS.

We are challenging you decorate your car’s trunk with the best Halloween themed display for our military kids. The best family decorated trunk and best command decorated trunks will receive trophies.

Hosting trunks must provide enough candy for 1500 children.

Why is there a cost this year? Due to recent government policies, we are no longer permitted to hold free events that include giveaways. However, children who are registered will receive Halloween bags, trick or treat candy, and zombie caricature art to take home. Additionally, winners of the costume contests will receive festive Boo Buckets filled with gifts as prizes. We hope this provides the clarification you were looking for.

name: Tulare Santa Fe Trail-A-Thon 5k
description:
Get ready to join the community for the 23rd annual Tulare Santa Fe Trail-A-Thon 5k, hosted by the Tulare Sunrise Rotary Club! This fun and impactful event supports the club’s High School Scholarship Program, which in 2024 awarded a $5,000 4 year college and a $1,500 trade school scholarship to two Tulare High School seniors. 

Event Details:

Date & Location: The race begins and ends at Live Oak Park, Tulare, offering a scenic route and plenty of space to enjoy the day.

 

Time: Onsite registration and bib pickup will run from 8:00 am to 8:45 am, with the race starting promptly at 9am.

 

Registration: This year we are charging a registration fee of $15 per participant. This fee helps cover the costs of the finisher and winner medals and the timing system costs. We will also accept donations this year.

Awards and Prizes:

Finisher Medal: All finishers will receive a commemorative medal and lanyard and Rotary participant pin.

 

Age Group Awards: Medals will be awarded to top finishers in each age group: 9 & Under, 10-14, 15-19, 20-29, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, 60+ (Male and Female).

 

Fastest Runner Awards: The top male and female runners will each receive a special trophy and $100 gift card!


Sponsor Opportunities:

Want to help make a difference in the lives of local students? Consider becoming a sponsor! Contact Matthew Hamilton at matt@hamiltonmarketing or Petrus Tjandra at ptjandra@aol.com for more information.

 

Join us for a memorable morning on the Santa Fe Trail as we come together to support education and enjoy some friendly competition. See you on race day!

name: Tule River Parkway 5K Walk Run
description:
5K walk run starting on the extended section of the Tule River Parkway. The route starts at Fallen Hero’s Park near Plano Street and the turnaround is west of the Native Plant Gardens section. The event is for both the runner who wants informal timing and individuals and families who just want to run or walk for health and fun. Fallen Hero’s Park is a popular location featuring picnic tables, a jungle gym, slides, and swings, plus a basketball court and a splash pad. Come and enjoy the new connections created by the improvements to the City of Porterville trail system. This event benefits the Tule River Parkway Association, a local environmental nonprofit whose mission is to enhance and restore the river habitat and improve public access to the river corridor. Please consider an additional donation to TRPA as you register for this race.

Tee shirts are available for purchase on an external site. Please be sure to come back and finish your registration for the run. 

https://www.awakeskateshop.com/trp

name: Tunnel to Towers 5K Run & Walk - Los Angeles, CA
description:
Place, Date, and Time


November 9th, 2025

8:30 am - Opening Ceremony

9:00 am - Race Start Time

Woodley Park

6350 Woodley Ave - Section 1

Van Nuys, CA 91436

__________________________________

Description

 

What is a Tunnel to Towers 5K Run & Walk?
The Tunnel to Towers Run & Walk Series was created to honor the heroic life and death of Stephen Siller, a New York City firefighter (FDNY) who lost his life on September 11, 2001 after strapping on his gear and running through the Brooklyn Battery Tunnel to the Twin Towers. The Tunnel to Towers Foundation supports the families of catastrophically wounded and killed first responders and veterans through their Fallen First Responder and Gold Star Family programs, which provides mortgage free homes and smart homes to these families in need. In 2021, the Foundation sought out to eradicate the issue of homelessness within our veteran community by providing housing and support to any veteran experiencing homelessness. For more information on the Tunnel to Towers Foundation, please visit www.t2t.org.

This will be our 1st Annual Tunnel to Towers 5K Run & Walk in Indianapolis and we are excited to grow the community’s commitment  to honor first responders, remember 9/11, and raise funds for the Tunnel to Towers Foundation.

 


How far is a Tunnel to Towers 5K Run, Walk, & Climb – Los Angeles?
This is a 5K (3.1 miles). You are welcome to walk or run this event.

 

What is the best time to register?
The best time to register is always RIGHT NOW. Registration is tied to a price tiering system where the price increases occur one week after the opening of registration, one month before the event, and on race day. 

 

What is the age limit?
There is no age limit. All are welcome!

 

Is there parking available?
Please carpool if you can, and parking is available in the lots around Woodley Park.  

 

Where can I pick up my packet?
We will have early packet pick-up at a site and place TBD and announced closer to the event. Additionally, packet pickup will be available on event day morning.

 

Can someone else pick up my packet for me?
Yes, they can.

 

Do I have to wear my bib number?
Yes, please display your bib on the front of your outermost garment. Those who run without a bib will be asked to leave the course and will not be allowed to finish.

 

I am a fast runner. Can I get a front line position?
Runners predicting a faster pace may make their way to the front of the line, based on space availability (hint: arrive early!).

 

Will the Event be timed?
Yes, the event will be timed. You are also more than welcome to use a smartphone, or watch to keep up with your own time.
